jobs.title: Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT Utrecht & Haarlem - Jobbird.com
jobs.description:
Werk aan innovatieve IT-oplossingen die Nederland in beweging houden. Maak impact, groei mee en bouw aan de digitale toekomst van NS.

Jij zorgt voor de mobiliteit van Nederland
Veel ontwikkel-mogelijkheden
Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden

Daarom wil je als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT bij NS werken

Je werkt aan technologie die direct bijdraagt aan betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig treinvervoer.
Je ontwikkelt en verbetert een bedrijfskritisch MES-platform op het snijvlak van IT, OT, techniek en productie.
Je krijgt veel ruimte om slimme oplossingen te ontwerpen voor de modernisering van onze treinen in Haarlem, dicht op de operatie.

Dit ga je doen als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT

Als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT bij NS werk je aan het Manufacturing Execution System (MES) binnen NS Treinmodernisering in Haarlem. Dit bedrijfskritische platform, gebaseerd op AspenTech, ondersteunt de productie- en onderhoudsprocessen waarmee treinen worden gemoderniseerd. Daarmee heeft jouw werk direct impact op de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van onze treinen.

Deze functie is anders dan een klassieke fullstack ontwikkelaarsrol. Je werkt niet alleen aan software, maar ook aan configuratie, integraties, procesontwerp en technische continuïteit binnen een operationele productieomgeving. Je schakelt met operators, productieondersteuning, functioneel beheerders, ontwikkelaars en andere collega’s om gebruikersvragen te vertalen naar robuuste technische oplossingen.

Je ontwikkelt nieuwe functionaliteiten, verbetert bestaande oplossingen en helpt verstoringen structureel op te lossen. Daarbij werk je met onder andere SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en MES-processen. Je denkt mee over de technische roadmap, migraties, beveiliging en de toekomst van het MES-landschap. Zo bouw je mee aan een platform dat belangrijk is voor de modernisering van treinen én voor de dagelijkse operatie in de fabriek.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

Je ontwikkelt, configureert en onderhoudt oplossingen binnen het AspenTech MES-platform.
Je vertaalt productie- en onderhoudsprocessen naar robuuste, schaalbare en praktisch toepasbare technische ontwerpen.
Je werkt aan nieuwe functionaliteiten, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en optimalisaties binnen het MES-landschap.
Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken en lost technische verstoringen structureel op, soms direct in contact met de fabriek.
Je neemt een leidende rol in technische ontwerpkeuzes en bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en veiligheid van oplossingen.
Je werkt nauw samen met functioneel beheerders, een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers zoals operators en productieondersteuning.
Je denkt mee over technische migraties, contracten, beveiliging en toekomstige ontwikkelingen op de roadmap van het MES-platform.
Je ondersteunt bij releases, migraties en technische verbetertrajecten.
Je deelt kennis binnen het team en helpt collega’s technisch verder, zodat de afhankelijkheid van enkele kennishouders kleiner wordt.

Hier ga je werken

Je komt terecht in het MES-team binnen NS Treinmodernisering in Haarlem. Hier worden treinen vernieuwd, verbeterd en toekomstbestendig gemaakt. Binnen die omgeving speelt digitalisering een steeds grotere rol. Het MES-platform ondersteunt collega’s op de werkvloer bij productie- en onderhoudsprocessen en vormt daarmee een belangrijke schakel tussen IT, OT en de dagelijkse operatie.

Het team bestaat uit een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars, een technisch applicatiebeheerder en een functioneel beheerder. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat het MES-platform stabiel blijft draaien én meegroeit met de behoefte van de fabriek. Je werkt in een omgeving waar techniek, softwareontwikkeling en productie samenkomen. Dat vraagt om nauwkeurigheid, eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de rust om ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag werk je aan een strategische verbetering van het platform, de andere dag help je een verstoring oplossen die direct impact heeft op de productie. Juist die combinatie van IT, techniek en operatie maakt deze functie interessant voor een ontwikkelaar die graag dicht bij de praktijk werkt.

Dit zijn de functie-eisen

Je bent een ervaren IT-professional of softwareontwikkelaar die technische diepgang combineert met een praktische aanpak. Je vindt het interessant om complexe systemen te doorgronden en krijgt energie van het slimmer maken van productieprocessen. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, denkt goed na over je aanpak en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen.

Verder herken je jezelf in het volgende:

Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van technische informatica, software engineering, industriële automatisering of vergelijkbaar.
Je hebt ruime ervaring als software engineer, systems engineer, IT engineer of ontwikkelaar binnen complexe en bedrijfskritische IT-landschappen.
Je hebt ervaring met of aantoonbare affiniteit met MES-systemen, productieomgevingen en industriële automatisering.
Ervaring met AspenTech MES, ASM of vergelijkbare MES-platformen is een sterke pré.
Je hebt goede kennis van SQL, databases en systeemintegraties.
Je hebt ervaring met JavaScript, TypeScript en bij voorkeur enige kennis van .NET.
Je hebt ervaring met API’s, koppelingen, data-integraties en technische architecturen.
Je kunt zelfstandig verstoringen analyseren, prioriteiten bepalen en tot een structurele oplossing komen.
Je communiceert duidelijk en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen, van ontwikkelaars tot gebruikers op de werkvloer.
Je bent stressbestendig, verandergericht en zelfbewust: je blijft rustig bij onverwachte situaties en durft keuzes te maken met oog voor kwaliteit en samenwerking.

Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de dynamische wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. En als één van de mooiste werkgevers van Nederland hebben we nog meer te bieden. Voor deze functie onder meer:

Een salaris tussen € 3.743,- en € 6.491,- bruto per maand op basis van schaal 60 en een 36-urige werkweek. Je inschaling is afhankelijk van je werkervaring.
De mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en flexibele werktijden, in overleg.
Een 36-urige werkweek.
3% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantietoeslag en een uitstekende pensioenregeling.
Bij goed functioneren krijg je na een jaar een vast contract.
Gratis treinreizen in de 2e klas. Reizen in de 1e klas kan tegen een kleine eigen bijdrage.
Je gezin reist gratis mee in de daluren.
144 uur wettelijk verlof op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, plus extra verlof afhankelijk van je leeftijd. Dit is minimaal een week.
De mogelijkheid om 3 christelijke feestdagen om te ruilen voor 3 niet-christelijke feestdagen.
Korting op Europese treinreizen zodra je 1 jaar bij NS werkt.
Een keuzeplan met onder andere een fietsenplan, extra pensioenopbouw of extra vakantiedagen.

Wil je meer weten? Bekijk dan onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en cao.

Solliciteren naar deze baan

Wil jij als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT werken aan software, integraties en productieprocessen die direct bijdragen aan de modernisering van treinen? Solliciteer dan direct via de sollicitatiebutton. Binnen enkele minuten ontvang je een automatische sollicitatiebevestiging. Binnen 2 weken reageren wij op jouw sollicitatie.

In onze werving nemen we bij NS ook Learning Agility mee, omdat we het belangrijk vinden om niet alleen te kijken naar wat je al kunt, maar ook naar hoe je leert, ontwikkelt en meebeweegt met verandering. Zo maken we samen een duurzame match.

Je kunt je sollicitatie richten aan Jeroen van den Berg, Corporate Recruiter IT.

Heb je nog vragen over het sollicitatieproces?
Mail dan naar Karin van onze frontoffice via . Heb je liever telefonisch contact? Bel dan met onze frontoffice op 088-6713666.

Goed om te weten

Een achtergrondonderzoek, waaronder een VOG (Verklaring omtrent Gedrag), maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure. Dit omvat ook het tekenen van een integriteitsverklaring en geheimhoudingsverklaring.
We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen die bij ons werkt zich thuis voelt. Dit zie je terug in ons aannamebeleid. Lees hier meer.
Met deze vacature werven wij zelf onze nieuwe collega. Dit is géén oproep voor acquisitie. De functie kan niet op interim basis worden vervuld. Bekijk daarvoor onze inhuurpagina.

Op NS kun je rekenen

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid. Powered by our deep-rooted entrepreneurial spirit, proprietary tech, curiosity and our incredible people, we’re accelerating - delivering best in class technology, the ultimate holiday app, and experiences that keep our customers coming back for more.

Ready to build the future of travel with us?

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend), you’ll design and build scalable applications, services and platforms across On the Beach.

This is a full-stack engineering position with a stronger emphasis on backend engineering, distributed systems and cloud-native architecture.

Our backend engineers solve a wide variety of problems. You could be working on systems responsible for communicating with external travel suppliers, processing large volumes of hotel inventory and pricing information, powering customer search experiences, or ensuring bookings move reliably through complex transactional workflows.

You’ll work across the development lifecycle and collaborate with engineers, product managers and other technical specialists to design, build, deploy and operate reliable software at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing Day To Day

Designing and building scalable backend applications and services
Developing APIs used by customer-facing applications and internal systems
Integrating with external suppliers and third-party platforms
Building systems that process high volumes of requests and data
Designing distributed and event-driven architectures
Working with asynchronous messaging and streaming technologies
Solving problems around performance, latency, resilience and availability
Improving caching and data-access strategies
Building reliable transactional workflows
Developing applications and services within AWS
Deploying and operating containerised applications
Improving monitoring, alerting and observability
Exploring AI-assisted engineering and modern development tooling

At Senior level, you’ll be expected to understand the wider system rather than only the individual service you are working on.

You should be comfortable considering how systems behave in production, identifying failure scenarios and balancing scalability, resilience, maintainability and delivery speed.

We’re looking for strong full-stack engineers whose experience leans towards backend and platform engineering.

You’ll be a great addition to our team if you have the following skills, knowledge and experience

Strong commercial backend software engineering
C# and .NET or comparable experience building modern backend applications
Designing and developing APIs
Building distributed systems and service-oriented architectures
Developing cloud-native applications, ideally within AWS
Working with messaging, asynchronous processing or event-driven architecture
Designing reliable integrations with external or internal systems
SQL and/or NoSQL data stores
Building scalable systems handling significant traffic or data volumes
Performance optimisation, caching and latency reduction
Designing for resilience and failure
Containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Observability, monitoring and operating production systems
Automated testing and modern engineering practices

We don’t expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and evidence of solving comparable problems at scale are more important than matching every individual tool.

What We’re Looking For At Senior Level

Beyond the technologies themselves, we’re looking for someone who:

Can independently solve complex engineering problems
Thinks about the customer and commercial impact of technical decisions
Understands the trade-offs between speed, quality and long-term maintainability
Can contribute meaningfully to technical and architectural discussions
Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues
Raises engineering standards through collaboration rather than hierarchy
Helps less experienced engineers develop
Is comfortable working in an environment where priorities and problems can change quickly

What To Expect From Our Interview Process

After a call with our Talent Acquisition Team, We will run a 3 stage interview process all on Microsoft Teams, Which will consist of:

Hiring Manager meet & greet - 30 Minutes

Behavioural & ways of working - 60 Minutes

Tech Pairing & System Design - 120 Minutes, broken down into two parts (50 minutes each) with a short break and time for your questions at the end.

We want to make sure everybody has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the interview process please let the Talent Acquisition team know and they will be happy to assist.

Ways of working

Our full time hours are 37.5 per week, but we don't have rigid working hours so you can find the working pattern that's right for you. We have core working hours between 10am - 4pm, so we can collaborate and enjoy the social side of work.

We also have hybrid working so we all work from home and from our Aeroworks office in Manchester City Centre. We operate a remote-first working model, with colleagues meeting in our Manchester office one day every two weeks. Please note that all applicants must be eligible to work full-time in the UK

Our Benefits

We might be biased but we think our colleagues are pretty great. They're the people that have made On the Beach what it is today and continue to make it vibrant and successful tomorrow. That's why we offer a competitive benefits package, known as our Beach Perks, to all On the Beach colleagues.

These Include

25 days holiday plus your birthday off
Generous discount on holidays, plus you will receive 2 extra days annual leave on top of your holiday allowance to use whilst you're away on your On the Beach package holiday
Access to Learnerbly learning platform, plus workshops, courses and professional qualifications
Enhanced maternity, paternity, shared parental leave and adoption pay, plus other family friendly support

We're On the Beach! One of the UK's largest online package holiday specialists, with significant opportunities for growth.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, product, operations, and support teams to ensure architectural alignment and successful delivery across relevant product and platform areas.
Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive architectural documentation that is clear, concise, and accessible to all relevant stakeholders.
Continuous Learning: Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies, applying this knowledge to enhance our software architecture.
Risk Management: Identify and document potential risks in the architecture, providing strategies to mitigate them effectively.

10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and evolving complex software architectures across multiple domains.
Proven ability to deliver hands-on, real-world solutions, actively supporting implementation, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making.
Strong understanding of designing enterprise-grade systems that are scalable, secure, cost-conscious, and maintainable.
Strong expertise in at least one modern back-end programming language, such as C#, Java, or C++, with the ability and willingness to learn new technologies as needed.
Solid experience with data systems, including SQL and NoSQL databases, data modelling, performance considerations, and operational behaviour at scale.

Regular hands-on use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or comparable tools, with an understanding of how to use them effectively in real engineering workflows.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex architectural concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong understanding of distributed systems, multi-platform development, non-functional requirements, and requirements engineering.
Ability to document complex technical systems and concepts in a structured, accessible, and standardized manner.
A pragmatic, outcome-focused mindset that balances technical excellence with business needs and delivery timelines.

What We Offer

Great compensation and benefits packages including company achievement bonus and regular salary reviews
Premiums for the private pension plan (BAV) up to the maximum amount are topped up by TeamViewer
Public transport friendly offices

TeamViewer is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building an inclusive culture where everyone feels welcome and supported. We C-A-R-E and understand that our diverse, values-driven culture makes us stronger. This is a high-agency role where you’ll lead technical decisions, ship fast, and directly impact how billions in capital are allocated globally.

London, UK

Why this role is remarkable

You are the first engineering hire, granting you total ownership over the technical roadmap and a direct path to leadership as the team scales.
The company is backed by founders who have built and sold eight-figure businesses and is supported by the Investment Association's SPARKS accelerator.
You will work with a cutting-edge stack including Next.js 16, React 19, and advanced LLM integrations using Gemini and Azure OpenAI to solve complex data problems.

What You Will Do

Build and manage a robust multi-tenant infrastructure on Azure, including deployment pipelines, observability, and tenant-specific isolation using PostgreSQL Row-Level Security.
Architect and iterate on the core data asset, normalizing disparate global datasets to create predictive signals for fund allocators across Europe and North America.
Collaborate directly with design partners at FCA-regulated firms to translate feedback into production-ready modules, shipping changes from development to users within hours.

The ideal candidate

You have 5+ years of experience shipping production software with significant depth in PostgreSQL, including schema design, performance tuning, and migrations against live data.
You possess 3+ years of professional TypeScript experience, using the type system as a design tool to handle complex data boundaries and LLM outputs.
You are a high-agency builder who has previously owned products end-to-end in small, fast-paced startup environments and is ready to set the architectural vision.

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

jobs.title: DevOps Architect
jobs.description:
Er du klar for å bygge Azure -plattformer som faktisk havner i produksjon, ikke bare i PowerPoint?  
Vil du bli del av et fagmiljø som deler kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess – og som liker folk som både kan kode, forklare og utfordre?  
Vil du jobbe i Oslo hos en global Microsoft-partner, med lokale kollegaer, store kunder og prosjekter som sjelden er små?  

Vi har skrevet stillingen som kode. Nå mangler vi bare deg som kjører apply .

resource " devops_arkitekt " "softwareone" {  
  location = "Oslo" # men magien skjer hos kunden  
  language = [  
    " norsk ", # ( flytende )  
    " engelsk "  
  ]  
  security_clearance = " må-kunne-oppnås "  
  stack              = [  
    "Azure",  
    "Terraform",  
    "Bicep",  
    "Kubernetes/ containere "  
  ]  
  cost_conscious      = true  
}  

Terraform vil utføre følgende handlinger:  

# devops_arkitekt.softwareone vil bli opprettet  
+ ansettelse  

Plan: 1 å legge til, 0 å endre, 0 å ødelegge.  

Vil du utføre disse handlingene?  
Skriv 'ja' for å bekrefte. ▊  
Hvorfor akkurat denne rollen ?

De fleste arkitektroller ender opp i PowerPoint. Denne ender i produksjon.  
Som DevOps Arkitekt hos oss sitter du ikke og tegner mållandskap for et selskap du aldri møter. Du sitter hos kunden, der kompleksiteten faktisk bor, der legacy -systemet ingen tør å røre står ved siden av landingssonen dere skal bygge. Du får eierskapet fra første workshop til siste pipeline-kjøring.  
Og du gjør det uten å brenne kundens budsjett. Vi mener at god arkitektur er billigere enn dårlig arkitektur, og vi ser etter deg som klarer å forsvare en teknisk beslutning både overfor en utvikler og en økonomidirektør, i samme møte.  
L urer du på hvorfor selskaps navnet ikke klinger helt: mye av miljøet du kommer inn i, er det du kjenner som Crayon. Vi er nå SoftwareOne – samme fagfolk, samme kunder, større ryggdekning.  
Og internt er det høyt under taket. Stor tillit, kort vei til beslutninger, og et team som deler kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess. Du får rom til å utvikle deg i den retningen du selv vil.  
Dette blir hverdagen din

Designe og bygge infrastruktur i Azure ,  landingssoner, nettverk, sikkerhet og styring – etter beste praksis, ikke etter vane  

Skrive infrastruktur som kode i Terraform og/eller Bicep , slik at det som funker i dag også funker om to år og tre konsulenter  

Kjøre containerbaserte plattformer på Kubernetes , eller ta steget dit sammen med kunden  

Være kundens tekniske og strategiske motpart – den som sier «det der bør vi ikke gjøre», og som blir hørt  

Holde workshops og dele kunnskap med både teknikere og folk som ikke vet hva en YAML-fil er, og ikke burde måtte vite det  

Bruke KI aktivt i eget arbeid, og være nysgjerrig på hvordan det endrer måten vi leverer på

Vi tror du kjenner deg igjen i minst tre av disse

Du har konsulent- og prosjekterfaring, og trives best når du er ute hos kunden.  

Du kan Azure godt, og har erfaring med IaC – Terraform, Bicep eller begge.  

Du har jobbet med Kubernetes , eller i det minste containere, og vet hvorfor det ikke alltid er svaret.  

Du tenker kostnad og verdi før du tenker teknologi.  

Du har en gang skrevet « temporary fix » i en kommentar som fortsatt står i produksjon. Vi dømmer ikke. Vi har alle vært der.  

Erfaring fra AWS, GCP eller OVH Cloud er en fin bonus, vi jobber teknologiuavhengig.  

Job Requirements
H va du får igje n?

Et fagmiljø som faktisk deler – kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess. Sertifiseringer og kurs. Tett oppfølging fra din leder, med retning i egen utvikling.  
Naprapat på huset, og forsikrings- og pensjonsordning  

Rabatter på blant annet SATS, Ruter og Visma-biblioteket  

Dekket mobil og internett  

Rekrutteringsbonus når du henter inn en god kollega  

Nye lokaler med kantine, innendørs sykkelparkering og verksted, garderober, shuffleboard og eget hvilerom  

Hovedsponsor for Vålerenga Ishockey: trening på Jordal Amfi og tilgang til VIP-losje på Jordal  

Stay Social , Stay Professional og Stay Active – tre interne grupper som sørger for at året består av mer enn sprinter  

Om SoftwareOne

Vi er verdens største Microsoft-partner. Det betyr ikke så mye i seg selv, men det betyr at når du sitter hos en kunde og trenger å vite hvor Microsoft faktisk er på vei, så finnes svaret et sted i huset. Og at prosjektene som kommer inn døra sjelden er de små.  
Det betyr også bredde. Vi jobber på tvers av lisens, sky, sikkerhet og applikasjoner, så teknologivalgene du anbefaler kan følges hele veien, ikke bare til neste fakturagrense. Du får jobbe med kunder i mange bransjer, fra virksomheter som tar sine første steg i Azure til de som har levd der lenge nok til å ha samlet på teknisk gjeld.  
Klar for å kjøre apply ?

Send søknad. Vi lover å svare fortere enn en cold start på en Kubernetes -node en mandag morgen.  
Ingen ressurser vil bli ødelagt i prosessen.  
Company description

SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

jobs.title: Senior Support Analyst (API & Cloud)
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

OneTrust is looking for a Senior Support Analyst to join the CORE Platform Support team in Madrid. In this role, you will own complex technical support cases involving integrations, authentication, APIs, messaging, and platform-level functionality.

You will act as a trusted technical partner to customers and an escalation point for Support Analysts. You will investigate difficult issues, communicate clearly with customers, collaborate with Product and Engineering, and help strengthen the team’s technical capability through knowledge sharing and mentoring.

The CORE team supports customers across areas including Single Sign-On, SMTP, APIs, Data Discovery, Certification Automation integrations, tenant-wide performance issues, integration workflows, and integration requests.

Your Mission

Own and resolve complex CORE support cases escalated from Support Analysts, taking responsibility from initial investigation through resolution or an effective engineering handoff.
Troubleshoot advanced issues across SSO, SAML, SMTP, APIs, integrations, workflows, Data Discovery, and related platform capabilities.
Reproduce customer issues in appropriate test or support environments and use available evidence to identify probable causes and practical resolutions.
Analyse logs, trace information, configuration details, API requests, integration behaviour, and other technical evidence to isolate issues.
Provide clear, structured customer communication, including acknowledgement, investigation updates, action plans, and resolution explanations.
Determine when an issue requires escalation to Product or Engineering and raise high-quality Jira tickets with the relevant troubleshooting, evidence, impact, and technical questions.
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Incident Management, and other Support teams to drive complex issues to resolution.
Identify recurring issues, documentation gaps, workflow improvements, and opportunities to reduce repeat contacts and escalations.
Mentor and support other analysts through case reviews, technical guidance, troubleshooting walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Contribute to onboarding and enablement for new analysts joining the CORE team.
Maintain strong case ownership, accurate documentation, timely updates, and adherence to support processes and service-level expectations.
Continue building expertise through product releases, technical training, office hours, hands-on investigation, and relevant certifications.

You Are

Experience in a technical customer support, technical account support, SaaS support, application support, or similar role.
Demonstrated experience handling complex technical issues and escalations in a customer-facing environment.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work methodically from symptoms and evidence to a clear diagnosis.
Experience supporting integrations involving identity providers, APIs, data connectors, or workflow automation.
Practical understanding of several of the following areas:
SSO, SAML, identity providers, certificates, and authentication flows
SMTP, email delivery, connection testing, and email-related troubleshooting
Kubernetes
REST APIs, authentication, request/response analysis, and tools such as Postman
SaaS integrations, workflows, web technologies, and system dependencies

Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Experience working with ticketing and engineering collaboration tools, such as Salesforce and Jira.

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview .
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

At Grant Thornton we do things differently - looking to the future, driving ambitious growth and pioneering positive change in our industry. With over 5,000 people in the UK, and a presence in 150 global markets, we're on an ambitious journey, from great to exceptional, and we need the best people to help us achieve our potential. And with that comes the opportunity to help redefine what our industry looks like, and what you want from your career.

Job Description:

MORE THAN YOU EXPECTED

Grant Thornton UK LLP is part of a global network of independent audit, tax and advisory firms, made up of some 58,000 people in over 135 countries. We're a team of independent thinkers who put quality, inclusion and integrity first. All around the world we bring a different experience to our clients. A better experience. One that delivers the expertise they need in a way that goes beyond. Personal, proactive, and agile. That's Grant Thornton.

NEW GROUND WON’T BREAK ITSELF.

Every day our teams help people in businesses and communities to do what is right and achieve their goals.

We're hiring Senior Engineers into our team, based in the North of England. You'll be a hands-on individual contributor, enabling our client facing teams, building real solutions that create measurable value, concentrating your engineering effort on solving in our GenAI platform, or building around and outside it when needed.

We’re happy to talk flexible working and consider reduced hours and job shares, we’ll support you to balance your work and life.

A look into the role

As a Senior Engineer within our team:

You'll work within a forward deployed engineering team or a delivery pod aligned to one of our service lines, alongside a product manager and under the technical direction of a Lead Engineer. The work spans the full stack of what engineering needs to do around a GenAI platform: solving problems natively, backend plumbing, API integrations, MCP server builds, and data connections.

Working in our GenAI platform doesn't always mean writing code. Often it means applying engineering judgement to solve problems natively, designing the right architecture, the right integration, the right data flow, directly within the platform itself. Knowing which mode the problem calls for is part of the craft here.

At Senior Engineer level, you'll own your delivery end-to-end. You translate business need into solutions and technical design, and work individually or as part of the team to solve those in the best way at pace.

You're fluent across AI-native engineering from building natively in the platform, using AI tooling to accelerate your own craft, and taking coalface experiments through to production-grade operationalised solutions.

At Senior Engineer level, that fluency is already there and you apply it independently.

Knowing you’re right for us

Joining us as a Senior Engineer, the minimum criteria you’ll need is

At Senior Engineer level you have a track record of owning delivery end-to-end in a team-based model. You've shipped production software and can speak to the decisions you made. You have real depth in backend and integration engineering using Python or C# .Net, and genuine judgement about when to solve natively in the platform and when bespoke engineering is the right call.

It would be great if you had some of the following skills, but don’t worry if you don’t tick every box, we’ll help you develop along the way.

Across both levels familiarity with Azure and Microsoft 365 is an advantage. Hands-on experience with LLM integration patterns, MCP tooling, and AI-enabled or agentic development environments is genuinely valued.
AI and LLM experience - you're comfortable using GenAI tools such as Copilot, Claude or ChatGPT.

Knowing we’re right for you

Embracing uniqueness, the culture at Grant Thornton thrives on the contributions of all our people, we never settle for what is easy, we look beyond to deliver the right thing, for everyone. Building an inclusive culture, where we value difference and respect our colleagues helps our people to perform at the best of their ability and realise their potential.

Our open and accessible culture means you’ll interact with leaders who are interested in you and everything you bring to our firm. The things that set you apart, we value them. That’s why we give you the freedom to bring your whole self to work and pursue your passions inside and outside of work.

Beyond the job

Life is more than work. The things you do, and the people you’re with outside of work matter, that’s why we’re happy to look at flexible working options for all our roles, and we’ll always do our best to keep your work and life in balance.

The impact you can make here will go far beyond your day job. From secondments, to fundraising for local charities, or investing in entrepreneurs in the developing world, you’ll be giving back to society . It’s that drive to do the right thing that runs through our every move, grounded in our firm’s values – purposefully driven, actively curious and candid but kind.

We’re looking for people who want to contribute, spark fresh ideas and go beyond expectations. People who want to be able to proudly do what’s right, for the firm, our clients, our people and themselves. It’s how it should be.

Job Description

Senior Integration Engineer

We are seeking an experienced API Engineer to design, build, secure, and operate enterprise-grade APIs that integrate cloud platforms with on‑premise banking application suites. The role focuses on developing reliable and scalable integration services, enabling secure data exchange across channels and systems (core banking, payments, fraud, risk, CRM, digital platforms), while meeting stringent regulatory, availability, and security requirements.

You will work closely with solution architects, platform engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders to deliver API products aligned to bank integration patterns, including synchronous REST services and event-driven integrations.

Direct line reporting:

Head of Architecture and Core Banking – Europe.
Accountabilities And Responsibilities

API Design & Delivery

Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration services connecting cloud services to on‑prem banking systems.
Create reusable API patterns for common banking capabilities (customer, accounts, payments, transactions, entitlements).
Define and maintain API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), versioning strategies, and backward compatibility.
Deliver APIs that meet performance, latency, availability, and resiliency expectations (e.g., timeouts, retries, circuit breakers).

Security, Compliance & Controls

Implement strong API security controls: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, JWT validation, request signing, API gateway policies, and rate limiting.
Apply secure coding practices and align solutions with bank security standards, audit requirements, and regulatory expectations (e.g., least privilege, encryption in transit/at rest).

About The Role

We're looking for a Deployed Architect to join our Professional Services team. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, deploy, and optimize production-grade AI infrastructure and agent systems. You'll be responsible for architecting scalable, secure infrastructure deployments and building reliable, well-evaluated agent applications that solve real business problems.

This role combines software development, infrastructure/platform engineering, and customer-facing skills. You'll work on everything from Kubernetes cluster design to multi-agent system architecture, requiring deep technical expertise across both infrastructure and agent engineering domains.

This role offers direct impact on customer success, the opportunity to shape best practices, and work with cutting-edge AI technology. You'll join a collaborative team environment with a strong engineering culture.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Assessment: Lead technical maturity assessments, work directly with enterprise customers to understand requirements and present recommendations, and partner with Engagement Managers and Product/Engineering teams

Required Experience

What We're Looking For

7+ years of experience in a technical, hands-on customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Deployed Architect or Forward Deployed Engineer. We also like former founders, so if you have an unusual background, but all the right skillsets, you are welcome to apply

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. The Test Engineer
ensures the quality of new and existing functionalities in applications by executing exhaustive tests, using state-of-the-art test tools with focus on non-regression testing using automation
. They are responsible for defining, writing, and implementing a rigorous, risk-based test strategy. They will report differences on expected results to development teams and provide objective, evidence-based quality assessments to support successful product deployments.

Define Test Strategy & Plan: Design, write, and maintain the comprehensive, risk-based test strategy and test plans for the project, covering scope, test levels, environmental needs.
Automation: Support the implementation of test automation where possible to optimize regression testing windows.
Analyse & Review: Read, analyse, and review all project and system documents to ensure the test strategy aligns perfectly with business requirements and technical designs. Identify gaps in Testing.
Test Design & Execution: Design, write, and execute comprehensive test scripts.
Defect & Risk Management: Create, document, and closely follow up on the resolution of defects. Assertively raise flags regarding outstanding testing and configuration issues under tight timelines.
Reporting: Produce highly transparent, validated test reports and readiness documentation to be signed off by Technology, Operations, and business stakeholders before go-live.
Collaboration: Closely collaborate with development (SCRUM) teams while maintaining the necessary QA independence to challenge deployment readiness.

Who Are We Looking For

Bachelor's degree in computer science or a similar education with a focus on IT.

Strong programming skills (e.g. Python, C#, Java or JavaScript) and experience with at least one automation framework (e.g., Selenium, Robot, Cypress, Appium).

Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and version control (Git).
Experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks, data-driven testing, and test utilities.
Linux and SQL Database knowledge.
Experience with defect management and test management tools (e.g., JIRA, XRAY).
Understanding of software development life cycle and agile methodologies

Perks & Benefits

At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:

Hybrid Working Policy
Gift vouchers on the occasion of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours

With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.

to join our Information Technology team. The Senior Fullstack .NET Developer position will work on a team focused on our core clinical systems as well as internal applications. Strong attention to detail, innovation, and implementation of new technologies are highly valued.

You will be joining an organization where your contribution makes a significant impact in positively impacting people's lives, as new treatments and therapeutics are developed.

Responsibilities

Collect, analyze and document user requirements;
Design, modify, develop and support software applications;

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. oplossingen. Met onze software en expertise helpen wij bedrijven om efficiënter om te gaan met de tijd van hun werknemers: hun Human Capital, dus. Ben jij een pionier die graag nieuwe technologieën verkent en ideeën omzet in werkende proof of concepts? Let’s meet! 🚀

Wat zal je doen als Innovation Developer bij Protime?

Als Full Stack .NET Develope
r werk je in ons Innovation Lab
. Samen met een gedreven team verken je nieuwe technologieën en ontwikkel je praktische toepassingen die direct waarde toevoegen aan onze producten.

omgeving, waarin je continu leert, verbetert en bijstuurt op basis van gebruikersinzichten en teaminput. Een nieuwsgierige houding
en een innovatieve mindset
zijn hierbij onmisbaar.

Vertaal ideeën naar prototypes: Je zet concepten om in werkende POCs binnen verschillende innovatietracks. Je schakelt snel van idee naar uitvoering en past continu bij op basis van feedback en testresultaten.
Verken nieuwe technologieën: Je experimenteert met de nieuwste tools en frameworks binnen het .NET-ecosysteem (vanaf versie 8) en combineert dit met moderne front-end technologieën zoals TypeScript en React. AI en data-driven oplossingen? Helemaal jouw ding!

Feedback-driven ontwikkeling: Je haalt actief input op bij eindgebruikers en gebruikt deze om prototypes te verfijnen. Je presenteert je ideeën aan zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders en zorgt dat iedereen begrijpt wat er mogelijk is.
Ruimte voor experimentatie: Je krijgt de vrijheid om buiten de standaard development flow te werken, nieuwe methoden uit te proberen en snel te schakelen.

Jouw skills en mindset

Je bent geen klassieke developer, maar een pionier
met een nieuwsgierige mindset en een brede interesse in zowel nieuwe als gevestigde technologieën. Je bent gepassioneerd over technologie en gedreven om steeds te ontdekken hoe je die in de praktijk kunt toepassen. Continu bijleren is voor jou vanzelfsprekend.

Ben jij de developer die we zoeken?

Je denkt kritisch, zoekt continu naar verbeteringen en weet je ideeën helder en onderbouwd over te brengen.
Je bruist van ideeën en experimenteert graag om tot verrassende inzichten te komen.
Je neemt graag initiatief en schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende projecten.
Je bent communicatief sterk en kan complexe concepten duidelijk uitleggen aan zowel technische als niet-technische collega’s.
Je blijft op de hoogte van trends in web development, service-oriented architecturen en AI-tools.

Technische skills

Sterke expertise in .NET 8 (of hogere versies).
Ervaring met frontend development (TypeScript of JavaScript; React is een plus).
Interesse in of ervaring met AI-development.
Vertrouwd met TDD, BDD, clean code en simple design.
Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Brutoloon: tussen €4000 en €5000 per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.
Voordelenpakket:
Bedrijfswagen met tankkaart/laadkaart
Netto-onkostenvergoeding
Maaltijdcheques en ecocheques
Hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering
Eindejaarspremie en jaarlijkse bonus
GSM abonnement en een voucher voor een toestel
FIP-plan (Flex Income Plan/cafetariaplan)

Werkregime: 40-urenweek met 12 ADV-dagen

Waarom voor Protime kiezen? ⌚

Protime is een groeibedrijf met een internationale mindset. Dat betekent dat jij impact kan maken, jezelf voortdurend kan blijven ontwikkelen en kan meegroeien met het bedrijf.
Werken bij Protime staat voor werken binnen een omgeving met snelle beslissingsprocedures en korte communicatielijnen. We omarmen verandering en nieuwe ideeën worden volop aangemoedigd.
We houden ervan ons werk en elkaar naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Samen presteren op ons best en voldoening halen uit ons werk: daar gaan we voor!
Bij ons werk je hybride: afwisselend vanop ons hoofdkantoor in Mechelen en van thuis. De werktijden zijn flexibel. De focus ligt op de kwaliteit van je werk.

The Senior Developer’s mission is to contribute to the functional and application related consistency of the IT solution and ensure the service continuity and continuous development. The Developer must perform activities within the framework of projects and/or application maintenance and development, seeking its continuous development and assuring its compliance with Quality and Security guidelines and best practices
We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer with expertise in analysing legacy implementations and implementing new systems following industry best practices. In addition to technical skills, soft skills like proactivity, outstanding communication abilities, and effective teamwork, are essential prerequisites. Candidates will engage with diverse locations and cultures, making cultural adaptability a valuable asset
As members of our IT department, Developers play a pivotal role in ensuring uninterrupted service delivery and elevating the overall quality of our IT operations

Your Main Activities Are

Software solution analysis, design, and implementation compliant with IT Department’s guidelines
Use of development best practices
Apply unit testing and follow the recommendations for high quality code
A team oriented profile working on a SCRUM environment

Profile
and Skills to Success

Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology and Computer Science or related
At least 10 years of experience in Information Rechnology or similar
Advanced level of English, both written and oral
Knowledge in C# .NET / SQL / Angular / Design Pattern / Dependency Injection / Test-Driven Development GIT/SVN
Creative and logical thinking to analyse a change request or problem or issue and define potential solutions or improvements, ways to do it, and being able to transpose logical thinking into a schematic diagram and documents for both presentation, discussion, and documentation
Ability to work in fast paced global environment
Attention to detail / rigour
Ability to collaborate / teamwork
Analytical ability

Why joining BNP Paribas?

BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner

Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities;
Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses;
Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate.

Our presence in Portugal

In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centers providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates.

Diversity and Inclusion Commitment

BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To

Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees;
Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard.

To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society.

Remote Working Conditions

At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices.

Commitment towards work/life balance

Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life.

To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page.

Please note that only applications submitted in English will be considered.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Analytics (Singapore)
jobs.description:
As a Data Engineer at Meta, you will shape the future of people\-facing and business\-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Reality Labs, Threads). Your technical skills and analytical mindset will be utilized designing and building large\-scale data sets, helping to craft experiences for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.In this role, you will collaborate with software engineering, data science, and product management teams to design/build scalable data solutions across Meta to optimize growth, strategy, and user experience for our 3 billion plus users, as well as our internal employee community.You will be at the forefront of identifying and solving some of the most interesting data challenges at a scale few companies can match. By joining Meta, you will become part of a data engineering community dedicated to skill development and career growth in data engineering and beyond.Data Engineering: You will guide teams by building optimal data artifacts (including datasets and visualizations) to address key questions. You will refine our systems, design logging solutions, and create scalable data models. Ensuring data security and quality, and with a focus on efficiency, you will suggest architecture and development approaches and data management standards to address complex analytical problems.Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, identify new opportunities, and tackle upcoming challenges. You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data\-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.  

  

  

### **Data Engineer, Analytics (Singapore) Responsibilities:**

* Conceptualize and own the data architecture for multiple large\-scale projects, while evaluating design and operational cost\-benefit tradeoffs within systems
* Create and contribute to frameworks that improve the efficacy of logging data, while working with data infrastructure to triage issues and resolve
* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs, representing key data insights in a meaningful way
* Define and manage Service Level Agreements for all data sets in allocated areas of ownership
* Determine and implement the security model based on privacy requirements, confirm safeguards are followed, address data quality issues, and evolve governance processes within allocated areas of ownership
* Design, build, and launch collections of sophisticated data models and visualizations that support multiple use cases across different products or domains
* Solve our most challenging data integration problems, utilizing optimal Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) patterns, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources
* Assist in owning existing processes running in production, optimizing complex code through advanced algorithmic concepts
* Optimize pipelines, dashboards, frameworks, and systems to facilitate easier development of data artifacts
* Influence product and cross\-functional teams to identify data opportunities to drive impact
* Mentor team members by giving/receiving actionable feedback

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent
* 4\+ years of experience where the primary responsibility involves working with data. This could include roles such as data analyst, data scientist, data engineer, or similar positions
* 4\+ years of experience (or 2\+ years with a Ph.D) with SQL, ETL, data modeling, and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C\+\+, C\#, Scala, etc.)

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Master's or Ph.D. degree in a STEM field
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

  

  

  

### **About Meta:**


Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

About The Role

The purpose of the role is to own the Azure platform on which IMSERV's Astral products are built, tested and run, helping us deliver highly scalable, secure, multi-tenant SaaS software to clients across the globe. You will be one of two DevOps Engineers who together own the path to production: the Azure environments, the CI/CD pipelines, the releases and the security and cost posture of the estate. The pair share the full scope so that no environment, pipeline or release depends on any one individual. This role sits within our Scrum teams, working day to day with Software Engineers, Testers and the Technical Architect. Where they own the code, you own the platform it ships on, through the entire product lifecycle.

Qualifications

Applicants should have at least 5+ years of experience managing production Azure environments, with a strong understanding of App Services, Azure SQL, storage solutions, and networking fundamentals. Proficiency in writing and maintaining CI/CD, build, and deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps (YAML) is essential, along with experience in artifact management, controlled build configurations, and pipeline variables. Candidates must be familiar with infrastructure as code tools such as Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform, and possess scripting skills in PowerShell and Azure CLI. A solid grasp of secure-by-default platform design principles, including Azure Key Vault, managed identities, RBAC, and least privilege access, is required. Experience in monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and incident response for live services, using tools like Application Insights and Log Analytics, is also necessary. Familiarity with Agile SCRUM methodologies and related ceremonies is important, as is a good understanding of SQL Server for managing environment data, refreshes, and safe testing data. Desirable qualifications include Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert), and experience with Azure PaaS services like Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure Logic Apps, or Azure Data Factory/Synapse/Microsoft Fabric. Knowledge of C#/.NET to read application code and assist with debugging, along with experience consolidating single-tenant deployments into multi-tenant platforms, will be advantageous. Additionally, familiarity with enterprise client security requirements, AI-assisted tooling, and penetration test remediation is beneficial.

Responsibilities

The role involves comprehensive environment management, including provisioning, configuring, and maintaining the Astral environment estate across development, test, UAT/load, and production stages. Ensuring environments are consistent, reproducible, and well-documented through infrastructure as code practices is crucial. Managing environment refreshes and test data in compliance with data protection policies is part of the duties. Building, maintaining, and continuously improving Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines is key, with a focus on artifact management, controlled build configurations, pipeline variables, and automated quality and security gates. Consolidating individual client pipelines into a unified deployment process as the platform evolves to multi-tenancy is also expected. Deployment planning and execution, including rehearsed rollback procedures and supporting product go-lives, are essential responsibilities, alongside maintaining a clear release calendar. Ownership of security protocols includes secrets and certificate management via Azure Key Vault, managed identities, role-based access control, and platform patching, in collaboration with IT security teams. Monitoring the platform’s health and reliability through observability tools, managing backups, disaster recovery tests, and leading incident response activities are vital for maintaining system stability. Cost management involves monitoring and optimizing Azure spend, right-sizing resources, and reporting on cost drivers. Maintaining up-to-date documentation, runbooks, environment configurations, and knowledge sharing within the team ensures operational resilience. Active participation in Scrum ceremonies, the wider Product Engineering community, and team events promotes collaboration and continuous improvement. Providing prompt support to engineers for environment and pipeline needs is also part of the role.

Benefits

Our employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including 28 days of holiday plus Bank Holidays, and an option to buy or sell annual leave through our scheme. We offer up to a 10% bonus based on performance, an enhanced salary sacrifice pension scheme, and life assurance coverage of up to six times your salary. Additional perks may include access to various wellness programs and discounts, designed to support a healthy work-life balance and financial security.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Workato**
=================



Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission\-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.


**Why join us?**
================



Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a **flexible, trust\-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles**. We are driven by **innovation** and looking for **team players** who want to actively build our company.



But, we also believe in **balancing productivity with self\-care**. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.



If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!



Also, feel free to check out why:


* Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
* Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
* Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
* Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers
**Responsibilities**
====================



We're building the infrastructure layer that connects enterprise systems to AI: an **MCP Gateway**, an **AI Gateway**, and the services around them. These are the systems that sit between LLM providers and everything else — routing, auth, rate limiting, observability, protocol translation. We're looking for a senior engineer who understands both the systems layer and the AI protocol layer, and who can build production\-grade services in Go and/or Ruby.



In this role, you will also be responsible to:


* **Design and develop the MCP Gateway and AI Gateway** — production services that mediate between applications, AI agents, and LLM providers. This means protocol\-level work: MCP server/client implementations, request routing, streaming, tool\-call proxying, authn/authz, and tenant isolation. You'll build the core infrastructure, not just applications on top of it.
* **Build high\-throughput, low\-latency network services.** You'll work close to the wire: TCP, TLS, HTTP/1\.1 and HTTP/2, JSON streaming, connection pooling, backpressure. When latency matters, you'll know exactly where it goes.
* **Own the data layer from the application side.** Deep PostgreSQL knowledge — schema design, indexing strategies, query planning, transactions and isolation levels, connection management. You're not a DBA, but you can read EXPLAIN ANALYZE output and fix the query, not just add an index and hope.
* **Design for concurrency.** Worker pools, queues, graceful shutdown, backpressure, race\-free shared state. You can profile a service under load (pprof, flamegraphs, query stats), find the bottleneck, and fix it.
* **Drive observability for AI systems.** Metrics, tracing, and logging that actually tell you what's happening — token usage, latency per provider, cache hit rates, failure modes, cost per request.

### **How we work with AI**


* **We encourage — but never force — the use of AI/LLM tools in development.** If AI\-assisted workflows make you faster, use them heavily. If you prefer to write something by hand, that's equally respected. What we care about is the quality of what ships, not how it was typed.
* **You'll have access to nearly every major tool and model on the market** — coding agents, IDEs, frontier models — with very generous usage limits. We want tooling budget to never be the reason a good idea goes unexplored.
* **We actively explore and enhance automated development.** You'll help shape how the team uses AI: agent workflows, code review automation, internal tooling. We build AI infrastructure, so we hold ourselves to being its most sophisticated users.
* **We believe LLM tools give a single engineer full visibility across the product**, regardless of area — frontend, backend, infra, docs. We want people who use that leverage to own problems end\-to\-end rather than stay inside one layer.
* **But the accountability never shifts to the machine.** You own what you merge. You can explain every statement and decision in the final output, and justify and defend the architectural choices to human colleagues in design and code reviews. "The AI suggested it" is never an acceptable rationale.

**Requirements**
================


### **Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills**


* **Senior\-level experience (5\+ years) in Go, Ruby, or both.** Any combination works: deep Go, deep Ruby, or strong in both. What matters is that you've shipped and operated production services in at least one of them.
* **Go candidates:** you know the stdlib deeply and prefer it over frameworks. net/http, crypto/tls, context, goroutines and channels, the memory model. You've done performance optimization on real services — allocations, GC pressure, lock contention — and you understand networking (TCP, TLS, HTTP, JSON) in depth, not just through a framework's abstraction.
* **Ruby candidates:** strong Rails in production — you know where Rails ends and Ruby begins, you've tuned ActiveRecord rather than fought it, and you've built services that stay fast under load.
* **PostgreSQL depth from an application developer's perspective.** Query optimization, indexing, transactions, connection pooling, migrations at scale. You don't need to administer the cluster; you need to write code that treats it well.
* **Concurrency and profiling as a practiced skill**, not a bullet point. You've debugged a production incident with a profiler open.
* **Familiarity with Kubernetes and containers.** You can deploy, debug, and reason about your services in a containerized environment — resource limits, health checks, rolling deploys, networking basics.
* You've built production services with proper observability, deployment pipelines, and security. You know how to run reliable systems and debug distributed systems when things break.

### **AI/LLM Experience**


* You've worked with LLMs at the **protocol level** — message structures, tool calling, streaming responses, caching strategies. You know what's happening on the wire, not just what the SDK abstracts away.
* Familiarity with **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** is a strong plus — ideally you've built or integrated MCP servers/clients and understand the transport and capability negotiation layers.
* You can integrate with OpenAI\-compatible and Anthropic APIs directly, evaluate responses, understand token usage, and optimize for latency and cost.
* **You can judge, audit, and verify LLM output.** You catch subtle bugs, security issues, and hallucinated APIs before they ship — and you're fluent enough in the underlying systems to know *why* the output is wrong, not just *that* it's wrong.

### **Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics**


* You learn fast and stay current. AI infrastructure is moving weekly; you follow it and can evaluate new protocols and approaches quickly.
* You participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, and you can explain complex concepts clearly to engineers and non\-technical stakeholders alike.
* You're comfortable owning the full lifecycle: design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

**(REQ ID: 2945\)**

:

Analyse und Behebung anspruchsvoller Incidents sowie Ableitung nachhaltiger Maßnahmen
Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben mit PowerShell, Bash und Azure Runbooks
Administration von Azure-Netzwerken, virtuellen Maschinen, Datenbanken, Identitäten, Berechtigungen und Richtlinien

Job Description:

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner.

About The Role

We are growing our digital capabilities at bp, and we're looking for a Software Engineer who is excited to shape the future of energy through technology. In this role, you will deliver features that will be used by teams throughout the business, help other teams adopt modern engineering standards, and help us deliver software that powers bp's global operations. You'll join a team that values curiosity, collaboration, and continuous learning, and you'll have the opportunity to influence how we design, build, and operate our digital products.

Please note that roles based out of SJS or Sunbury will move to Timber Square, Southwark, from Q4 2027.

What You'll Do

As a Software Engineer, You’ll Contribute Hands-on To Building, Improving, And Operating Reliable Software While Collaborating Closely With Your Team And Stakeholders. In This Role, You Will:

Contribute to the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and resilient software solutions.
Work with your tech leads to deliver on team priorities aligned with bp’s broader strategy.
Collaborate with other engineering teams across bp to help adapt and integrate their solutions with the Yalla stack.
Write high-quality, production-ready code in languages such as C#, Python, Java, or Go, and be willing to learn new technologies when needed.
Work closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to build solutions that make effective use of the Yalla stack.
Implement and deliver changes to our platform in a timely and reliable manner.
Follow and uphold established software engineering standards and best practices across bp.
Develop, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to support reliable and repeatable releases.
Support configuration and release processes to ensure smooth and predictable deployments.
Share knowledge with teammates, support other engineers when appropriate, and contribute positively to a collaborative team culture.
Design, implement, and optimize relational databases and data models in support of application needs.
Support live services by improving monitoring, reliability, and responding to incidents when required.
Participate in system design discussions, providing input and feedback under the guidance of senior engineers.
Apply secure coding practices and follow bp’s information security policies and standards.
Contribute to delivery planning, progress tracking, and execution of digital initiatives within your team.

What You Bring

We're Looking For Someone Who Enjoys Solving Meaningful Technical Problems And Working Collaboratively With Others. You'll Thrive In This Role If You Have:

Experience working as a Software Engineer on production systems, with growing technical ownership of your work.
A solid understanding of Agile development and modern software engineering practices.
A collaborative mindset and the ability to communicate clearly with engineers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, build automation, or release processes.
Practical experience designing and working with relational databases and data models.
Proficiency in at least one common high-level programming language (e.g. Java, C#, Python, Go, JavaScript, TypeScript), with exposure to or interest in learning others.
Familiarity with container-based development (e.g. building, running, or deploying containerised applications).
An understanding of secure software development principles and how to apply them in day-to-day coding.
Experience contributing to production-ready systems, including logging, monitoring, and reliability considerations.
The ability to participate in system design discussions and understand architectural trade-offs, with guidance from senior engineers.
Experience using Git-based source control and working with common branching strategies.

Why join us?

At bp, we support our people to grow in a diverse and exciting environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity.

There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are meaningful, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, excellent retirement benefits, among others!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Reinvent your career as you help our business meet the challenges of the future. Apply now!

Travel Requirement

No travel is expected with this role

Relocation Assistance:

This role is not eligible for relocation

Remote Type:

This position is a hybrid of office/remote working
