jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Investing Systems
jobs.description:
Company Overview

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

THE TEAM

The Investment Technology group at KKR builds and operates the systems that power the entire investment lifecycle, from deal sourcing and portfolio construction to risk management and monetization. We design platforms that connect data, people, and insights across Private Equity, Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure, and Capital Markets, enabling investment teams to make faster, smarter decisions at scale. Our mandate is to transform how KKR invests by engineering shared, data-driven platforms that replace fragmented legacy tools with integrated solutions that drive efficiency, transparency, and alpha generation.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As part of our continued investment in Ireland, KKR is launching a Technology & Engineering Centre of Excellence in Dublin. This new hub will play a central role in building the world’s first technology platform engineered to manage over one trillion dollars in alternative AUM (assets under management.) Designed from the ground up for scale, security and speed, this is the infrastructure for the future of global finance. Areas of focus include investment technology, portfolio construction and management, liquidity solutions, risk analytics, and advanced data platforms.

This is an exceptional opportunity to join a growing team within one of the world’s leading investment firms. You will contribute to high-visibility, strategic initiatives that are critical to the success of KKR’s business, working alongside a talented group professionals.

We’re committed to attracting and developing top-tier technology talent in Ireland. We’re looking for exceptional engineers who are passionate about innovation, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to work on some of the most interesting challenges in financial technology. We need you to help establish this team’s reputation for excellence and leadership.

THE ROLE

As a Principal Engineer, you will define the technical vision for key parts of our stack, shaping how data, analytics, and applications come together to drive business value.

You’ll combine deep engineering expertise with a strategic mindset—designing scalable systems, mentoring top talent, and setting standards for technical excellence. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering, data, and finance.

Our stack includes AWS, Postgres, Python, and React, with an emphasis on AI-assisted development and automation to enhance speed and quality across the SDLC.

Responsibilities

Work at the scope of the Investment Systems group to drive Architecture and Technical Strategy: Define and evolve the architecture for complex, cloud-native systems that support KKR’s investment operations.
Shape Engineering Practices: Establish standards for design, testing, observability, and CI/CD across multiple teams.
Drive Innovation: Identify and introduce new tools, frameworks, and AI-driven approaches that improve developer efficiency and data insights.
Mentor and Grow Talent: Coach engineers at all levels, cultivating technical depth, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Deliver Measurable Impact: Align technology initiatives to business objectives, tracking progress and outcomes.
Champion Reliability and Security: Ensure systems are built for resilience, performance, and compliance.
Influence Talent Decisions: Play a key role in recruiting and retaining top engineering talent through technical leadership and cultural alignment.

Who We Are Looking For

~12+ years of professional software engineering experience, exhibiting technical leadership across complex, distributed systems.
Proven success designing and scaling cloud-based platforms (AWS experience strongly preferred).
Expertise in one or more object-oriented languages (Python, Java, C++, etc) and strong familiarity with modern front-end frameworks such as React.
Solid understanding of database technologies (SQL & NoSQL), with experience in optimizing data models, caching, and performance.
Proficient in leveraging AI tools within the developer workflow to enhance productivity.
Effective communicator who can connect technical vision to business goals.
Experienced mentor who elevates the skills and judgment of others.
Curiosity and enthusiasm for finance and investment technology.
Strategic thinker who values simplicity, automation, and measurable results.
Proven record of ownership, able to deliver in a fast-paced, dynamic business environment, with exceptional attention to detail.

Power Platform -arkkitehti Space & Geo -tiimiin

Haemme Space & Geo -tiimiimme Power Platform -arkkitehtia, joka vastaa ratkaisujen arkkitehtuurista, teknisestä kokonaisuudesta ja toteutuksen teknisistä linjauksista. Roolissa pääset myös arvioimaan ja suunnittelemaan, miten tekoälyä voidaan hyödyntää osana Power Platform -kehitystä ja tulevia ratkaisuja.

Toimit tehtävässä myös kehitystiimin Scrum Masterina. Fasilitoit tiimin ketterää työskentelyä, autat poistamaan kehityksen esteitä ja tuet jatkuvaa parantamista. Aiempi kokemus Scrum Masterin roolista tukee tehtävässä onnistumista.

Työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla.

Tuleva tiimisi

Space & Geo on avaruusteknologioihin, satelliittidataan ja paikkatietoon keskittynyt osaamiskeskus, jossa työskentelee noin 80 ammattilaista aidosti poikkitieteellisessä ympäristössä. jobs.title: AI Workflow Engineer
jobs.description:
About us

We build the KeyShot, one of the leading 3D rendering products in the world, used across product design, engineering, marketing, and manufacturing to visualize and communicate ideas even before they're real. Used by companies like Google, Rolex, Louis Vuitton, HP, Microsoft, Philips, Adidas, and many more.

You'll be joining our cross functional web team, that builds the web services that expand KeyShot Studio for its users — powering collaboration, effective workflows, and the infrastructure that lets people work with renderings the way that suits them. We're growing this team to keep pushing that experience forward.

What you'll do

Design and set up AI workflows for implementing backend services in TypeScript, running on AWS
Retain high quality in an increasingly AI-driven development process - having strong review practices and keep tests quality.
Work within a microservice architecture, building services that are reliable and observable
Own your code through our CI/CD pipelines, and treat our test suite as a first-class part of the job
Build the services that give KeyShot users and collaborators smooth, reliable workflows - from SSO, integrations with Studio, Cloud Rendering to collaboration features
Collaborate closely with your team - reviewing code, finding solutions, share your insights and taking shared ownership of outcomes rather than working in solitude

What we're looking for

Experience designing and running AI-driven development workflows - using agentic coding tools (like Claude Code) to build and ship real production software
A track record of keeping quality high while working AI-first: reviewing, verifying, and course-correcting AI-generated code rather than accepting it at face value
Solid experience with TypeScript in a backend context
Experience with AWS cloud services and cloud architecture best practices (Infrastructure as Code like CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform is a plus)
Comfort working in a microservice architecture - working with serverless and event-driven application design (Lambda, DynamoDB, or similar)
Experience with CI/CD and a genuine belief that a strong automated test suite is the foundation for moving quickly on top of a robust foundation
A collaborative, self-driven working style - we don't manage tightly, but we rely on people to bring initiative and support their teammates in equal measure
You're past needing close guidance on how to do the job, and you're looking for a team where your judgment is trusted
Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken - our colleagues come from all over the world and English is our primary working language

What you'll join

You'll join a 8 person team of backend, frontend, and QA engineers, most based in our Aarhus Office, building the web services around KeyShot. We run flat and self-driven, valuing finding the solutions as a team. We back your development with real structure: biweekly 1:1s and an ongoing growth plan, so you keep developing.

Beyond the work, we offer health insurance, good maternity leave terms and a pension program as standard. On top of that: lunch scheme, massage, foosball, and regular social events.

Application and Interest

We are looking for candidates based in Aarhus, Odense, or Copenhagen. If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we'd love to hear from you! Got any questions? Feel free to reach out to Steffen Østerby Muldbjerg at steffen.muldbjerg@keyshot.com .

jobs.title: Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services
jobs.description:
Job Description

Build the enterprise platforms that power intelligent operations.

Join Agilent's Global OT & AI Engineering organization and help develop the cloud-native platforms that connect enterprise systems, manufacturing operations, and intelligent digital solutions across Agilent's global operations.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, enterprise APIs, integration platforms, and cloud-native applications that enable secure, reliable, and real-time information exchange across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, Engineering, and Operational Excellence.

Working closely with Application Experience Engineers, Data Engineers, AI & Data Scientists, Smart Factory Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will develop the enterprise services that power digital products, operational analytics, AI applications, and connected manufacturing systems.

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.

About Global OT & AI Engineering

Global OT & AI Engineering develops the digital platforms that power intelligent operations across Agilent's global manufacturing network.

Our organization combines software engineering, enterprise data platforms, Artificial Intelligence, industrial automation, cloud technologies, and Smart Factory solutions to build scalable digital capabilities that improve operational visibility, accelerate decision-making, and enable continuous improvement across global operations.

Our mission is to build the digital operating system for intelligent manufacturing.

Our portfolio includes:

Global Operations Control Tower
Enterprise Data Platform (GOLake)
AI & Decision Intelligence Platform
Smart Factory Applications
Manufacturing Knowledge Platform
Enterprise KPI Platform
Digital Twin Solutions
Manufacturing Data Exchange Platform
AI-powered Digital Coworkers

About The Role

Modern enterprise software depends on reliable, scalable, and secure platform services that connect business applications, operational technologies, enterprise systems, and cloud services into a unified digital ecosystem.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer – Platform Services, you will build the backend capabilities that power Agilent's digital products. From enterprise APIs and integration services to cloud-native microservices and event-driven architectures, your work will provide the foundation that enables seamless communication between applications, data platforms, AI services, and manufacturing systems.

You will collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to develop reusable platform capabilities that accelerate software delivery, improve system reliability, and support Agilent's long-term digital transformation strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Services Development

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services that support enterprise digital products.
Build reusable APIs, microservices, and shared platform capabilities that accelerate software development across multiple applications.
Develop secure and maintainable services that enable reliable communication between enterprise systems and operational platforms.
Ensure platform services are scalable, resilient, and designed for long-term maintainability.

Enterprise Integration

Develop integration services connecting ERP, MES, PLM, Quality Systems, AI platforms, enterprise applications, and cloud services.
Design API-first solutions that promote reuse and simplify system integration.
Implement event-driven and asynchronous communication patterns to improve scalability and responsiveness.
Enable secure and efficient information exchange across enterprise and manufacturing environments.

Cloud-Native Engineering

Develop cloud-native applications and services using modern architectural patterns.
Support containerized deployments, automated testing, and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD).
Optimize platform performance, reliability, scalability, and operational resilience.
Implement monitoring, logging, and observability capabilities that improve platform health and operational support.

Security & Reliability

Apply secure software development practices throughout the application lifecycle.
Implement authentication, authorization, and API security standards.
Support disaster recovery, fault tolerance, and high-availability strategies.
Continuously improve platform performance through proactive monitoring and optimization.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner with Application Experience Engineers to deliver end-to-end enterprise applications.
Collaborate with Data Engineers to expose trusted enterprise data through secure services.
Work with AI & Data Scientists to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
Support Smart Factory Engineers by enabling secure integration between operational technologies and enterprise applications.
Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and Agile delivery activities.

Technology Environment

You will have opportunities to work with modern enterprise technologies including:

Backend Development

.NET
Python
Node.js (preferred)

API & Integration

REST APIs
GraphQL (preferred)
gRPC (preferred)
OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect

Cloud Platforms

Microsoft Azure
AWS

Containers & DevOps

Docker
Kubernetes
Azure DevOps
GitHub Actions

Messaging & Event Streaming

Apache Kafka
Azure Event Hub
RabbitMQ (preferred)

Databases

SQL Server
PostgreSQL
MongoDB
Redis (preferred)

Monitoring & Observability

Azure Monitor
Application Insights
Grafana
Prometheus (preferred)

Qualifications

We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience and demonstrated capability.

You should have:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Experience developing backend applications, APIs, or enterprise software platforms.
Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages such as C#, Python, or Java.
Understanding of API development, system integration, and relational databases.
Familiarity with cloud computing concepts and distributed application architecture.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Passion for building scalable software platforms that enable enterprise digital transformation.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is advantageous:

Cloud-native application development (Azure or AWS)
Microservices architecture
Event-driven architecture
Container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
Enterprise Integration Patterns
CI/CD and DevOps practices
Identity and Access Management (IAM)
Manufacturing or industrial software platforms

Leadership Competencies

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

Strong software engineering and systems design fundamentals.
Passion for building reliable, scalable, and maintainable software platforms.
Customer-focused problem solving with a commitment to delivering business value.
Excellent collaboration across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset.
Curiosity to explore emerging technologies and modern engineering practices.
Ability to balance technical excellence with pragmatic business outcomes.

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule.

Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Insight Global is seeking a Senior .NET Software Engineer to support a large-scale enterprise application modernization initiative. This individual will play a key role in transitioning critical business applications from a legacy Java/ADF environment to a modern .NET ecosystem. The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader with deep expertise in C#, ASP.NET Core, software architecture, and enterprise application development.

This role will be responsible for leading development efforts, mentoring engineers through a technology transition, establishing engineering best practices, and partnering closely with business and technical stakeholders to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions.

Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise web applications using C#, ASP.NET Core MVC, and .NET

Drive the modernization of legacy Java/ADF applications into a scalable and maintainable .NET architecture

Develop new application features and capabilities while ensuring functional parity during system migrations

Partner with architects to define application architecture, API strategies, and database design standards

Design and develop RESTful APIs integrated with Oracle and other relational databases

Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following SOLID principles and Clean Architecture practices

Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and code reviews for development team members

Establish and enforce Git branching strategies, CI/CD practices, and development standards

Identify and resolve technical debt while improving application performance, reliability, and security

Collaborate directly with business partners and global stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions

Maintain technical documentation related to architecture, database design, and migration activities

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Minimum 8 years of professional experience in the .NET ecosystem with expert-level knowledge of C# and ASP.NET Core

Strong software design and architecture experience including;
Dependency Injection, Repository Pattern, Clean Architecture, Modular Design, and design patterns with the ability to develop scalable enterprise solutions

Advanced database architecture and SQL expertise, including;
Entity Framework Core and Oracle DB optimization (SQL Server and PostgreSQL experience also considered)

Experience building enterprise web applications using ASP.NET Core MVC and JavaScript

Frontend development experience including responsive UI development with HTML, CSS, and UI component libraries such as Telerik UI

Experience leading development teams, mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and driving software quality standards

Strong verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to collaborate across global teams and explain technical concepts to varying audiences

Ability to participate in occasional technical discussions aligned to Eastern Time Zone (EST)

Hands-on experience with Git/GitLab, branching strategies, merge requests, version control best practices, and CI/CD pipelines

Self-motivated with the ability to manage priorities independently and design systems with long-term scalability in mind

Exposure to Java or Java ADF and the ability to understand legacy business logic

Experience with Supply Chain Management (SCM) or ERP systems

Experience with Telerik UI for ASP.NET Core, Ajax Binding, or Tag Helpers

Experience working within Agile/Scrum environments

Experience supporting legacy application modernization initiatives

Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and modern software engineering practices

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Experience modernizing or migrating legacy enterprise applications

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Application instructions:**  

**Interested applicants, please apply for this job at this link:** https://grnh.se/7o1evgyx2us
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

We're building the infrastructure layer that connects enterprise systems to AI: an
  
  

MCP Gateway
  
  

, an
  
  

AI Gateway
  
  

, and the services around them. These are the systems that sit between LLM providers and everything else — routing, auth, rate limiting, observability, protocol translation. We're looking for a senior engineer who understands both the systems layer and the AI protocol layer, and who can build production\-grade services in Go and/or Ruby.
  
  

**In this role, you will also be responsible to:**  

Design and develop the MCP Gateway and AI Gateway
  
  

— production services that mediate between applications, AI agents, and LLM providers. This means protocol\-level work: MCP server/client implementations, request routing, streaming, tool\-call proxying, authn/authz, and tenant isolation. You'll build the core infrastructure, not just applications on top of it.
  
  

Build high\-throughput, low\-latency network services.
  
  

**You'll work close to the wire:** TCP, TLS, HTTP/1\.1 and HTTP/2, JSON streaming, connection pooling, backpressure. When latency matters, you'll know exactly where it goes.
  
  

Own the data layer from the application side.
  
  

Deep PostgreSQL knowledge — schema design, indexing strategies, query planning, transactions and isolation levels, connection management. You're not a DBA, but you can read EXPLAIN ANALYZE output and fix the query, not just add an index and hope.
  
  

Design for concurrency.
  
  

Worker pools, queues, graceful shutdown, backpressure, race\-free shared state. You can profile a service under load (pprof, flamegraphs, query stats), find the bottleneck, and fix it.
  
  

Drive observability for AI systems.
  
  

Metrics, tracing, and logging that actually tell you what's happening — token usage, latency per provider, cache hit rates, failure modes, cost per request.
  
  

How we work with AI
  
  

We encourage — but never force — the use of AI/LLM tools in development.
  
  

If AI\-assisted workflows make you faster, use them heavily. If you prefer to write something by hand, that's equally respected. What we care about is the quality of what ships, not how it was typed.
  
  

You'll have access to nearly every major tool and model on the market
  
  

— coding agents, IDEs, frontier models — with very generous usage limits. We want tooling budget to never be the reason a good idea goes unexplored.
  
  

We actively explore and enhance automated development.
  
  

**You'll help shape how the team uses AI:** agent workflows, code review automation, internal tooling. We build AI infrastructure, so we hold ourselves to being its most sophisticated users.
  
  

We believe LLM tools give a single engineer full visibility across the product
  
  

, regardless of area — frontend, backend, infra, docs. We want people who use that leverage to own problems end\-to\-end rather than stay inside one layer.
  
  

But the accountability never shifts to the machine.
  
  

You own what you merge. You can explain every statement and decision in the final output, and justify and defend the architectural choices to human colleagues in design and code reviews. "The AI suggested it" is never an acceptable rationale.
  
  

Requirements
  
  

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills
  
  

Senior\-level experience (5\+ years) in Go, Ruby, or both.
  
  

**Any combination works:** deep Go, deep Ruby, or strong in both. What matters is that you've shipped and operated production services in at least one of them.
  
  

**Go candidates:**  

you know the stdlib deeply and prefer it over frameworks. net/http, crypto/tls, context, goroutines and channels, the memory model. You've done performance optimization on real services — allocations, GC pressure, lock contention — and you understand networking (TCP, TLS, HTTP, JSON) in depth, not just through a framework's abstraction.
  
  

**Ruby candidates:**  

strong Rails in production — you know where Rails ends and Ruby begins, you've tuned ActiveRecord rather than fought it, and you've built services that stay fast under load.
  
  

PostgreSQL depth from an application developer's perspective.
  
  

Query optimization, indexing, transactions, connection pooling, migrations at scale. You don't need to administer the cluster; you need to write code that treats it well.
  
  

Concurrency and profiling as a practiced skill
  
  

, not a bullet point. You've debugged a production incident with a profiler open.
  
  

Familiarity with Kubernetes and containers.
  
  

You can deploy, debug, and reason about your services in a containerized environment — resource limits, health checks, rolling deploys, networking basics.
  
  

You've built production services with proper observability, deployment pipelines, and security. You know how to run reliable systems and debug distributed systems when things break.
  
  

AI/LLM Experience
  
  

You've worked with LLMs at the
  
  

protocol level
  
  

— message structures, tool calling, streaming responses, caching strategies. You know what's happening on the wire, not just what the SDK abstracts away.
  
  

Familiarity with
  
  

MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  
  

is a strong plus — ideally you've built or integrated MCP servers/clients and understand the transport and capability negotiation layers.
  
  

You can integrate with OpenAI\-compatible and Anthropic APIs directly, evaluate responses, understand token usage, and optimize for latency and cost.
  
  

You can judge, audit, and verify LLM output.
  
  

You catch subtle bugs, security issues, and hallucinated APIs before they ship — and you're fluent enough in the underlying systems to know
  
  

why
  
  

the output is wrong, not just
  
  

that
  
  

it's wrong.
  
  

Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics
  
  

You learn fast and stay current. AI infrastructure is moving weekly; you follow it and can evaluate new protocols and approaches quickly.
  
  

You participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, and you can explain complex concepts clearly to engineers and non\-technical stakeholders alike.
  
  

**You're comfortable owning the full lifecycle:** design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  
  

Workato is an award\-winning cloud intelligent automation and integration platform with enterprise\-grade capabilities and no coding required. Workato seamlessly integrates with over 300\+ business applications and enables integration and task automation across all those apps.
  
  

Recognised as a Leader in Forrester Wave iPaaS for Dynamic Integrations and Leader on Debut in Gartner’s Enterprise iPaaS Magic Quadrant, Workato is the only company that provides an easy, self\-service way to integrate cloud and on\-premise applications for all types of businesses — ranging from Fortune 500 Enterprises as well as SMBs.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you interested in cloud computing and helping customers build on AWS? We have a role you might find interesting.  

  

The AWS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with customers as they build and grow their businesses on AWS. We're here to make sure they can deploy the best, most scalable, and most secure architectures possible — and that they spend as little time and money as possible doing so.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

We are looking for technical builders who love the idea of working with customers to help them succeed. In this role, you'll work directly with a variety of interesting customers and help them make the best (and sometimes the most pragmatic) technical decisions along the way. You'll have a chance to build enduring relationships with these companies and establish yourself as a trusted advisor.  

  

As well as spending time working directly with customers, you'll also get plenty of time to "sharpen the saw" and keep your skills fresh. We have more than 175 services across a range of different categories, and it's important that we can help customers take advantage of the right ones. You'll also play an important role as an advocate with our product teams to make sure we are building the right products for the customers you work with. And for the customers you don't get to work with on a 1:1 basis, you'll get the chance to share your knowledge more broadly by working on technical content and presenting at events.  

  

A day in the life  

Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the fastest\-growing companies to Global 500 enterprises trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.  

  

About the team  

AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest\-growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.

* Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)

* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Speak, write, and read fluently in Vietnamesse

----------------------------

* Experience implementing a cloud\-based technology solution
* Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About This Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job.

You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter.

In this role

Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision.
Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop.
Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team.
Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve.
Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor.
Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding.
Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments.
The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What You Will Need

5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.
Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made.
Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly.
Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it.
Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow.
A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback.
Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on.
Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems.
Fluency in English is a must.

What We Offer

Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.
Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.
A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates.
Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.
Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.
Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.
We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
TOPdesk builds service management software used across education, healthcare, government, and manufacturing. We are 700+ colleagues in 11 offices worldwide. Founded over 30 years ago, we serve more than 10 million users worldwide and have been helping organisations deliver better services ever since.

We are an open, collaborative organisation with little hierarchy — people own their work end to end and are trusted to make the decisions that matter. We are reinventing ITSM and ESM for the agentic era, building AI agents our customers can trust, and this role is part of that.

Job Description

About the role

As an Engineering Manager, you lead one or two teams with a specific technical mission — front-end, middleware, back-end, data, or platform — giving both people and technical direction, and owning what your teams ship.

You set team-level technical direction within the wider architectural guardrails, grow strong engineers into stronger ones, and own delivery and operational outcomes — creating the conditions for your senior and staff engineers to provide technical leadership too. You operate agents yourself and lead our AI-native SDLC from the front. You report to your domain's senior engineering leader.

What this is not A purely process or Scrum-master role, or a hands-off manager who sets no technical direction. You lead people and technology together, and stay technically close through design, pairing, incident response, reviews, technical investigation, and agent workflows — regular individual coding output is not the measure of the role.

The team

You lead one or two teams with a specific mission — for example front-end feature development, middleware, back-end services, data, or platform.

Delivers its part of the domain's roadmap.
Sets and upholds the technical standards for its domain.
Adopts the target architecture and our AI-native SDLC practices.
Sits within a approx 170-strong engineering organisation across Delft, Budapest, and Kaiserslautern.

What you'll do

Provide technical direction

Set technical direction and standards for your teams' domain, alongside your engineers.
Make and steward the key technical decisions; uphold quality, security, and operational stability.
Contribute to system and architecture decisions for your domain with the Enterprise Architects and your peers.

Grow the people

Coach and develop your engineers — including growing strong ones into senior and staff engineers.
Hire, and act on tough talent calls with clarity and care.

Own the delivery and the bar

Own your teams' roadmap commitments and delivery and operational outcomes; protect cycle time, quality, and operational stability.
Keep review sustainable in an agentic SDLC — ensure your teams do not create excessive review burden or unnecessary code, match agent autonomy to the risk of the task, and keep human accountability clear.
Raise the engineering bar for your domain; make standards explicit and inspectable.
Operate agents yourself — build the subagents, evals, and patterns your team reuses, and contribute them back to the shared libraries.

Technical environment

Claude Code is our current primary agentic engineering environment: agents may plan and execute within defined constraints and governed environments, while engineers stay accountable for problem framing, architecture, acceptance criteria, security, verification, and production outcomes. Agent-generated work is backed by automated tests, runtime checks, reviewable evidence, and risk-based human approval — we match deterministic automation, structured workflows, or agents to the nature and risk of the task rather than maximising autonomy for its own sake.

Your domain: front-end, middleware, back-end, data, or platform — the specific stack depends on your teams' mission.
Legacy: Java, MS SQL, heritage architecture — being decomposed.
Modern: Python, TypeScript, Vue, Postgres, Azure, Kubernetes; cloud-native / service-oriented architecture; Terraform-managed infrastructure.
Mechanisms: subagents, MCP tool integrations, multi-agent workflows, and shared prompt, agent, and eval libraries.

Success in your first year

Your teams reliably deliver their part of the domain's roadmap, with measurably better cycle time, quality, and stability.
Technical direction and standards for your domain are clear, owned, and upheld — the bar has gone up.
Your engineers have grown, including movement into senior or staff roles.
AI-native ways of working are normal in your team, with patterns and evals you contributed.

Qualifications

Required

Engineering manager with a track record of growing engineers — including into senior and staff roles — and owning team delivery.
A strong technical foundation in a relevant domain (front-end, middleware, back-end, data, or platform) — you set team-level technical direction, not just run process.
Current, personal practice of AI-native software delivery (Claude Code or equivalent) — you can show your work and lead by example.
Strong on talent development; comfortable acting on tough calls.
Comfortable in ambiguity and inside legacy codebases; a strong communicator.

Nice to have

Led a team through a significant technical or operating-model change.
Has built and shared subagents, evals, or CLAUDE.md conventions a team reused.
Deep domain expertise relevant to one of the product domains.

Additional Information

What's in it for you

A strong focus on personal development — including, in the Netherlands, our “10 to Grow” programme: 10% of your time and budget for your own growth.
A hybrid working environment built on freedom, trust, and responsibility.
An open, informal, and supportive culture, with collaboration across national borders.
Excellent employment conditions.

That's where you come in. As our Business Solutions Engineer, you'll design and build internal business systems end-to-end: workflow-driven applications, smart interfaces, and data models that help teams work faster and rely less on manual work. This isn't a simple automation role. You'll work closely with stakeholders, get to the root of how processes really work, and build solutions that are reliable, secure, and production-ready.

Our team moves with the speed and ownership of a scale-up — you won't be waiting for perfect requirements or spending months in theory. You'll go from first idea to live solution, and you'll own the whole journey.

Translate & design: Turn business needs and process challenges into clear, structured system designs.

Who Are You?

You're a builder. You get energy from understanding how things work, spotting what's slowing a process down, and turning that into something practical that people can rely on. You're comfortable with ambiguity, confident working directly with stakeholders, and you know how to balance speed with quality.

You'll Thrive Here If Most Of This Sounds Familiar

Ben je klaar voor de stap naar Enterprise Level Solution Architectuur? Kom dan kennismaken bij HSO! Join the Journey!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Azure Integration Architect begeleid jij klanten inhoudelijk in hun reis naar de Microsoft Cloud of bij het professionaliseren van de Cloud Competence. Je houdt je bezig met de (Hybride) Cloud Architectuur, het realiseren van een veilige Azure-omgeving en het moderniseren (Cloud Native) van applicaties, integraties en bijbehorende infrastructuren. Je inspireert organisaties en helpt met het nemen van beslissingen rondom migraties. Daarnaast geef je workshops over Cloud Architectuur, Integratie, Infrastructuur, Governance en Security & Compliance. Je bent gewend om in complexe omgevingen te werken en je weet lastige vraagstukken moeiteloos te vertalen naar technische oplossingen. Kortom, jouw hart klopt sneller van de Microsoft-technologie!

Wat vragen wij van jou?

Je hebt HBO-werk- en denkniveau.
Je bent ondernemend en wilt graag helpen bij de doorontwikkeling van onze Managed Cloud.
Je hebt relevante Microsoft-certificeringen op het gebied van Azure-architectuur en -ontwikkeling.
Je hebt expertise in het Microsoft Azure-portfolio (Azure Well-Architected Framework, Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Integration Services, Infrastructure as Code, Azure DevOps & CI/CD).
Je beschikt over goede Nederlandse taalvaardigheden (zowel mondeling als schriftelijk).

Wat bieden we jou?   

Werken bij HSO is uitdagend, we willen je daar graag een goede beloning voor teruggeven. Naast goede primaire voordelen bieden wij: 

Een competitief salaris, een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van bedrijfs-, team- en individuele prestaties;
Mobiliteitsvergoeding waarbij je of een auto kunt leasen of het bedrag toe kunt voegen aan je salaris. Daar bovenop krijg 100% betaald van de ov-kosten;
25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 35 van te maken; 
Hybride werken, vanuit huis, op kantoor (Rotterdam, Veenendaal) of zelfs tijdens je Workation; 
EUR 65,- netto vitaliteitsbudget – we vinden het belangrijk dat we gezond blijven en een veilige werkplek hebben, zowel op kantoor als remote; 
Je kunt deelnemen aan het leasefietsplan; 
En vooral een leven lang leren. Op dag één start jouw onboardingprogramma, daarnaast krijg je een persoonlijk studiebudget dat je kunt inzetten voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling en ontvang je ook een GoodHabitz account, een online trainingstool voor je persoonlijke ontwikkeling.  

Vrijheid, flexibiliteit en fun

Je werkt in een internationale omgeving met professionals met verschillende nationaliteiten. Een flexibele werkweek van 40, 36 of 32 uur behoort tot de mogelijkheden omdat wij van mening zijn dat jouw manier van werken bij jouw levensstijl moet passen. HSO heeft professionals in dienst die plezier hebben in hun werk en klaar staan voor elkaar. Om het plezier in ons werk nog groter te maken, organiseren we uiteraard teamuitjes en bedrijfsfeesten, maar ook wekelijkse zomerborrels op ons dakterras, allerlei sportactiviteiten en is er de mogelijkheid bij te dragen aan onze Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen-werkzaamheden.

Over HSO  

HSO is de eerste full-service Microsoft Partner in Nederland. Samen met ruim 2500 getalenteerde medewerkers in Europa, Azië en Noord-Amerika verlenen we ondersteuning op lokaal en internationaal niveau aan industriële bedrijven, retailers, financiële en zakelijke dienstverleners en overheidsinstellingen.  HSO is voortdurend op zoek naar nieuw talent. We blijven onze wereldwijde community uitbreiden en scheppen er plezier in om samen te werken met prestatiegerichte mensen met een ondernemersgeest. Professionals die voortdurend willen leren en innoveren.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Description

BESCHREIBUNG:

Wir suchen einen motivierten Full-Stack Developer (C#/.NET & Angular) zur Verstärkung unseres dynamischen Produkt- und Entwicklungsteams.

ÜBER Freicon

Freicon Software GmbH, ein Unternehmen der Valsoft Corporation, entwickelt und liefert moderne Dealer-Management-Systeme (DMS), die speziell auf die Anforderungen der Automobil-, Nutzfahrzeug- und Caravan-Branche zugeschnitten sind. Unser Flaggschiffprodukt FILAKS.PLUS unterstützt Autohäuser bei der Steuerung sämtlicher Geschäftsprozesse – von Kundenservice und Lagerlogistik bis hin zum Fahrzeugverkauf.

Über Valsoft Corp

Valsoft wurde 2015 in Kanada gegründet und ist mittlerweile auf ein globales Portfolio von über 118 Unternehmen gewachsen. Wir erwerben und entwickeln vertikal spezialisierte Softwareunternehmen, um unseren Kunden in verschiedenen Branchen die besten geschäftskritischen Lösungen bereitzustellen.

Ein zentraler Bestandteil der Valsoft-Philosophie ist es, in etablierte Unternehmen zu investieren und ein unternehmerisches Umfeld zu fördern, das diese zu führenden Anbietern in ihren Märkten macht. Wir kaufen, halten und schaffen langfristigen Wert durch Partnerschaften mit bestehenden Managementteams.

Investitionsstrategie

Im Gegensatz zu Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Firmen sind wir Unternehmer, die Softwareunternehmen erwerben, weiterentwickeln und nachhaltig ausbauen. Richtig gelesen – wir verkaufen keine Unternehmen. Stattdessen gehen wir strategische Partnerschaften mit bestehenden Managementteams ein. Wir schätzen die Hingabe und Ausdauer, die zum Aufbau eines Unternehmens erforderlich sind, und stellen das Wohl unserer Kunden und Mitarbeiter über kurzfristige Ziele.

Unternehmenskultur

Valsoft ist mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz wir sind ein Team. Unsere Mitarbeiter sind unser wertvollstes Kapital, und ihre Weiterentwicklung hat für uns höchste Priorität. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem unsere Mitarbeitenden jeden Tag dieselbe Begeisterung wie am ersten Arbeitstag verspüren.

Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von Leistungsstärke, Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitiger Unterstützung. Wir feiern unsere Erfolge – und sind stolz darauf. Wir träumen groß, bleiben bescheiden und bleiben hungrig.

Stellenbeschreibung

Als Full-Stack Developer bist Du der Mensch, der das baut, was das Geschäft wirklich braucht: neue Produkt-Features, Integrationen und interne Systeme. Du arbeitest sowohl am Backend mit C#/.NET als auch am Frontend mit Angular und entwickelst unsere Kernplattform kontinuierlich weiter. Du arbeitest eng mit Produkt, Vertrieb und unseren Kunden zusammen, verstehst FILAKS.PLUS und die zugrunde liegende Architektur und baust zuverlässige Lösungen, die das Geschäft nach vorne bringen.

Hauptaufgaben

Design und Entwicklung von Features und Integrationen für unsere Kernplattform mit C#/.NET im Backend und Angular im Frontend.
Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von FILAKS.PLUS – von der technischen Konzeption bis zum produktiven Einsatz bei unseren Autohaus-Kunden.
Mitarbeit an AI-gestützten Features, Agents und Integrationen als ergänzender Bestandteil unserer Produktentwicklung.
Zusammenarbeit mit Produkt- und Vertriebs-Teams, um Business-Probleme in saubere technische Lösungen zu übersetzen.
End-to-End-Verantwortung: Scoping, Bauen, Ausliefern, Messen, Iterieren.
Aktive Nutzung moderner Entwicklungs- und AI-Coding-Workflows (Claude Code, Cursor o. Ä.), um mit kleinem Team schnell und qualitativ zu shippen.
Schnelle Einarbeitung in FILAKS.PLUS und unsere bestehende Architektur mit dem Ziel, frühzeitig produktionsreife C#/.NET- und Angular-Features auszuliefern.

We are seeking a motivated Full-Stack Developer to join our dynamic product and development team.

About Freicon

Freicon Software GmbH, part of Valsoft Corporation, develops and delivers advanced Dealer Management Systems (DMS) tailored to the specific needs of the automotive, commercial vehicle, and caravan industries. Our flagship product FILAKS. PLUS supports dealerships in managing all operational processes – from customer service and warehouse logistics to vehicle sales.

About Valsoft Corp

Established in Canada in 2015, Valsoft has grown to a global portfolio of 118+ companies, acquiring and developing vertical market software companies, enabling each business to deliver the best mission-critical solutions for customers in their respective industries. A key tenet of Valsoft’s philosophy is to invest in well-established businesses and foster an entrepreneurial environment that molds companies into leaders in their respective industries. Valsoft looks to buy, hold, and create value through long-term partnerships with existing management.

Investment Approach

Unlike private equity and venture capital firms, we are Entrepreneurs who Buy, Enhance and Grow Software Businesses. That’s right; we don’t sell businesses. We form a strategic alliance with existing management teams. We recognize the dedication and perseverance required to create a firm and place a premium on customers’ and workers’ well-being over short-term goals.

Culture

Valsoft is more than just a place to work; we’re a team. We mean it when we say people are our greatest assets, so investing in them is our number one priority. We create an environment where our employees feel first-day-on-the-job excitement, day after day, creating a culture of high performers and collaboration. We celebrate our milestones, and we’re proud of them. We Dream Big, Stay Humble, and Stay Hungry.

Position Description

As a Full-Stack Developer, you will be the person who builds what the business actually needs: new product features, integrations and internal systems. You will work across the backend using C#/.NET and the frontend using Angular, continuously developing and improving our core platform.

You will work closely with product, sales and our customers, understand FILAKS.PLUS and its underlying architecture, and build reliable solutions that move the business forward.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop features and integrations for our core platform using C#/.NET on the backend and Angular on the frontend.
Develop and continuously improve FILAKS.PLUS, from technical concept through to production use with our dealership customers.
Contribute to AI-powered features, agents and integrations as a secondary part of our product development.
Work directly with product and sales teams to translate business problems into clean technical solutions.
Own the full delivery cycle: scoping, building, shipping, measuring and iterating.
Use modern development and AI coding workflows (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) to ship quickly and effectively as a small team.
Quickly ramp up on FILAKS.PLUS and our existing architecture, with the goal of delivering production-ready C#/.NET and Angular features early on.

Requirements

Starke Software-Engineering-Grundlagen. Du schreibst sauberen, produktionsreifen Code und verfügst über fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit C#/.NET im Backend und Angular im Frontend.
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Auslieferung produktionsreifer Full-Stack-Anwendungen mit C#/.NET und Angular.
Erfahrung mit LLMs, Agents oder AI-Tooling in Produktionsumgebungen ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Starke Problem-Framing-Skills. Du verstehst den Business-Need, bevor Du die Tastatur berührst.
Starker Kommunikator. Du kannst technische Entscheidungen für nicht-technische Stakeholder übersetzen und deren Vertrauen gewinnen.
Self-Starter, der schnell ist und Codebases besser hinterlässt, als er sie vorgefunden hat.
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse(mindestens C1 in beiden Sprachen),um mit Kunden in DACH und Kolleginnen und Kollegen in der internationalen Valsoft-Gruppe zu arbeiten.
Strong software development fundamentals. You write clean, production-quality code and have strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET on the backend and Angular on the frontend.
Experience developing and shipping production-grade full-stack applications using C#/.NET and Angular.
Experience with LLMs, agents or AI tooling in production is a nice-to-have, but not a requirement.
Strong problem-framing skills. You understand the business need before you touch the keyboard.
Strong communicator. You can translate technical decisions for non-technical stakeholders and earn their trust.
Self-starter who moves fast and leaves codebases better than you found them.
Fluent in German and English(C1 or better in both), to work with customers in DACH and colleagues across the global Valsoft group.

Benefits

Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit.
Remote-Arbeit innerhalb des DACH-Raums mit gelegentlichen Onsite-Tagen an unserem Standort in Bötzingen.
30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr.
Ein Produkt mit echter Marktrelevanz: FILAKS.PLUS wird täglich in Autohäusern in der ganzen DACH-Region genutzt. Dein Code läuft in Produktion, bei echten Kunden.
Rückhalt der globalen Valsoft-Gruppe und Zugang zu deren AI-Infrastruktur und Know-how bei gleichzeitig kurzen Wegen und unternehmerischer Autonomie bei Freicon.
Moderne Tooling-Kultur: Wir erwarten, dass Du in AI-assistierter Entwicklung bereits fließend bist. Nicht neugierig, sondern aktiv damit Deinen Output vervielfachst.
Permanent, full-time employment.
Remote work within the DACH region with occasional onsite days at our office in Bötzingen, Germany.
30 days of paid vacation per year.
A product with real market relevance: FILAKS.PLUS is used daily by dealerships across DACH. Your code runs in production, with real customers.
The backing of the global Valsoft group and access to its AI infrastructure and expertise combined with short decision paths and entrepreneurial autonomy at Freicon.
Modern tooling culture: we expect you to be already fluent in AI-assisted development not curious about it, but actively using it to multiply your output.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) Cloud Anwendungen
jobs.description:
Schon heute die Zukunft gestalten – mit Wolters Kluwer

Seit über 180 Jahren unterstützen wir Unternehmen weltweit dabei, Arbeitsprozesse einfacher, effizienter und zukunftssicher zu gestalten. Mit Niederlassungen in über 40 Ländern und Kunden in mehr als 180 Märkten sind wir ein globaler Partner für Fachwissen und Technologie.

Unsere Lösungen verbinden tiefgehendes Know-how mit innovativen Technologien – inklusive moderner KI-Funktionen – und helfen unseren Kunden, ihre größten Herausforderungen erfolgreich zu meistern. Mehr als 21.000 Kolleginnen und Kollegen weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, Wissen nutzbar zu machen und Arbeitsprozesse neu zu denken.

Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting (TAA)

Die Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting Deutschland GmbH mit Hauptsitz in Ludwigsburg ist Teil der internationalen Wolters Kluwer Gruppe. Mit über 600 Mitarbeitenden an 10 Standorten in Deutschland entwickeln wir Softwarelösungen wie ADDISON, SBS-Software und AKTE, die Steuerberatungskanzleien und Unternehmen in ganz Europa unterstützen.

Allein in Europa vertrauen mehr als 46.000 Steuerberatungskanzleien sowie über 1,5 Millionen kleine und mittelständische Unternehmen auf unsere Lösungen.

Worum es geht

Du entwickelst die nächste Generation unserer Cloud-Lohnabrechnung und arbeitest Dich in eine der spannendsten und fachlich anspruchsvollsten Domänen des deutschen Softwaremarkts ein.

Bei Wolters Kluwer Tax & Accounting entwickeln wir ein Produkt, auf das sich Steuerberater und Unternehmen in ganz Deutschland verlassen, wenn es Monat für Monat um korrekte Gehälter, Steuern und Meldungen geht. Dabei erwarten Dich hunderte Lohnarten, ständig neue Gesetze und komplexe Meldeverfahren wie DEÜV, ELSTER und DaBPV. Entscheidend ist für uns nicht, dass Du dieses Fachwissen bereits mitbringst, sondern dass Du Freude daran hast, Dich in komplexe Themen einzuarbeiten, moderne Softwarelösungen zu entwickeln und mit Werkzeugen wie Claude Code und GitHub Copilot neue Wege zu gehen.

Dein Team

Du arbeitest in einem Team aus Entwickler:innen, Business-Analyst:innen sowie Testautomatisierung. Wir arbeiten in gemeinsamen Sprints, machen regelmäßig Pair Programming und Tech-Demos, und wir probieren KI-Werkzeuge nicht nur aus - wir verwenden sie aktiv in unserem Entwicklungsalltag und binden sie gezielt in unsere Produkte ein.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest Dich in komplexe steuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtliche Anforderungen ein und übersetzt diese gemeinsam mit Fachkolleg:innen in robuste Softwarelösungen.
Du entwickelst Fullstack-Features mit Kotlin und Spring Boot im Backend sowie React im Frontend.
Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge wie Claude Code und GitHub Copilot als festen Teil Deines Entwicklungsalltags und hilfst uns, das Zusammenspiel aus KI und Softwareentwicklung weiter auszubauen.
Du bringst Dich in Architektur- und Designentscheidungen ein, hinterfragst konstruktiv und trägst zu konsensfähigen Lösungen bei.
Du sorgst für hohe Qualität - mit testgetriebener Entwicklung, sauberem Code und einem Blick für Sicherheitsthemen in Web-Anwendungen.

Damit begeisterst du uns

Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Fullstack-Entwicklung mit einer objektorientierten Sprache (Java, Kotlin oder C#) und einem modernen Web-Framework für das Frontend (idealerweise React).
Erfahrung mit Spring Boot, Schnittstellen nach REST-Prinzip, SQL-Datenbanken und Cloud Plattformen.
Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit, sich schnell in neue fachliche Domänen und komplexe Geschäftsprozesse einzuarbeiten.
Praktische Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse am Einsatz von KI-Werkzeugen in der Softwareentwicklung und an modernen Entwicklungsmethoden.
Freude daran, neue Technologien auszuprobieren und die eigene Arbeitsweise kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch.

Schön wäre außerdem

Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Software für die Lohnabrechnung oder Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Steuerrecht, Sozialversicherung und Meldewesen.
Erfahrung mit Microservices, Event-Sourcing oder CQRS.
Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams (wir arbeiten eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen in Rumänien zusammen).
Lust, KI nicht nur im Entwicklungsprozess, sondern auch als Produktfeature zu denken und mitzugestalten.
Freude daran, Wissen aktiv zu teilen - Silo-Denken ist nicht unser Ding.

Damit begeistern wir dich

Sichere Zukunft: Du bekommst eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem internationalen Unternehmen sowie eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit persönlicher Beratung.
Work-Life-Balance: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, an dedizierten Tagen mobil zu arbeiten– so passt der Job zu Deinem Leben.
Arbeiten im Ausland: Du kannst bis zu 20 Tage innerhalb von zwölf Monaten flexibel im Ausland arbeiten.
Karriereentwicklung: Wir unterstützen Dich mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Learning on the Job, internationalen Karriereoptionen und internen sowie externen Weiterbildungen.
Gesundheit & Soziales Engagement: Unser Corporate Benefits Programm bietet Dir alles von JobRad über Lebens- und Rentenberatung. Zusätzlich bekommst Du einen zusätzlichen freien Tag, den Volunteer Day, um soziale Projekte zu unterstützen. Mit unserem Programm „Wolters Kluwer hilft“ unterstützen wir als Unternehmen ebenfalls soziale Projekte.
Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: Du arbeitest mit leistungsstarker IT-Ausstattung, an modernen Arbeitsplätzen mit einem shared desk System, kostenlosen Getränken und in gut angebundenen Bürogebäuden.
Teamspirit: Bei unseren Mitarbeiterevents und über unser Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm erlebst Du echten Zusammenhalt. Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und Raum für Deine Ideen sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

Wir wachsen - wachse mit uns

Hier kannst du deine Ideen verwirklichen, dich weiterentwickeln und wachsen. Wir haben viel zu bieten. Komm zu uns und gestalte mit uns gemeinsam die Zukunft.

Bewirb dich jetzt ganz einfach mit einem Klick auf den Button oben.

Willkommen, sind bei uns alle Menschen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Behinderung, Religion, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Hanna Fischer

Senior Interim Recruiter – Talent Acquisition

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Job Title

Infrastructure Automation Engineer (PowerShell, DSC & DevOps) (M/F/D) (German & English)

Job Description

Technical Products and Services (TPS):

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Job Summary

CSA GD is seeking an engineer with deep hands-on expertise in PowerShell and Desired State Configuration (DSC) to design and deliver Infrastructure-as-Code solutions and reusable delivery assets for enterprise customers. The role is engineering-heavy (software engineering for infrastructure, not basic scripting) and focuses on building and operating production-grade automation frameworks, DSC resources/configurations, and CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps/GitHub for hybrid and cloud environments.

Responsibilities

Engineer and maintain production-grade PowerShell automation (functions, modules, packaging, versioning, release management) with an emphasis on reliability, maintainability, and re-use.
Design, author, and troubleshoot DSC resources and configurations (idempotent behavior; correct Get/Test/Set; LCM troubleshooting; drift detection and remediation).
Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure automation using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub (PR workflows, gated builds, artifact publishing, environment promotion).
Work effectively in and with open-source projects and communities (fork/PR model, upstream collaboration, issue triage, documentation, and contribution hygiene).
Troubleshoot complex PowerShell/DSC issues end-to-end (VS Code debugging, logging/telemetry, remoting, authentication, runspaces, and execution policy constraints).
Translate customer requirements into an automation architecture and implementation plan (scope, assumptions, constraints, and operational model) and deliver through workshops/advisory and hands-on implementation.
Create high-quality engineering documentation (Markdown) and handover materials; coach peers/partners to ramp up on the solution assets.

Qualifications

Must-have / minimum qualifications

Strong software-engineering background in infrastructure automation using PowerShell (advanced functions, modules, classes, error handling, performance, and maintainability). Experience with C# for infrastructure tooling is highly valuable.
Deep Git + platform skills: proven hands-on experience with GitHub and/or Azure DevOps (branching strategies, PR reviews, merge conflict resolution, repo hygiene, releases).
DSC engineering experience: authoring and operating DSC resources/configurations with correct idempotent behavior; troubleshooting LCM execution and configuration drift; experience with at least one of: class-based DSC resources, script-based resources, or DSC v3/DSC CLI concepts.
Code quality: Pester testing strategy (unit/integration), PSScriptAnalyzer (or equivalent), and comfort working with code reviews and CI quality gates.
Open-source collaboration experience: has contributed to or maintained open-source projects (or equivalent multi-contributor codebases), including documentation and issue/PR workflows.
Windows fundamentals: solid knowledge of Windows Server administration and core platform services (e.g., Active Directory, certificates/PKI, networking basics), sufficient to automate and troubleshoot them.
Microsoft365DSC (preferred) or demonstrable ability to ramp up quickly with prior DSC module/resource development.
Customer-facing delivery: ability to run technical workshops, capture requirements, propose architecture, and deliver/hand over automation assets in a structured way.

Nice-to-have Skills

Strong hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions for IaC and configuration pipelines (release strategies, approvals, environments).
Hybrid/on-prem platform experience relevant to DSC-driven deployments (e.g., Hyper-V, Azure Local, Windows Server failover clustering, offline/air-gapped environments).
Security-first automation: secrets management, certificate lifecycle automation, least privilege, and secure coding practices for PowerShell.
Experience with configuration data and templating approaches (YAML/JSON/PSD1), plus packaging/distribution (PowerShell Gallery or internal feeds).
Experience mentoring/ramping up peers or partners on PowerShell/DSC and codebase onboarding.

Relevant Certifications

Microsoft Certified Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)
Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)
Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600)
Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
GitHub Foundations Certification
GitHub Administration Certification
GitHub Actions Certification
GitHub Advanced Security Certification

The role requires around 80% travel, with potential flexibility subject to business requirements.
