jobs.description:
Company Description

Vialto is a market leader in global mobility services. Our purpose is to ‘Connect the world’. We are unique and the only stand-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.

Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work. 

Working at Vialto is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team.  Globally, Vialto has over 8,000 staff and continues to grow.  You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.  

Vialto is unstoppable when we work together in a culture of belonging, where everyone can thrive. We encourage employees to bring their true selves and share their unique talents and expertise to positively impact the communities we serve.

To learn more about what we do, tune in to our podcast On the Move to hear expert insights on issues affecting global mobility, and read about the latest news in the industry.  You can also follow us on Linkedin and Instagram. 

Role Summary

Vialto is hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and operate secure, scalable products that power our Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity offerings for the world’s most complex multinational employers. You will deliver hands-on engineering across Next.js and React front ends and C# and .NET services running on Microsoft Azure, working in a highly regulated, multi-jurisdictional environment where accuracy, auditability, and data privacy are non-negotiable. This role is for an experienced engineer who can own end-to-end features—from cross-border compensation data ingestion to shadow payroll calculation engines to equity event processing—contribute to architectural decisions and consistently deliver production-ready solutions using agentic development practices including spec-driven development and agent-driven development with tools such as Claude Code and Codex. You will build AI-native products and workflows, embedding AI capabilities directly into compensation, payroll, and equity workflows to reduce manual effort and improve global mobility outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Build and evolve modern web experiences for Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity products using Next.js, React, and TypeScript with a focus on performance, reliability, and clarity for tax, payroll, and mobility operators.
Design and implement backend services and APIs using C#, .NET, and WebAPI to support compensation data ingestion, cross-border payroll calculations, equity event processing, and integrations with client HR, payroll, and equity administration systems (e.g., Workday, SAP, ADP, Shareworks, E*TRADE, Carta).
Deliver Azure-native implementations of shadow payroll calculation engines, compensation aggregation pipelines, and equity tax event workflows using Microsoft PaaS services, secure patterns, and operational best practices.
Contribute to system architecture and technical design for multi-country payroll, compensation, and equity domains, including integration patterns using REST, file-based feeds, and event-driven approaches.
Own production readiness for your work including logging, monitoring and alerting, reconciliation tooling, incident response support, and operational documentation—critical for payroll cycles and equity event deadlines that cannot slip.
Apply secure development practices appropriate for handling sensitive compensation, payroll, and equity data including privacy, auditability, segregation of duties, and country-specific data protection requirements (GDPR, SOC 2, country-level payroll regulations).
Partner with product, mobility tax, payroll, and equity subject-matter experts to translate complex regulatory and client requirements into technical plans and deliverables.
Use agentic development practices including agent-driven development with Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI coding agents to accelerate design, implementation, testing, and operations across the SDLC.
Work in a spec-driven development workflow, authoring detailed specifications—including country-specific shadow payroll rules and equity tax treatment—that guide both human and AI agent implementation.
Design and implement AI-powered features within Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity products including intelligent data extraction from compensation statements, anomaly detection on payroll inputs, LLM-assisted user workflows, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over tax and payroll guidance.
Evaluate, integrate, and operationalize AI APIs, models, and toolchains within application architectures, ensuring responsible AI usage, cost management, and observability—especially where AI touches financially material outputs.
Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance on payroll, compensation, and equity domain patterns.

Required Qualifications

5+ years professional software development experience building enterprise web applications and services, ideally including payroll, compensation, equity, HR, finance, or tax domains.
Strong experience designing and building large JavaScript applications with Next.js and/or React (TypeScript, state management, performance optimization).
Strong backend development experience in C# and .NET (ASP.NET, WebAPI, MVC) including API design and service patterns for high-integrity calculation and data-processing systems.
Proven experience with Microsoft Azure designing and building cloud solutions using PaaS services, frameworks, and operational tooling.
Experience delivering systems in regulated or compliance-oriented environments (security controls, auditability, privacy, sensitive financial or personal data handling).
Strong engineering fundamentals including design patterns, separation of concerns, scalable architecture, and pragmatic trade-offs—with attention to accuracy and reconciliation in calculation-heavy systems.
Experience with agentic or AI-assisted development workflows such as spec-driven development, agent-driven development using tools like Claude Code or Codex, or similar AI coding agent practices.
Demonstrated ability to build products that incorporate AI capabilities including prompt design, LLM API integration, or AI-augmented user experiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Direct experience building or integrating with payroll, shadow payroll, compensation collection, equity administration, or global mobility tax platforms.
Familiarity with cross-border compensation concepts: gross-to-net calculations, hypothetical tax, tax equalization, modified shadow payroll, and equity-related compensation events (RSU vest, ISO/NSO exercise, ESPP).
Experience integrating with HCM, payroll, and equity systems such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, Ceridian/Dayforce, Shareworks, E*TRADE, Carta, or country-specific payroll engines.
Azure certifications and/or Microsoft certifications.
Experience with event-based and distributed systems including messaging and asynchronous workflows for payroll cycles and equity event processing.
Data and persistence experience with SQL Server and ORMs (Entity Framework, nHibernate) plus caching strategies; experience modeling compensation, payroll, and equity data is a strong plus.
Strong testing discipline including TDD and BDD, xUnit, Jest or Mocha, CI/CD automation, and quality gates—especially for calculation engines requiring reconciliation and regression coverage.
Experience building analytics and reporting with BI and data visualization tools, including payroll reconciliation, compensation analytics, and equity reporting.
Exposure to mobile ecosystems (iOS and Android) and API design supporting mobile clients for assignee/employee experiences.
Experience with prompt engineering patterns, RAG architectures, vector databases, or AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Services).
Familiarity with AI code generation and review workflows, including evaluating and curating AI-generated code for production readiness in regulated financial workflows.

Technical Skills We Value

Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, SPA architecture, performance and accessibility
Backend: C#, ASP.NET, WebAPI, RESTful design, authentication and authorization patterns, high-integrity calculation services
Cloud: Azure PaaS services, observability, secure networking, identity, deployment automation
Domain: Compensation Collection workflows, Shadow Payroll calculation and reporting, Equity event processing and tax treatment, cross-border payroll integrations
Engineering practices: Git-based workflows, secure SDLC, spec-driven development, AI-assisted code reviews, automated testing, reconciliation tooling, documentation
AI-enabled delivery: agentic development using Claude Code, Codex, or similar AI coding agents; spec-driven development workflows; prompt engineering; LLM API integration; RAG patterns; AI orchestration frameworks; responsible AI practices and observability

What Success Looks Like

Delivers complex Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity features end-to-end with high quality, predictable timelines, and production readiness aligned to payroll cycles and equity event deadlines.
Produces clean, maintainable code—whether hand-written or AI-generated—with strong test coverage, reconciliation checks, and clear documentation.
Identifies and resolves performance, reliability, accuracy, and security issues before they reach production or affect a client’s payroll or equity event.
Contributes meaningfully to architecture and raises standards through code reviews and technical leadership across the compensation, payroll, and equity domains.
Communicates clearly with engineering, product, and domain experts; flags risks early; and collaborates effectively across teams and geographies.
Effectively leverages agentic development tools and AI-augmented workflows to increase velocity while maintaining the quality, accuracy, and security standards required for regulated financial workflows.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field required.
Master’s degree preferred.

Why This Role

You’ll help build and scale the technology behind Compensation Collection, Shadow Payroll, and Equity—the engines that keep globally mobile employees of the world’s largest multinationals paid accurately, taxed correctly, and compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll modernize and operate a platform that sits at the intersection of complex tax regulations, sensitive financial and personal data, and high-stakes global payroll and equity events. You’ll also work at the forefront of AI-augmented engineering, using agentic development practices and building AI-powered product experiences that redefine how global mobility compensation, payroll, and equity technology is delivered.

We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status.

About Quantum Base

Quantum Base exists to make quantum science useful. Founded at Lancaster University in 2015 by Professor Robert Young, we have spent a decade solving a problem the security industry had accepted as unsolvable: authentication that is impossible to copy, clone or fake, yet simple enough for anyone to use.

Our core technology, Q-ID®, is an authentication fingerprint built on quantum physics that anyone can authenticate in under three seconds with the smartphone already in their pocket. Impossibly simple. Atomically secure.

Q-ID® is protected by more than 40 patents, has undergone independent adversarial testing, and is already protecting around two billion products worldwide across tax stamps, pharmaceuticals, alcohol, luxury goods, FMCG, automotive, aerospace, secure documents and more. We work with printers and brands to make quantum technology practical and accessible for any product, anywhere in the world.

Quantum Base is headquartered in Lancaster and listed on the London Stock Exchange (LON: QUBE) in 2025. See Q-ID® in action: https://www.quantumbase.com/how-q-id-works

In this contract you will be checking the cloud infrastructure is compliant across; FFIEC, state banking department, Federal Reserve, OCC/FDIC, NY DFS Part 500 Cybersecurity Regulation (23 NYCRR 500), Federal Reserve Requirements eg Operating Circular 5, NIST, ISO27001, FFIEC, NY DFS, SOC 2 etc.

This is assurance, not build. If you want to be architecting and deploying the controls yourself, you'll find this frustrating. It also needs someone comfortable working on their own initiative, because the team around you is a couple of security engineers and analysts rather than a department.

Non-Negotiables

Regulatory interpretation – reading regulation and saying what it means in practice for the Azure cloud build. US, UK, EU or any other financial service regulation experience is ok
Azure: hands-on cloud architecture knowledge
Security architecture across network, cloud, application and data, gained in financial services
Architecture and data-flow diagrams clear enough to put in front of an auditor
Threat modelling and attack surface analysis: running it, then writing it up
Evidence trackers: building and maintaining large audit documentation sets for a regulatory programme
Control assurance: judging whether what has been built actually works, and saying so plainly
At least one of financial NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, FFIEC or NY DFS Part 500 or other country equivalents are OK
5+ years in security or enterprise architecture

What You'll Work With

A newly built Azure cloud and platform estate
A SaaS core banking platform
Banking regulation across multiple jurisdictions, including US requirements
Penetration test findings and what they mean for the control set
An in-house infrastructure and cloud team who build what you assess
A security lead who needs your work to sign off with confidence

Nice to Haves

FFIEC IT Examination Handbook, particularly Information Security and Architecture, Infrastructure & Operations
NY DFS Part 500, including CISO reporting, MFA, encryption and third party requirements
Preparing documentation for a charter, licence application or regulatory examination
New bank builds or banking authorisation programmes
SaaS core banking platform migrations
Penetration testing oversight and remediation tracking

Why Join / Projects

You're assessing infrastructure that's new, not untangling twenty years of accumulated decisions. The estate has been built properly, and your job is to prove it, find the gaps, and produce the evidence that lets the bank be regulated for the USA market.

Day to day you'll map the Azure and platform controls back to the regulations the bank has to meet, then produce the artefacts that prove it: architecture and data-flow diagrams an examiner can follow, threat models and attack surface analysis, and an evidence tracker that holds the whole control set together. You'll pick up penetration test findings and work out what they change. You report to the security lead with no layers in between, so decisions happen in a conversation rather than a committee.

They're moving quickly on this one, so apply and I'll give you a call to talk it through.

Il s'agit d'une petite équipe autonome où le jugement sénior a un impact exponentiel : il/elle va définir la manière dont l'équipe conçoit, révise et livre ses solutions, y compris la façon dont nous utilisons les outils d'IA agentique comme partie intégrante de notre pratique de développement.

Ce que vous allez faire

Diriger la conception de bout en bout pour l'ingestion, les Pipelines, le stockage et les requêtes ClickHouse, ainsi que les tableaux de bord sur lesquels les développeur(se)s s'appuient.
Rédiger et maintenir des services Go de haute qualité capables de gérer à grande échelle des entrées contrôlées par des acteurs malveillants, avec une attention particulière à la fiabilité, à la performance et à la clarté des contrats de données.
Rehausser les standards de revue de code et de revue de résultats assistés par l'IA — définir les normes utilisées par l'équipe lorsqu'elle livre des travaux en collaboration avec des agents de codage.
Collaborer avec les différentes équipes (Data, IAP, Unity Profiler, DevX, Analytics) afin de concevoir des intégrations robustes en conditions de production et adaptées aux besoins réels des client(e)s.
Encadrer les développeur(se)s de l'équipe, partager largement les bons modèles, et décomposer des problèmes ambigus en parcours concrets maximisant la valeur.

Ce que nous recherchons

Avoir une expérience en production avec Go dans des services à haut débit, ainsi qu'une aisance sur un large éventail de tâches backend (ingestion, Pipelines, stockage et requêtes OLAP/colonnaires, tableaux de bord au besoin).
Démontrer un jugement de niveau sénior : avoir mené des conceptions transversales, rehaussé le niveau de développement, et mentoré les pairs et collaborateur(rice)s individuel(le)s autour de soi.
Posséder une réelle expérience pratique des flux de travail avec IA agentique : avoir utilisé des agents de codage (Claude Code, Codex, mode agent de Cursor, Gemini CLI ou équivalent) sur du travail concret, développé une opinion éclairée sur leurs compromis, et conçu des harnais, prompts ou sous-agents robustes face à la variance. Revoir les sorties de modèles avec la même rigueur que des revues de PR, et être capable de défendre chaque ligne de code en ses propres mots.
Avoir de l'expérience en conception et en interrogation de magasins de données NoSQL ou OLAP/colonnaires (ClickHouse est un atout), ainsi qu'une compréhension pratique de bout en bout des Pipelines de données.
Posséder d'excellentes aptitudes de collaboration et de communication, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre plusieurs équipes et fuseaux horaires.

Vous avez peut-être également

Manifester un intérêt sincère ou une expérience en observabilité et télémétrie (OpenTelemetry en particulier) — c'est notre cœur de métier.
Avoir une expérience front-end avec TypeScript et des contributions à des surfaces de type tableau de bord. Le backend est la priorité pour ce rôle; les compétences front-end sont un atout bienvenu, sans être une attente quotidienne.
Avoir une expérience en production avec Kotlin, ou une exposition à C# du côté du moteur.
Posséder un parcours dans le domaine du jeu vidéo — comprendre comment les développeur(se)s consomment les diagnostics, et ce que la performance et le profilage d'un jeu signifient concrètement pour eux/elles.
Adopter des habitudes responsables dans la gestion des données des utilisateur(rice)s : tenir compte des frontières de confiance, de la rétention, de la journalisation hygiénique (aucune donnée personnelle identifiable, aucun jeton, aucun contenu complet de charge utile) et de la modélisation des menaces avant d'implémenter une fonctionnalité.

Information supplémentaire

Le support à la relocalisation n'est pas disponible pour ce poste
Un visa de travail ou un parrainage de l'immigration n'est pas disponible pour ce poste

The opportunity

Developing the Unity platform means designing, building, testing, and maintaining the systems that empower developers to ship and operate live games at scale. The Diagnostics team sits inside Unity's LiveOps umbrella and is responsible for the data that tells creators how their games are actually behaving in the wild — crash reports from the Unity runtime, telemetry and observability across customer projects, product health analysis, and the Unity Dashboard surfaces that put that data back in developers' hands.

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer to join the Diagnostics team as a backend-leaning generalist. You will lead end-to-end design across our stack — ingest from millions of game clients, pipelines built on OpenTelemetry, a ClickHouse-based data lake, and the dashboard surfaces customers depend on — and you will partner closely with the Data, IAP, Profiler, and DevX teams on the integrations that make Diagnostics useful. Our stack is Go (primary), Kotlin, TypeScript, and C#. This is a small, autonomous team where senior judgment compounds: you will shape how the team designs, reviews, and ships, including how we work with agentic AI tools as a core part of the craft.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead end-to-end design across ingest, pipelines, ClickHouse storage and query, and the dashboards developers rely on.
Write and maintain high-quality Go services that handle attacker-controlled inputs at scale, with strong attention to reliability, performance, and clean data contracts.
Raise the bar on code review and AI-assisted output review — set the norms the team uses when shipping work alongside coding agents.
Partner across teams (Data, IAP, Unity Profiler, DevX, Analytics) to design integrations that hold up under real production load and real customer needs.
Mentor engineers across the team, share patterns broadly, and decompose ambiguous problems into the highest-value path forward.

What We're Looking For

Production experience with Go in high-throughput services, plus comfort moving across a backend-leaning generalist surface (ingest, pipelines, OLAP/columnar storage and query, dashboards when needed).
Demonstrated senior-level judgment: a track record of leading cross-cutting design, raising the engineering bar, and mentoring peers and ICs around you.
Real, hands-on fluency with agentic AI workflows — you have used coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor agent mode, Gemini CLI, or similar) on real work, formed informed opinions about their trade-offs, and built harnesses, prompts, or sub-agents that hold up under variance. You review model output as rigorously as PR code, and can defend any line of it in your own words.
Experience designing for and querying NoSQL or OLAP/columnar data stores (ClickHouse a plus), and a working understanding of data pipelines end to end.
Excellent collaboration and communication, with the ability to work effectively across teams and time zones.

You might also have

Genuine interest or experience in observability and telemetry (OpenTelemetry especially) — this is our bread and butter.
Front-end experience with TypeScript and contributions to dashboard-style surfaces. Backend is the primary lens for this role; front-end capability is a welcome bonus, not a daily expectation.
Production experience with Kotlin, or C# exposure on the engine side.
Gaming background — context for how developers consume diagnostics, what game performance and profiling actually mean to them.
Habits around handling user data responsibly: thinking about trust boundaries, retention, hygienic logging (no PII, no tokens, no full payloads), and threat-modeling features before writing them.

Additional Information

Work visa/immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

La vie chez Unity

Unity [NYSE : U] est le premier moteur de jeu au monde, propulsant les expériences de plus de 3 milliards d’utilisateurs(rices) chaque mois. Les plus grands jeux mobiles, les titres indépendants PC les plus populaires, des jeux console parmi les plus innovants, ainsi que la quasi-totalité des principales expériences XR et jeux Web sont développés, déployés et optimisés avec Unity.

You will help deliver quality automated CI/CD pipelines, from requirements through test and behaviour driven development, whilst maintaining operational stability and high coding standards, together with supporting quality deployments, monitoring of the tech stack and overall production health.

The main outcome for this role is dependable delivery — well-tested, well-documented code shipped with minimal disruption to the business — and steady growth towards owning larger pieces of work independently. You will be part of our engineering chapter and will contribute to a DevSecOps culture towards build and run.

System design and architecture

Contribute to the design of integration solutions using .NET technologies and event-driven architecture, working to the technical approach set by the Lead Engineer and within the agreed architecture blueprint
Work with cross-functional colleagues (product management, architects, business analysts) to understand business requirements and translate them into technical tasks
Raise design questions, risks and unknowns early rather than resolving them alone

Integration development

Develop and implement .NET-based integration components under the technical direction of a Senior or Lead Engineer, ensuring correct data flow across platforms, systems and applications
Write automated, reusable, testable and efficient code, applying Pandora engineering standards for performance, security and scalability
Participate actively in pair programming and code review — both submitting your work and reviewing the work of peers
Write and maintain unit and integration tests within the team's automated testing frameworks
Maintain technical documentation for the components you build — integration mappings, API specifications and troubleshooting notes
Identify opportunities to simplify or improve existing integrations and propose them to the team

Deployment and operations support

Prepare and execute deployments of your changes into non-production environments, and support production deployments alongside a more senior engineer
Provide post-deployment support and monitoring; join the on-duty engineering roster once onboarded, with a defined escalation path to Senior and Lead Engineers
Investigate and resolve incidents and defects affecting the components you work on, escalating promptly when an issue crosses system boundaries

Ensure changes comply with security standards, privacy regulations and company policies; raise anything unclear with the Lead Engineer or Information Security rather than working around it

We are super excited to announce that Jimmy Sigwid is looking for our next Staff Software Engineer
to join our Data & Integrations product area and Team Points.

Our mission is to make loyalty, incentives and customer data scalable, reliable and actionable across Voyado’s platform. Behind that mission are systems handling business-critical transactions and data for some of the world’s leading brands — and as Voyado and our customers grow, so do the technical challenges we need to solve.

A key focus going forward is evolving our platform architecture to support greater scale, stronger domain ownership and more independent services. This means working with everything from distributed systems and data consistency to event-driven architecture and service boundaries.

About The Role

The Points team owns the systems behind how consumers earn and use loyalty points and rewards across Voyado’s retail customers. Whether someone earns points from a purchase, uses them towards a reward, or interacts with a loyalty program across different channels, our services help make that experience possible.

These are business-critical systems that need to remain fast, reliable and consistent as transaction volumes and use cases grow.

Right now, the team is in the middle of an exciting technical transition. We are evolving parts of the architecture to handle greater scale, reduce dependencies between domains and make it easier for teams to evolve their services independently. A large part of this means moving towards more event-driven and service-oriented patterns and rethinking how services and data interact.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll be one of the technical drivers behind that evolution. You’ll work hands-on with backend development and distributed systems while helping the team make architectural decisions that need to hold up over time.

The role combines deep technical work with technical leadership. You’ll drive complex initiatives, mentor other engineers and collaborate across teams to improve both our platform and the way we build software.

So, who are you?

We’re looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical depth with the ability to influence technical direction beyond their immediate team.

You enjoy taking ownership of complex technical problems where the solution isn’t always obvious. You’re comfortable creating clarity, evaluating trade-offs and bringing other engineers along in the direction you propose — while still staying close to the code.

You don’t need experience from our exact stack, but we believe you have worked with several of the following:

Backend development in C#, .NET, Java, Kotlin, Go, or similar
Distributed systems, cloud-native services and event-driven architectures
REST APIs, asynchronous workflows and message-based systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ or Azure Service Bus
SQL databases, transactional consistency and scalable data handling
Observability, automated testing and secure engineering practices

Enjoy driving technical direction and improving engineering practices
Are comfortable mentoring and supporting other engineers
Can lead technical initiatives that span teams or domains
Use AI coding tools as a natural part of software development and see AI-assisted engineering as an important capability going forward as we continue our journey toward becoming AI-native

Experience with high-volume transactional systems
, such as fintech, payments, loyalty or similar domains, is a strong plus — but previous retail experience is not required.

What's in it for you?

Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers and some examples of what we can offer you are:

An engaged team with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture
Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture, we value engagement over hours worked.
An office-first but flexible hybrid working policy.

Some of our benefits:

30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
Breakfast buffet on Fridays
Inhouse gym only for Voyadoers
A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
Parental leave top-up additional support for new parents
A wellness hour you can use every week

About Voyado

Voyado is the agentic CX suite for retail. We help retailers of all sizes to create exceptional experiences – from first click to lasting loyalty. Our products help retailers understand customers, predict behaviors, and deliver personalized journeys that drive conversion and loyalty.

With offices in Sweden, the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands, we work with hundreds of leading retailers like H&M, Stronger, Nudie Jeans, and Power. Voyado is backed by Viking Global Investors, Novax, Verdane, eEquity, and H&M Group.

We at Voyado strive to make everyone feel like they can bring their true self to work every day. Gender-equal and diverse teams have more perspectives on life and bring different ideas to the table which in the end leads not only to making a better working environment but also a better product.

Ready to find out more?

Lovely! 🎉

Making it personal with AI

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description:
MongoDB is looking for an outstanding person to join our newly created Forward Deployed Engineering team and take on a key role in our extended R&D organization. Forward Deployed Engineering is linking the work of teams engaged on application modernization roles with our Product and Engineering teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin or Cork for our hybrid working model.

Many organizations have built up large estates of legacy applications. Lack of scalability and resilience, long development times, operating cost, and inability to run on cloud are common issues with these applications. To address these issues, organizations are engaging in large transformational Application Modernisation programs. MongoDB is recognized as the developer data platform of choice for transactional systems that provide the best scalability, resiliency and developer experience in the cloud as well as on premises. Organizations are continuously migrating workloads from these legacy applications to new platforms, often based on microservices, using MongoDB.

Such transformations are time intensive and often risky. Tooling based on generative AI promises to accelerate these transformations in a way never seen before. Forward Deployed Engineering is responsible for exploring the possibilities of Generative AI technologies and providing invaluable feedback to MongoDB’s R&D teams to drive future capabilities of MongoDB and the MongoDB ecosystem.

Application Modernization Engineers will work alongside project teams that are executing Application Modernisation projects with customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluation, build, and applying tools in modernization projects, facilitating the usage of such tools and processes across the different project teams, identifying opportunities for tooling deployment, selecting potential 3rd party tools, contributing to the development of tooling prototypes and helping to shape the product roadmap.

Our ideal candidate will have

4+ years of experience as a field engineer or professional services consultant or full stack developer working directly with Enterprise clients
Proficiency in Java or C#, and some familiarity with common database access patterns and frameworks in one or more of these languages
Strong knowledge about enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations
Experience developing enterprise applications using relational databases, and employing SQL and stored procedures with Oracle, MS SQL Server, Sybase and/or PostgreSQL databases
Experience of using and developing with MongoDB and JSON based Document models is highly desirable
Problem solving skills, including the ability to collaborate across disciplines and teams to come up with creative solutions to technical and business challenges
Willingness to dive into a complex domain, ask the right questions, and bring new software tools and technologies to the table to solve customer problems
Great communication skills (both spoken and written), within the team and in customer meetings
Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, tools, and services. Any experience to build new applications/tools using Generative AI is a big plus. That includes Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini, and OpenAI APIs
And finally, a strong interest in how AI supported toolchains can improve application development

Position Expectations

Contribute to customer application modernization initiatives at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: assessment and analysis; planning and design; data modeling; application code conversion, development, test and build; integration and release configuration, production operations, application optimisation, and best practices adoption
Test drive MongoDB migration products to deliver on customer use cases and drive adoption of the product. Deliver concise feedback to the rest of the development organisation
Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap
Personally execute POCs including developing or extending existing tools when necessary and appropriate for customer success, with an eye towards reusability and eventual integration with our products. These are often on premises at client locations
Maintain a broad and deep technical understanding of the product line and the underlying technologies and protocols
Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising consulting engineers from MongoDB Professional Services, project managers, and account teams
Assist sales teams in evaluating opportunities with prospects and customers
Willingness to work on site with customers for 7 days per month, which includes regional travel (within Europe)

Success Measures

The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

Become an expert level user of MongoDB, and our tools current migration products
Develop a playbook for customer application modernization engagements, in collaboration with other MongoDB Engineers, Product Management and Engineering
Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences
Provide unique insight into customer needs, product requirements and strategic opportunities by contributing experience from the field
Gain the reputation as a trusted advisor with our field teams and customers
Contribute to the success of customer application migration initiatives that they support

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Internal Platform and APIs - Greenstep Espoo
jobs.description:
Have you ever looked at a sprawling internal IT estate and known exactly how much smaller and safer it could be?
We have one. Hundreds of repositories and thousands of Azure Functions, Logic Apps and low-code flows, built by many hands over many years. We are looking for one person to own turning it into a small number of well-designed, centralized APIs running on Kubernetes.

Greenstep is a Finnish, family-owned growth company
founded in 2010 that provides high-quality technology and back-office services to support its clients' growth and success. Today we are a community of more than 800 experts
working in the Nordics and across Europe. We have grown organically, and today Greenstep has people in Finland, Åland, Sweden, Norway, Estonia, Denmark and the Netherlands. We share one goal: to help growth companies become leaders in their fields.

Our internal automation grew as fast as the company did. It works, mostly, and nobody can see all of it. That is the problem you will solve.

The Role

You own the target architecture for Greenstep's internal platform
and you build a large part of it yourself. You lead our internal developers technically,
and you decide what gets consolidated, what gets rewritten and what gets deleted. Deleting is a big part of the job.

What will you do as a Staff Engineer:

Set and own the target architecture and build most of it. A handful of centralized, versioned APIs with clear ownership, running on AKS, with authentication, observability and access control solved once instead of in every repo.
Inventory the estate, then shrink it. You map what exists, decide what gets consolidated, what gets rewritten and what gets deleted. Deleting is a big part of the job.
Design the migration so it is boring. Functions and Kubernetes run side by side while traffic shifts incrementally. No big-bang cutover, no weekend where payroll stops.
Move business logic out of low-code. HR, payroll, finance and client onboarding flows become services that can be tested, versioned and reused.
Build the platform, not just the services. Service templates, CI/CD, GitOps, infrastructure as code, secrets handling, API gateway, tracing and metrics. You set the standard by shipping it first.
Make agentic development normal here. Migrating thousands of functions by hand is not realistic. You design the workflow, the review gates and the guardrails that keep AI-generated code safe to put in front of payroll data, and you use these tools heavily yourself.
Lead the internal developers technically. Architecture reviews, pairing, code review, and a roadmap business stakeholders can actually follow.
Partner with the App Factory staff engineer, who owns the internal applications, so those apps consume your APIs instead of talking to source systems directly.

What We're Looking For

You have taken a sprawling estate and made it smaller and safer before. You can describe what you kept, what you killed, and how you got people to agree.
You are as comfortable
in a design review as you are explaining to a payroll team why their flow is being replaced and what they gain.

What you bring:

7+ years in software and cloud engineering, including several years leading platform or API consolidation at scale. You can describe an estate you made smaller: what you kept, what you killed, and how you got people to agree.
Deep Python backend experience, and the judgment to know when a service should not be Python at all.
Production Kubernetes you have operated, not just deployed: Helm, GitOps, ingress, secrets, resource limits, upgrades.
Event-driven workloads on Kubernetes, specifically KEDA or equivalent. You know why scale-to-zero and queue-depth scaling decide whether this migration saves money or costs it.
Azure fluency: networking, security, Entra ID, Workload Identity, Key Vault, API Management, Functions and Logic Apps, including how to migrate off the parts that should not be there.
Terraform, as the single source of truth for infrastructure. State management, modules, drift, and a review process that treats infrastructure changes like code changes.
Security as a default, not a review stage. Centralizing payroll and HR APIs across six jurisdictions means centralizing trust: least privilege, managed identity over secrets, auditability, data residency, ISO 27001 and GDPR in the design rather than bolted on after.
Deliberate, heavy use of AI coding agents to write and refactor in volume, and clear opinions about where they fail.
Technical leadership without a management title.
Working language is English. Finnish helps when working with Finnish business teams but is not required.

Extra but not mandatory:
Reading Go well enough to debug the tooling you depend on.

You join Greenstep's internal technology team, which builds and runs the platforms our 800 experts use every day. You work alongside our internal developers, the BI Book product team and our data and analytics specialists,
and directly with the business owners in HR, payroll and finance whose processes run on the platform.

Why Greenstep?

Greenstep Oy is a family company
founded in 2010 that provides high-quality services to support its clients' business and growth. Every Greenstepper matters to us, and alongside interesting work we want to offer excellent employment for everyone. You join a community where expertise,
responsibility and caring for each other show in everyday work. Across Greenstep we are already a network of more than 800 experts. Together we move forward while building our own professional expertise.

💚 Support for your well-being.
For us, everyone's well-being and well-being at work are top priorities. Our occupational health is comprehensive, and our offices are ergonomically designed. The Flex benefit and lunch discount offered through Epassi are available to you. However, the number one thing that supports your well-being at work is a sustainably built resource budget.

💚 A salary model
that matches your responsibilities and experience. All Greenstep employees are also included in our Together bonus,
through which we share 10% of the annual operating profit among all employees, regardless of role.

💚 Support and time for development

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Web Platform
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Web Platform team here at Unity. Unity's Web platform lets games and real-time 3D content run in a browser, on any internet connected device. Browser capability has moved fast, browser gaming is going through a revival, and the Unity Web runtime is what makes it possible. Our work also supports an exciting new partnership with a major platform, which puts what this team builds in front of audiences at a scale few browser platforms reach.

In this role, you will own meaningful areas of the runtime outright. This is not website development. We embed Unity inside the browser, and the problems are the deep ones: making a single-threaded platform multi-threaded, cutting megabytes out of a build, getting a game playable in seconds rather than minutes. You will work alongside engineers who helped invent the browser technology we build on, and you will help the people around you grow.

What You'll Be Doing

Own meaningful areas of the Unity Web runtime, from design through to release
Research, design and implement optimizations to the Web build target, such as stripping unused code from builds and progressively loading assets as a game needs them
Improve download size, load and startup performance for Web builds, and set measurable targets for it
Solve uncommon, low-level problems across C++, C# and JavaScript, for example bringing multi-threading to parts of the runtime that are single-threaded today
Partner with teams across Unity who build on the Web platform, translating what they need into platform work
Mentor teammates and help set the bar for code quality across the team
Keep Unity at the frontier of the Web's constantly evolving capabilities

What We're Looking For

Deep, hands-on proficiency with C++ in performance sensitive code
Development experience with WebAssembly, using Emscripten and/or LLVM
Ability to decompose complex technical problems and complete them on your own technical judgment
Experience profiling, debugging and optimizing across the native and browser boundary
Working knowledge of C# and JavaScript
Effective written/verbal communication with peers, managers and key decision makers in other teams
A proven track record of mentoring engineers and raising code quality standards

You might also have

Experience contributing to a browser engine or browser runtime
Deeper domain knowledge of rendering, physics or audio in a real-time 3D engine
Familiarity with compression methodologies and build size reduction

What You'll Be Working On

You'll join Merkle's Aarhus software team to help develop an API Management system exposing endpoints from a marketplace for aircraft spare parts. You'll work primarily on the Backend-for-Frontend (BFF), handling users and applications against a database, running in Azure.

Methods and technologies

Java & Spring Boot
REST API development
Docker & Azure deployments
SCRUM & Jira, and agile methods
Git
CI/CD and version control workflows
Unit testing and automated E2E testing

Tasks And Responsibilities

Build and maintain backend solutions in Java/Spring Boot, including REST endpoints and integration with external services
Gain practical experience with unit tests, automated E2E testing, and debugging
Learn how a modern API Management system fits together (frontend, BFF, database, and platforms such as SAP APIM and Entra ID)
Understand the professional development process, from business requirements to running code via version control, code review, and CI/CD
Collaborate through pair programming and agile methods, contributing your own solution proposals

Personal And Professional Skills

You come from a relevant education in IT and software development
You are curious and willing to learn
You are engaging and open, and can work both independently and in teams
You are thorough, professional, and quality minded

Backend development and API management are becoming a bigger and bigger part of our company, and right now we are growing every year. As an intern you will get a lot of interesting and challenging tasks. You will get great knowledge of modern software development methods, cloud deployment, and of how it is to work in an innovative company. It is very important to us that you learn a lot, evolve personally, and that we have fun while doing it. There will be an opportunity to be hired afterwards if it is a great match.

About Merkle

Merkle is the strong combination of local and global. We are more than 200 colleagues here in Denmark and part of Merkle worldwide with more than 11,000 people. Merkle is a leader in data-driven customer experience management (CXM), and we deliver unique, personalized customer experiences across channels and devices.

We are also part of dentsu – a global agency network with more than 46,000 dedicated employees in 145 markets. But size isn't everything. At Merkle, our mission is to help our clients provide their customers with the best experiences possible. More than anything, this requires skills, passion and cooperation.

We provide expertise in customer experience strategy and consulting, user experience design, CRM, data management, commerce, mobile, content management systems (CMS), adtech and martech platforms.

Where, when and how?

We are located at the center of Aarhus with a nice office at Åboulevarden 18, 2. sal, 8000 Aarhus C.

The internship will be from mid-January and for the following 3–4 months, and in that period, there will also be time to make your project in cooperation with Merkle. The internship is fulltime and unpaid - but we do offer a lot of social events, lots of learning opportunities and free breakfast and lunch.

Is your heart racing a little now? If you can see yourself in all this - both the internship and being part of Merkle - don't hesitate. Send us your CV and application as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer – Healthcare Integrations & Systems
jobs.description:
Who is FluidAI?

FluidAI Medical is creating a paradigm shift in post-operative care, utilizing the plethora of data within the body, to help in the detection of post-operative complications at their onset. Our clinically validated platform sensing technology augments existing wound drains and catheters, providing healthcare providers with a smart monitoring tool that can support earlier detection of deadly complications and enhance the delivery of care.
We are an equal-opportunity employer and have a diverse team representation across language, ethnicity, gender and nationality.

Why join FluidAI Medical?

Mission to save lives and improve patient care with revolutionary technology that's already deployed on patients in real-world settings.
Work with a high-performing and cross-functional team that is empowered to grow, learn, and contribute across all levels of the organization.
We are a team of passionate builders and boundary-breakers that are on a singular mission to disrupt how patient care is done. We aim to succeed and perform together - as a team and as individuals.
Gain exposure across the entire technical stack, from novel sensing technologies and proprietary hardware to mobile/web software and ML algorithms.
Personal career-focused development and training with access to workshops, coursework, and experienced mentors/consultants.

Backend Engineer – Healthcare Integrations & Systems

FluidAI Medical is at the forefront of integrating data, technology, and healthcare to improve patient outcomes. Our platform generates rich, high-frequency clinical data at the bedside, and for that data to change how care is delivered it must flow reliably into the systems clinicians already use. We are expanding our team to include a Backend Engineer who can design and build the integration layer that connects our platform to hospital EHRs, laboratory and device systems, and national health data exchanges.
This role is ideal for a hands-on backend engineer with strong experience building production APIs and services, deep familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 FHIR and HL7 v2, and a track record of shipping and supporting integrations in live hospital environments. Experience with EHR vendor integration (e.g., Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, InterSystems) and regional health information exchange requirements is highly preferred.
This position is remote but requires travel across the Middle East to collaborate with the FluidAI team, hospital IT departments, and clients.

Responsibilities

🔌 Design, build, and maintain the integration services that exchange clinical data between the FluidAI platform and hospital systems (EHRs, LIS, ADT feeds, device gateways, and national health exchanges).
🧬 Implement and maintain HL7 FHIR APIs and resources (e.g., Patient, Encounter, Observation, Device, DiagnosticReport) as well as HL7 v2 message interfaces (ADT, ORU, ORM) for inbound and outbound data flows.
🏗️ Build clean, well-tested, production-grade backend services and APIs (REST and event-driven) that are secure, observable, and resilient to the realities of hospital networks.
🗺️ Own data mapping and transformation logic between FluidAI's internal data models and external standards, including terminology mapping (LOINC, SNOMED CT, UCUM) and vendor-specific profile variations.
🔁 Develop robust interface engine and integration patterns: message queuing, retries, deduplication, acknowledgement handling, idempotency, and reconciliation.
🏥 Lead the technical side of hospital onboarding: gather interface requirements, conduct connectivity and message testing with hospital IT and EHR analysts, and support go-live and hypercare.
🔍 Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging for integration health so that message failures and data gaps are caught early and traced end-to-end.
🔐 Apply healthcare security and privacy best practices, including OAuth2/SMART on FHIR, mutual TLS, VPN connectivity, audit logging, and data minimization, in line with regional regulations (e.g., Saudi NPHIES/SeHE requirements, HIPAA, PIPEDA).
📚 Create and maintain clear technical documentation: interface specifications, FHIR implementation guides, integration runbooks, and data flow diagrams.
🤝 Partner with product, clinical, regulatory, and QA teams to ensure integrations meet clinical workflow needs and medical device software standards (e.g., IEC 62304, ISO 13485 processes).
🏃‍♂️ Participate in sprint planning and Agile ceremonies, contributing to roadmap planning and prioritization from an integrations and platform perspective.
🔧 Collaborate closely with software, hardware, data, and ML teams to expose reliable data services across the full technology stack.

Qualifications

📚 Strong hands-on experience as a Backend Engineer, Integration Engineer, or Interoperability Engineer, ideally within healthcare or medical technology.
🧬 Deep working knowledge of HL7 FHIR (R4 and/or R5), including resource modelling, profiles, extensions, search, and bulk data, and hands-on experience with FHIR servers or SDKs (e.g., HAPI FHIR, Firely, Microsoft/Azure FHIR, Google Cloud Healthcare API).
📨 Solid experience with HL7 v2.x messaging, including message structure, segments, ACK/NACK handling, and common workflows (ADT, ORU, ORM, MDM).
🔌 Experience with integration/interface engines such as Mirth Connect (NextGen Connect), Rhapsody, InterSystems, Cloverleaf, or equivalent custom pipelines.
💻 High proficiency in at least one backend language such as Python, Java/Kotlin, C#/.NET, Go, or TypeScript/Node.js, with strong API design skills (REST, OpenAPI, webhooks) and familiarity with message brokers (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT).
🗄️ Strong SQL and data modelling skills with relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle) and familiarity with NoSQL or time-series stores.
☁️ Experience deploying and operating services in cloud and hybrid environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; CI/CD; infrastructure as code), including on-premise hospital deployments.
🔐 Working knowledge of healthcare security and identity standards: OAuth2/OIDC, SMART on FHIR, TLS/mTLS, encryption at rest and in transit, and audit requirements.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and entrepreneurial Lead Software Engineer to architect, build, and scale the core trading infrastructure for a newly formed quantitative trading pod. You will lead the design and deployment of systems that support systematic strategies operating across global markets and time zones.

This is a hands-on leadership role at the intersection of technology, research, and trading - you'll collaborate directly with quantitative researchers and the Senior Portfolio Manager to turn ideas into production-ready strategies.

The pod is led by a Senior Portfolio Manager with 15+ years of experience and a proven track record in alpha generation, strategy development, and risk management at top-tier quant firms. This is a unique opportunity to own the technology stack from day one, influence strategic direction, and help shape a high-performance team in a collaborative and intellectually rigorous environment.

Location

Dubai

Principal Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture
Design and maintain the trading system architecture, including components for data ingestion, signal generation, backtesting, execution, and risk management
Make decisions on technology stack, performance optimization, and scalability
Ensure the system supports reasonable latency, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant trading

Team Leadership & Collaboration
Help recruit and Lead a small team of developers (sometimes quants as well) within the pod
Work closely with the quant researchers and traders to understand strategy requirements and translate them into code
Prioritize tasks and mentor junior developers or quant devs

Strategy Implementation Support
Build and maintain research infrastructure (e.g., backtesting frameworks, simulation environments, feature stores)
Translate researchers' prototypes (e.g., in Python) into production­ grade code, often in C++, or C# for latency-sensitive components

Execution & Infrastructure
Optimize and support order execution systems, integrating with various exchanges or broker APIs
Implement real-time risk checks, monitoring, logging, and alerting tools

Data Engineering & Management
Oversee the pipeline for ingesting, cleaning, and storing data (market, alternative, internal)
Ensure data integrity and low-latency access for trading and research

DevOps & Reliability
Often take responsibility for deployment pipelines, version control, and production support
Ensure high system availability and rapid recovery in case of failures

Security & Compliance
Make sure that the pod's infrastructure adheres to firm-wide compliance and security standards
Ensure rigorous version control, code quality, and documentation standards
Conduct thorough testing and debugging of software components, resolving any issues or discrepancies.

Required Technical Skills

1st class Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field
Fluency in C++ or C# for performance-critical systems
Proficiency in Python, especially for scripting, research integration, and data tools
Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, and multithreaded/concurrent programming
Strong knowledge of SQL and modern database design (e.g., column stores, time-series DBs)
Familiarity with software engineering best practices: version control (Git), unit testing, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, etc.
Strong troubleshooting skills across distributed systems

Required Experience

3+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining high-performance trading systems, ideally in a systematic equities or quant trading environment
Proven experience in:
Handling large-scale market data (e.g., normalization, feed handling, replay systems)
Order routing and exchange connectivity, including FIX protocols and direct market access (DMA)
Building event-driven architectures and real-time systems with tight SLAs
Identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, or system instability in production environments

Highly Valued Relevant Attributes

Excellent communication skills - able to interface directly with quant researchers and traders, translate requirements, and explain technical decisions
Demonstrated initiative and ownership: able to drive projects independently, while collaborating effectively in a team setting
Comfortable in fast-paced, iterative environments where priorities can shift quickly based on market conditions or research insights

Autonet ontwikkelt software en automatiseringsoplossingen voor de Nederlandse demontagebranche. Sinds 1990 ondersteunen wij demontagebedrijven bij al hun primaire processen: van voertuigregistratie en voorraadbeheer tot verkoop en integraties met externe systemen.
Met platforms zoals Onderdelenlijn en Proxyparts bereikt Autonet meer dan 1 miljoen bezoekers per maand in Europa en speelt het een essentiële rol binnen de automotive sector.
Autonet opereert in een omgeving met een sterke focus op vernieuwing, schaalbaarheid en modernisering en combineert bestaande systemen met de ontwikkeling van nieuwe platformen.

Wat de .NET Developer zal doen

Als Medior .NET Developer werk je voornamelijk aan backend‑ontwikkeling binnen meerdere applicaties en diensten. Je draagt actief bij aan zowel het onderhoud en de doorontwikkeling van bestaande systemen als aan de bouw van een nieuw webplatform dat de huidige backend zal vervangen.
Je werkt aan bedrijfskritische applicaties, integraties met externe partijen en schaalbare oplossingen binnen een omgeving die zich ontwikkelt richting service‑ en (micro)service‑architecturen. Frontendwerk speelt een beperkte, ondersteunende rol.

Je werkt proactief, zelfstandig en oplossingsgericht en neemt eigenaarschap over je werk. Je hebt een sterke interesse in AI en past dit actief toe binnen je ontwikkelwerk.
Daarnaast beschik je over:
– Ervaring met C# en .NET (bij voorkeur modern .NET / .NET Core)

– Affiniteit met of ervaring in API‑integraties
– Basiskennis van frontendtechnieken (JavaScript, jQuery, CSS)
– Het vermogen om te werken in zowel legacy‑ als moderne omgevingen
– Actieve interesse in AI en het toepassen hiervan in softwareontwikkeling
– Een proactieve mindset en inhoudelijke betrokkenheid binnen het team

Nice to have

– Ervaring met het implementeren van AI in bestaande applicaties
– Ervaring met of interesse in service‑georiënteerde of microservice‑architecturen
– Affiniteit met de automotive sector of logistieke processen

Onze tools & technische omgeving

Je werkt in een technisch landschap dat sterk in ontwikkeling is, met onder andere:
– C#
– .NET (voornamelijk .NET Core / modern .NET)

– Nieuwe platformontwikkeling met ASP.NET Core en Razor Pages
– Meerdere .NET Core applicaties en services
– MSSQL en/of PostgreSQL
– JavaScript, jQuery en CSS
– Architectuur in transitie naar schaalbare services en (micro)services

Wat wij bieden

De .NET Developer wordt onderdeel van een stabiel, technisch sterk en groeiend team van acht personen (zeven developers en één tester).

– Fulltime dienstverband (32–40 uur)

Over Vitec Software Group

Vitec Software Group is een internationale leverancier van Vertical Market Software met meer dan 40 zelfstandige business units. Binnen Vitec combineren we ondernemerschap met lange‑termijnstabiliteit en ontwikkelen we software die cruciaal is voor specifieke sectoren.

Senior Backend Engineer (TypeScript/Python/C#) - Remote

Kake
is a remote-first company and a people-first global community of senior engineers. Kake engineers are behind some of the world’s most innovative products (Brands you’ve heard!), from Fortune 500 to fast-growing companies. We believe it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. Our community spans 45,000+ engineers across 55+ countries; join a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive (and love eating kake!).

We’re looking for Senior Backend Engineers
specializing in TypeScript, Python, or C#
, skilled in building high-performance, scalable systems that support millions of users, and committed to solid architectural judgment and engineering best practices. It's a great fit for people who enjoy owning problems end-to-end and collaborating closely with product and frontend teams to ship reliable, well-crafted software.

What you’ll build and own

Build and ship production backend services end-to-end in TypeScript, Python, or C#, owning your work from implementation through deployment.
Design, build, and version REST or GraphQL APIs that serve as the contract between frontend and backend systems.
Make architecture decisions around data modelling, service boundaries, and component design, applying event-driven thinking where it fits.
Model and query data across relational and NoSQL stores, choosing the right database and structure for each use case.
Write clean, well-tested code and set up the observability needed to catch and debug issues in live systems.

Core Requirements

5+ years of experience in software engineering, with hands-on work in TypeScript, Python, or C#
.
Hands-on experience designing and versioning REST
or GraphQL APIs
.
Experience with modern git workflows, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure such as GCP
, AWS
, or Azure
.
Strong system-design instincts: data modelling, component architecture, and event-driven thinking.
Comfortable with relational databases and SQL
, plus familiarity with NoSQL
such as MongoDB or similar.
A genuine bar for clean, testable, robust code, backed by sound testing and observability habits.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills across distributed systems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.

Nice-to-Have

AI-forward mindset with active use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate delivery, while staying the engineer who judges correctness.
Experience with e-commerce, payments, video platforms, or other correctness-critical domains is a strong plus.
Availability to work aligned with the partner's time zone.

Additional

US Timezone Overlap
: 5h–6h daily PST

Why Join Kake?

The icing on the Kake:
💰 Competitive Pay in USD: Work globally, get paid globally.
🌎 Fully Remote: Simply put, we trust you.
💜 Better Me Fund: We invest in your personal growth and passions.
🎂 Compassion is Badass: Join a community that invests in social good.

Ready for your piece of the Kake? Apply now!

Quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.title: Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA
jobs.description:
As a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA, you develop software for high-tech products and machines.

In this role, you support our customers in the semiconductor, analytical instrumentation, and medical equipment industries, within the triangle of Nijmegen, Enschede, and Zwolle, by delivering smart, sustainable, and reliable software solutions. Your software expertise plays an essential role in bringing these high-tech solutions to life.

What excites you as a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA?

As a Software Designer, you contribute to defining requirements and you are responsible for translating them into robust software designs, ensuring high-quality implementation and seamless integration. You are eager to grow into a role where you bring your own technical contribution, while guiding the development team.

From our office in Apeldoorn or at our clients’ premises, you enjoy working on:

Translating customer and system requirements into innovative, clear, and feasible concepts during the conceptual phase of projects.
Acting as a bridge between architects and engineers from a technical perspective.
Taking responsibility for a module/subsystem throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
Ensuring software quality, scalability and maintainability through sound engineering practices.
Applying strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor a team of engineers, helping them grow and deliver high-quality results.

Sounds good? We’d love to tell you more…

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

You have a technical Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
You have 7+ years of experience in technical software development, gained in various roles and across diverse product environments and/or projects.
Over the past 4–5 years, you have worked within technical domains such as Semicon, Medical, or Analytical.
You have experience with at least two of the following programming languages: C#, C++, or Java.
You have knowledge of and/or experience with various development methodologies and techniques such as Design Patterns, UML, and Agile, and you keep your technical expertise up to date. You are looking for an environment where you can apply these developments in practice as well.
Based on your experience, you are able to coach junior engineers.
You are a team player and keep the common goal in mind.
You have a good command of both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
You hold a valid European driver’s license and are willing to travel.

This is what you can expect in return from Sioux

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to acquire an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from events together with your partner and family, summer barbecues, innovative knowledge sessions to tasty lunches and after work drinks.
You will be working at a prime location in a green, wooded environment, close to the Veluwe National Park. The perfect base within the triangle of Enschede, Zwolle, and Nijmegen.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux-culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

jobs.title: Teamlead Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Als Teamlead Software Engineering breng jij technisch leiderschap en architectuur samen in de ontwikkeling van slimme machinebesturingen.

Voor deze functie zijn we op zoek naar een Teamlead Software Engineering voor onze opdrachtgever, een toonaangevende speler in de ontwikkeling en bouw van industriële plaatbewerkingsmachines, met productielocaties in Lochem en Eijsden. Onze opdrachtgever bedient klanten wereldwijd vanuit een internationale organisatie met vestigingen in onder meer Zweden, Noord-Amerika, Duitsland en het Verenigd Koninkrijk.

Onze opdrachtgever ontwikkelt en bouwt volledig in eigen huis innovatieve en geautomatiseerde oplossingen voor plaatbewerking, met een sterke focus op technologische vernieuwing en kwaliteit. Vanuit nauwe samenwerking tussen R&D, productmanagement en internationale softwareteams wordt voortdurend gewerkt aan de volgende generatie machinebesturingen, waarbij innovatie en duurzaamheid samengaan met een persoonlijke, betrokken werksfeer.

Wat ga je doen?

Binnen deze functie combineer je technisch leiderschap met architectuur en actieve softwareontwikkeling. Je stuurt een softwareteam van acht FTE aan, verdeeld over .NET/HMI-ontwikkeling, embedded software en Automated Solutions. Prioriteiten stellen, capaciteit verdelen en de voortgang bewaken horen daarbij. Coaching van engineers krijgt veel aandacht, net als het voeren van voortgangs- en ontwikkelgesprekken. Daarnaast ben je het escalatiepunt voor complexe technische vraagstukken.

Op architectuurvlak bewaak je de samenhang tussen embedded software, HMI, motion control, robotinterfaces en connectiviteit. Coding guidelines en architectuurrichtlijnen stel je op en bewaak je, met oog voor een toekomstbestendig softwareplatform. Ook aan de meerjarenvisie voor softwareontwikkeling werk je actief mee.

Zelf ontwikkelen blijft onderdeel van je werk: gemiddeld één dag per week schrijf je embedded software voor machinebesturingen. Code reviews, debugging en het ondersteunen van prototypes horen hier ook bij. Tot slot draag je bij aan backlogbeheer, sprintplanning en releaseprocessen, en lever je een actieve bijdrage aan de cybersecurity- en kwaliteitsprocessen binnen R&D.

Wij bieden

Voor deze functie mag je een salaris verwachten dat past bij jouw ervaring en verantwoordelijkheid, aangevuld met uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Je krijgt een vast dienstverband voor 40 uur per week, met 27 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen. Er is volop ruimte voor jouw verdere ontwikkeling dankzij uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden. Daarnaast profiteer je van een leasefietsregeling, een pensioenregeling binnen de Metalektro, een collectieve zorgverzekering en korting op een sportschoolabonnement. De werksfeer is informeel en betrokken, met leuke collega's, een actieve personeelsvereniging en een geregelde borrel. Flexibiliteit en persoonlijke ontwikkeling staan centraal, zodat werk en privé goed in balans blijven.

Wat breng je mee

HBO- of WO-diploma in Informatica, Embedded Systems, Software Engineering of vergelijkbaar
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als lead engineer, architect of teamlead
Ervaring met embedded softwareontwikkeling
Ruime ervaring met softwarearchitectuur
Achtergrond binnen machinebouw, industriële automatisering of robotica
Kennis van Embedded C/C++, .NET/C#, EtherCAT en motion control
Bekend met Git, Azure DevOps en OPC-UA
Affiniteit met IEC 62443 en cybersecurity
Sterke leiderschaps- en coachingsvaardigheden
Analytisch en resultaatgericht, met oog voor samenwerking

Wat kun je van CTS verwachten?

CTS helpt jou om de juiste volgende stap in je carrière te zetten. Wij begeleiden je gedurende het gehele sollicitatieproces en zorgen ervoor dat je goed voorbereid bent op gesprekken. Daarnaast bieden we advies op maat, zodat jouw profiel perfect aansluit bij de wensen van de opdrachtgever. Met onze persoonlijke aanpak en ervaring in de technische sector staan we garant voor een succesvolle samenwerking.

Bij CTS draait alles om de juiste match tussen mens en organisatie. Wij bemiddelen professionals naar vaste banen binnen de techniek en begeleiden je gedurende het volledige sollicitatieproces. We starten met een persoonlijk kennismakingsgesprek om jouw wensen en ambities in kaart te brengen. We begeleiden je tijdens het hele traject, van voorbereiding op gesprekken tot ondersteuning bij onderhandelingen. Ook na je start blijven we betrokken en denken we mee over jouw verdere ontwikkeling

Wij geloven dat werk een belangrijk onderdeel is van het leven. Daarom is het essentieel dat je werk doet dat bij je past en waar je energie uit haalt. Of je nu precies weet wat je zoekt of nog aan het oriënteren bent, wij helpen je de juiste richting te vinden. Indien nodig schakelen we daarbij onze vaste partner voor loopbaanadvies in.

En nu? Herken je jezelf in dit profiel? Neem contact op met CTS, dan bespreken we de mogelijkheden.
