jobs.title: Mobile App Developer
jobs.description:
Wil jij technische richting geven aan mobiele oplossingen die dagelijks door professionals worden gebruikt, in een team van ervaren en inhoudelijk sterke developers? Neem jij graag ownership over complexe applicaties, architectuurkeuzes en teamontwikkeling, en zoek je actief de samenwerking en het sparren op senior niveau? Dan is deze rol als Senior Mobile Apps Developer bij 4PS iets voor jou.

Wie zijn wij?

4PS biedt een uitgebreid portfolio van ERP-oplossingen op basis van Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, inclusief bijbehorende portals en apps, voor bedrijven in de bouwsector. Met meer dan 400 professionals werken wij elke dag aan applicaties die het verschil maken voor onze 450 klanten wereldwijd.

Binnen onze development teams werk je samen met ervaren en inhoudelijk sterke collega’s. We beschikken over een volwassen team met een goede mix van senior, medior en specialistische profielen. Dit betekent dat je als senior niet alleen richting geeft, maar ook kunt sparren op niveau en samenwerkt met collega’s die gewend zijn ownership te nemen en kwaliteit te leveren.

We zijn gepassioneerd en halen voldoening uit het leveren van resultaat. Als team helpen en inspireren we elkaar, delen we kennis en groeien we professioneel. Naast hard werken vinden we plezier erg belangrijk. Dit doen we door regelmatig sociale activiteiten te organiseren en een ontspannen werkomgeving te creëren.

De 4PS Group maakt inmiddels deel uit van de Hilti Group. Samen werken we aan de missie: “Making Construction better”.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Mobile Apps Developer speel je een sleutelrol binnen het development team. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van mobiele applicaties voor Android en iOS, en zorgt ervoor dat deze schaalbaar, performant en toekomstbestendig zijn.

Je bent betrokken bij de volledige software development lifecycle en neemt het voortouw in technische beslissingen. Daarnaast bewaak je de kwaliteit, veiligheid en maintainability van de oplossingen en werk je actief mee aan het continu verbeteren van processen en werkwijzen.

Je werkt in een multidisciplinair scrumteam en fungeert als sparringpartner voor productmanagers, UX/UI designers en andere stakeholders. Je neemt ownership over complexe features en draagt bij aan een sterke teamdynamiek door kennisdeling en coaching.

Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

Definiëren en bewaken van de technische architectuur van mobiele applicaties
Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van schaalbare mobiele oplossingen
Maken van onderbouwde keuzes in frameworks, tooling en technologieën
End-to-end ownership van complexe features en projecten
Integreren van API’s en externe services
Waarborgen van codekwaliteit, performance, security en maintainability
Opzetten en verbeteren van CI/CD processen en automatisering
Coachen en begeleiden van (junior/medior) developers
Fungeren als technisch aanspreekpunt voor stakeholders
Signaleren van risico’s en proactief aandragen van oplossingen

Hoe werk je?

Je maakt onderdeel uit van een scrumteam en werkt nauw samen met Product Management, UX/UI en andere development teams. Je neemt actief deel aan Agile/Scrum processen en draagt bij aan een effectieve samenwerking en continue verbetering.

Je vertaalt functionele vraagstukken naar robuuste technische oplossingen en houdt hierbij rekening met gebruikerservaring, performance en verschillende scenario’s zoals offline en online gebruik.

Wat breng je mee?

Minimaal 5+ jaar ervaring als Software Developer, waarvan meerdere jaren in mobile development
Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met .NET (bij voorkeur .NET Core / .NET 6+)
Ervaring met ASP.NET Core (ontwikkelen van REST API’s en backend services)
Ervaring met .NET MAUI of vergelijkbare mobile frameworks (bijv. Xamarin)
Aantoonbare ervaring met mobiele app development (Android en/of iOS)
Sterke ervaring met Git (branching, pull requests, code reviews)
Sterke kennis van software design principes (SOLID, DRY, Clean Code)
Aantoonbare ervaring met het bouwen van maintainable en testbare software
Sterk analytisch vermogen en probleemoplossend denken
Affiniteit met mobile app development (UX, performance, offline/online scenario’s)
Ownership mindset en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid voor kwaliteit en delivery
Ervaring met werken in Agile/Scrum teams

Nice to have

Ervaring met CI/CD (bijv. YAML pipelines)
Ervaring met Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines)
Ervaring met testautomatisering (UI testing zoals Appium en API/integration testing)
Ervaring met Azure of andere cloudomgevingen
Ervaring met monitoring en logging (bijv. Application Insights)
Kennis van performance optimalisatie (mobile en backend)
Ervaring met AI-tools in development (bijv. Copilot, AI-assisted testing)

Wie ben jij?

Je werkt graag zelfstandig en neemt duidelijk eigenaarschap over je werk en resultaten. Tegelijk beschik je over een sterke technische visie, die je helder en overtuigend weet over te brengen op anderen. Je voelt je echter niet alleen comfortabel in een zelfstandige rol; je draagt actief bij aan samenwerking en functioneert uitstekend als teamspeler.

Je bent analytisch sterk, communiceert doelgericht en bent in staat om complexe vraagstukken terug te brengen tot werkbare oplossingen. Daarnaast coach je collega’s, deel je kennis actief en draag je bij aan een professionele en positieve teamcultuur.

Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

Een uitstekend salaris met een bonus aan het einde van het jaar;
Werken met high-end en de nieuwste software van Microsoft en andere leveranciers;
Een fijne werkplek op ons kantoor in Ede, met alle faciliteiten om prettig te werken;
Flexibiliteit in werktijden en locatie, inclusief thuiswerken en een thuiswerkvergoeding;
28 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen;
Een ambitieus en inhoudelijk sterk team met ervaren collega’s
Toenemende focus op AI en procesoptimalisatie;
Werk dat direct impact heeft op klanten en de sector;
Werken bij een organisatie met veel ambitie, zowel nationaal als internationaal;
Een werkplek waar je impact kunt maken, met veel autonomie, zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid;
Een gecertificeerde Great Place to Work, erkend door onze eigen collega’s;
4PS Academy – dé plek voor interne en externe trainingen;
4PS Life – gericht op een gezonde en leuke werk-privébalans (bijv. LAN-party’s, borrels, vers fruit, periodieke gezondheidschecks en bedrijfsfeesten).

jobs.title: Senior Applicatieontwikkelaar.NET
jobs.description:
Over de functie

In het kort: Je gaat als principal .NET-ontwikkelaar complexe applicaties ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden, databases en platforms migreren, REST-services realiseren en als technisch vraagbaak samenwerken met stakeholders in een iteratieve ontwikkelomgeving.

Functieprofiel

UWV is voor het Applicatie Ontwikkel Centrum (AOC) binnen Concern-ICT op zoek naar een ervaren Principal Applicatie Ontwikkelaar (.Net) voor de ontwikkeling en het onderhoud van één of meer applicaties. De Principal Applicatie Ontwikkelaar is in staat .Net-applicaties (releases) te realiseren en te integreren vanaf de requirementsfase tot en met de oplevering. De werkwijze is iteratief en er wordt intensief samengewerkt met andere ontwikkelaars, de klant, gebruikers en testers. De kandidaat is communicatief sterk en kan zelfstandig inhoudelijk met de klant afstemmen.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer – Azure
jobs.description:
Bij Solvinity werk je aan Azure-omgevingen voor organisaties die geen fouten kunnen veroorloven. Denk aan het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en toonaangevende financiële dienstverleners. Maar deze rol gaat verder dan engineering alleen. Je werkt ook mee in het Cloud Center of Excellence van het ministerie, waar je de cloud-strategie van een van de grootste overheidsorganisaties van Nederland mede vormgeeft. Diepgaand technisch werk, gecombineerd met echte strategische impact.

Wat ga je doen?

Je ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert veilige Azure-omgevingen voor klanten met strenge eisen op het gebied van beveiliging en compliance. Je werkt met Terraform, Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en Azure Policies. Deployments automatiseer je via CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps of GitLab. Wijzigingen rollen geautomatiseerd en foutloos uit. Je beheert het versie- en lifecycle management van cloud resources en zorgt dat alles gedocumenteerd en herleidbaar is.

Je stelt accreditatiedocumentatie op, voert risicoanalyses en security assessments uit en zorgt dat cloudservices aantoonbaar voldoen aan normen zoals BIO2 en NIS2. Je bent daarin een betrouwbare gesprekspartner voor security- en risk-stakeholders.

Jouw kerntaken

Ontwerpen en beheren van Azure-netwerkarchitecturen (VNet, NSG, UDR, BGP, VPN, ExpressRoute)
Configureren van Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en implementeren van zero-trust netwerksegmentatie
Bouwen en onderhouden van Infrastructure as Code met Terraform en CI/CD pipelines
Opstellen en implementeren van Azure Policies en policy-initiatieven voor governance en compliance
Opstellen van accreditatiedocumentatie, risicoanalyses en security assessments

Je werkt in een klein, hecht cloudteam met korte lijnen. Er zijn twee à drie standups per week. Geen zware vergadercultuur, wel nauwe samenwerking met collega’s, klanten en stakeholders.

Wat bieden wij?

€5.356 – €7.961 bruto per maand (o.b.v. een 40-urige werkweek), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
Mobiliteitsvergoeding of een lease-auto
32 tot 40-urige werkweek
Grotendeels thuiswerken met een vaste dag per week op kantoor en bij de klant
80% pensioenbijdrage van de werkgever

26 vakantiedagen, met mogelijkheid tot uitbreiding

Tot €300 per jaar voor jouw sportactiviteiten

Solvinity investeert structureel in jouw ontwikkeling. Vanaf dag één volg je relevante opleidingen en trainingen. Na twee jaar in dienst ontvang je €1.000 extra opleidingsbudget dat je volledig zelf mag invullen. Denk aan een Azure-certificering zoals de AZ-104 of AZ-400, de Palo Alto PCNSE of een ander traject dat bij jou past. Jaarlijks stel je samen met je manager een persoonlijk opleidingsplan op.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een ervaren cloud engineer met een analytische instelling en een security-first mindset. Je bouwt niet alleen — je denkt ook na over waarom je iets zo inricht en wat de risico’s zijn. Je werkt zelfstandig, maar schakelt makkelijk met collega’s, klanten en stakeholders. Je bent nauwkeurig, documentatievaardig en weet complexe technische vraagstukken helder op te schrijven.

Wat Je Meebrengt

Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare cloud-rol
Diepgaande kennis van Azure-netwerken (VNet, NSG, UDR, BGP, VPN, ExpressRoute)
Hands-on ervaring met Palo Alto firewalls (VM-Series) en zero-trust segmentatie
Aantoonbare ervaring met Terraform en CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps of GitHub Actions)
Ervaring met Azure Policies, accreditatieprocessen en compliance-kaders (BIO2, NIS2 is een pré)

Kennis van Bicep of ARM is een pré. Een relevante Azure-certificering (AZ-104, AZ-400) of Palo Alto PCNSE is een pluspunt, maar aantoonbare praktijkervaring weegt minstens zo zwaar. Je beheerst het Nederlands goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, op minimaal hbo-niveau.

Over Solvinity

Solvinity levert Secure Managed Cloud Services aan organisaties met hoge beveiligingseisen. Hiermee ondersteunt het bedrijf de (rijks-)overheid, gemeenten en toonaangevende organisaties in de financiële en zakelijke dienstverlening, zoals het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid, Politie Nederland, TransLink (OV-chipkaart), ING en Klaverblad. Solvinity ontwerpt, bouwt en beheert de complexe platformen waarop bedrijfskritische applicaties veilig en optimaal functioneren. Daarnaast levert het bedrijf CI/CD, containertechnologie en ‘Stretched’ DevSecOps oplossingen voor softwareontwikkelaars.

Solvinity onderscheidt zich op het gebied van cybersecurity met een uitgebreid portfolio aan securitydiensten en -oplossingen en biedt, met een meerderheidsbelang in Securify.nl, aanvullende cybersecurity diensten. Daarnaast heeft het bedrijf certificeringen volgens (inter)nationale normen als ISO 27001, ISO 14001, ISO 9001, PCI DSS en heeft het als eerste MSP in Nederland SOC 1 en 2 compliance rapporten voor de gehele beheeromgeving van de private én Azure cloud.

Kijk voor meer informatie op [www.solvinity.nl](http://www.solvinity.nl), of volg Solvinity op LinkedIn.

Interesse?

Passen we bij elkaar? Wil je ons daarvan overtuigen? Bel of app dan onze recruitmentspecialist, Niels Moelard, op 06-30399509 of stuur een mail naar niels.moelard@solvinity.com We streven naar een snel en persoonlijk sollicitatieproces: na een eerste (online) kennismaking volgt een gesprek op kantoor in Amersfoort. Binnen twee gespreksrondes weet je waar je aan toe bent.

About Us

We believe in the power of play. Through our innovative serious games, we are changing the way the world looks at people with cognitive challenges, such as dementia or intellectual disabilities. Our games combine smart hardware, thoughtful software, and evidence-based interactive content to create meaningful moments of joy for players and caregivers worldwide.
To scale our technology roadmap and lead our core engineering team, we are looking for a hands-on, empathetic, and technically grounded Manager Software Engineering
.

The Role

As Manager Software Engineering
, you will directly manage a cross-functional team of 7 engineers across systems, web, and QA disciplines.
You will bridge the gap between product strategy and technical execution while fostering individual growth. Because our domain spans embedded/systems engineering, web platforms, and quality assurance, we need a leader with a solid technical background who can speak the team's language, guide architectural decisions, and manage a diverse set of engineering disciplines effectively.

Key Responsibilities

People Management & Leadership:
Provide direct line management for a cross-functional team of 7 engineers. Conduct regular 1-on-1s, drive talent development, evaluate performance, and maintain a high-trust, collaborative engineering culture.
Cross-Functional Team Enablement:
Align distinct technical disciplines toward shared sprint goals, deliverable milestones, and seamless product releases.
Technical Guidance:
Leverage your software engineering background to engage in technical architecture discussions, review trade-offs, and help the team solve complex engineering challenges.
Delivery & Agile Processes:
Optimize team processes and workflows to ensure high code quality, reliable releases, continuous testing, and scalable architecture.
Cross-Department Collaboration:
Act as the primary liaison between your engineering team, Product Owners, UX/UI Designers, and Hardware teams to ensure smooth end-to-end integration.

Requirements

Leadership Experience:
3+ years in an engineering leadership role (e.g., Engineering Manager, Technical Team Lead) with a proven track record of managing cross-functional technical teams.
Strong Technical Background:
A solid background as a Software Engineer/Developer with the technical depth needed to guide cross-functional software teams effectively.
Cross-Functional Domain Knowledge:
Broad understanding of software development lifecycles across systems software, modern web applications, and QA automation/processes.
Leadership Style:
Coaching, servant-leadership approach. You prioritize removing roadblocks, empowering engineers, and fostering clear communication across disciplines.
Languages:
Professional fluency in both English and Dutch (spoken and written).
Bonus:
Experience in IoT, hardware-software integration, MedTech, or interactive media/gaming platforms.
Location:
Candidates need to located in the Netherlands. We do not offer relocation support.

What We Offer

Meaningful Impact:
Lead a key team building technology that directly improves the lives of hundreds of thousands of vulnerable people.
Inspiring Work Environment:
A dynamic, open, and friendly team culture in our Utrecht office.
Hybrid Working:
Balanced mix of on-site collaboration and working from home.

Annual salary up to 100K, company shares, 25 vacation days (full-time basis)and travel allowance.

JetBrains is a software development company focused on creating developer tools and platforms. Since its founding in 2000, the company has developed a broad portfolio of products and is now evolving toward a unified, AI-native platform for software development.

The JetBrains Platform team is building infrastructure that connects developer workflows, team collaboration, and organizational controls across products, teams, and environments.

About the Role

JetBrains is looking for an experienced Staff Software Developer to join its Identity and Access Management team within the JetBrains Platform. The team owns foundational services responsible for authentication and authorization, as well as organizations, user memberships, groups, and workspaces.

These services support multiple JetBrains products and platform components, making reliability, security, scalability, and performance essential to the role.

As a Staff Software Developer, you will take ownership across the entire software development lifecycle, including architecture, development, code review, and production operations. You will primarily work with Kotlin, with some Go, while designing and evolving services within a distributed, multi-tenant SaaS environment.

Own the complete software development lifecycle, including code, architecture, and operations.

Maintain and evolve production services primarily written in Kotlin, with some Go.

Ensure platform services remain reliable and performant as the platform scales.

Design and implement features across identity, organization, membership, group, and workspace domains.

Review and integrate pull requests from other platform teams.

Manage integrations with other JetBrains Platform components and connected applications.

Take ownership of existing production services and continuously improve their reliability and performance.

Collaborate with engineering teams across the platform to deliver robust identity and access solutions.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of JVM development experience, preferably with Kotlin.

Strong understanding of JVM performance and PostgreSQL performance optimization.

Experience building and operating production SaaS services.

Experience working with distributed and multi-tenant environments.

Ability to work with modern DevOps technologies and infrastructure.

Experience with Kubernetes (K8S), OpenTelemetry, and Grafana.

Demonstrated experience taking ownership of existing production services and improving them.

Strong software architecture and engineering skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with identity management protocols such as:

OAuth 2.0

OpenID Connect (OIDC)

SAML 2.0

SCIM 2.0

Experience designing and evolving domain models for organizational or identity systems.

Cybersecurity experience, including risk estimation, recognizing common vulnerability patterns, and promoting secure software development lifecycle practices.

Hands-on experience with Go.

Kotlin

Java / JVM

Go

PostgreSQL

Kubernetes

OpenTelemetry

Grafana

Authentication & Authorization

OAuth 2.0

Secure SDLC

Work Environment

JetBrains offers a flexible work location, allowing employees to work from home or from an office. Employees can also work remotely from abroad for up to 30 days per year.

The role involves working with platform engineering teams and connected applications across a modern distributed software environment.

Compensation & Benefits

JetBrains offers:

Competitive base salary reflecting skills and experience.

Flexible home or office working options.

Up to 30 days per year of remote work from abroad.

Additional time off.

Medical insurance allowance for employees and families.

Learning and development opportunities, including conferences and courses.

Language classes.

Company-wide events and team gatherings.

The ideal candidate is an experienced JVM engineer with at least seven years of development experience and a strong preference for Kotlin. jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. DEINE ROLLE

Gestalte Testarchitekturen: Entwickle und pflege Testautomatisierungsarchitekturen und stelle die Qualität geschäftskritischer Software sicher.

Berate Stakeholder: Unterstütze User der Fachabteilungen und Entwicklungsteams bei Fragen zur Softwarequalität und Testmaßnahmen.
Unterstütze die Testplanung: Trage durch Schätzungen und Statusberichte zur Planung und Steuerung von Testaufgaben bei.
Arbeite neue Teammitglieder ein: Unterstütze neue Tester:innen bei der Einarbeitung und teile dein Wissen, um den Testprozess kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

DEIN PROFIL

Fachliche Qualifikation: Ein Ausbildungs- oder Studienabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik bildet deine Basis für diese Rolle.
Testautomatisierung und Programmiersprachen: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in agilen Projekten mit DevOps mit und bist sicher in mindestens zwei Programmiersprachen wie Java, TypeScript, C# oder Python.
Know-how in Automatisierung: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von Automatisierungslösungen mit Technologien wie Playwright oder Selenium und kannst diese in CI/CD-Pipelines wie Jenkins oder GitLab integrieren.
Testdaten und Umgebungen: Synthetische Generierung von Testdaten und Containerisierung von Testumgebungen, z.B. mit Docker und Kubernetes sind dir nicht fremd.
Schnittstellen: Vertrautheit mit dem automatisierten Test für synchrone Schnittstellen (Client-Server) und asynchrone Schnittstellen (Microservices) wie REST, SOAP, AMQP oder MQTT gehören zu deinem Skillset.
KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen.
Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation.

Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.

Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. What Sets Us Apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication
. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.

You will join the API Enterprise
team. We sit at the intersection of DeepL's API platform and our Enterprise ecosystem. Whereas the Core team obsesses over the self-service developer journey, our focus is on enterprise customer adoption: the usage insights, cost controls, RBAC , compliance, and data residency capabilities that enterprise IT and security teams depend on. We work hand-in-hand with a wide set of stakeholder teams to make DeepL's API the obvious and safe choice for global enterprises.

We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Athera Healthcare delivers innovative healthcare solutions that improve patient outcomes and transform healthcare delivery.

About the role

We are looking for a QA Engineer who wants the opportunity to shape how quality assurance is done, rather than simply inherit an established testing process.
You will be our first dedicated QA hire and will work closely with the Head of Technology and the wider development team to define and establish a pragmatic QA approach across a varied technology estate.
Our applications span modern web technologies and long-established desktop systems, including React, Angular, .NET, Java, Delphi, WinForms/WPF and ASP.NET Web Forms.
Automation today is relatively limited. A major part of this role will be helping us change that.
We are particularly interested in someone who is keen to embrace AI-assisted testing and modern automation techniques. We do not expect you to arrive with every answer. We are looking for someone with strong QA fundamentals, good scripting and technical skills, and the curiosity to investigate new approaches and turn them into practical improvements.
This could suit an experienced mid-level QA Engineer who wants greater ownership and the opportunity to demonstrate that they can build and influence a QA capability.

What you'll be doing

The role will be approximately 50% test automation and 50% hands-on exploratory and manual testing, although the balance will naturally change depending on releases and projects.
You will:

Help define and continuously improve our overall QA strategy, processes and standards.
Build out automated regression coverage across both web and legacy desktop applications.
Investigate where AI can make testing faster, broader and more maintainable.
Convert existing manual regression tests into appropriate automated tests.
Use AI-assisted tools to help generate, maintain and improve automated test suites.
Investigate agentic and computer-use technologies for automating applications that are difficult to test using traditional automation frameworks.
Identify gaps in regression coverage and prioritise automation based on risk and business impact.
Create and maintain appropriate test data.
Use AI and automation tooling to analyse failures, diagnose issues and reduce brittle or unreliable tests.
Perform exploratory testing to identify issues that scripted and automated tests may miss.
Manually verify complex functionality and changes where automation would not provide sufficient confidence.
Test functionality across modern web applications and legacy Windows desktop systems.
Test APIs and integrations.
Participate in performance, security and non-functional testing where appropriate.
Review acceptance criteria and contribute to improving testability before development begins.
Produce proportionate test plans based on technical and business risk.
Participate in defect triage and help development teams understand and reproduce issues.
Contribute to release readiness and release sign-off.
Help manage test environments, test data and regression coverage.
Integrate automated testing into our Azure DevOps development and delivery processes.
Work closely with developers to encourage quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final release step.

AI and automation

We see AI as an important part of the future of software quality.
We are not looking for someone who simply uses AI to generate test scripts. We want someone interested in understanding where AI genuinely improves QA and where traditional engineering judgement remains essential.
You will be encouraged to investigate and apply AI to areas including:
Generating initial automated test cases and scripts.
Turning manual regression scenarios into automation
Identifying potential gaps in regression coverage.
Generating realistic and useful test data.
Analysing automated test failures and logs.
Diagnosing flaky or brittle tests.
Improving and maintaining existing automated tests.
Exploring AI-driven browser automation.
Exploring computer-use and agentic testing approaches for legacy desktop applications.
Supporting exploratory testing and identifying unusual edge cases.

AI-generated tests and results must still be critically reviewed. Strong QA judgement, curiosity and the ability to recognise unexpected behaviour remain central to the role.

What we're looking for

You should have:
Commercial experience in software quality assurance or software testing.
Strong exploratory and manual testing skills.
Experience testing web applications.
An understanding of automated regression testing and when automation is appropriate.
The ability to write scripts or test automation without needing to be a full-time software developer.
An interest in modern AI-assisted and low-code/no-code automation tools.
Experience investigating defects and providing developers with clear, reproducible information.
Experience creating test cases, test scenarios and regression suites.
An understanding of API testing.
An understanding of risk-based testing.
Experience working alongside software developers in an Agile or iterative development environment.
The confidence to question requirements and identify scenarios that may not have been considered.
The ability to work independently and establish structure in an environment where the QA function is still developing.

Most importantly,
you should be someone who is curious about how modern tools can improve software quality and willing to experiment, learn and challenge established testing approaches.

Useful experience

Experience in any of the following would be beneficial, but we do not expect candidates to have everything:
Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or similar web automation frameworks.
Windows desktop application automation.
Testing WinForms, WPF or Delphi applications.
Testing applications built using React or Angular.
Testing .NET or Java applications.
ASP.NET Web Forms applications.
REST API testing.
Postman or similar API testing tools.
Azure DevOps.
Automated testing within CI/CD pipelines.
Performance testing.
Security testing.
Accessibility testing.
AI-assisted development or testing tools.
Agentic automation or computer-use technologies.
Healthcare, audit or other environments where accuracy, traceability and reliability are particularly important.

What success looks like
During your first year, we would expect you to progressively:
Establish a clear and pragmatic QA approach across the technology team.
Create greater visibility of regression coverage and software quality risks.
Build a maintainable automated regression suite for our highest-value and highest-risk workflows.
Introduce appropriate automated testing into Azure DevOps pipelines.
Reduce the amount of repetitive manual regression testing required for releases.
Establish effective exploratory testing practices alongside automation.
Demonstrate practical uses of AI that improve testing speed, coverage or maintainability.
Develop workable approaches for automating appropriate parts of our legacy application estate.
Improve the quality and consistency of release readiness decisions.
Help developers consider testing and quality earlier in the development lifecycle.

The opportunity

This is not a role where you will simply execute someone else's test scripts.
You will have the opportunity to influence how QA develops across the organisation, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and demonstrate what a modern QA function can deliver.
There will be guidance and support from the technology leadership team, but we are looking for someone who wants ownership, is comfortable investigating unfamiliar problems, and is motivated by the opportunity to build something better.

Benefits

· £35,000 - £45,000 per annum, dependant on experience
· Company pension scheme
· Professional development opportunities
· 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Location

Leeds, Norwich or London – Hybrid / Remote

Athera Healthcare is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified individuals regardless of age, gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief.

Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to break down complex problems into manageable tasks.

Experience working with everything from relational databases though to a multitude of NoSQL stores.
Experience working with technologies, including message queues, event streams, authentication, caching, API hosting, containers, lambdas, FaaS patterns, orchestration / workflow engines and search engines.
Strong communication skills—our ideas are nothing if we cannot communicate them.
Analytical mindset with the ability to articulate your thinking.

Experience working with multi-region cloud deployments, designing for availability, resilience and maintainability.
Security best practices and compliance standards in cloud environments.
We are primarily on AWS but experience working with GCP and Azure would be helpful.

Since our launch in May 2023, we've already seen significant traction and customer revenue that outpaces most companies at our stage. About us

Artlogic is a leading technology platform for the art world. Founded in 1989, Artlogic empowers over 6,000 galleries, dealers, and art professionals worldwide to streamline their operations and grow their businesses. The company’s integrated platform combines inventory management, CRM, websites, sales, marketing, and payment tools, everything needed to run a modern and successful art business.

In 2021, Artlogic was acquired by tech investors Cove Hill Partners to accelerate innovation and expand its global reach. Since then, the company has doubled in size, with employees across London, New York, Atlanta, and Cape Town.

Today, Artlogic is entering an exciting new chapter through its merger with ArtCloud, another industry leader in art technology. Together, the two companies are uniting complementary platforms to build the most comprehensive, forward-thinking solution for the art world. This collaboration brings together deep expertise across CRM, sales, marketing, inventory, payments, and AI-powered tools, empowering galleries, artists, and collectors worldwide.

Joining Artlogic means becoming part of a growing global team that is shaping the future of how art is bought, sold, and managed, both online and in person.

Our technology team comprises over 50 people across Product, UX and Engineering working in cross-functional teams geographically distributed principally between the UK and Brazil with a technical operations team in the UK and South Africa. At present, our technology stack comprises a combination of Python, Typescript, C# in Azure, GCP and AWS cloud environments.

About the role

We are seeking a pragmatic, impact-driven AI-Native Senior Software Engineer
to help evolve and extend our platform while guiding technical direction and supporting team development.

This role centres on solving real-world problems for art professionals, making thoughtful technical decisions that balance business impact with engineering trade-offs. You will work closely with Product Managers, Designers, and engineers to take ideas from inception through to production, ensuring we build the right solutions for our customers.

You will act as both a senior technical contributor and a product-minded engineer, someone who doesn’t just implement requirements but actively shapes them. You will challenge assumptions, ask the right questions, and help ensure we are solving meaningful problems in the most effective way.

You will contribute to technical strategy by identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, performance, and user experience within our current architecture, while also supporting the evolution of our strategic platform.

This role will play a key part in driving the adoption of AI across engineering, leveraging emerging technologies and embedding AI-native workflows to improve how we design, build, and deliver software.

This role is predominantly hands-on, with around 20–30% of time on technical leadership: architecture, mentoring, and shaping how the team works.

Key Responsibilities

Help the team move faster by adopting AI-native workflows and the shift to an agentic development lifecycle, without compromising the architectural qualities that make our platform reliable, scalable, and maintainable over the long term.
Define guardrails, review practices, and validation gates that hold AI-generated code to our standards for security, reliability, and cost-efficiency (FinOps). These are first-class concerns in agentic pipelines, not afterthoughts.
Design, build, and operate software across our platform, applying the same rigour to AI-augmented work as to anything else you ship.
Embed deeply with Product and Design from the earliest stages of discovery, using rapid prototyping and iteration to compress the gap between idea and validated solution.
Act as feature lead on a rotating basis, taking accountability for the development and delivery of a feature from shaping through to production. This means partnering with Product and Design on the approach, breaking the work down, coordinating the engineers contributing to it, removing blockers, and being the person who knows the state of the feature at any point
Serve as a critical technical voice, stress-testing AI-generated solutions, surfacing second-order risks, and ensuring the team builds the right thing, not just the fast thing.
Shape platform architecture with an architectural lens, contributing to long-term decisions about how AI tooling, LLM integrations, and human-in-the-loop controls evolve across the stack.
Continuously identify and exploit opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and user experience, using observability and analysis to find signals in noisy systems.
Navigate confidently across legacy and greenfield contexts, applying AI tooling pragmatically to modernise where it matters most.
Set the engineering standard, demonstrating through your own work what excellent looks like when much of the code is AI-generated.
Grow the team's capability and confidence with AI-native practices, coaching more junior engineers to think critically about model outputs, prompt design, and the boundaries of automation.
Define and evolve best practices for code quality, testing, documentation, and delivery in a world where much of the first draft is AI-generated.
Evolve CI/CD pipelines to incorporate agentic workflows, automated testing, AI-assisted code review, and intelligent deployment gates.
Champion secure by design principles across both human-written and AI-generated code, embedding security validation into the development pipeline rather than treating it as an afterthought.
Own system observability and reliability, moving from reactive alerting to proactive, model-assisted incident prevention.
Participate in on-call rotation, bringing the same rigour to incident response that you bring to day-to-day development.

About you

You're a hands-on senior engineer with a product mindset and the judgement to know which trade-offs matter. You care about business impact as much as engineering quality, and you've been building with AI tools long enough to know how to use them effectively.

You'll likely bring:

Deep experience building scalable, secure, cloud-based systems, giving you the foundation to confidently guide and validate agentic workflow outputs.
Proven ability to work across both legacy and greenfield codebases, using modern tooling to improve reliability and evolve architecture pragmatically.
Strong system design fundamentals across scalability, performance, and distributed systems, including API design (REST, GraphQL).
Hands-on experience with observability tooling (Datadog, Grafana, or similar) and a data-informed approach to system health and reliability.
Solid SQL and data management skills, with an appreciation for AI-enabled, data-driven systems.
Familiarity with CI/CD, containerisation (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Docker), and DevSecOps practices in modern AI development environments.
A pragmatic approach to testing, knowing what to cover, what to skip, and how to use AI to improve efficiency.
Experience mentoring engineers and supporting the adoption of modern tools and AI-native workflows.
Strong communication skills and the ability to articulate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

Ask "what problem are we solving and why?" before reaching for a solution.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Foundry
jobs.description:
At a glance

Location:
Cambridge
In-office expectation:
Once every two weeks
Employment type:
Permanent
Salary:
£55,000-£80,000

This role will be a mid or senior level engineer dependant on experience

Why this role exists

Redgate's Foundry is our innovation incubator, the team scanning the horizon for Redgate's next big opportunity. This role exists because that kind of work needs engineers who are genuinely excited by discovery: people who can form a hypothesis, test it fast, and make a clear-eyed call on whether to push forward or change course.

Most ideas won't become products. That's by design. Each experiment sharpens our thinking and improves the odds of finding the one that will. If you're motivated by that kind of challenge, where the destination isn't fixed and the work is never the same twice, this is the role for you.

About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases that their organisations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.

Why join our engineering team?

You'll work in a team that cares about collaboration, craft and quality, not just in how we build, but in choosing what to build, finding the shortest path to the questions that matter most.
There’s real scope to grow your skills and impact, with clear pathways and support.
We value sustainable delivery, good ways of working and time to improve how we build.

About the role

The Foundry operates differently to the rest of Redgate's product teams. You won't be handed a roadmap. Instead, you'll work across the full arc of innovation — from horizon-scanning and ideation through to early-stage research, rapid prototyping, and working directly with customers to validate what you're building.

You'll be part of a small cross-functional team (a Tech Lead plus four to six Software and Machine Learning Engineers), and you'll regularly run projects in parallel: contributing to ongoing experiments while also exploring entirely new directions. The tech stack is deliberately varied, the right tool for the job, not a fixed list, spanning C#, TypeScript, Python, and more across desktop, web, API, database, and ML development.

What makes this role different:

You'll work on problems where there is no established answer and you'll have the autonomy to explore them seriously.
Your work sits at the intersection of software engineering, customer insight, and product thinking; it's rare to find all three in one role.
You'll use and help shape how Redgate adopts agentic coding and AI development tools, not as an afterthought, but as a core part of how the team works.
The scope is genuinely broad: a typical day could see you balancing technical prototypes, customer interviews, and competitor teardowns.

What makes you a great fit

Proven experience using AI coding tools. You've used them extensively, understand their limitations, and have developed ways to work around them productively and safely.
Strong software design and coding skills across modern languages, particularly C#, TypeScript, or Python, enough to guide and review AI-generated code with confidence.
Hands-on experience building agentic systems using frameworks such as LangGraph, Microsoft Agentic Framework, or MCP, with a solid understanding of LLM capabilities and risks.
Experience designing and running experiments to validate ideas quickly, using technical prototypes, customer feedback, and lean startup principles to test assumptions and make clear decisions.
Comfortable engaging directly with customers and stakeholders: running interviews, demos, and concierge-style validation processes, and communicating findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A product mindset; you think in terms of user value, outcomes, and market fit, not just features or technical delivery.

What we offer

Salary range: £55,000-£80,000
Hybrid working: home and Cambridge office
Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off
Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression
Private health insurance

What happens next

Your application will be reviewed by a person, we don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications. Every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

You'll hear back within a few days, whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.

Our interview process is straightforward and consistent, you'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.

Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

In this role, you will help modernize a mission-critical estate of 149 production applications using cutting-edge agentic AI coding workflows, specification-driven analysis, and automated remediation pipelines. The portfolio is predominantly C# / .NET and Python, with Angular, WPF/WCF frontends, SQL Server backends, and internal APIs. Working alongside senior London-based consultants, you will build and drive an advanced AI pipeline designed to improve existing codebases, lift automated test coverage past 70%, clear security vulnerabilities (CVEs), and migrate services to the cloud via GitHub Actions.

Responsibilities

Spec-Driven Insights & Agentic Diagnostics: Apply cutting-edge spec-driven approaches and agentic AI tooling (Copilot agent mode, internal client LLMs, Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude Code) to analyze code health, perform deep-dive assessments, and triage defects at scale.
Vulnerability Remediation: Validate and fix pre-identified security vulnerabilities, execute dependency upgrades, and resolve SAST/DAST/CVE findings to pass quality gates into modern delivery platforms.
Test Engineering & Quality Hardening: Build out functional, integration, and end-to-end test suites using AI tooling, replacing ineffective tests with high-confidence automated suites to reach 70%+ coverage.
Pipeline Extension & BAU Scaling: Enroll additional portfolio services into the standing agentic analysis and remediation pipeline while continuously refining the pipeline's automation patterns.
Extended Architectural Analysis: Perform deep architectural evaluations for flagship codebases exceeding 500k LoC to formulate targeted analysis and refactoring strategies.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with London-based onsite consultants, business stakeholders, and technical teams to validate findings, prioritize backlogs, and align on remediation goals.

Requirements

General Engineering & Legacy Experience: Strong general software engineering background with proven ability to navigate, understand, and contribute production-quality changes across under-documented legacy codebases.
Agentic AI & LLM Proficiency: Demonstrated, hands-on experience using LLMs in software engineering settings to drive agentic coding workflows, generate tests, and remediate non-trivial code at scale.
Testing Discipline: Genuine test engineering mindset—writing high-confidence tests by default and differentiating between raw line coverage and true functional confidence.
Autonomy & Communication: High autonomy with a pragmatic, get-it-done attitude; fluent written and spoken English with clear technical communication capabilities.
Location: Based in Poland, comfortable working in a hybrid model (3 days per week in-office) with regular collaboration across Poland and London teams.

Nice to have

Core Tech Stack Experience: Production experience with C# / .NET (.NET Framework to .NET 6/8 modernization, WPF/WCF replacement) and/or Python.
Spec-Driven & Pipeline Tooling: Exposure to specification-driven AI tools (e.g., JUXT's Allium or GitHub's spec-kit) or experience building repeatable code-analysis pipelines.
Security & CI/CD: Practical experience with CVE triage, dependency upgrades, SAST/DAST tools, and enterprise CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Octopus Deploy).
Domain Knowledge: Prior experience in financial services, asset management, or other heavily regulated enterprise environments.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer - Internal Developer Platform
jobs.description:
About Frontiers

At Frontiers, our purpose is simple yet ambitious: to make science open. We believe open science empowers the global scientific community to accelerate discovery and develop the solutions needed for healthy lives on a healthy planet.

We are one of the world's largest and most influential open-access research publishers. Every article we publish is peer-reviewed and quality-certified, ensuring research is accessible to everyone, everywhere. To date, Frontiers research has been viewed over 4 billion times, demonstrating the real-world impact of science without barriers.

Joining Frontiers means being part of a global, mission-driven organization at the intersection of science, technology, and innovation — working alongside passionate colleagues who care deeply about advancing knowledge for the benefit of society. To learn more about our impact and culture, please watch this video.

The Mission

At Frontiers, we are rewriting the rules of scientific publishing. To support our scale, we are transforming our Engineering Platform into a state-of-the-art Internal Developer Platform (IDP) built on modern principles and AI-augmented workflows — with a North Star of evolving it into an Agentic Development Platform (ADP) where human engineers and AI agents build software side by side, safely and at scale.

We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer
— Internal Developer Platform
to help build and run that platform and the AI-First Delivery capabilities on top of it. This is the modern evolution of the DevOps Engineer role: you won't run a ticket queue — you'll treat the platform as a product, own a capability area end to end, and ship the golden paths, guardrails and automation that let our Stream-Aligned Teams (and their agents) deliver faster and more safely. You'll work closely with our Platform Product Manager and Senior Cloud Architect — turning platform strategy and prioritised needs into working capabilities.

The Technical Context

You will build and operate the capabilities that make up the IDP.

jobs.description:
The Role

As a Backend Engineer at our client, you will contribute directly to the core index layer, processing video indexing based on signals from the algorithm team. Your work will power the auto-tagging engine—the system that splits sports games into distinct events and accurately assigns start and end times to each action. You will balance deep feature development with critical problem-solving in a highly collaborative, AI-integrated environment.

About The Product

The product is an AI-powered sports media platform used by major sports organizations to transform live broadcasts into personalized digital content at scale. Every live stream is continuously ingested, analyzed, and enriched with AI-generated metadata, enabling automatic detection of key moments, intelligent video indexing, and near real-time content creation.

Behind the scenes, the platform processes massive volumes of live and archived video 24/7, powering personalized fan experiences across web, mobile, social, and broadcast channels. The backend infrastructure is built for extreme throughput, low-latency processing, and elastic scaling, combining distributed microservices with production-grade ML inference pipelines to deliver reliable performance under unpredictable traffic peaks.

Team Structure & Collaboration

You will join a focused backend squad consisting of four developers, one QA, and one PM, led by the engineering manager. This squad sits within a larger group of two backend teams and two algorithm teams. Because the index layer relies heavily on algorithm signals, you will work in close daily collaboration with the AI and algorithm teams.

What You’ll Be Doing

Video Indexing & Auto-Tagging: Build and maintain the C#/.NET backend infrastructure that interprets algorithm signals to index videos and auto-tag live sports events
Technical Leadership: Elevate the team by actively participating in design discussions, driving code review standards, and mentoring fellow developers
On-Call Rotation: Participate in a shared on-call pool (approximately one week every five weeks). While critical nighttime or weekend outages are rare, you must remain reachable and have access to a laptop to respond to operations team escalations
Proactivity: Execute tasks independently, demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, and maintain prompt, proactive communication via Slack with the Israel-based team

What We Expect

Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, with 5+ years of commercial .NET experience
Hands-on experience developing within Azure cloud environments
Familiarity with and daily use of AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor)
Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven ability to mentor peers and lead design discussions
High autonomy, independent task execution, and proactive communication habits for effective distributed collaboration
Familiarity with event-driven messaging services such as Azure Service Bus or Kafka
Working knowledge of SQL databases (general proficiency; specific engines do not matter)
Basic familiarity with DevOps terminology and Kubernetes (operational expertise is not required)
Willingness to work in a hybrid mode, 3 days from the office in Warsaw

Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

Direct ownership of pure backend compute at scale—no full-stack dilution, focusing entirely on high-load microservices, indexing engines, and real-time processing
High-autonomy environment with modern workflows where AI tools (Claude, Cursor) are embraced to eliminate boilerplate and keep focus on architecture

JOB DESCRIPTION – NETSUITE ARCHITECT (FIXED TERM CONTRACT - 2 Years)

THE TEAM & THE JOB

The Enterprise Systems NetSuite team owns the support, development and strategic direction of YouGov's NetSuite ERP platform, the system underpinning the company's core finance processes. The team is being reshaped to combine operational analyst support with dedicated architectural capability under the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager.

As NetSuite Architect, you will be the expert-level professional providing technical leadership for the platform on a fixed term contract. You will own the overall technical vision and architecture, define the "how" and "what" of solutions on significant and unique issues, and act as the recognised subject matter expert advising senior stakeholders. You will translate the functional vision for the ERP into an architectural plan and guide its execution, maintaining a future-focused approach to scalability, maintainability and long-term platform evolution.

What You Will Be Doing – Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end technical vision and architecture for the NetSuite platform, translating business strategy into an architectural roadmap.
Design and architect end-to-end NetSuite solutions, including customisations, integrations and workflows, exercising considerable creativity, foresight and judgment.
Make high-impact technical decisions on integration patterns, customisation approaches and data models, evaluating trade-offs between business needs, intangibles and technical constraints.
Assess and document the existing customised NetSuite landscape (scripts, workflows, forms, integrations) to support future transitions and upgrades.
Architect integrations across multiple systems using SuiteTalk, RESTlets and middleware platforms.
Define and enforce NetSuite development standards, governance policies and best practices across the platform.
Lead complex, enterprise-wide NetSuite initiatives from requirements gathering through deployment and post-go-live support.
Conduct solution design reviews, code reviews and performance optimisation assessments, providing expert technical leadership and mentorship to the wider team.
Advise senior business and functional stakeholders, developing recommendations and persuading diverse audiences on platform decisions and module/third-party evaluation.
Produce comprehensive technical architecture documentation, data models and integration specifications so knowledge is retained beyond the contract term.
Work closely with the Senior Finance Systems Implementation Manager, the Senior NetSuite Analyst, Finance stakeholders and third-party providers, staying current with NetSuite platform updates and industry trends.

What You Need To Know (technical & Behavioural Skills/Competencies)

6–8+ years' hands-on NetSuite experience operating as an architect, with a proven track record of leading full implementation lifecycles as a technical leader.
Experience architecting solutions independently across multiple implementations or complex enterprise-wide projects, in more than one enterprise-sized organisation.
Deep technical expertise across the entire NetSuite platform, including expert knowledge of SuiteScript 2.x (Client, User Event, Scheduled, RESTlets, Map/Reduce) and custom development.
Extensive experience with SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk (SOAP/REST), SuiteAnalytics and SuiteBundler, and a deep understanding of NetSuite data architecture, saved searches and custom records.
Strong understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and experience with integration platforms (Boomi, Celigo, Workato, MuleSoft or similar).
Strong knowledge of accounting principles and ERP business processes (Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Financial Close).
Conceptual thinking to work on significant and unique issues where analysis requires evaluation of intangibles, with independent judgment on methods, techniques and evaluation criteria (be accountable).
Ability to convey complex, non-routine information and persuade diverse senior stakeholders across multiple cultures, frequently advising others on complex matters (communicate clearly).
A collaborative approach to technical leadership, building capability in others rather than holding knowledge (trust each other), and staying current with platform and industry developments (be fast).
NetSuite certifications (Administrator, SuiteFoundation; SuiteCloud Developer II preferred) and ideally architect qualifications such as TOGAF or CSA.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Why join YouGov?

Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people’s opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities.

Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do.

Life at YouGov

We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do.

We strive to provide YouGovers with best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We want our employees to have a sense of belonging and uniqueness in a supportive workplace, so they can bring their full selves to work.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Specialist in Digital Automation
jobs.description:
IKEA Group brings together three core businesses: Retail Concept, Range and Supply
. Together we work constantly to improve the IKEA offer and make it more accessible for the many people. IKEA Supply is responsible for securing that the product offer is produced and delivered to our customers. We lead the supply agenda across many functions and work together with all business areas, different business units, but also retail markets to secure customer availability in all markets and sales channels at lowest total cost.

Together we create a workplace where everyone feels free to be themselves, to experiment, try new ways, and dare to ask, “What if…?”. We believe in everyday personal growth and offer the opportunity to develop your career globally. At IKEA we have a vibrant culture where ideas are heard, where there is opportunity to learn new skills and where the goal always is “To create a better everyday life for the many people”. We give down-to-earth, straightforward people the possibility to grow, both as individuals and in their professional roles. We offer this position in a fast-paced, truly global environment with an endless supply of challenges and development opportunities.

Job Description

As a Software Engineering Specialist in Digital Automation, you will combine deep technical expertise with hands-on software engineering to enable the successful delivery of automation capabilities across the IKEA value chain. You will act as a recognised specialist within your area of expertise while remaining actively involved in the design, development, deployment and operation of digital solutions.

The Software Engineering Specialist role builds upon the Software Engineer role by providing deeper expertise within a specialised discipline and supporting engineering excellence across teams, products and technology domains. You will contribute both vertically within your assigned product area and horizontally through collaboration, coaching and knowledge sharing across the broader engineering community.

Within Digital Automation, your specialisation may include areas such as DevOps engineering, cloud engineering, data and integration engineering, API development, Requirement solicitation, security engineering, knowledge engineering, intelligent automation or other specialised technical domains. You will apply your expertise to solve complex technical challenges, improve engineering practices and help shape the evolution of our automation capabilities.

More Specifically, In This Role You Will (be)

Act as a recognised technical specialist within a defined software engineering discipline, driving best practices and providing expert guidance.
Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain software solutions that enable business outcomes and deliver value to users.
Apply and promote modern software engineering practices, including continuous integration, continuous delivery, automation and quality engineering.
Take ownership of complex technical challenges and provide specialist expertise to support delivery teams.
Contribute to architecture discussions and provide specialist input to solution designs and technical decision making.
Explore and evaluate emerging technologies, industry trends and engineering practices that may benefit Digital Automation products and platforms.
Create prototypes, proofs of concept, data models, integrations, configurations or other technical artefacts needed to validate new ideas and technologies.
Support and coach engineers within your area of expertise through mentoring, knowledge sharing and technical guidance.

Qualifications

We are on the journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people, data & technology together - an enabler for IKEA to become an even better home furnishing company in the future. A journey that needs passionate people who embrace change, dare to question and want to make a difference. If that sounds like you, come and join us. Together we can do great things.

We’re doing some amazing things in IKEA Supply; therefore, we need some amazing people – this position is not an exception.

To be successful in this role, we expect you to have:

Experience & Qualifications

Formal qualifications in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an equivalent engineering discipline.
Formal qualifications within a recognised specialist discipline, or demonstrated expert-level experience within that area.
A minimum of five years' professional experience as a Software Engineer.
At least three years of experience within a defined specialist area such as cloud engineering, integration engineering, API development or a similar discipline.
Experience designing, developing, deploying and supporting enterprise-grade software solutions.
Experience influencing technical decisions and driving adoption of engineering standards and good practices.
Experience working within large and complex organisations is considered an advantage.

Knowledge & Motivation

Expert knowledge within a defined specialist software engineering discipline.
Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, methodologies and industry-leading practices.
Good understanding of software architecture, design patterns and engineering quality attributes.
Broad technical understanding across multiple technology domains and how they interact within a larger ecosystem.
Passion for technology, innovation and continuous learning.
Motivation to stay at the forefront of emerging tools, technologies and engineering practices.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Curiosity and confidence to navigate uncertainty, challenge existing approaches and explore new possibilities.

Additional Information

The IKEA culture and values are crucial for our business and day-to-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more regarding our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com .

If you have any questions about the role, please reach out to Akash Jha, Development Manager in D&T SCD. Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. We look forward to receiving your application at the latest 9th October.

You might have some questions about the recruitment process, and we are more than happy to answer those! Feel free to connect with the People & Culture Generalist, Katarzyna Ziółkowska-Niezgoda.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Full Stack Developer who enjoys building modern, scalable, and business-critical applications? Do you want to play a key role in a new strategic initiative within a global organisation while working with modern technologies and cloud-based solutions?

We are currently looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to join our Global Applications team in Malmö, Sweden.

In this role, you will take a leading part in developing new applications and enhancing existing solutions used across ASSA ABLOY's global business. You will work with technologies such as .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, SQL, and Microsoft Azure, collaborating with colleagues across multiple countries and functions.

This is an opportunity for an experienced developer who thrives in a hands-on role, enjoys technical ownership, and wants to contribute to the design, development, and future direction of business-critical applications. You will join a collaborative team environment where knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

What you will do as our Senior Full Stack Developer

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and improving applications and services that support our global business. You will work closely with colleagues across development, support, and business functions to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-focused solutions.

You would also:

Participate in daily operations and strategic digital transformation initiatives, contributing to the ongoing evolution of our application landscape.
Design, develop, maintain, and enhance applications, services, and platforms using technologies such as Microsoft Azure, .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, SQL, MS Windows, Visual Studio, and related tools.
Develop, maintain, and support application platforms and their underlying infrastructure, ensuring reliability, scalability, performance, and required maintenance activities.
Identify and drive improvement and automation opportunities, taking ownership from idea and solution design through implementation and documentation in line with best practices.
Act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders, development teams, business users, and business analysts to translate business requirements into practical solutions.
Architect, design, build, and implement application platforms and services, while delivering new functionality and enhancements for internal customers.
Analyse, troubleshoot, and resolve platform-related issues, coordinate defect resolution across teams, and support the ongoing maintenance, improvement, and documentation of application platforms.

The Skills And Experience You Need

We are looking for someone who has:

At least 5 years of experience in Full Stack Development.
Strong experience with C#, .NET, SQL, and modern application development.
Experience working with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based solutions.
Experience with frontend technologies such as React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
Experience building and consuming APIs and working across the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to deployment.
Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and communicate effectively in English and Swedish.

You are a proactive, structured, and solution-oriented developer who enjoys taking ownership and turning ideas into practical, scalable solutions. You thrive in collaborative environments and are comfortable working closely with developers, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams. Experience working in Agile environments is important, and you bring curiosity, initiative, and a genuine passion for learning new technologies and approaches.

Experience working in enterprise-scale environments, setting up Azure infrastructure and cloud environments, and using tools such as Jira, GitHub, and ServiceNow is considered an advantage. Most importantly, you are someone who can navigate complex technical challenges, balance technical excellence with business needs, and contribute ideas that improve both our technology and the way we work.

What We Offer

We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:

Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills.
A competitive salary
Hybrid model of working
Stable employment in a friendly international atmosphere

We review applications regularly, so don't wait.

We are building diverse and inclusive teams and encourage applications from all who can envision themselves working with us.

To ensure that your personal information is secure, we do not review any applications sent via email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please send an email to Khalil Kabakibi, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at Khalil.kabakibi@assaabloy.com .

Let's together create a safer and more open world!

To find out more about us, visit www.assaabloy.com.

We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.

As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.

As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer (Azure)
jobs.description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom applications-team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation, med leverans av affärskritiska cloudlösningar i hög kvalitet och hastighet, möjliggjort genom Generative AI. Bli en del av oss och hjälp världsledande organisationer att frigöra teknikens värde och bygga en mer hållbar och inkluderande framtid!

Om rollen

Som Cloud Engineer med fokus på Azure blir du en del av vårt Göteborgsteam med cirka 30 engagerade utvecklare som tillsammans skapar affärskritiska lösningar i varierande och spännande kunduppdrag. Du arbetar i agila team där modern teknik, samarbete och verkligt kundvärde står i centrum.

Hos oss är lärande en naturlig del av vardagen. Genom certifieringar, utveckling i uppdrag och arbete i tekniskt komplexa Azure-miljöer får du kontinuerligt stärka din kompetens. AI‑stödd utveckling är en viktig del av vårt arbetssätt, där du använder AI‑verktyg som stöd i ditt dagliga arbete, samtidigt som du behåller fullt tekniskt ansvar för arkitektur, kodkvalitet och säkerhet.

Vi satsar aktivt på att bygga AI‑kompetens och ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas inom området genom praktisk tillämpning, samarbete med specialister och tillgång till kurser. Fokus ligger på att använda AI på ett ansvarsfullt och värdeskapande sätt i utvecklingsprocessen.

Vi ger dig förutsättningarna att växa, både tekniskt och professionellt, och att utvecklas till en nyckelperson inom cloud.

I den här rollen spelar du en nyckelroll i:

Designa, implementera och optimera säkra och skalbara Azure-lösningar
Arbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter och andra kompetenser i tvärfunktionella team
Arbeta med AI‑stöd i utvecklingsarbetet, till exempel för kodgenerering, refaktorering, test, felsökning eller dokumentation
Bidra med din Azure-expertis och aktivt delta i ständig förbättring och innovation

Vi arbetar enligt en hybrid arbetsmodell, där du varierar mellan arbete hos kund, på vårt kontor och hemifrån med flexibilitet utifrån uppdrag.

Din profil

Minst 5 års erfarenhet som utvecklare, med goda kunskaper inom .NET och Microsoft Azure
Praktisk erfarenhet eller vana av att använda AI‑verktyg, exempelvis AI‑baserad kodkomplettering eller AI som “pair programmer” samt förmåga att kritiskt granska och kvalitetssäkra AI‑genererad kod ur perspektiv som säkerhet, prestanda och arkitektur
Erfarenhet av containerteknologier (t.ex. Kubernetes/AKS)
Erfarenhet av CI/CD, exempelvis via Azure DevOps eller GitHub
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har Microsoft Azure-certifieringar, exempelvis AZ-204 och/eller AZ-900 samt certifieringar eller erfarenhet inom AI.

Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas

Möjlighet att ta en viktig roll i utvecklingen av affärskritiska cloudlösningar, där du får påverka arkitektur, och hur AI‑stödd utveckling används i praktiken hos våra kunder
Arbete i tekniskt komplexa och moderna Azure-miljöer, där du får tillgång till och arbetar med den senaste tekniken inom moln, automatisering och AI, tillsammans med erfarna kollegor och ett starkt globalt nätverk av specialister.
En kultur som aktivt uppmuntrar lärande, innovation och kunskapsdelning, med tydliga möjligheter till certifieringar, kompetensutveckling och mentorskap, och där du ges förtroende att driva förändring, utvecklas som expert och skapa verkligt affärsvärde.
Flexibelt arbete som stödjer balans i livet, samt kontinuerligt lärande genom utbildningar, certifieringar och mentorskap
Engagerande tech communities och interna initiativ, i en inkluderande kultur med fokus på gemenskap, hållbarhet och välmående

Ansökan

Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.
