***Project Technical Leadership***


* Lead technical workshops and design sessions; translate requirements into architectural designs and technical specifications.
* Guide implementation teams (dev leads, developers, integration/data specialists) through build, testing, deployment, and post‑go‑live stabilisation.
* Anticipate and manage technical risks and dependencies; drive mitigation strategies and escalations.
* Oversee release strategy and environment management (sandboxes, pipelines, branching, SFDX), enabling reliable CI/CD and quality gates.
***Stakeholder Advisory \& Enablement***


* Advise business and technology stakeholders on platform roadmap and alignment to wider enterprise architecture.
* Communicate technical constraints and trade‑offs clearly; co‑create feasible, value‑driven alternatives with stakeholders.
* Support enablement through whiteboarding, quick proof‑of‑concepts, and knowledge transfer to client and internal teams.

***Team Development***


* Coach team leads and senior developers/consultants; review designs and complex work items; uplift implementation capability through guidance and feedback.
* Contribute to team development (playbooks, accelerators, reusable assets) and run knowledge‑sharing forums.
* Support skill matrix development and resourcing considerations aligned to project demand.

***Pre‑sales \& Account Growth***


* Shape solution approaches for proposals, including effort sizing, delivery plans, risk/assumption registers, and architectural POVs.
* Evaluate and recommend AppExchange or complementary technologies; contribute to differentiators, demos, and benefit realisation narratives.
**Must have skills and experience**
-----------------------------------


* 10\+ years in enterprise software delivery with 8\+ years in Salesforce projects, spanning presales and implementation of medium to large\-scale projects.
* Salesforce Architect certifications (e.g. System Architect, Application Architect)
* Rapid comprehension of client landscapes and ability to define a future‑state architecture and roadmap.
* Deep knowledge of Salesforce platform architecture: multi‑cloud solutioning, security \& sharing, data modelling, Apex/LWC patterns, and performance \& scalability considerations.
* Strong understanding of DevOps and release management (SFDX, source‑driven development, pipelines, quality gates) and integration architecture (MuleSoft/API‑led, batch, SFTP, event‑driven).
* Solid software engineering fundamentals (OO design, design patterns, relational \& NoSQL, testing strategies).
* Excellent communication (storytelling, facilitation, executive updates) and technical writing (solution illustrations, proposals).
* Proven leadership in building and guiding multi‑disciplinary teams and stakeholders.
* Good to have
* Experience in an IT services/consulting environment.
* Additional Salesforce certifications (e.g. OmniStudio, Industries/Public Sector Solutions, Integration, JavaScript Developer).
* MuleSoft certification or equivalent integration experience.
* Enterprise architecture credentials (e.g. TOGAF) and/or cloud certifications (e.g. AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Hands‑on background in Apex/Java, LWC, JavaScript, HTML/CSS—even if not the primary focus now.
* Experience in public sector projects or regulated environments.
***Ways of working***


* Operate as the design authority, ensuring decisions are documented, transparent, and aligned with governance.
* Collaborate in an agile, sprint‑based model while safeguarding architectural integrity and long‑term maintainability.
* Communicate proactively on risks, trade‑offs, and dependencies; enable timely decisions.
* Promote a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement (automation, quality gates, reusable assets).

***Success measures***


* Approved designs with documented decisions; minimal design‑origin defects across QA/UAT/production.
* Appropriate balance of configuration vs. custom code aligned to standards and maintainability.
* Early identification/mitigation of technical risks; no critical severity issues attributable to architectural gaps.
* Positive feedback from leads on coaching effectiveness; increased autonomy and quality in downstream teams.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Workato**
=================



Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission\-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.


**Why join us?**
================



Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a **flexible, trust\-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles**. We are driven by **innovation** and looking for **team players** who want to actively build our company.



But, we also believe in **balancing productivity with self\-care**. That's why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.



If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!



Also, feel free to check out why:


* Business Insider named us an "enterprise startup to bet your career on"
* Forbes' Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
* Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
* Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers
**Responsibilities**
====================



We're building the infrastructure layer that connects enterprise systems to AI: an **MCP Gateway**, an **AI Gateway**, and the services around them. These are the systems that sit between LLM providers and everything else — routing, auth, rate limiting, observability, protocol translation. We're looking for a senior engineer who understands both the systems layer and the AI protocol layer, and who can build production\-grade services in Go and/or Ruby.



In this role, you will also be responsible to:


* **Design and develop the MCP Gateway and AI Gateway** — production services that mediate between applications, AI agents, and LLM providers. This means protocol\-level work: MCP server/client implementations, request routing, streaming, tool\-call proxying, authn/authz, and tenant isolation. You'll build the core infrastructure, not just applications on top of it.
* **Build high\-throughput, low\-latency network services.** You'll work close to the wire: TCP, TLS, HTTP/1\.1 and HTTP/2, JSON streaming, connection pooling, backpressure. When latency matters, you'll know exactly where it goes.
* **Own the data layer from the application side.** Deep PostgreSQL knowledge — schema design, indexing strategies, query planning, transactions and isolation levels, connection management. You're not a DBA, but you can read EXPLAIN ANALYZE output and fix the query, not just add an index and hope.
* **Design for concurrency.** Worker pools, queues, graceful shutdown, backpressure, race\-free shared state. You can profile a service under load (pprof, flamegraphs, query stats), find the bottleneck, and fix it.
* **Drive observability for AI systems.** Metrics, tracing, and logging that actually tell you what's happening — token usage, latency per provider, cache hit rates, failure modes, cost per request.

### **How we work with AI**


* **We encourage — but never force — the use of AI/LLM tools in development.** If AI\-assisted workflows make you faster, use them heavily. If you prefer to write something by hand, that's equally respected. What we care about is the quality of what ships, not how it was typed.
* **You'll have access to nearly every major tool and model on the market** — coding agents, IDEs, frontier models — with very generous usage limits. We want tooling budget to never be the reason a good idea goes unexplored.
* **We actively explore and enhance automated development.** You'll help shape how the team uses AI: agent workflows, code review automation, internal tooling. We build AI infrastructure, so we hold ourselves to being its most sophisticated users.
* **We believe LLM tools give a single engineer full visibility across the product**, regardless of area — frontend, backend, infra, docs. We want people who use that leverage to own problems end\-to\-end rather than stay inside one layer.
* **But the accountability never shifts to the machine.** You own what you merge. You can explain every statement and decision in the final output, and justify and defend the architectural choices to human colleagues in design and code reviews. "The AI suggested it" is never an acceptable rationale.

**Requirements**
================


### **Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills**


* **Senior\-level experience (5\+ years) in Go, Ruby, or both.** Any combination works: deep Go, deep Ruby, or strong in both. What matters is that you've shipped and operated production services in at least one of them.
* **Go candidates:** you know the stdlib deeply and prefer it over frameworks. net/http, crypto/tls, context, goroutines and channels, the memory model. You've done performance optimization on real services — allocations, GC pressure, lock contention — and you understand networking (TCP, TLS, HTTP, JSON) in depth, not just through a framework's abstraction.
* **Ruby candidates:** strong Rails in production — you know where Rails ends and Ruby begins, you've tuned ActiveRecord rather than fought it, and you've built services that stay fast under load.
* **PostgreSQL depth from an application developer's perspective.** Query optimization, indexing, transactions, connection pooling, migrations at scale. You don't need to administer the cluster; you need to write code that treats it well.
* **Concurrency and profiling as a practiced skill**, not a bullet point. You've debugged a production incident with a profiler open.
* **Familiarity with Kubernetes and containers.** You can deploy, debug, and reason about your services in a containerized environment — resource limits, health checks, rolling deploys, networking basics.
* You've built production services with proper observability, deployment pipelines, and security. You know how to run reliable systems and debug distributed systems when things break.

### **AI/LLM Experience**


* You've worked with LLMs at the **protocol level** — message structures, tool calling, streaming responses, caching strategies. You know what's happening on the wire, not just what the SDK abstracts away.
* Familiarity with **MCP (Model Context Protocol)** is a strong plus — ideally you've built or integrated MCP servers/clients and understand the transport and capability negotiation layers.
* You can integrate with OpenAI\-compatible and Anthropic APIs directly, evaluate responses, understand token usage, and optimize for latency and cost.
* **You can judge, audit, and verify LLM output.** You catch subtle bugs, security issues, and hallucinated APIs before they ship — and you're fluent enough in the underlying systems to know *why* the output is wrong, not just *that* it's wrong.

### **Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics**


* You learn fast and stay current. AI infrastructure is moving weekly; you follow it and can evaluate new protocols and approaches quickly.
* You participate in technical design discussions and code reviews, and you can explain complex concepts clearly to engineers and non\-technical stakeholders alike.
* You're comfortable owning the full lifecycle: design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

**(REQ ID: 2945\)**

Ben jij de architect die het overzicht bewaart zonder de diepte te verliezen? Die klanten weet te overtuigen in een pitch én intern de technische koers bepaalt, van eerste verkenning tot livegang? Dan past de rol van Solution Architect bij iO je perfect.

Als Solution Architect ben je de brug tussen de strategische ambities van onze klanten en de technische realisatie ervan. Je vertaalt functionele eisen én non-functionals naar een gedragen solution architecture, documenteert trade-offs en architectuurbesluiten, en begeleidt de realisatie, uitgevoerd door een team van gespecialiseerde engineers.

Je verschilt daarin bewust van de Software Architect: waar die inzoomt op code-architectuur en implementatiedetails, kijk jij naar het grotere geheel, platforms, integraties, schaalbaarheid en de organisatiedoelen die daarachter liggen. Je stuurt geen team aan in de traditionele zin maar je geeft wél technische richting en zorgt dat architectuurbesluiten helder zijn en nageleefd worden.

Binnen onze campus in Utrecht werken we intensief met Digital Experience Platforms (DXP), waarbij composable architectuur, headless-aanpakken en MACH-principes (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless) centraal staan. De focus van onze techstack ligt op .NET, Node.js, Drupal, headless CMS-platformen en frontend-engineering, en we begeleiden regelmatig complexe platformmigraties. Hoe breder jouw technische achtergrond, hoe fijner, maar voor de diepte-specialisaties staan Lead Engineers klaar.

Je bent ook nadrukkelijk client-facing: je werkt mee aan pitches, bouwt klantvertrouwen op en combineert technische scherpte met sterke communicatieve en adviserende vaardigheden.

De lijnen binnen én tussen de teams zijn kort. Collega-architecten staan altijd klaar voor een scrum-of-the-architects, en bij elk project is een projectmanager betrokken, zodat jij je volledig kunt richten op architectuur en advies.

Wat zijn jouw taken als Solution Architect?

Klantsamenwerking & pitches:
Je bent een vertrouwde technische gesprekspartner, van de eerste pitch tot en met de oplevering. Je neemt actief deel aan verkooptrajecten, helpt klanten de juiste technische keuzes te maken, en past je communicatiestijl aan op je gesprekspartner, of dat nu een CTO, een product owner of een business stakeholder is.

Architectuur & Design:
Je vertaalt requirements én non-functionals naar een heldere solution architecture. Je documenteert architectuurbesluiten en trade-offs, identificeert risico's vroegtijdig en bewaakt de architecturale integriteit gedurende de realisatie. Je denkt in alle lagen van de stack, van frontend tot backend, van cloud tot integratie.

DXP, composable & MACH:
Je begrijpt de principes achter moderne DXP-architecturen: composable, headless en MACH. Je weet wanneer welk principe van toepassing is, en welke concrete technologieën, zoals .NET, Drupal, Contentstack of andere headless CMS-platformen, daar het best bij passen. Je maakt het onderscheid tussen architectuurprincipes en de specifieke implementatiekeuzes die daaruit volgen.

Technische sturing:
Je geeft technische richting aan het projectteam. Je helpt engineers bij het nemen van de juiste beslissingen, signaleert pijnpunten en risico's vroegtijdig, en zorgt dat het team op de juiste architecturale koers blijft.

Data & Integratie:
Je kent de principes van moderne integratiepatronen: API-first, event-driven architectuur en messaging. Je ontwerpt integraties die schaalbaar, onderhoudbaar en toekomstbestendig zijn.

Security, Privacy & Compliance:
Security is voor jou geen afterthought, maar een architectuurprincipe. Je integreert privacy by design, IAM en compliance-overwegingen (AVG/GDPR, NIS2) structureel in je oplossingen.

AI-architectuur:
Je kunt klanten en teams adviseren over de rol van AI in hun technische landschap, van het integreren van AI-diensten tot het architecturaal borgen van datakwaliteit en governance.

Organisatiesensitiviteit & advies:
Je hebt een sterk gevoel voor prioriteit en weet hotspots en risicopunten te identificeren. Je geeft helder advies op basis van soms beperkte informatie, en begrijpt de dynamiek binnen verschillende organisaties.

Je groeit bij iO als Professional binnen het Solution Architecture-domein. Je krijgt ruimte om je persoonlijke groeipad volledig zelf vorm te geven, ondersteund door een persoonlijk ontwikkelingsbudget. Je bent actief lid van een relevant Chapter, waar je in lunch- en pizzasessies met collega's uit verschillende teams nieuwe technieken onderzoekt en proof-of-concepts ontwikkelt , denk aan microservices, API-gateways, serverless architectuur en de nieuwste DXP-innovaties.

Daarom ben jij de perfecte Solution Architect

Must-haves

Ruime ervaring in het (mee)bouwen van complexe applicaties en digitale platformen
Aantoonbare ervaring met solution architecture in complexe, digitale omgevingen
Kennis van DXP, composable architectuur, headless en MACH-principes
Ervaring met cloud-omgevingen (Azure of AWS) en moderne integratiepatronen (API-first, event-driven)
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden: je vertaalt technische concepten naar begrijpelijke taal voor klanten en stakeholders
Je hebt ervaring met het werken in een adviserende rol en kunt op basis van bijvoorbeeld SWOT-analyses en strategisch inzicht weloverwogen keuzes maken.
Je kunt op een abstract niveau denken en je gedachten vangen in zowel tekst als diagrammen of een goed gesprek a.d.h.v. een presentatie

Pre's

Ervaring met .NET en/of Node.js
Kennis van Drupal en/of headless CMS-platformen
Ervaring met complexe platformmigraties
Kennis van security- en compliance-vraagstukken: privacy by design, IAM, AVG/GDPR, NIS2
Affiniteit met of kennis van AI-toepassingen in digitale platformen

Dit krijg jij van ons

25 vakantiedagen

Op basis van een 40-urige werkweek.

Reiskosten & vakantiegeld

Uiteraard kun je rekenen op 8% vakantiegeld. Daarnaast hebben we verschillende mobiliteitsregelingen, maar afhankelijk van jouw functie en voorkeur een keuze.

Goede pensioenregeling

Jij legt 4% in en iO vult de rest aan tot de volledige premie.

Hybride werken

Een goede werk- en privébalans is superbelangrijk. Samen met jouw team maak je afspraken over wanneer én waar je werkt.

Gezonde snacks & lunch

Op iedere iO campus pak je de hele dag een gezond tussendoortje en kun je tegen een kleine vergoeding gezond én gevarieerd lunchen.

Persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget

Zet jaarlijks € 3.000,- in om jezelf te ontwikkelen, in je vak of als persoon, met trainingen, events of cursussen.

Milestones & celebrations

En bovenal zijn we bij iO ook gewoon een gezellige club mensen, al zeggen we het zelf. Het Fun & Party-team op jouw campus staat op z'n tijd dan ook garant voor de leukste feestjes.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer bij Navara

Bij Navara bouwen we software die werkt: oplossingen die live gaan en aantoonbare impact maken. Van digitale producten die miljoenen mensen gebruiken tot complexe systemen in het hart van organisaties. Je werkt in Navara teams waarin je richting geeft aan technische keuzes. Met moderne technologie, bewezen engineering practices en veel aandacht voor developer experience helpen we organisaties echte techbedrijven te worden.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Software Developer geef je richting op technisch en architectuurniveau binnen complexe projecten. Je combineert hands-on development met het adviseren over technologiekeuzes, ontwikkelstrategieën, softwarearchitectuur en bewaakt de kwaliteit.
Verder:

Zorg je dat best practices worden toegepast (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development);
Vertaal je business- en technische vraagstukken naar schaalbare oplossingen;
Stimuleer je moderne engineering practices en Developer Experience binnen de teams;
Ben je een inhoudelijke sparringpartner binnen het team, je helpt het technische niveau structureel te verhogen.

Softwareontwikkeling als teamsport

We hebben een passie voor softwareontwikkeling en zien het als een teamsport. Je werkt met gedreven, hoogopgeleide en betrokken software engineers in Navara teams samen.
Kennisdeling zit verweven in ons werk. Denk aan code reviews, pair programming, kennisfestival, LunchLabs en hackathons. Zo blijf je jezelf technisch ontwikkelen en leer je continu van andere engineers.

Onze impact

Je werkt aan software die dagelijks door grote groepen mensen wordt gebruikt. Een aantal voorbeeld projecten waar we nu aan werken zijn:

BerekenJeRecht
: met een team van 5 een applicatie bouwen die miljoenen mensen helpt inzicht te krijgen in hun rechten en financiële situatie (TypeScript, React frontend met Next.js, CI/CD met GitHub Actions, en IAC met Bicep);
Integratie van het nieuwe pensioenstelsel (Wtp)
: alles wat deelnemers en werkgevers zien, loopt via systemen waar jij aan bouwt. Dit doe je samen met een team van 8 collega’s (Python, Docker, AWS, Azure);
Slim laden van elektrische auto’s
: software bouwen in een team van 8 die ervoor zorgt dat auto’s op duurzame en efficiënte momenten worden opgeladen (AWS en TypeScript, Kafka).

Je bouwt dus niet alleen systemen, maar oplossingen die zichtbaar impact maken in de maatschappij.

We werken ook met andere technologieën zoals C#, Java, Python, TypeScript en frameworks als Angular en React. Qua cloudtechnologie werken we met Azure en AWS.

Waarom werken bij Navara?

Bij Navara draait het om samen groeien en beter worden. Geen gebaande paden, maar echte uitdagingen in complexe omgevingen.
Verder kan je nog denken aan:

Er is veel aandacht en ruimte voor ontwikkeling, zo heb je sessies met je Technology Officer en mentor om je ontwikkeling gericht te sturen;
Een helder groeipad, richting technische diepgang of juist leiderschap;
Flexibel werken (hybride);
Regelmatige kennissessies, meetups, hackathons en andere bedrijfsactiviteiten;
Een salaris tussen de € 5.000,- en € 7.000,- euro per maand én maandelijkse bonus;
Een vast contract, leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding, netto telefoon- en onkostenvergoeding en een premievrij pensioen.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Je ziet kansen voor verbetering en neemt het initiatief om samen met je team nieuwe technieken of methodieken uit te proberen. Verder heb jij:
Een technische bachelor, master en/of PhD op zak;
Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring opgedaan;
Een onderzoekende houding waarbij je kritische vragen stelt en het leuk vindt om buiten de gebaande paden naar oplossingen te zoeken;
Een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Over onze Business Unit Zuid-Holland

Je komt terecht in het hechte team van Rotterdam, bestaande uit zo’n 50 collega’s. Ons kantoor ligt op een prachtige locatie aan de Parklaan, midden in het hart van Rotterdam. Het is de ideale uitvalsbasis om, naast het werken bij klanten op locatie, samen te komen met je Navara-collega’s en kennis en ervaringen uit te wisselen.

Naast hard werken vinden we ontspanning en plezier minstens zo belangrijk. Daarom lunchen we samen en organiseren we met enige regelmaat leuke activiteiten en gezellige borrels. Zodra de zon zich laat zien, genieten we van de lunch in onze groene tuin en sluiten we af met een wandeling door het park.

Ben je benieuwd naar meer informatie of wil je eerst even vrijblijvend sparren? Dan is dit natuurlijk mogelijk, we vertellen je graag meer! Solliciteer via LinkedIn of mail naar recruiters@navara.nl.

jobs.title: Wetenschappelijk Software Engineer | Geotechniek
jobs.description:
Heb je een civieltechnische opleiding en zoek je een baan waarin je jouw talent voor softwareontwikkeling inzet om de wereld duurzamer en leefbaarder te maken? Voor Deltares, het kennisinstituut voor water en ondergrond, zijn wij op zoek naar een wetenschappelijk software engineer.

Taken
Dit kun je verwachten als wetenschappelijk software engineer bij Deltares

Je komt te werken in het domein Geotechnical and Flood Defences software. In deze rol ben je dagelijks bezig met om jouw geotechnische kennis te laten landen in onze verschillende open-source softwareproducten.

Al onze producten, binnen de D-Serie waar jij aan gaat werken, zijn van hoge kwaliteit en dat is nodig! Onze wetenschappelijke modellen worden wereldwijd gebruikt voor beslissingen met grote maatschappelijke impact. Denk daarbij aan het beoordelen van damwandconstructies, funderingsontwerpen en stabiliteitsanalyses van dijken. Onderwerpen die hoog op de agenda staan van gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen. Zo draag jij direct bij aan hoogwaterveiligheid en kustverdediging.

Jouw hoofdtaken zijn

Het ontwerpen en programmeren van gebruiksvriendelijke wetenschappelijke software;

Het ophalen en vertalen van gebruikerswensen naar taken die je in samenwerking met (wetenschappelijke) software engineers en specialisten in een scrum-team uitvoert.

Het testen en analyseren van functionele en technische softwarevereisten samen met product owners en specialisten;

Het versnellen en vernieuwen van bestaande simulatiemodellen, waarbij je gebruikmaakt van moderne technologieën, zoals HPC-clusters;

Het verkennen van de mogelijkheden van AI en data science, en technologieën zoals cloud computing, voor nieuwe toepassingen in de deltatechnologie.

Je hoeft niet alle technologieën al te beheersen. Er is genoeg ruimte bij ons om verder te ontwikkelen.

Het
team

Je komt te werken in een team van experts in een samenwerkingsomgeving waarin geotechniek en geavanceerde softwareontwikkeling samenkomen. Een perfecte plek om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen! We werken volgens agile ontwikkelmethodologiën en gebruiken ontwikkeltechnieken zoals Test Driven Development, pair programming en Continuous Integration. De grafische user-interfaces worden geschreven in C#, de onderliggende rekenharten in C++ en de analysetools in Python. De specialisten van de diverse disciplines van Deltares zijn nauw betrokken bij de specificatie en de validatie van nieuwe software.

Vereisten
Wat verwacht Deltares van jou als wetenschappelijk software engineer?

Je hebt de ambitie om hoge kwaliteit software te ontwikkelen en zoekt een baan waarin je kunt blijven leren. Daarnaast vragen wij:

Een afgeronde MSc-opleiding in Civiele Techniek, Technische Natuurkunde, Geotechnical Engineering of een vergelijkbare studie, met minimaal 1 jaar programmeerervaring vanuit je studie of werk.

Basiskennis van geotechniek, grondmechanica, funderingen, waterkeringen of ondergrondse infrastructuur.

Affiniteit met stedelijke en infrastructurele vraagstukken, zoals damwanden, funderingen of pijpleidingen.

Het vermogen om concepten en modelleringsvereisten te vertalen naar robuuste softwareoplossingen.

Je hebt ervaring met objectgeoriënteerd programmeren, het schrijven van testen en het gebruik van versiebeheersystemen.

Het is een pre om kennis te hebben van onderwerpen zoals: softwarearchitectuur, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery, Docker, Kubernetes en/of SOLID en GRASP principes.

Benefits
Wat wij bieden:

jobs.title: Commercial Solutions Engineer - EMEA
jobs.description:
About Dash0

Join Dash0 and help us define the future of observability. We are OpenTelemetry-native, building a delightful, simple, and AI-centric platform that eliminates vendor lock-in and meaningless toil. Shape a product that developers love—all with transparent pricing and cost-control built in.

The Opportunity

As a Commercial Solutions Engineer, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to our customers and prospects in the commercial segment. You'll bridge the gap between product and customer outcomes — designing, demonstrating, and validating Dash0's technical capabilities in real-world environments.

You'll partner with sales and product teams to deliver high-impact Proofs of Concept, guide observability architecture discussions, and ensure customers realize the full technical value of Dash0. This role is based in Amsterdam.

Note: Your internal title would be a Solutions Architect. Our Solutions Engineers work across both Pre-Sales and Post-Sales!

What You'll Do

Design and architect observability solutions leveraging OpenTelemetry, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies.
Translate complex customer requirements into scalable, performant, and maintainable Dash0 implementations.
Develop and execute Proofs of Concept (POCs) that highlight Dash0's differentiated technical capabilities.
Deliver engaging technical demos and presentations tailored to engineering and executive audiences.
Collaborate closely with Account Executives throughout the sales cycle to position Dash0 as the technical solution of choice.
Provide architecture guidance and best practices for observability setup, telemetry data modeling, and OpenTelemetry collector design.
Create and maintain reusable demo environments, reference architectures, and POC templates.
Partner with Product Management to provide technical insights that influence roadmap and feature priorities.

What You Bring

Deep technical knowledge in Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, observability pipelines, and distributed tracing.
Hands-on experience with instrumentation, telemetry data ingestion, and performance optimization.
Strong understanding of modern DevOps, SRE, and platform engineering practices.
Excellent communication skills — you can explain complex observability concepts clearly to both engineers and decision-makers.
Ability to create and execute technical demos, architectures, and POCs that prove business value.
Collaborative mindset — you work seamlessly across Sales, Product, and Engineering teams.

Nice to Have

Experience with CRM tools (HubSpot) for collaboration and pipeline visibility.
Contributions to technical content — blog posts, conference talks, or open-source documentation.
Familiarity with the CNCF ecosystem and community.
Experience in a high-growth, venture-backed startup environment.

Why Dash0

This is a unique opportunity to help build a generational company. Dash0 is backed by top-tier investors including Balderton Capital, Accel and Cherry Ventures and led by a founding team with decades of experience in observability. We're in the middle of a massive growth phase after our Series B — and we're just getting started.

If you're looking for a place where a great product meets great people, where momentum is real and your impact is visible from day one — this is it.

What we offer:

Competitive salary & meaningful equity participation — you'll own part of what you're building
Flexible, remote-first work environment with offices in New York, Amsterdam, and Munich
€60/month phone & internet allowance
Location-specific benefits
Collaborative, fast-moving team culture with a builder mindset
Clear path for career growth and development
Direct access to founders and leadership

jobs.title: Platform Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
THIS IS YOUR JOB

As Engineering Manager Platform, you will own the platform function end-to-end: the operating model, internal developer platform, platform investments, team, and outcomes. This is a hands-on leadership role where you will combine people management with active technical contribution to platform architecture, automation, and engineering excellence. You will lead a team of Platform Engineers and SREs (3–4 FTE), working closely with Product, Engineering, Security, and Architecture to enable high-performing software teams across Effectory.

Our ambition is to build a world-class engineering platform that enables teams to deliver software faster, more reliable, and more securely. You will shape the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our Internal Developer Platform (IDP), creating an environment where developers can focus on delivering customer value while platform capabilities provide scalability, reliability, security, and operational excellence by default.

In this role, you will report directly to the CTO

What you’ll be doing:

Platform Strategy & Developer Experience

Define and own the platform engineering strategy and 12-month roadmap, aligned with company objectives and engineering priorities.
Drive the evolution of our Internal Developer Platform, making infrastructure, deployment, observability, and security capabilities available through self-service experiences.
Continuously improve developer experience by reducing friction, increasing engineering productivity, and simplifying operational tasks.
Establish platform standards, golden paths, and engineering practices that promote consistency across teams.
Partner with engineering leadership to identify opportunities for platform investments that increase delivery speed, reliability, and quality.

Reliability, operations & cloud infrastructure

Own the reliability, availability, and operational excellence of our cloud-native platform.
Lead improvements in observability, incident management, resilience, disaster recovery, and service reliability practices.
Drive infrastructure modernization initiatives across Azure, Kubernetes, networking, and platform services.
Ensure infrastructure and platform services can scale efficiently with business growth and product demands.
Champion automation-first approaches to operations and platform management.

Security, compliance & governance

Collaborate closely with the CISO to embed security, compliance, and identity management into platform capabilities and engineering workflows.
Ensure platform services meet enterprise-grade security and governance requirements.
Drive adoption of secure-by-default engineering practices, automated controls, and policy enforcement.
Contribute to platform and infrastructure decisions that support Effectory's security and compliance objectives.

Engineering leadership

Lead, coach, and develop a team of Platform Engineers and Site Reliability Engineers.
Create a high-performance engineering culture focused on ownership, continuous improvement, learning, and operational excellence.
Set clear goals, priorities, and success metrics for the platform team.
Support hiring, onboarding, career development, and performance management within the team.
Build strong partnerships with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and stakeholders across the business.

Architecture & AI-enabled engineering

Provide technical leadership on cloud-native architecture, platform design, and engineering enablement.
Guide decisions around Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, container platforms, and platform automation.
Set the standard for how platform teams leverage AI, automation, and modern engineering tooling to improve productivity and operational efficiency.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational work and improve platform self-service capabilities.

Hands on platform engineering & technical contribution

Act as a senior hands-on contributor within the platform team, regularly participating in the design, implementation, and operation of platform capabilities.
Lead by example through direct involvement in platform engineering work, including Infrastructure as Code, cloud architecture, automation, CI/CD, observability, and reliability improvements.
Maintain sufficient technical depth and platform expertise to coach engineers effectively and make informed technology decisions.

THIS IS YOU

10+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, or related disciplines.
At least 3 years of experience in an engineering leadership or management role.
Strong experience designing and operating cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure.
A solid background in .NET and modern software development practices.
Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform and/or Bicep.
You enjoy combining engineering leadership with hands-on technical work and are comfortable contributing directly to platform engineering initiatives when needed.

Additionally, You’ll Have

You’re a strong people leader who builds clarity, accountability, and momentum in technical teams. You’re able to set direction, coach engineers and analysts, and create the conditions for high-quality delivery.
You have experience operating in ambiguous, fast-growing environments where ownership is unclear and priorities shift
An energetic, pragmatic, and results-oriented personality with a bias for action.
Privacy and security are essential in our business. You understand what it takes to create highly flexible insights while safeguarding individuals' privacy and meet enterprise security requirements.
You’re fluent in English

THIS IS US

Effectory is Europe’s leading employee feedback solution. Our platform helps HR and leaders collect feedback throughout the employee journey. That feedback is transformed into people analytics that boost productivity, engagement, and retention. 

Built on 25 years of experience, our 200 specialists in Amsterdam and Munich support more than 800 organizations across 70+ countries. Now more than ever, HR is an integral part of business strategy which is why our feedback technology is tailor-made for strategic HR. 

Effectory’s mission 

We are dedicated to improving the working world by giving employees a voice and ensuring their feedback creates real impact. 

Our experts work with HR teams and leaders worldwide to overcome some of their biggest people-oriented challenges. From software engineers to HR specialists, every day we work to improve the working world and we’re looking for talented people who want to be part of that mission. 

This Is What We Offer 

25 days leave on a fulltime basis 
4 “cool down days”(additional company wide days off a year, where the entire office is closed) 
The option to purchase extra holidays 
Your birthday off 
A day off to move house 
A volunteer day off to support something you care about 
Full additional parental leave for partners 
Flexible working hours from 7am – 7pm 
A sabbatical once every 5 years 
Working from abroad option for up to 4 months 
A great lunch (hot & cold,  meat and vegetarian options) at the office, made by our in house chef 
A week of fun and interactive onboarding to get to know Effectory and your new colleagues 
A learning budget for personal development + extensive internal development opportunities 
Budget to set up your home office 
Additional monthly compensation for working from home 
Pension 
Access to financial advice 
Annual Body & Mind budget for anything that energizes or relaxes you 
Yearly Summer School & Winter School 
Annual events: Winter Party, Summer Party & the legendary Big Day 

This Is How It Works 

You want this job:  submit your application via the link below 
We are intrigued: join a phone call to introduce yourself and ask questions 
It feels like a match : we meet live (or via video) to get to know each other better 
We like each other even more: meet potential team members for a friendly deep-dive

The final step : we agree on terms, sign… and you start!

jobs.title: developer
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen?

Je Vertaalt User Stories Naar Technische Oplossingen En Realiseert Verbeteringen Aan De Applicatie BVH (Basisvoorziening Handhaving) Op Technisch En Functioneel Gebied. Je Werkt Zelfstandig Aan De Implementatie Van De Toegewezen Werkzaamheden En Stemt Waar Nodig Af Met Collega's Binnen Het Multidisciplinaire Scrumteam Over Ontwerpkeuzes, Afhankelijkheden En Voortgang. Je Activiteiten

Front- en/of backend ontwerpen, beheren en door ontwikkelen van onze registratieve systemen;
Het ontwikkelen en aanbrengen van wijzigingen in de database;
Het (door)ontwikkelen van het Continuous Integration en het Continuous Delivery proces (o.a. Jenkins);
In sprints waarde voor de business ontwikkelen en opleveren;
Meedraaien in piketrooster voor beheer en implementatie.

Meer over DevOps bij de politie.

Waar ga je werken?

Binnen het productiehuis bouwen en onderhouden zo’n honderd DevOps-teams de informatiesystemen voor de Nederlandse politie. Jij gaat werken bij een DevOps team binnen de productielijn Handhaving.

Binnen De Productielijn Staat Het Delen Van Kennis En Ervaring Centraal. Onze Hoofdtaak Is Het Bouwen, Onderhouden En Beheren Van Een Webapplicatie En De Daaronder Liggende Middleware En Ondersteunende Systemen (API’s). We Werken Volgens De Agile-methodiek Met Prioritering Vanaf De Product Backlog. De Teams Combineren Het Thuiswerken Deels Met Werken Op Het Politiedienstencentrum Te Zwolle. Onze Teams Werken Onder Andere Aan

De Basis Voorziening Handhaving (BVH) waar jij aan gaat werken is de applicatie die door de basispolitiezorg wordt gebruikt om proces-verbaal op te maken van incidenten, aanhoudingen, verhoren, verkeersongevallen, inbeslaggenomen goederen en dergelijke.
De Generieke Gegevens Koppeling (GGK) is een platform dat de uitwisseling van gegevens uit de verschillende BVH's binnen de politie efficiënt en veilig mogelijk maakt door gebruik te maken van RESTful API’s en Event Driven Architecture-oplossingen, met een focus op standaardisatie van gegevens en interoperabiliteit tussen systemen.
De Handhaving Ontsluiting Service (HOS) ontsluit gegevens uit registratieve systemen binnen de BVH naar andere diensten binnen de politie.

Om meer inzicht te krijgen hoe onze systemen bijdragen aan de politietaak stimuleren we onze medewerkers om dit zelf te ervaren door een dienst mee te gaan met een collega in het veld. Gaandeweg de tijd gaan we op in de vernieuwing. Dit is op basis van modules in het verlengde van waar cluster Handhaving mee bezig is.

Wie ben jij?

Jij Kunt Binnen Een Complexe Omgeving Slimme IT-aanpassingen Bedenken En Realiseren. Feedback Geven En Krijgen Gaat Je Goed Af En Je Maakt Je Nieuwe Kennis Snel Eigen. Je Bent Gericht Op Samenwerken En Neemt Het Voortouw Om Het Team Met Elkaar Te Laten Afstemmen. Je Gaat Uitdagingen Niet Uit De Weg En Je Denkt Graag Mee Aan Vernieuwende Oplossingen. Je Hebt De Kennis En Ook Ruime Ervaring Om De Continuïteit En Kwaliteit Van Softwareontwikkeling Te Kunnen Borgen. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Software Engineer bij Navara

Bij Navara bouwen we software die werkt: oplossingen die live gaan en aantoonbare impact maken. Van digitale producten die miljoenen mensen gebruiken tot complexe systemen in het hart van organisaties. Je werkt in Navara teams waarin je veel invloed hebt op technische keuzes. Met moderne technologie, bewezen engineering practices en veel aandacht voor developer experience helpen we organisaties echte techbedrijven te worden.

Wat ga je doen?

Je denkt mee over technische keuzes, vertaalt user stories naar robuuste implementaties en optimaliseert deze continu. Je krijgt veel eigenaarschap binnen kleine, hoogwaardige teams.
Verder:

Zorg je dat best practices worden toegepast (TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based development);
Vertaal je business- en technische vraagstukken naar schaalbare oplossingen;
Werk je in nauwe samenwerking met je team, waarin code reviews en inhoudelijke afstemming centraal staan.

We zien ons werk als teamsport

Je werkt binnen een sterke engineering cultuur met focus op Developer Experience. We zien softwareontwikkeling als een teamsport. Je werkt samen met gedreven engineers aan hoogwaardige oplossingen, met moderne technologie en bewezen best practices als basis.
Kennisdeling zit verweven in ons werk. Denk aan code reviews, pair programming, kennisfestival, LunchLabs en hackathons. Zo blijf je jezelf technisch ontwikkelen en leer je continu van andere engineers.

Onze impact

Je werkt aan software die dagelijks door grote groepen mensen wordt gebruikt. Een aantal voorbeeld projecten waar we nu aan werken zijn:

BerekenJeRecht
: met een team van 5 een applicatie bouwen die miljoenen mensen helpt inzicht te krijgen in hun rechten en financiële situatie (TypeScript, React frontend met Next.js, CI/CD met GitHub Actions, en IAC met Bicep);
Integratie van het nieuwe pensioenstelsel (Wtp)
: alles wat deelnemers en werkgevers zien, loopt via systemen waar jij aan bouwt. Dit doe je samen met een team van 8 collega’s (Python, Docker, AWS, Azure);
Slim laden van elektrische auto’s
: software bouwen in een team van 8 die ervoor zorgt dat auto’s op duurzame en efficiënte momenten worden opgeladen (AWS en TypeScript, Kafka).

Je bouwt dus niet alleen systemen, maar oplossingen die zichtbaar impact maken in de maatschappij.

We werken ook met andere technologieën zoals C#, Java, Python, TypeScript en frameworks als Angular en React. Qua cloudtechnologie werken we met Azure en AWS.

Waarom werken bij Navara?

Bij Navara draait het om samen groeien en beter worden. Geen gebaande paden, maar echte uitdagingen in complexe omgevingen.
Verder kan je nog denken aan:

Er is veel aandacht en ruimte voor ontwikkeling, zo heb je sessies met je Technology Officer en mentor om je ontwikkeling gericht te sturen;
Een helder groeipad, richting technische diepgang of juist leiderschap;
Flexibel werken (hybride);
Regelmatige kennissessies, meetups, hackathons en andere bedrijfsactiviteiten;
Een salaris tussen de € 3.500,- en €5.000,- euro per maand én maandelijkse bonus;
Een vast contract, leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding, netto telefoon- en onkostenvergoeding en een premievrij pensioen.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

Je ziet kansen voor verbetering en neemt het initiatief om samen met je team nieuwe technieken of methodieken uit te proberen. Verder heb jij:
Een technische bachelor, master en/of PhD op zak;
Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring opgedaan;
Nieuwsgierigheid en de drive om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen;
Een goede beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.

Over onze Business Unit Zuid-Holland

Je komt terecht in het hechte team van Rotterdam, bestaande uit zo’n 50 collega’s. Ons kantoor ligt op een prachtige locatie aan de Parklaan, midden in het hart van Rotterdam. Het is de ideale uitvalsbasis om, naast het werken bij klanten op locatie, samen te komen met je Navara-collega’s en kennis en ervaringen uit te wisselen.

Naast hard werken vinden we ontspanning en plezier minstens zo belangrijk. Daarom lunchen we samen en organiseren we met enige regelmaat leuke activiteiten en gezellige borrels. Zodra de zon zich laat zien, genieten we van de lunch in onze groene tuin en sluiten we af met een wandeling door het park.

Ben je benieuwd naar meer informatie of wil je eerst even vrijblijvend sparren? Dan is dit natuurlijk mogelijk, we vertellen je graag meer! Solliciteer via LinkedIn of mail naar recruiters@navara.nl.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

KNDS Deutschland Mission Electronics GmbH, a subsidiary of the KNDS Group, has been developing specialized IT solutions for over 40 years at its Konstanz location. The company focuses on creating secure and robust IT systems tailored for the global security and defense sectors, as well as safety-critical industrial applications. As a comprehensive provider, KNDS Deutschland Mission Electronics GmbH designs, develops, and implements complex, hardened hardware and software systems in close collaboration with its clients. These solutions encompass information and communication systems that meet rigorous security and operational standards. The company’s expertise spans the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept and requirements analysis to deployment, maintenance, and ongoing support. Being part of the KNDS Group, the organization benefits from a strong network and shared technological advancements, ensuring innovative and reliable solutions for its customers.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Developer with a focus on application development to join our dynamic team in Konstanz. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, implementing, and maintaining complex software solutions tailored for military communication systems, hardened hardware platforms, and monitoring and testing systems. You will work within cross-functional project teams, engaging in all phases of the software development lifecycle, from initial requirements gathering to system deployment and maintenance. Your expertise will contribute significantly to developing secure, efficient, and reliable software components that meet stringent safety and security standards. The role offers an excellent opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects in a regulated environment, applying modern software engineering practices and contributing to innovative solutions that enhance national security and industrial safety.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will possess a university degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Communications Technology, or a related field. You should have several years of professional experience in software development within regulated environments, demonstrating your ability to deliver high-quality, compliant solutions. Profound knowledge of programming languages such as Python, C++, or C# is essential, along with a solid understanding of model-based development approaches and contemporary software architecture principles. Familiarity with requirements engineering tools and methodologies is required to effectively translate client needs into technical specifications. Experience with development environments, version control systems, and collaboration platforms is necessary. Additional expertise in areas such as functional safety, IT security, Linux-based systems, communication protocols, and CI/CD pipelines would be advantageous. Candidates should be proactive, willing to learn new technologies, and capable of working independently and systematically while maintaining a high standard of quality. Fluency in German, both spoken and written, is mandatory, and willingness to undertake occasional business trips is expected.

Responsibilities

Design, implement, and document complex software solutions for military communication, hardened hardware platforms, or monitoring and testing systems.
Conduct requirement analysis and participate in system architecture design and requirements engineering processes.
Create and maintain system architectures, develop APIs, and produce comprehensive technical documentation.
Develop test plans and concepts for formal acceptance testing and other validation activities, including documentation.
Assist in preparing project proposals, effort estimations, and technical concepts during client acquisition phases.
Analyze existing codebases to identify bottlenecks, optimize system performance, and ensure system robustness.
Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams to ensure seamless integration and adherence to project specifications.
Stay updated with emerging technologies and best practices, integrating them into ongoing projects and team workflows.

Benefits

Secure employment with a reputable organization in the defense and security sector.
Competitive salary aligned with the Bavarian IG Metall collective agreement.
Additional benefits including Christmas and holiday bonuses.
Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
Generous holiday entitlement of 30 days annually.
Accessible location with excellent public transportation links and available employee parking.
Company-sponsored retirement plan to support long-term financial security.
On-site canteen providing meals and refreshments.
Flexible working hours and Gleitzeit arrangements to promote work-life balance.

Equal Opportunity

KNDS Deutschland Mission Electronics GmbH is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diversity and equal opportunity. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, or other protected characteristics. Our hiring practices are designed to ensure fairness and equal access to employment opportunities, and we strive to create a work environment where all employees can thrive and contribute to our mission of delivering innovative security solutions.

Answer Digital is looking to recruit a Principal Software Engineer to play a pivotal role in shaping how we deliver our large-scale, operationally critical projects.

This is a senior leadership opportunity for someone who wants to help set the direction for software engineering at Answer: co-owning capability strategy, raising the technical bar across our teams, and acting as a trusted voice with our biggest clients.

What you'll be doing

As a key member of the senior Engineering Leadership team, you will help shape the strategy, standards and growth of our largest capability.
Owning the technical direction across multiple client engagements, ensuring the solutions we propose are sound, deliverable and aligned with each client's wider business and technical strategy.
Setting and upholding the engineering standards our teams work to, including code quality, security, assurance and operability, and being accountable for the technical quality of what your engagements deliver.
Leading the technical side of new business: shaping proposals, owning the technical content of bids and pitches, and being a credible senior voice in front of prospective clients.
Driving continuous improvement of our software development practices, tooling and technology choices across the capability
Building trusted relationships with client stakeholders at executive and director level, and acting as the senior technical escalation point across your engagements.
Shaping how Answer adopts AI-assisted engineering, including the standards and guardrails for its use across our teams and how we offer it to clients.
Mentoring and developing senior engineers and technical leads, and building a strong pipeline of technical leadership within Answer
Representing Engineering in cross-capability and company-wide leadership discussions
Representing Answer externally: speaking at and attending events such as Leeds Digital Festival, contributing to the wider engineering community, and helping build Answer's reputation as a place where serious engineering happens

What you'll bring to Answer

A strong track record of technical leadership at scale, ideally across multiple teams or projects simultaneously
Experience providing technical leadership to clients as well as internal teams, including at executive and director level
Hands-on experience delivering large-scale, complex development projects, ideally in a consultancy or software vendor setting
Agile delivery experience with continuous delivery, and a strong grasp of secure, operable software: threat modelling, assurance evidence, observability and cloud cost
Practical experience adopting AI-assisted engineering tooling within teams, and a clear view on where it helps, where it doesn't, and how to govern its use
Deep expertise in .NET, ASP.NET Core and C#
Strong SQL and NoSQL database experience
AWS/Azure experience
JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks
The ability to shape our engineering practice, standards and strategy, not just deliver within it

It would be great if you also had experience in some of these, but if not we'll help you with them

Delivering software in regulated environments, particularly health and the NHS, including clinical safety, data protection and public sector assurance requirements
Technical involvement in bids, tenders and pre-sales
Defining technical solutions involving integration with legacy systems, interoperability and system-to-system integration
Common design patterns such as event-based architecture, CQRS and Domain-Driven Design
Experience contributing to or owning a capability-level strategy (technology roadmaps, standards, hiring strategy)

The perks of being at Answer

We’re an Employee-Owned Company. After 12 months – through the Employee Ownership Trust you will be part of the ownership of Answer; a major factor in driving engagement, retention and growth for our people. We also offer as part of our benefits package:
Competitive salary
Flexible annual leave (buy/sell and carry forward)
Twice a year income-tax free bonus based on company performance - it’s a reward for being a part of our EOT journey
Continuous training and development - if you want to learn, we’ll provide the support you need
Flexible Pension - we match your own contributions up to 5%
A flexible Healthcare cash plan so you can fund the care you value most
A packed social calendar including; end of year party (partners invited) and Summer away days, monthly and quarterly company team socials.
Parking at Head Offices in central Leeds, plus Cycle2Work & Green Car Lease schemes to help get you here
The chance to give back – get involved nationally and regionally with partnerships to get people from different backgrounds into tech, as well as lots of charity and community events

Diversity and Inclusion

At Answer we proudly embrace diversity and inclusion - we want to create a safe environment for everyone to bring their true selves to work.

We will do everything we can to support your application. If you require any adjustments to be made to your application (whether that’s support with our interview questions, adjusting how we interview, or financial support with our hiring process) then please speak to Jonny Hiles, TA Lead (jonny.hiles@answerdigital.com)

A bit more about us.

Answer Digital is a highly successful digital transformation consultancy headquartered in Leeds. We’re a company on a fast growth trajectory with a reputation of delivering large-scale, operational critical solutions.

People are at the heart of everything we do - so much so we’re owned by our people. It sets us apart from most digital businesses you’ll meet and defines our culture and values. Our people are invested in everything we do, because we are invested in them.
Don't believe us? Well check out our glassdoor and here what our people have to say

Our Interview Process

We pride ourselves on having a fair but flexible recruitment process, we want to create a platform where you can show us your best. For us, keeping it simple means you can focus on understanding if our people, values and the work we do are right for you. Our typical process can be broken down into 3 stages;
Recruiter call:
This normally lasts 15-30 minutes. We will talk to you about Answer Digital, the type of work we do, and an overview of the role. We’ll ask you some questions about your current situation and why you’re interested in working here. Here, we’d advise asking any “people” questions, anything about our culture, career progression or approach to flexible working.
Skills based interview:
This interview will be with 2 people, normally from the team you’re applying to work with. We can do this stage remote or in person, whichever you’d prefer. This interview will involve questions around your experience, the skills you’ve gained and the work you’ve done. We’ll also ask questions about the role and challenges you might face and how you’d face them. Here, we’d recommend asking questions about the role, the day to day responsibilities and what life in the team is like.
Cultural/Value interview:
This interview will be with 2 of our Leadership team, either our Directors or Capability Leads. It will focus on our culture and values, talking about our values and what they mean to us as well as understanding what values are important to you and how you like to work. This interview is about making sure Answer is right for you, as much as the other way around. Here, we advise you to ask as many questions around our business model, our ambitious growth plans and anything to do with Answer as a business.

jobs.title: Technical Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
We're recruiting for an experienced Technical Solution Architect to join our Technology team here at Penguin. This role is offered on a permanent basis with hybrid working from our office in Embassy Gardens, London.

This is a senior architecture role with a strong engineering focus. You’ll work to shape and assure our integration architecture, turning wider technology strategy into practical, implementable patterns that our engineering teams can use with confidence.

A key focus of the role will be supporting the modernisation of our integration landscape, as we move away from hundreds of point-to-point and file-based integrations towards a more governed platform of reusable business-domain services, REST APIs, business events and Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces on Azure.

You’ll work closely with engineering teams to guide this transition incrementally, helping us to reduce complexity, improve resilience and make change easier, whilst ensuring the stability and continuity of our existing live services. It’s a role for someone who combines credible architecture expertise with recent, hands-on engineering experience and who enjoys working closely with delivery teams to turn architectural direction into solutions that work in practice.

About the team

The Technology team provides expertise and effective solutions to Penguin Random House. We integrate flexibility and agility which supports our consistent way of working. We set ourselves up for success by holding ourselves accountable and welcoming change. Each member of the Technology team brings skill and initiative to their role; we take personal ownership within a one team culture, working collaboratively to meet expectations from our stakeholders who trust us to deliver.

The role

Key responsibilities:

Own and evolve the target architecture, principles and migration roadmap for Integration Services, defining clear business-domain boundaries, service ownership and stable contracts.
Set reusable architectural patterns for APIs, business events, adapters, synchronous and asynchronous communication, versioning and compatibility.
Design Azure integration solutions using services including API Management, Service Bus, Logic Apps, Functions, App Services, Container Apps or AKS, Key Vault and appropriate data services.
Define non-functional and engineering requirements across security, resilience, performance, scalability, observability, supportability, disaster recovery, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and automated testing.
Create safe modernisation and coexistence approaches for legacy and partner platforms, including adapter patterns, cutover, rollback and decommissioning.
Establish secure-by-design standards across identity, authentication, authorisation, secrets and network controls, alongside appropriate governance for MCP and other AI-facing interfaces.
Maintain hands-on technical credibility through targeted prototypes, proof-of-concepts and technical spikes that help de-risk important architectural decisions.
Lead and contribute to architecture reviews, maintaining clear decisions, standards, reference designs and service documentation, while mentoring developers and enabling teams to make sound technical decisions within agreed architecture.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Data Architecture, Security, Cloud Platforms and delivery teams to ensure integration designs align with wider organisational strategy and controls.
Provide timely architectural guidance during discovery, refinement and delivery, escalating significant enterprise, security, data, commercial or cross-portfolio risks to the appropriate accountable owner.

What you’ll bring

Essential criteria:

Substantial senior software engineering experience followed by credible solution-architecture accountability in complex production environments.
Recent hands-on C# and .NET credibility, including .NET 10+, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs and production microservices.
Strong domain-driven design, distributed-systems and event-driven architecture practice, including service boundaries, contracts and failure modes.
Deep Azure integration and platform knowledge: Service Bus, API Management, Logic Apps, Functions, App Services, Container Apps or AKS, Key Vault, Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
Practical Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code delivery, CI/CD automation and automated testing strategy.
Secure API and service design using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and Microsoft Entra ID.
Ability to balance strategic architecture with delivery pragmatism, operational constraints and incremental migration.
Strong written and visual architecture communication, senior stakeholder influence and constructive challenge across organisational boundaries.

Desirable criteria:

SAP, Blue Yonder, BiblioSuite, EDI or broader B2B integration.
MCP, AI-agent architectures and governance of AI-facing services.
Platform engineering, developer self-service and product operating models.
Data modelling, semantic design, event sourcing or operational data ownership within domain services.
Power Platform integration and governance.
Vendor assessment, procurement support and technical due diligence.

Application instructions

Please apply with your CV by 23:59 on Sunday 4th October 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and the advert may close at any time. We would encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

AI

Here at Penguin, we believe in the power of authenticity and human creativity. When you apply for a position, we want to encourage you to showcase your unique voice. Throughout our recruitment process, please share your own thoughts, experiences, and skills. This helps us get a true sense of who you are and what you might bring to our team.

We celebrate creativity and diverse perspectives, so please be yourself! While we recognise AI tools can be helpful, we recommend using them thoughtfully to ensure your responses reflect you.

Disability Confident

As a Disability Confident Committed organisation, we offer interviews to candidates with a disability who meet the essential criteria for the role, and opt-in on their application form. The essential criteria for this role are listed as part of the ‘What you’ll bring’ section.

Remember, you only need to share what you are comfortable with, for us to support your request.

Salary

The salary for this opportunity is up to £80,000 depending on how your skills and experience align to the role, plus a generous bonus scheme and benefits.

Hybrid working

While our offices across the UK are places to connect, collaborate and celebrate with colleagues, we recognise that flexibility around where you work is just as important.
For this role we expect that you will work from our head office in Embassy Gardens, London a minimum of 2 days per week (Tuesday & Thursday) with additional days for team meetings, townhalls etc as required. There may also be occasional travel to our warehouse site in Frating, Colchester.

jobs.title: Software Development Manager
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Software Development Manager to join our Technology team here at Penguin. This role is offered on a permanent basis from our office in Embassy Gardens, London.

This is a hands-on leadership role, combining people management with technical direction. You’ll lead and develop our developer community, helping us to turn technical strategy and agreed architecture into consistent engineering standards and reliable delivery.

A key focus of the role will be supporting the modernisation of our integration landscape, moving away from isolated Logic Apps and point-to-point integrations towards reusable .NET services, APIs and event-driven solutions, while ensuring the stability and continuity of our existing live services.

Around 70% of your time will be focused on people leadership, capability building, engineering standards and delivery leadership, with around 30% dedicated to purposeful hands-on technical contribution. It’s a role for someone who enjoys leading others while staying close enough to the technology to provide credible technical guidance and support.

About the team

The Technology team provides expertise and effective solutions to Penguin Random House. We integrate flexibility and agility which supports our consistent way of working. We set ourselves up for success by holding ourselves accountable and welcoming change. Each member of the Technology team brings skill and initiative to their role; we take personal ownership within a one team culture, working collaboratively to meet expectations from our stakeholders who trust us to deliver.

The role

Key responsibilities:

Lead, support and develop our permanent software developers across Integration Services, including regular 1:1s, objective setting, development planning, performance management and pastoral support.
Own recruitment, onboarding, retention and succession planning for the developer community, while ensuring contractors work effectively within agreed team standards and ways of working.
Build capability against our target architecture and delivery pipeline, identifying skills gaps and creating practical opportunities for learning, coaching and delegated leadership.
Use your strong C# and .NET expertise to support code and design reviews, pairing, proof-of-concepts and complex technical problem-solving where your input adds the most value.
Define and maintain engineering standards, development controls and quality gates, including CI/CD, automated testing, secure development, observability and operational readiness.
Establish responsible standards for AI-assisted development, covering validation, security, data handling, attribution and human accountability.
Improve developer tooling, source control, pipelines and work tracking where this strengthens delivery, maintainability and control.
Lead healthy Agile delivery across the squads, ensuring effective planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives and day-to-day coordination, while coaching others to take on greater delivery leadership as teams mature.
Support the Head of Integration Services with developer allocation across business-as-usual and project work, balancing service continuity, strategic priorities, individual development and sustainable capacity.
Monitor squad health, capacity, dependencies and delivery risks, providing clear reporting and working with product, programme and engineering stakeholders to resolve constraints.
Own developer deployment, engineering standards and implementation quality within approved architecture, while working closely with Technical Solution Architects, Senior Developers, Squad Leads, Delivery Managers and Product Owners across their respective areas of responsibility.
Escalate significant architecture, security, data, commercial or delivery issues to the appropriate accountable owner.

What you’ll bring

Essential criteria:

Substantial experience as a senior or lead developer or technical team lead, with evidence of solving production engineering problems.
Proven line or team leadership, including developer coaching, performance conversations, objective setting and capability growth.
Deep, current C# and .NET 10+ expertise, including ASP.NET Core and Web API services.
Strong API and microservice engineering, plus event-driven delivery with Azure Service Bus, Kafka or an equivalent messaging platform.
Practical CI/CD, automated testing, Git, secure development and production-support experience.
Working knowledge of containers and infrastructure as code, with the judgement to collaborate effectively on platform decisions.

Desirable criteria:

Azure API Management, Logic Apps, Functions and wider cloud-native Azure engineering.
Node.js, Python or TypeScript in a mixed-language engineering estate.
Integration or middleware modernisation, especially migration from legacy point-to-point solutions.
GitHub, GitLab and Jira, including practical toolchain or pipeline consolidation.
AI-assisted engineering practices and the governance needed for responsible adoption.

Application instructions

Please apply with your CV by 23:59 on Sunday 4th October 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and the advert may close at any time. We would encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

AI

Here at Penguin, we believe in the power of authenticity and human creativity. When you apply for a position, we want to encourage you to showcase your unique voice. Throughout our recruitment process, please share your own thoughts, experiences, and skills. This helps us get a true sense of who you are and what you might bring to our team.

We celebrate creativity and diverse perspectives, so please be yourself! While we recognise AI tools can be helpful, we recommend using them thoughtfully to ensure your responses reflect you.

Disability Confident

As a Disability Confident Committed organisation, we offer interviews to candidates with a disability who meet the essential criteria for the role, and opt-in on their application form. The essential criteria for this role are listed as part of the ‘What you’ll bring’ section.

There may be times when the volume of applications means we cannot take all eligible candidates to interview. We encourage you to tell us about any reasonable adjustments you may need by emailing PRHCareersUK@penguinrandomhouse.co.uk. Remember, you only need to share what you are comfortable with, for us to support your request.

Salary

The salary for this opportunity is c.£100,000 depending on how your skills and experience align to the role, plus a generous bonus scheme and benefits.

Hybrid working

While our offices across the UK are places to connect, collaborate and celebrate with colleagues, we recognise that flexibility around where you work is just as important.
For this role we expect that you will work from our head office in Embassy Gardens, London a minimum of 2 days per week (Tuesday & Thursday) with additional days for team meetings, townhalls etc as required. There may also be occasional travel to our warehouse site in Frating, Colchester.

About the Company

At IMSERV, we're proud to be one of the UK's leading energy data and metering specialists. We deliver award-winning services to customers across the country, providing specialist metering technology for electricity, gas and water, alongside highly accurate energy data collection services.

About the Role

The purpose of the role is to own the Azure platform on which IMSERV’s Astral products are built, tested and run, helping us deliver highly scalable, secure, multi-tenant SaaS software to clients across the globe. You will be one of two DevOps Engineers who together own the path to production: the Azure environments, the CI/CD pipelines, the releases and the security and cost posture of the estate. The pair share the full scope so that no environment, pipeline or release depends on any one individual. This role sits within our Scrum teams, working day to day with Software Engineers, Testers and the Technical Architect. Where they own the code, you own the platform it ships on, through the entire product lifecycle.

Responsibilities

Environment management.
Provision, configure and maintain the Astral environment estate (development, test, UAT/load and production), keeping environments consistent, reproducible and documented through infrastructure as code. Manage environment refreshes and test data in line with our data protection rules.
CI/CD pipelines.
Build, maintain and continuously improve our Azure DevOps build, test and release pipelines, including artifact management, controlled build configurations and pipeline variables, and automated quality and security gates. Consolidate duplicated per-client pipelines toward a single deployment path as the platform moves to multi-tenancy.
Release management.
Plan and execute deployments through the environment chain to production, with rehearsed rollback for every release. Support product go-lives and maintain a clear, communicated release calendar.
Security and access.
Own secrets and certificate management (Azure Key Vault, managed identities), role-based access control and least-privilege across the estate, and platform patching. Work with IT security on audit remediation and the security release plan.
Monitoring, reliability and recovery.
Own observability (Application Insights, Log Analytics), alerting, backups and disaster recovery, including periodic DR tests. Lead incident response for platform issues and run blameless root-cause reviews.
Cost management.
Monitor and optimise Azure spend across environments and clients; right-size resources and report on cost drivers.
Documentation and knowledge.
Keep runbooks, environment documentation and configuration records current, written up the same day work is done. We are removing single points of failure, not creating new ones.
Community membership.
Be an active member of the Scrum team and the wider Product Engineering community, taking part in sprint ceremonies, the Innovation Forum and team events, and unblocking engineers’ environment and pipeline needs quickly.

What you'll need

Essential
Has 5+ years running production Azure environments as their primary discipline (App Services, Azure SQL, storage, networking fundamentals).
Has written and maintained CI/CD, build and deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps (YAML), including artifact management, controlled build configurations and pipeline variables.
Routinely practices infrastructure as code (Bicep, ARM or Terraform) and is a confident scripter in PowerShell and the Azure CLI.
Strong appreciation for secure-by-default platform design: Key Vault, managed identities, RBAC and least privilege.
Has owned monitoring, backup and disaster recovery for a live service (Application Insights, Log Analytics), including responding to and resolving incidents.
Has worked in an Agile SCRUM team and is familiar with the associated ceremonies and artefacts.
Understands SQL Server well enough to manage environment data, refreshes and test data safely (in a Relational Database system).

Desirable:
Microsoft certification: AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert).
Has run or supported one or more of the following Azure PaaS services: Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Azure API Management (APIM), Azure Logic Apps , Azure Data Factory / Synapse / Microsoft Fabric.
Enough C# / .NET to read application code and debug a failing build alongside the engineers,
Experience consolidating single-tenant, per-client deployments into a shared multi-tenant platform.
Experience of enterprise client security requirements (supplier security reviews, ISO 27001-style controls, penetration test remediation).
Practical use of AI-assisted tooling in platform and pipeline work.

Buy & sell annual leave scheme
Up to a 10% bonus
Enhanced salary sacrifice pension
Life assurance (up to 6x salary*)
Simply Health plan (with upgrade options)
Car salary sacrifice scheme*

Job summary
