As AI systems become embedded in critical services, robust testing and validation practices are essential to ensure that models perform as expected, outputs are trustworthy and risks are effectively managed. Ofgem plays a vital role in the UK’s energy system, protecting consumers and enabling a more secure, fair and sustainable energy future, and strong assurance of AI-enabled services is critical to delivering this mission.
Ofgem is on an ambitious transformation journey. Within the Digital, Data and Security Services (DDSS) directorate, we are building advanced data and AI capabilities to support innovation, improve efficiency and enhance decision-making. As part of this, we are embedding modern testing practices across digital, data and AI services, ensuring that quality is built into every stage of delivery.

As the Senior Test Engineer for AI
, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of AI and data-driven solutions. You will lead the design and implementation of testing strategies for complex systems, including AI models, data pipelines and digital services. You will work across multidisciplinary teams, embedding test-driven and behaviour-driven development practices and promoting a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
This is a senior, hands-on technical role requiring strong expertise in testing, automation and AI systems, alongside the ability to influence and mentor across delivery teams.

Job description

You will be responsible for:

Leading the design and execution of test strategies across AI, data and digital services, ensuring alignment with organisational standards and delivery objectives.
Designing and implementing testing approaches for AI systems, including model validation, data quality assurance and pipeline testing.
Embedding quality practices such as TDD and BDD across delivery teams, ensuring early and continuous testing throughout the lifecycle.

Placement, you'll gain invaluable skills by working as part of a team during part of (or multiple parts) the Development Life Cycle. You could be analyzing requirements, designing an application, or defining a test specification or supporting configuration management, database development and system monitoring, engaging with internal and external customers and third-party vendors.

On Wing Technology (Bristol) - Developing intuitive, responsive user interfaces for aerospace applications using modern web technologies. Passionate about Software Engineering
Programming experience in at least one of C#, Java, or Python, with willingness to work across more than one language

To be in your penultimate year of study and returning to education post placement

Organised & able to work towards deadlines
Inspired and curious to learn
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Able to take ownership for projects

Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

Our Values are key to driving our success, and are at the heart of everything we do:

Clients Come First - Always | Execution Supersedes Intention | Together We Win | Diversity Improves Results | Truth Builds Trust

If our mission, values, and purpose align with your own, we would love to hear from you!

Your opportunity

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You will build, and you will lead the people who build. It starts with your own hands on the keyboard; it grows into ownership of a team, its deliverables, and the roadmap they work to.

Janus Henderson is undertaking a firm-wide AI transformation to become the most technologically sophisticated asset manager in the industry. Our AI capability sits in a single centralised function under the Head of AI, and Forward Deployed Engineering is the part of it that embeds with the business and builds what business units cannot stand up alone. As Principal Forward Deployed Engineer you are the most senior engineer in that team and its lead. Reporting to the Head of AI Technology, you set the technical bar, own the team’s deliverables and outputs, and are accountable for what it ships and runs — while still embedding with business units yourself.

You will also form part of the AI Technical Leadership Team, whose remit is to build an AI Technology roadmap that lines up with the JHI strategic roadmap and own the deliverables against it. It works across every AI technology remit — AI Platforms, AI Architecture, AI Engineering, and AI Governance Implementation — keeping them aligned so the firm has one coherent plan rather than four competing ones. It also decides what we adopt: you will review new models, tools, and vendors, test their claims against our own workloads, and judge whether they are feasible here, technically, commercially, and against the constraints a regulated asset manager operates under.

The balance of the role will shift, and we would rather be explicit than discover a mismatch later. Today it is predominantly hands-on: you are expected to be one of the strongest builders in the firm. As the team grows, the weight moves towards strategy, roadmap, and management, and your technical contribution shifts from writing most of the code to setting direction and holding the standard. If you want to stay purely hands-on, the Forward Deployed Engineer role is the better fit.

What success looks like

Your team ships. Solutions reach production, are used, and stay healthy — and you can point to the business outcome, not the delivery activity.
You are still trusted technically. Engineers bring you the hard problems, and you are close enough to the work to help.
The Forward Deployed Engineering roadmap is sequenced, agreed with the AI Technical Leadership Team, and lines up with the JHI strategic roadmap.
Technology decisions are evidence-based, and your engineers grow — people join, get productive quickly, take on more, and stay.

Your responsibilities

Lead the
team and own its deliverables

Line-manage Forward Deployed Engineers as the team grows: hiring, onboarding, objectives, development, and performance.
Own the team’s deliverables and outputs — what is committed, what is delivered, to what standard, and by when.
Allocate people and effort across the demand pipeline, and be the person who says no, not yet, or not like that.
Hold the engineering bar through design and code review, and grow engineers into owning engagements themselves.
Report progress, risk, and capacity to the Head of AI Technology and to business stakeholders honestly, including when delivery is off track.

Build and deliver, hands on

Design, build, and productionise bespoke, higher-complexity AI solutions yourself, taking the hardest and least-defined engagements personally.
Own the architecture and design decisions for the team’s solutions, keeping them secure, scalable, and aligned to the enterprise core stack.
Take solutions through evaluation, observability, and our AI governance checkpoints, and keep them healthy afterwards.

Own the roadmap and the technology choices

Form part of the AI Technical Leadership Team, and build an AI Technology roadmap that lines up with the JHI strategic roadmap.
Work across the AI technology remits — AI Platforms, AI Architecture, AI Engineering, and AI Governance Implementation — owning the Forward Deployed Engineering deliverables and keeping them aligned to enterprise architecture.
Contribute to AI technology strategy, standards, and buy-versus-build, and to the investment recommendations and backlog that follow.
Review new models, tools, and vendors and determine their feasibility here, weighing cost, licensing, security, supportability, and vendor viability alongside capability, and documenting the recommendation — including the recommendation not to adopt.

Embed with the business and build investment capability

Sit with business users and hold the relationship senior enough that the team is invited into problems early rather than handed finished requirements.
Partner with the AI Enablement Partners on escalated demand, and set realistic expectations with senior stakeholders.
Build advanced investment capability on Nexus, our agentic workspace, taking models and signals from one desk into a supported, firm-wide capability, and lead the build-out of citizen developer workflows through to production.
Expose data and capability through Accio, our centralised MCP server, and as skills, tools, and connectors on Nexus, building reusable components rather than one-off integrations.
Co-build enterprise core-stack deliverables with Percepta and AI Engineering, and represent Forward Deployed Engineering in architecture and design authority forums.

What to expect when you join our firm

Hybrid working and reasonable accommodations
Generous Holiday policies
Excellent Health and Wellbeing benefits including corporate membership to Wellhub
Paid volunteer time to step away from your desk and into the community
Support to grow through professional development courses, tuition/qualification reimbursement and more
Maternal/paternal leave benefits and family services
All employee events including networking opportunities and social activities
Lunch allowance for use within our subsidized onsite canteen

Must have skills

At minimum eight years in technical, business-facing engineering roles — forward deployed engineering, solutions engineering, consulting-side software engineering, or engineering embedded in a business unit — including time as the most senior engineer on the work. Former technical founders are encouraged to apply.
Experience leading engineers as a line manager, tech lead, or founder. You need not have run a large team, but you must have been accountable for other people’s delivery.
Strong Python and SQL, and a track record of shipping production applications, with hands-on delivery recent enough to still be real.
Production experience with LLMs — prompt and context engineering, agent development, evaluation, deployment at scale — including agentic capability such as MCP servers, tools, or connectors.
Experience building data pipelines from APIs and enterprise systems, and working knowledge of a major cloud, ideally Azure, with CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure as code.
Experience owning a technical roadmap, and judgement on technology selection — you can evaluate a new tool, model, or vendor, test it properly, and defend the recommendation.
Excellent stakeholder skills, credibility with senior audiences, and the ability to influence without direct authority.
High agency, genuine interest in the business problem, and willingness to move from building towards leading as the team grows.
Experience in a regulated environment where governance, compliance, and data sensitivity shape how solutions are built.

Nice to have skills

Experience standing up a new engineering team or function from scratch, including hiring and defining how it works.
Asset management or financial services domain knowledge, particularly the investment process, front office workflows, or fixed income.
Quantitative investment concepts such as fair value, relative value, signal generation, or portfolio construction.
Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric / OneLake, Azure AI Foundry, model gateways, or AI observability in production.
Vendor selection, commercial negotiation, or licensing at enterprise scale, or contributing to architecture and technology governance forums.

Supervisory responsibilities

Yes. This role line-manages Forward Deployed Engineers. There may be no direct reports on day one; the team is expected to be built out under this role, with line-management responsibility growing accordingly. Until then it carries technical leadership and delivery accountability for Forward Deployed Engineering.

Potential for growth

Mentoring
Leadership development programs
Regular training
Career development services
Continuing education courses

jobs.description:
Employment type:
Permanent

Location:
London/Kubrick HQ (QVS). Client engagements predominantly London & Southeast. ( May require client site visits)

The Opportunity:

We're looking for an experienced Agentic Forward Deployed Engineer to help our clients turn the potential of agentic AI into real-world business impact. Working at the intersection of AI engineering, solution architecture and consulting, you'll take complex customer challenges from initial idea through to production - designing and deploying agentic AI solutions that deliver measurable value.

About Kubrick:

Kubrick is an award-winning AI consultancy helping organizations turn AI ambition into measurable, real-world impact. We design, build and scale solutions that solve complex business challenges and deliver lasting value.

We work with leading organizations across industries including financial services, healthcare, retail, energy, aviation, and the public sector, and partner with some of the world’s leading technology providers, including Microsoft, Snowflake, Databricks, and Collibra.

What sets us apart is how we build capabilities and careers alongside the solutions we deliver. Through continuous learning, hands-on experience, and a collaborative culture, our people develop deep expertise while solving complex, real-world challenges for our clients.

The Role:

As an Agentic Forward Deployed Engineer (Agentic FDE) at Kubrick, you'll work directly with customers to identify where agentic AI can create genuine business value - then design it, build it, deploy it and make it work in the real world.

The role sits at the intersection of AI engineering, solution architecture, consulting and product thinking, taking ideas from an initial customer conversation all the way through to production. You'll do it alongside some of the best technology and specialist capability in the market, including Anthropic Claude, Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure, Databricks and Snowflake.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between a customer boardroom, a whiteboard architecture session and a development environment.

Your work will include:

Working with customers to uncover high-value opportunities for agentic AI, from intelligent automation and knowledge work to decision support and complex operational workflows
Turning ambiguous business problems into practical, measurable AI solutions
Designing agentic architectures covering agents, tools, models, data, orchestration, human oversight and evaluation
Rapidly prototyping and iterating solutions with real users
Building and deploying production-grade agentic AI solutions
Integrating agents with enterprise data, APIs, applications, workflows and identity systems
Ensuring solutions are secure, governed, observable, reliable and cost-effective
Establishing evaluation, testing and monitoring approaches so customers can understand how their AI is performing
Leading technical workshops and communicating complex ideas to everyone from engineers to senior executives
Supporting pre-sales - shaping opportunities, developing technical propositions, contributing to demos and helping customers understand what's possible
Creating reusable patterns and accelerators that make the next AI solution faster and better

Technical Leadership

Demonstrable experience providing technical leadership for engineering teams on AI-oriented projects, ideally in a consultancy environment
Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and influence decision-making at senior levels
Strong understanding of regulatory, ethical, accuracy and security considerations for developing autonomous agentic systems
(Desirable) Degree, Masters or Doctorate in Software Engineering, Computer Science or ML/AI related subject
Strong software engineering and solution-development skills, with the ability to build, test, debug, integrate, and operate production services
Hands-on experience designing AI, data, cloud, automation, or enterprise application solutions
Ability to work across APIs, data platforms, databases, identity, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise integration patterns
Understanding of agentic AI concepts, including orchestration, tool use, retrieval, memory, planning, multi-agent patterns, human oversight, and evaluation
Ability to translate between business outcomes and technical implementation choices
Strong stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, communication, and technical storytelling skills
Comfort operating in ambiguous environments, prioritising effectively, and taking ownership from discovery through deployment
Awareness of enterprise security, data governance, responsible AI, privacy, and compliance requirements

Benefits:

A fast moving and fast growth business which is doing something seriously innovative and valuable. We already have a very supportive, diverse and appreciative client base, giving us stable foundations enabling us to keep working to high standards as we continue to grow. We also offer:

Enhanced paid maternity, paternity and adoption leave, above the statutory minimum, with shared parental leave options
Additional family leave support, including up to 18 weeks parental leave, 5 days dependent care leave, paid fertility treatment leave, and up to 3 weeks paid parental bereavement leave
25 days' annual leave plus 8 bank holidays
Flexible working options, including flexible start and finish times and part-time arrangements, available upon request
Hybrid working, with employees typically spending 2–3 days per week in our London office alongside client meetings and remote working
Pension contributions matched up to 5%
Unlimited mental health support through Help@Hand, available 24/7 for you and eligible family members
Financial wellbeing support
Cycle to Work scheme, saving you up to 43% on a new bike through Evans Cycles
Specsavers eye care vouchers
Internal mobility and career development opportunities
Recognition and reward programs
Learning and development opportunities, including professional certifications
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
Mental health, diversity and inclusion support

Diversity & Inclusion:

To that effect, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from groups currently underrepresented in the industry, including women, those from ethnic minority backgrounds, members of the LGBTQ+ community, disabled people and those who are neurodivergent.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Technical Sales Leadership

Lead strategic technical customer engagements focused on application modernization, AI solutions, developer productivity, and intelligent applications.

Deliver compelling demonstrations, workshops, architecture reviews, envisioning sessions, and proof-of-concept engagements.

Translate customer business challenges into modern application and AI solution architectures.

Guide customers through architectural decisions involving web applications, APIs, microservices, containers, Kubernetes, event-driven architectures, and serverless technologies.

Design scalable, reliable, secure, and resilient application platforms that support current and future business requirements.

Support customers in adopting DevOps, GitOps, platform engineering, and modern software delivery practices.

AI & Intelligent Applications

Design and position AI-powered solutions that enable new business capabilities and user experiences.

About the job

Successful candidates may be based in any of our office locations – London, Cardiff or Glasgow. We especially welcome applicants from Cardiff and Glasgow. (20% hybrid, 1 day per week)

Job summary

Across government, modern infrastructure underpins the delivery of secure, resilient and scalable digital services. As organisations transition from legacy estates to cloud-first environments, the need for robust infrastructure capability—combining reliability, automation and security—has never been greater. Ofgem plays a vital role in the UK’s energy system, protecting consumers and enabling a more secure, fair and sustainable energy future, and strong infrastructure services are fundamental to delivering this mission.
Ofgem is on an ambitious transformation journey. Within the Digital, Data and Security Services (DDSS) directorate, we are modernising our core infrastructure, evolving from legacy environments to hybrid and cloud-native platforms. This includes strengthening our Azure capability, improving automation and embedding consistent standards across infrastructure delivery.

As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer
, you will play a key role in delivering and maintaining Ofgem’s infrastructure services. You will work across legacy, hybrid and cloud environments, ensuring systems are reliable, secure and aligned with enterprise standards. You will combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership, supporting colleagues, influencing design decisions and driving continuous improvement across the infrastructure estate.
This is a technically focused role within a fast-paced and evolving environment, offering the opportunity to work on both operational services and transformation initiatives.

Delivering and supporting Azure Legacy, Azure Hybrid and Azure Cloud infrastructure environments, ensuring reliability, performance and security across services.
Working with architects and delivery teams to translate designs into operational infrastructure solutions aligned with enterprise standards.
Providing technical leadership and acting as an escalation point for complex infrastructure issues.
Leading troubleshooting and root cause analysis, implementing long-term solutions to improve system stability and resilience.
Developing automation and configuration management approaches using tools such as PowerShell, Terraform and Azure CLI.
Supporting the adoption of modern engineering practices, including Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD and monitoring solutions.
Managing infrastructure components across their lifecycle, including patching, backup, disaster recovery and compliance activities.
Collaborating with vendors and third-party providers, ensuring effective delivery of infrastructure services.
Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across infrastructure, tooling and operational processes.

We are looking for:

A technically strong infrastructure professional who can operate effectively across both legacy and modern cloud environments. You will bring hands-on experience in Azure and hybrid infrastructure, alongside a proactive approach to problem-solving and service improvement.
You may come from an infrastructure, cloud engineering or DevOps background, but you will demonstrate:

Strong experience managing Azure and hybrid infrastructure environments
Experience with automation tools and scripting, such as PowerShell, Terraform or Azure CLI
A solid understanding of infrastructure security, networking and operational best practice
Experience troubleshooting complex systems and delivering sustainable improvements
The ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders across teams

A relevant certification such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
is expected.
Experience mentoring colleagues and contributing to capability development would be beneficial.
This is an opportunity to play a key role in modernising Ofgem’s infrastructure landscape. You will help ensure that core systems are resilient, scalable and fit for the future, supporting the organisation’s digital transformation and enabling delivery of critical services.

Demonstrable experience working within infrastructure engineering teams supporting both legacy systems and modern cloud-native platforms, including exposure to Kubernetes-based solutions (Lead Criteria).

Strong hands-on experience implementing and supporting infrastructure in Microsoft Azure, including core areas such as networking and security (Lead Criteria).

Practical experience contributing to good DevOps practices, supporting CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation through tools such as Terraform.
Previous experience maintaining operational stability while contributing to continuous improvement, ensuring infrastructure solutions align with organisational standards.
Demonstratable ability to work across technical teams, vendors, and stakeholders to deliver reliable and scalable infrastructure services.

Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate

Making Effective Decisions
Working Together

jobs.title: Software Engineering Leader for Digital Automation
jobs.description:
IKEA Group brings together three core businesses: Retail Concept, Range and Supply
. Together we work constantly to improve the IKEA offer and make it more accessible for the many people. IKEA Supply is responsible for securing that the product offer is produced and delivered to our customers. We lead the supply agenda across many functions and work together with all business areas, different business units, but also retail markets to secure customer availability in all markets and sales channels at lowest total cost.

Together we create a workplace where everyone feels free to be themselves, to experiment, try new ways, and dare to ask, “What if…?”. We believe in everyday personal growth and offer the opportunity to develop your career globally. At IKEA we have a vibrant culture where ideas are heard, where there is opportunity to learn new skills and where the goal always is “To create a better everyday life for the many people”. We give down-to-earth, straightforward people the possibility to grow, both as individuals and in their professional roles. We offer this position in a fast-paced, truly global environment with an endless supply of challenges and development opportunities.

Job Description

As a Software Engineering Leader for Digital Automation, you will shape the technical direction, engineering practices, and architecture of Automation solutions across IKEA Supply. Working closely with Digital Product Teams, Software Engineering Managers, Platform Engineering Leaders, Architects, and business stakeholders, you will drive engineering excellence and help deliver scalable, resilient, and future-ready automation and AI solutions. You will play a key role in defining engineering standards, guiding technical decisions, and evolving our capabilities in automation, AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent workflows.

As a technical leader and role model, you will mentor engineers, promote best practices, and help teams deliver business value through modern engineering and emerging technologies.

More Specifically, In This Role You Will (be)

Define and drive the engineering direction for Digital Automation platforms and products.
Act as the technical authority for software engineering, automation engineering, AI engineering, and platform development practices.
Drive adoption of engineering standards, development frameworks, architecture principles, and secure-by-design practices.
Lead technical design and architecture discussions for automation, AI, and agentic solutions.
Mentor software engineers, automation engineers, and technical specialists while fostering a strong engineering culture.
Evaluate new technology trends and emerging capabilities in AI, Agentic AI, Computer Vision, and Intelligent Automation.
Partner closely with Architects, Platfrom engineers and Software Engineer managers to define future technical roadmaps.
Lead Proof of Concepts (PoCs), Proof of Technologies (PoTs), and technical innovation initiatives.
Drive engineering excellence through reusability, automation, quality practices, observability, and operational resilience.
Champion AI-native software development and AI-assisted engineering practices across the organization.

Qualifications

IKEA are on the journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people, data & technology together as an enabler for IKEA to become an even better home furnishing company in the future. On this journey we’re doing some amazing things; therefore, we need some amazing people – this position is not an exception.

We are looking for a leader who is passionate about developing people and technology capabilities while enabling business transformation through automation and AI. To succeed in this role, you are a collaborative and people-focused engineering leader who can inspire, coach, and mobilize teams towards shared objectives. You combine strong engineering understanding with the ability to build trust, develop talent, and drive change in a fast-paced environment.

We Believe You MUST have

Software Engineering Leadership: 8+ years of experience in software engineering, automation engineering, or digital product development, with proven experience leading technical direction across engineering teams.
Development Background: Strong hands-on development experience using modern programming languages, frameworks, APIs, integrations, and cloud-native architectures.
Engineering Excellence: Deep understanding of software engineering principles, architecture patterns, DevOps practices, quality engineering, security, scalability, and maintainability.
Intelligent Automation Expertise: Extensive experience delivering solutions using digital automation technologies like RPA, workflow automation, Process Mining, Power Platform, and AI-enabled automation.
AI Engineering Experience: Practical experience building, integrating, or governing AI-powered applications and services, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI copilots, and AI orchestration frameworks.
Agentic AI Knowledge: Good understanding of Agentic AI concepts, autonomous workflows, multi-agent systems, tool orchestration, human-in-the-loop patterns, and governance considerations.
Technical Leadership: Experience driving engineering standards, technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and establishing best practices across distributed teams.
DevOps & AI Tooling: Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering tools and modern development practices to improve developer productivity and software quality.

Nice to have

Knowledge of Computer Vision, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), OCR technologies, and multimodal AI solutions.
Experience with Microsoft Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI Foundry, or equivalent AI platforms.
Experience building enterprise-grade AI and automation platforms.
UiPath Solution Architect, Advanced Developer, or Microsoft AI certifications.

The IKEA culture and values are crucial for our business and day-to-day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more regarding our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com .

Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft.

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
AI Labs is a sub-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self-serve access to the AI-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Hi there!

We are STX Next, a global IT consulting company specializing in customer-focused software services. Join a group of 500 professionals dedicated to helping customers build outstanding products. Leveraging the latest advancements in the field, and a passion for innovation, we're shaping the future of technology one project at a time.

Are you the NEXT one?

Type of contract
A B2B contract for your flexibility and competitive compensation package

Location
A remote model. Work anywhere from Poland but be ready for regular business trips.

Role Description

We are looking for an engineer
who would rather sit in a client's office and build the thing than sit in ours and specify it.

STX Next builds software for European companies, and we are changing how we do it. Instead of sending a team and a project manager, we send one engineer who owns the client. You work inside their business, you find out how it actually runs, and you build. Behind you sits an AI pod, a small team of engineers plus our own agent tooling on our AI SDLC, which takes on the bulk of delivery once you have proven what is worth building.

The name is literal. Forward deployed means physically there. Not remote, not from our office, not on a call. You will be at the client's premises around four days a month, and the whole role depends on it.

What This Role Is Not

You will write production code. If you want to stop being hands-on, this is the wrong move.
It is not a specialist post. Not only data, not only AI, not only backend. Versatility is the point, because you will not get to choose what the client's problem needs.
It is not project management. Reporting cadence, documentation and invoicing stay with our PM function.
It is not new business development. Winning new logos stays with Sales. You grow the client you already have.

What You'll Do

Own one client, end to end. You are the one name the client knows, from the first conversation through discovery, build, production and whatever comes after it. Nobody hands them on to a successor.
Find the real problem. Discovery is not a workshop. It is watching how the work is really done, listening for the manual workaround nobody has mentioned, and working out whether fixing it would actually move the client's numbers.
Build the prototype yourself. The way you prove something is worth doing is to build a working version of it and put it in front of the client. Not a deck, not a recommendation. A thing that runs.
Lead the AI pod behind you. You decide who is on it, you are accountable for what it ships, and you stay close enough to know when it is drifting. As delivery settles, more of it moves to the pod and more of your time goes to the next problem.
Make the value legible. You will show the client what a change saved them in hours, cost or risk, in numbers their own leadership can act on. Technical elegance is not the argument.
Unlock the next project. Once the current work is safe, your job is to spot the next problem, prototype the answer and put the case to the client. Our commercial team handles pricing, contracting and paperwork. The idea and the conversation are yours.
Bring it back to us. What you learn about how this client works, and about how we should estimate and sell this kind of work, comes back into our playbooks and accelerators. The second engagement should be cheaper than the first.

What We're Looking For

Strong, broad engineering. You can design, build, deploy and run a real system end to end, across the stack, in an environment that will not look like a clean internal codebase.
Working command of AI. Real understanding of what current AI tooling can and cannot do, and where an accelerator shortens the path. Not prompt literacy.
Translation, both directions. You listen to a business problem and come back with a technical option framed as a commercial decision. Cost, risk, payback, and what happens if the client does nothing.
Communication as a first-class skill. You can hold a room with a CTO and a CFO at the same time and make sense to both. You send the update before anyone asks for it, and bad news comes from you first.
You behave like an owner. The team is yours, the client is yours, the result is yours. You will have the mandate that goes with that, including the standing to advise a client against work we could have sold.
Comfort with ambiguity. No finished spec, a moving target, and a client who often cannot yet articulate the problem. If that reads as energising rather than exhausting, good.
Language. Fluent English, spoken and written. Polish if you will be working with our Polish clients.

Extra package

Pay that reflects the ownership. Market salary for a senior engineer of this calibre, plus an uncapped bonus tied to the margin your account delivers and to the new work you unlock.
A genuine mandate. Decision authority over your pod, your technical approach and the proposals that go to your client, with the access to project financials that makes that real.

What You'll Get

Remote-First Flexibility

Stay where you feel most productive. Here’s a remote-first environment with the freedom to set your own schedule. Whether you need a midday break or a specific routine, we trust you to manage your time and deliver results while maintaining your personal well-being.

Cafeteria & Health Membership

We provide access to premium medical packages which include Medicover Sport. You can also choose a MultiSport card and group insurance options. All these packages are managed through Cafeteria System, giving you the autonomy to choose exactly what fits your lifestyle.

Collaboration Mindset

Facing a complex challenge? At STX Next, you collaborate with true enthusiasts and experts who prioritize professional support and direct, honest feedback.

Tech Events

Gain access to specialized knowledge through bootcamps, Strategic Skills Labs, and Tech Knowledge Hubs focused on AI, Data, and Cloud. Beyond our internal webinars and technical materials, we host branded meetups like DevDuck and PAIDA.

In-person Networking

We support autonomy by enabling project groups to set up their own internal meetings in a location they prefer, often in our Poznań or Gliwice offices, which are great for coordination and building professional relationships. We also take a break from our screens twice a year for our Summer and Winter events.

Professional Toolkit

Prior to your first day as a NEXTer, you will receive a top-tier equipment setup: laptops, monitor, and peripherals tailored to your needs and specific project role.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award-winning B2B tech unicorn with an ambitious mission to revolutionize the payroll & payments industry. With over $400M raised from multiple tier-one investors, our innovative technology provides a comprehensive solution for managing global workforces, encompassing everything from hiring and onboarding to managing and paying employees in over 160 countries.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Architect
to join Papaya's central Architects Team
— a small group of senior architects that partners with every R&D department in the company. In this role you won't own a single product silo; instead, you'll move across domains (payments, payroll, workforce management, platform, data, security) to help teams shape sound, scalable, secure systems and to keep Papaya's overall technical direction coherent.

This is a hands-on architecture role at the intersection of engineering, product, security, and DevOps. You'll be expected to dive deep into unfamiliar domains quickly, influence without direct authority, and bring the highest bar of technical thinking — including modern AI-assisted engineering practices — to everything you touch.

If you're energized by hard problems at global scale, by working across many teams rather than one, and by shaping how a modern engineering organization actually builds software in the age of AI, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Lead architectural design across multiple Papaya domains and infrastructure systems, ensuring solutions meet business, scalability, performance, and compliance needs.
Act as a trusted architectural partner to R&D, Product, Security, and DevOps teams — translating business and product requirements into clear technical direction.
Define and maintain high-level architecture across domains, with a focus on seamless integration, maintainability, and long-term evolvability.
Build hands-on Proofs of Concept (POCs) to de-risk architectural decisions, validate new technologies, and demonstrate viable paths forward before broad investment.
Lead technical Due Diligence on third-party vendors, platforms, and integrations — evaluating architecture fit, scalability, security posture, compliance, operational maturity, and long-term cost.
Drive secure-by-design practices, embedding security, privacy, and regulatory considerations into every stage of system design.
Evaluate and introduce emerging technologies, frameworks, and patterns — including AI/LLM-based capabilities — where they create real leverage for the business.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and agentic workflows across R&D, helping teams use them effectively, safely, and consistently.
Define and steward Papaya's architectural guidelines, standards, and best practices, and help ensure they are actually applied in day-to-day delivery.
Provide technical mentorship and architectural guidance to development teams across the company.
Review designs, RFCs, and critical implementations to maintain architectural consistency and system quality across projects.

Requirements:

Experience & background

8+ years of proven experience as a System / Software Architect designing robust, scalable systems.
12+ years of hands-on software development experience, with strong proficiency in Java (preferred) or an equivalent backend language.
Proven experience building enterprise SaaS platforms, self-service products, and highly scaled production systems.
Experience in financial technology (FinTech) or other regulated industries is a strong advantage.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

Technical depth

Deep expertise in cloud-native architecture; strong advantage for AWS (Lambda, ECS, S3, RDS, IAM, etc.).
Hands-on experience with microservices, event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS), and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Strong command of software design patterns, SDLC, and system integration strategies.
Expertise in design paradigms such as DDD, TDD, EDD, and principles like SOLID, KISS, DRY, SSOT, and CQS.
Solid grasp of security fundamentals: encryption, authentication, authorization, data privacy, and secure coding practices.
Proficiency with SQL and NoSQL databases, and API design using REST and GraphQL.
Practical experience with Git branching strategies, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.

AI-powered engineering (required)

Deep, hands-on experience with at least one agentic AI coding tool such as Claude Code
, Cursor, GitHub Copilot (Agent Mode), or Codex CLI — used regularly on real, non-trivial work.
Practical fluency with AI productivity tools across the broader workflow: LLM chat assistants for design and review, AI-assisted code review, documentation generation, and research.

and the broader pattern of connecting AI agents to internal tools, data sources, and services.
Awareness of the security, privacy, IP, and quality risks of AI-assisted development, and opinions on how to mitigate them at an organizational level.
Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities and agent-based components into backend products and workflows is a strong plus.

Ways of working

Demonstrated ability to drive end-to-end delivery of complex features — from architecture through production.
Excellent analytical skills and a strong self-learning instinct; comfortable ramping up quickly on unfamiliar domains.
Strong communication and influencing skills — able to align engineers, product managers, and senior stakeholders around a technical direction.
Excellent written and verbal English.

As a Software Engineer in Digital Automation, you will design, develop, test, deploy and maintain high-quality software that enables automation and supports business outcomes across the IKEA value chain. You will apply modern software engineering principles and use appropriate tools, automation and delivery practices to create secure, reliable, reusable and maintainable solutions. Within Digital Automation, your work may include workflow and process automation, integrations, APIs, low-code or pro-code extensions, data models, cloud services and AI-enabled capabilities. Apply and promote modern software engineering practices, including version control, code review, automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery.
Work collaboratively in an agile, cross-functional team, contributing to planning, backlog refinement, delivery, maintenance and continuous improvement.
Create and evaluate solution proposals and prototypes, such as mock-ups, data models, integrations or proof-of-concept implementations.
Continuously explore relevant technologies, tools, standards and working methods that can improve innovation, productivity, reliability and user experience.
Produce and maintain appropriate technical documentation and proactively share knowledge, learning and good practices with colleagues.
Contribute to team and product performance indicators and work with colleagues to continuously improve delivery effectiveness and technical quality.

Qualifications

We are on the journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people, data & technology together - an enabler for IKEA to become an even better home furnishing company in the future. A journey that needs passionate people who embrace change, dare to question and want to make a difference. If that sounds like you, come and join us. Together we can do great things.

Experience & Qualifications

Experience designing, implementing, testing, deploying and maintaining software solutions.

Experience working collaboratively in cross-functional and culturally diverse teams.

Technical knowledge of relevant technologies, standards, protocols and interfaces, and the ability to apply them effectively.
Clear communication skills, verbally and in writing, with the ability to collaborate and build relationships across organisational levels and backgrounds.
Passion for delivering high-quality software and a great user experience.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer – Stockholm
jobs.description:
Är du en systemutvecklare inom .NET som inte bara skriver kod, utan utvecklar lösningar som fungerar idag såväl som håller och utvecklas över tid? På Solita vill vi också något mer, vi tar initiativ, samarbetar och utforskar för att skapa en AI- och datadriven framtid.

Som Senior .NET Developer blir du del av ett växande område med runt 20 konsulter inom cloud, AI och systemutveckling. Samtidigt får du kollegor från hela Solita med expertis i allt från data, strategi och mycket mer att dela kunskap och perspektiv med, läs mer om det här och ta del av insikter från utvecklare på Solita redan nu i vår Dev blog här.

När vi nu växer gör dina möjligheter också det, du får vara med och påverka kulturen, affären och din roll.

En dag på Solita

En dag på Solita kan börja med ett standup-möte med teamet på kunduppdraget, ibland består det av fler kollegor från Solita. Är det fredag kanske du jobbar från Solita kontoret i Stockholm för att starta dagen med frukost. Andra dagar jobbar du från kundens kontor eller hemifrån.

Sen kliver du in i ditt arbete, när du stöter på ett problem söker du upp en lång diskussionstråd i slack med insikter från kollegor som haft samma problem. Andra gånger passar du på att fråga en kollega vid kaffemaskinen om deras perspektiv för att komma vidare. Du kan också delta i interna utbildningsmöten där vi delar kunskap om allt från nya tekniker och arbetssätt till välmående. Vissa dagar avslutar du med AW, brädspel, filmkväll eller annan aktivitet du och kollegor tycker är kul.

Din roll som Senior .NET Developer

I rollen som Senior .NET Developer utformar och utvecklar du robusta och skalbara lösningar – från idé till produktion – för organisationer inom alla möjliga branscher från sjukvård till e-handel, transport och energi. En kollega beskriver sin roll som en “ Glue Engineer ”; du binder samman olika projekt genom att kombinera kundinteraktion, förundersökningar och kodning. Det roligaste med rollen enligt en annan kollega är “att få kombinera teknik och problemlösning: förstå hur olika delar hänger ihop, bygga något som verkligen används, och se helheten fungera i praktiken.”

Du kan exempelvis vara med och modernisera och migrera en plattform, utveckla nya datadrivna produkter eller optimera systemutvecklingsprocessen med implementationer av AI- eller automationslösningar där de skapar som mest värde.

Känner du igen dig i följande?

Du kan kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är ett plus om du varit konsult tidigare, det avgörande är din förmåga att snabbt komma in i nya sammanhang och lära dig. Tack vare flera års erfarenhet av att bygga moderna lösningar genom hela utvecklingscykeln, främst i C# .NET, känner du dig trygg i rollen då du fått med dig:

Vana att jobba med distribuerade system och eventdriven, skalbar arkitektur. Gärna med tekniker som Kafka, RabbitMQ eller Azure Service Bus.
God förståelse för Dev(Sec)Ops-principer, CI/CD och orkestrering.
Erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller GCP. Har du jobbat med containerization (Kubernetes, Docker) eller Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, Bicep) är det en extra tillgång.
Nyfikenhet på AI i utvecklingsarbetet: hur verktyg som GitHub Copilot, OpenAI API:er eller ML-integrerade pipelines kan göra kodningen smartare och effektivare.

Vi letar inte bara efter tekniska skills, vi vill jobba med dig som tar ansvar för att bygga rätt lösningar på rätt sätt genom att utmana med omtanke. Du ser kod som ett hantverk, inte bara ett medel till funktion: du bryr dig om kvalitet, läsbarhet och hållbarhet. Du kommer trivas hos oss om du tycker om att dela med dig av din kunskap lika mycket som du är nyfiken på- och lyfter andras.

Vad vi erbjuder

Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete och trevliga kollegor. Här kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.
Meningsfulla projekt: Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna
Flexibilitet och autonomi för att utforma ditt arbete med flextider– läs mer från vår blogg här.
Ständig utveckling: Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen.
Innovativ kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling – läs mer i bloggen här.

Utöver detta får du även ta del av följande förmåner:

💰 Fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande
🏦 Pensionsavsättning i linje med ITP1 samt möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande vid inkomst över 8,07 inkomstbasbelopp
🏖️ 30 semesterdagar
🏥 Sjukvårdsförsäkring för både din mentala och fysiska hälsa som täcker dig även utanför tjänstetid
🏋️ ♀️ Friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr via Benifex (tidigare Benify)
🔗 Intern coach för att stödja ditt välbefinnande
🪩 After Work och hobbyaktiviteter
🥐 Fredagsfrukost

Vilka är vi?

Solita är ett värderingsstyrt konsultbolag med över 2200 medarbetare i 9 länder, varav ca 230 i Sverige. Vår storlek gör oss tillräckligt stora för att vara en stabil och innovativ arbetsgivare, men samtidigt tillräckligt små för att värna om våra medarbetare och kunder. Med bred kompetens inom digital transformation erbjuder vi en dynamisk arbetsmiljö. Hos oss får du friheten att utvecklas, både professionellt och personligt.

Intresserad av att höra mer?

Låter det som en intressant möjlighet? Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team som ligger i framkant inom systemutveckling!

Om du har några frågor, skriv gärna till Jacob Beck på Linkedin alternativt kontakta via mail på Jacob.Beck@solita.fi.

Hur ser processen ut?

I rekryteringsprocessen tror vi på en snabb och effektiv process. Du ansöker med CV eller LinkedIn och svarar på några korta frågor. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Om vi ser en potentiell matchning, bjuder vi in dig till ett första möte för att lära känna dig och berätta mer om vår kultur och våra värderingar på Solita. I andra intervjun fokuserar vi på din tekniska kompetens och din erfarenhet. Om allt går bra tar vi oss vidare till sista steget där vi presenterar ett erbjudande och välkomnar dig som ny Solitan!

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs

På Norion Bank arbetar vi enligt en hybrid-setup med både kontorsarbete och distansarbete. Kontorsarbetet sker på vårt huvudkontor vid Lilla Bommen i Göteborg. Där sitter våra team tillsammans vilket främjar både kommunikation och samarbete.

OM NORION BANK GROUP

Norion Bank Group är en affärsnära nordisk finansieringsbank. Genom koncernens varumärken Norion Bank, Walley och Collector erbjuds kundanpassade finansieringstjänster som möter distinkta kundbehov inom tre kundsegment: medelstora företag och fastighetsbolag, handlare och privatpersoner. Som specialist på finansieringslösningar är Norion Bank Group ett ledande komplement till traditionella storbanker, med visionen att vara den främsta nordiska finansieringsbanken inom de utvalda segmenten.  

Norion Banks erbjudande omfattar företags- och fastighetskrediter samt factoring för medelstora företag och fastighetsbolag. Genom varumärket Walley erbjuds flexibla betal- och checkoutlösningar till handlare och privatpersoner. Varumärket Collector tillhandahåller privatlån och kreditkort till privatpersoner samt sparkonton för privatpersoner och företag. Norion Bank Group (tidigare Collector Bank) grundades 1999 och har kontor i Göteborg, Stockholm, Helsingborg, Oslo och Helsingfors. Verksamheten bedrivs genom Norion Bank AB (publ) som är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm.  

NORION BANKS ERBJUDANDE TILL DIG

För oss är det självklart att varje individs utveckling värdesätts högt vilket innebär ett stort fokus på självledarskap och kompetensutveckling. Gemenskap, innovation och modern arbetsmetodik är saker som kännetecknar Norion Bank Group. Vi erbjuder dig helt enkelt en organisation med snabba beslutsvägar, stor öppenhet och mycket energi.

Vi erbjuder dig ett spännande bolag med goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, löpande kompetensutveckling och gemensamma aktiviteter på och utanför arbetsplatsen.

jobs.description:
As a Solution Designer you will be part of a dedicated agile Software Development Team and your main responsibilities are:

To guide and support the agile development team to build high quality software solutions
To develop and design robust and sustainable IT Solutions to ensure the best user and customer experience.
To act as a bridge between business and technical knowledge
Be able to translate user stories into detailed solutions and integration design, following architecture guidelines.
To team up with IT Solution Architects and Solution Designers to collaborate on technical aspects by following and improving Vattenfall IT framework and guidelines
To refine and review business requirements to ensure the most effective use of infrastructure, IT systems and customer experience
Your solution design and software development skills are according to best practice principles
Contribute to agile team norms and coding standards, software design best practices, and architecture strategy
Use, ensure and implement secure software development
Be an ambassador for application solution best practices and application security
Share your software development and solution design best practices with your peers within IT

Qualifications

We believe you will thrive in this role if you have strong communication skills, a solid understanding of the IT business, and a collaborative mindset, along with the ability to motivate others. A deep interest in driving value-creating innovation is key. We also value experiences that have helped you develop leadership capabilities.

Your Background Peferably Include

University degree in Information Technology, Engineering or other relevant education
At least 6 years of the tech stack: Angular 20+, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS .net core 9, Microsoft Azure Cloud solutions
Including: Experienced fullstack developer (Frontend and Backend)
Experienced in Frontend software development
Experienced in API development, design, integration and management

At least 5 years’ experience in Solution Design and good understanding of IT architecture within end to end web and cloud solutions
Have used Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, Git, Tailwind, Bootstrap, SAST and DAST tools in your daily work
A deep interest in driving value-creating innovation and of using AI software development tools (like Cursor, Github CoPilot and MS Foundry)
Knowledge of  Optimizely (EpiServer CMS) development is a beneficial
Experience in Agile frameworks and agile software development  
English fluently both oral and written is a must and it is beneficial if you also speak Swedish fluently both oral and written

You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues as ‘Ask and Share’ concept is essential for the way we work. jobs.title: Software Engineer | Product Management | Range Core
jobs.description:
Hej Software Engineer,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?
With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilities, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.

Our team is based in Malmö. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important.

Your new job

We are hiring for two positions within this role. We’re looking for Software Engineers who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be software development within the Product Management domain, contributing across several product components. You will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining solutions. Your expertise will be essential in driving the success of our projects and ensuring optimal performance.

The Product Management team manages the total offer by establishing and lifecycle-managing products and services in the range, ensuring product information can be managed or automatically derived from detailed engineering and manufacturing data. You will report to a Software Engineering Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world. On a typical day, you will:
Develop, maintain and operate software code within the assigned technology domain, platform or product
Apply and promote good software engineering practices such as CI/CD within an agile and iterative development approach
Deliver tested, maintainable and well-documented code in line with agreed architectural principles and security requirements
Work closely with team members to ensure quality, reuse and learning across the product area

What we’d like you to bring to the table

The role as a Software Engineer requires you to:
Have good knowledge of software engineering principles and practices
Have solid experience in both frontend and backend development
While technologies and tools may vary between teams, you should feel comfortable working with programming languages such as React/NextJS, Typescript, C#, .net, Node.js
Have a solid understanding of API design and integration (REST/GraphQL)
Have some knowledge of databases (SQL &/or NoSQL &/or PostgreSQL)
Be familiar with version control (Git)
Have experience working in agile or iterative development teams, ideally with a DevOps setup
Have experience developing, testing and maintaining software in one or more relevant technology stacks
Be able to collaborate effectively with other engineers and cross-functional roles
Take responsibility for code quality, including automated testing, documentation and continuous improvement
Contribute to a product mindset by understanding user needs and business outcomes, and adapting how you develop software accordingly

It's a plus if you also:
Have experience working across multiple components or products within a digital product area
Support the ongoing shift towards treating data and software as products, by being open to new ways of working and value-based thinking
Experience in generative & agentic AI with principles surrounding, agent orchestration & systems thinking, context & memory management, evaluation & verification literacy, AI governance & security.
Experience in Microsoft Azure services, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as Code, Containerization & Orchestration, version control, scripting & automation.
Experience developing PIM solutions/applications with skills around Data modelling & governance, data migration & synchronization, workflow automation.

Be yourself, a Software Engineer, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.

This position is based in a part of IKEA that we call 'Range Core'. We support key flows in managing the range offer as well as the capabilities needed to create physical products and their core information. Our mission is to simplify and enable product and information creation and maintenance through software.

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 4th of October at the latest. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to contact the Recruiter Vera Bendz, vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com or Hiring Manager Joseph Jeffrey joseph.jeffrey1@inter.ikea.com.

Please note that applications sent by email will not be processed.

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers dreams and needs.

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in Core Business Range and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB provided competence requirements are met for the role.

jobs.title: Azure AI Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Att välja Capgemini innebär att välja en arbetsplats där du ges möjlighet att forma din karriär på det sätt du själv önskar, där du ingår i en stödjande och inspirerande gemenskap med engagerade kollegor världen över, och där du får chansen att omdefiniera vad som är möjligt. Våra Cloud & Custom applications-team fokuserar på att utveckla skräddarsydda cloudapplikationer, integrera IT-system och driva affärstransformation, med leverans av affärskritiska cloudlösningar i hög kvalitet och hastighet, möjliggjort genom Generative AI. Bli en del av oss och hjälp världsledande organisationer att frigöra teknikens värde och bygga en mer hållbar och inkluderande framtid!

Om rollen

Vill du arbeta hands-on med att utveckla och implementera AI-drivna lösningar i moderna molnarkitekturer? I ett av våra team på Malmökontoret leder Patrik ett engagerat, kompetent och prestigelöst team med stark sammanhållning. Teamet har ett tydligt fokus på Microsoft Azure och arbetar kontinuerligt med kompetensutveckling inom cloud, data och AI. Målet är tydligt: att vara en helhetsleverantör inom Microsoft Azure, end to end. Hos oss tror vi att verkligt värde skapas när du behärskar båda sidor av AI: att både bygga med AI och att bygga AI-lösningar som skapar affärsvärde för kunder.

Som Azure‑specialist på Capgemini blir du en del av ett högpresterande, agilt utvecklingsteam som bygger affärskritiska lösningar för våra kunder. Vi arbetar med breda, moderna och framtidssäkra tekniska lösningar, framför allt baserade på Microsofts ekosystem. Vi designar och bygger AI-enabled applikationer och skalbara cloudlösningar för internationella organisationer i framkant, inklusive integration av generativa AI‑tjänster, dataflöden och API:er i moderna cloudlösningar. AI är inte ett stöd, det är en central del av lösningarna vi bygger.

Du arbetar med internationella kunder i framkant och bidrar i transformationsprojekt som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Samtidigt blir du en del av ett stöttande team där samarbete, lärande och innovation står i centrum, och där vi har roligt tillsammans längs vägen.

Under det senaste året har teamet intensifierat sin satsning på Azure AI, Generative AI och agentbaserade lösningar. Genom strukturerade kompetensinitiativ, XProjects och praktiska AI-use cases bygger vi nu vidare på vår Azure-expertis för att kunna leverera moderna, säkra och AI-drivna lösningar till våra kunder.

I den här rollen spelar du en nyckelroll i:

Designa, bygga och vidareutveckla skalbara, säkra och AI‑drivna lösningar i Microsoft Azure
Samarbeta tätt med utvecklare, arkitekter och andra specialister i tvärfunktionella och agila team
Arbeta med AI i två dimensioner: både som ett verktyg för att effektivisera utveckling (t.ex. generera, granska och förbättra kod) och som en kärnkomponent i de lösningar du bygger
Utveckla intelligenta lösningar såsom copilots, AI workflows och datadrivna applikationer som skapar mätbart affärsvärde
Arbeta aktivt med AI‑stöd i utvecklingsprocessen, exempelvis för att generera, granska, förklara eller förbättra kod samt för test och felsökning
Använda din Azure‑expertis för att driva förbättringar, dela kunskap och bidra till innovation och ständig utveckling

Vi arbetar enligt en hybrid arbetsmodell, där du varierar mellan arbete hos kund, på vårt kontor och hemifrån med flexibilitet utifrån uppdrag.

Din profil

Minst 4 års erfarenhet av arbete med Microsoft Azure
Stark bakgrund inom .NET, cloud development och DevOps
Erfarenhet av att både använda AI i utvecklingsprocesser och bygga AI-drivna lösningar
Förståelse för hur AI används i skalbara system och skapar affärsvärde
Erfarenhet inom ett eller flera Azure‑områden, till exempel Azure Integration, Azure Native Development, Cloud Adoption & Governance, App Modernization eller Azure Big Data, AI & ML
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska

Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas

Möjlighet att bygga AI-drivna lösningar på riktigt, inte bara använda AI som verktyg
En roll där du utvecklar båda sidor av din kompetens: att arbeta effektivt med AI och att skapa AI-lösningar som gör skillnad
En modern tech-miljö där AI, cloud och data möts
En kultur som uppmuntrar lärande, innovation och kunskapsdelning, med tydliga möjligheter till certifieringar, kompetensutveckling och mentorskap
Flexibelt arbete som stödjer balans i livet, i kombination med kontinuerligt lärande och utveckling
Möjlighet att arbeta med teknik i framkant och påverka, i samarbete med andra specialister och några av världens ledande organisationer
En inkluderande kultur med stark gemenskap och attraktiva förmåner

Ansökan

Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.

Om Capgemini

Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.

jobs.title: Test Engineer

Vi tror på ett samhälle format av framgångsrika företag där entreprenörskap och samhällsnytta går hand i hand. Att vara en del av Fortnox är att vara en del av en ständig förändring - en förändring där du själv bestämmer hur långt du vill nå. Vårt största fokus är att ge dig rätt förutsättningar att få leva din passion tillsammans med oss. Var du kommer ifrån är inte relevant - det är vart du är på väg som är intressant för oss. Precis som vi igår inte kunde drömma om det Fortnox som finns idag, så kan du vara med och forma vilka vi är imorgon.

Om tjänsten

Nu söker vi en Test Engineer till Fortnox och produktområdet Styrning & Kontroll. I denna roll spelar du en central roll i att säkerställa kvaliteten på våra produkter genom att verifiera krav och testa funktionalitet. Du blir en del av ett team som driver utvecklingen av både kommunikation- samt ärendehanteringssystem. Här får du chansen att påverka, experimentera och vara med och skapa det som kommer att definiera morgondagens redovisning.

Som Test Engineer kommer du att vara involverad i analysarbete, felsökning och releasehantering samt hantera beroenden mot både interna och externa tjänster. Du ansvarar för att skapa rätt förutsättningar och metoder för att kvalitetssäkra produkten i ett så tidigt skede som möjligt. Du är med genom hela processen – från att diskutera krav och ta fram lösningsförslag till att deploya nya versioner av våra tjänster i olika miljöer. Genom ditt arbete säkerställer du den bästa möjliga upplevelsen för våra användare och har en direkt inverkan på tusentals företags dagliga verksamhet.

Om dig

För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du är lösningsorienterad och trivs i en dynamisk och föränderlig miljö. Du uppskattar teambaserat arbete, har en analytisk förmåga och tänker gärna i nya banor. Du är strukturerad och noggrann, samt kommunikativ och bekväm med att diskutera krav med utvecklare och övriga stakeholders i organisationen. Vi tror även att du:

Har några års erfarenhet av professionellt testarbete eller motsvarande erfarenhet från en liknande roll.
Har koll på testning av REST APIer (t.ex. med Postman, RestAssured, eller liknande verktyg).
Har jobbat med automatiserad testning med verktyg som Selenium, Cypress, Playwright eller motsvarande.
Har erfarenhet av scriptning (exempelvis med Python, JavaScript, Bash eller PowerShell).
Har jobbat med prestanda- och belastningstestning (exempelvis JMeter, k6, Locust).
Är flytande i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift.

Fortnox - mitt i företagslivet

Fortnox hjälper företag att starta, växa och utvecklas. Med smarta tekniska lösningar för företag och redovisningsbyråer, smidig finansiering och ett ekosystem av starka partnerskap är Fortnox ett nav för företagande i Sverige. Vi drivs av visionen om ett välmående samhälle format av framgångsrika företag.

Fortnox grundades 2001 med huvudkontor i Växjö. Läs mer på www.fortnoxgroup.com.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Behandling av personuppgifter

Vi på Fortnox värnar om din personliga integritet. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss kommer vi att behandla dina personuppgifter för att administrera rekryteringsprocessen. Personuppgiftsansvarig är det bolag som du söker arbete hos och är något bolag inom Fortnoxkoncernen. Du kan läsa integritetsmeddelandet i sin helhet på följande länk:

Our approach focuses on energy efficiency and optimal utilisation, ensuring that electrification is not only sustainable but also financially and commercially viable for our customers. their knowledge of business domains, quality assurance, testing strategies, and test automation. You

should expect to contribute to testing and quality assurance activities when needed, as quality is a

shared responsibility across the team.

What You Will Be Responsible For

Working with a team of software engineers in the design, development, and maintenance of software applications and sometimes even manual testing. 
Design and implement robust and efficient solutions using programming languages like primarily APL also sometimes in C#.
Working with product management to refine new features 
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and define software requirements 
Developing core functionality to support the business modules 
Ensuring software quality through comprehensive testing and validation 
Conduct code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to best practices  
Writing and maintaining unit tests to ensure software quality and reliability 
Maintaining the existing code base 
Constantly learning and developing yourself and our product 

What We Are Looking For 

We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest. 

1–8 years of experience in software development, with a passion for building high-quality software solutions.
Good working knowledge of C#, .NET Core/Framework, and object-oriented design principles.  
Interest in developing testing and quality assurance skills, with a willingness to contribute across both development and testing activities when needed.

Genuine willingness to learn and to dig into unknown areas  
A commitment to constantly deliver value to the clients, to improve yourself and the team  
You are interested and able to work with complex architecture 
Understanding Agile practices, values and principles allow you to better understand how we work  
Strong communication and collaboration skills 

What We Value 

Are motivated to work within the financial domain  
Are willing to acquire other technical and programming skills  
Consistently learn through experimentation when addressing the latest problems, using experiences from both accomplishments and setbacks 
Can introduce new ways of looking at problems and that you can take creative ideas and put them into practice  
Are able to work in a hybrid setup (virtual and physical work environments)  
We embrace AI in our everyday work. From GitHub Copilot to emerging tools, we encourage our Engineers to innovate and use AI to work smarter and build better products. 
Eager to broaden your skills beyond software development and grow into business areas as quality assurance, testing strategies, and test automation.

Benefits   

Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.  
Growth and innovation - Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team or the application.  
Self-Direction - High degree of self-organization. Each team and developer have a high degree of freedom to plan, organize and design their work.  
Inclusive and diverse company culture  
Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace  
Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes  

NEXT STEPS
