jobs.title: Senior Backend Specialist
jobs.description:
Senior Backend Specialist

Location:

Aarhus C, DK, 8000

Category: IT

Job Type: Headquarter

Vil du være med til at forme fundamentet under Søstrene Grenes digitale fremtid?

Vi søger en erfaren backend-udvikler, der har lyst til at kombinere hands-on udvikling med teknisk lederskab. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores digitale udviklingsrejse og får mulighed for gradvist at tage det tekniske ansvar for backenden bag vores digitale univers.

Om jobbet

I dag er vores platform primært bygget på Umbraco og .NET og understøtter både sostrenegrene.com, vores indhold og en stadig større del af forretningen. Samtidig står vi foran en spændende transformation, hvor vi ønsker at bevæge os mod en mere moderne og skalerbar arkitektur med tydelige domænegrænser og stærke integrationer.

Som Senior Backend Specialist bliver du med til både at definere retningen og realisere den. Rollen kombinerer arkitektur, udvikling og teknisk sparring med interne og eksterne udviklere. Du refererer til vores E-commerce Technology Manager og samarbejder tæt med vores Senior Frontend Specialist, samtidig med at du har en tæt dialog med forretningen om de behov, vores løsninger skal understøtte.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at

Være med til at forme og implementere vores fremtidige backend-arkitektur
Kortlægge og udvikle centrale domæner og services i vores platform
Modernisere og videreudvikle integrationer til forretningskritiske systemer
Sikre en stabil, performant og fremtidssikret platform
Etablere gode standarder for kvalitet, test, deployment og dokumentation
Coache, sparre med og understøtte udviklere i teamet
Bidrage aktivt med kode og tekniske beslutninger i hverdagen

Vi tror på, at holdbare tekniske løsninger skabes gennem godt håndværk, samarbejde og velovervejede skridt fremad. Derfor arbejder vi langsigtet og med fokus på kvalitet frem for hurtige genveje.

Om dig

Du har solid erfaring som senior .NET-udvikler og har arbejdet indgående med Umbraco. Du kender platformens styrker og muligheder, men også dens begrænsninger, og du trives med at finde løsninger, der skaber værdi både teknisk og forretningsmæssigt.

Du interesserer dig for arkitektur og systemdesign og har erfaring med komplekse løsninger. Samtidig ved du, at god arkitektur ikke handler om at følge de nyeste trends, men om at skabe den rette løsning til den virkelighed, den skal fungere i.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

Har flere års erfaring med .NET og gerne Umbraco
Har arbejdet med arkitektur, integrationer og skalerbare løsninger
Har erfaring med at sætte teknisk retning, formelt eller uformelt
Motiveres af at sparre med og udvikle andre mennesker
Tager ansvar, når udfordringer opstår, og deler succesen, når målene nås
Kan kommunikere komplekse tekniske valg til både udviklere, projektledere og forretningsinteressenter
Arbejder struktureret og kommunikerer klart, både mundtligt og skriftligt
Ser AI-værktøjer som en naturlig del af moderne softwareudvikling og er nysgerrig på, hvordan de kan skabe reel værdi i hverdagen

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er mindre vigtig for os. Måske er du datalog, måske har du fundet en anden vej ind i faget. Det vigtigste er din faglighed, din nysgerrighed og din evne til at omsætte idéer til løsninger sammen med andre. Vi forventer ikke, at du har alle svar fra første dag, men vi håber, at du har lyst til at udforske dem sammen med os.

Om Søstrene Grenes Ånd

Hos Søstrene Grene stræber vi efter at røre folks hjerter gennem et unikt univers, der omfavner mangfoldighed og inklusion og skaber et imødekommende fællesskab for alle uanset køn, etnicitet, religion, handicap eller baggrund.

Vi har en arbejdsplads, hvor alle bliver kaldt "Søster" uanset køn. Vi deler glæder, gør hinanden stærkere og griner sammen. Dét kalder vi Søsterånd, og vi opfordrer på det varmeste alle til at søge og være med til at skabe en levende og rummelig arbejdsplads.

Der er mange gode grunde til at vælge Søstrene Grene

Hos os får du en attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring og vi prioriterer det, der gør en forskel i hverdagen og skaber trivsel.

En vigtig del af den trivsel handler om fællesskab. Vi værner om det kollegiale sammenhold, som dyrkes både i de enkelte teams og på tværs af landegrænser og funktioner. Derudover har vi en aktiv personaleforening, som arrangerer alt fra fredagsbar og foredrag til sportsaktiviteter.

I vores nye, lyse lokaler midt i Aarhus kan du glæde dig til friskbrygget kaffe fra espressomaskinen og en af Danmarks bedste frokostordninger. Og fordi balance er vigtig, tilbyder vi fleksible rammer og mulighed for hjemmearbejde, så arbejde og privatliv kan gå op i en højere enhed.

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: Åboulevarden 21, 8000 Aarhus C

Arbejdstid: 37 timer om ugen

Start: Hurtigst muligt

Ansøgningsfrist: Hurtigst muligt. Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at lukke stillingen, når vi har den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Vision and Robotics
jobs.description:
Job Description

Do you thrive in designing and developing software solutions for modular robotics platforms? Are you motivated by taking responsibility for the entire software development process and ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards?

If so, we might have the right job for you!

As a Software Engineer within vision and robotics, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining software solutions while ensuring compliance with quality and architectural standards. Moreover, you will contribute to the successful implementation of solutions by conducting training sessions for internal stakeholders and end users. You will support projects, collaborate closely with the Technical Product Owner (TPO), and ensure valuable feedback from projects and site integration is used for adjustments and further development.

Responsibility for Vision and Robotics

Responsibilities

We are a global organization, but you will be working from our office in Aarhus and be part of a small team of highly skilled colleagues in logistics. You will join the Robot Product Team, which covers multiple disciplines – Electrical, Mechanical, Automation – with you as the software responsible. You will work in close collaboration with the TPO, who acts as Product Owner, and you will have sparring opportunities with software colleagues across the organization to support knowledge sharing and development. Here, your responsibilities will be:

Improving new software products related to vision and robotic applications and supporting their use in projects.
Maintaining and developing software applications according to our operating model and applicable standards.
Ensuring code quality through reviews, documentation, and adherence to coding and architectural guidelines.
Offering input to automation strategy and technical requirements and setting product requirements in collaboration with the business.
Testing and validating functionalities on our local test loop or on sites.
Collaborating with interdisciplinary teams on a common system and evaluating and selecting appropriate technologies for automation and system integration.

Experienced Software Developer

You are familiar with commonly used tools, frameworks, and libraries relevant to 3D vision, point cloud processing, and AI development, and can evaluate and apply them effectively based on product needs. Additionally, we imagine that:

You hold a bachelor's or master's degree, or an equivalent qualification in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
You have solid proficiency developing real-time applications in C# and Python.
You possess solid expertise in classical computer vision and 3D geometry, with a strong focus on point cloud processing and object recognition.
Experience or interest in machine learning and signal processing is highly relevant, as these fields play an increasing role in advancing vision and robotics applications.
You have experience in developing and maintaining various software architectures such as Docker and Kubernetes.
You possess strong knowledge of software design principles, design patterns, and effort estimation for development tasks, and have hands-on experience with version control systems (e.g., Git), as well as software prototyping and conceptualization.
You bring a solid understanding of high-level integration with robotic systems and can design and implement interfaces that enable effective communication between software components and robotic controls.
You can combine input from multiple sensors into valuable insights. This could be cameras, LiDAR's, encoders, safety sensors etc.

Moreover, you demonstrate innovative thinking, analytical skills, and a strong problem-solving mindset. You bring excellent communication skills, team spirit, and a high willingness to learn. You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines in a diverse and inclusive environment.

Interested?

If you find the description interesting, please do not hesitate to contact Henning Horn Lauritsen +45 8741 4674 with any question you might have or apply via the link.

We look very much forward to hearing from you!

BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, sortation, and distribution – BEUMER Group is a leader within the development and manufacture of high-technological intralogistics systems for global markets. Our employees stand out from others thanks to their ability to supply innovative solutions to our customers. They can do this because they know the industry and are passionate about continuously developing and expanding their knowledge. We support these high standards through teamwork, mutual respect and a working culture based on trust that fosters stability and security for all our employees. Our common goal is to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

jobs.title: Student Software Engineer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Are you studying computer science, software engineering, AI, or a related subject- and looking for more than an ordinary student job? Do you enjoy understanding complicated problems, building software that real people use, and exploring how AI and agents are changing the way software is developed?

We are looking for a Student Software Engineer to join the engineering team behind Omnidocs Create, its integrations, and related engineering projects.

You will work as part of our engineering team on real product challenges across frontend and backend development. You will also help us develop how we use AI and agentic engineering workflows to understand systems, investigate problems, plan solutions, implement changes, and verify results.

You do not need professional experience with our technology stack. We care more about how you think, how quickly you learn, and how you approach problems when the answer is not immediately obvious.

The basics

• 12–15 hours per week during the semester.
• Flexible scheduling around classes and exams.
• Possibility of additional hours during quieter study periods and holidays.
• Competitive salary.
• Opportunities to grow into greater technical ownership and responsibility.

What you will work on

• Contribute to established production codebases and new engineering projects.
• Build and improve functionality across our products and integrations, primarily using .NET, C#, and Blazor.
• Connect frontend experiences to backend APIs and services.
• Work on integrations and related engineering projects, sometimes involving unfamiliar systems or technologies.
• Help turn complex business rules and document workflows into understandable product experiences.
• Investigate defects, improve tests, and strengthen code quality.
• Work with product, design, and engineering colleagues to understand problems and shape solutions.
• Participate in code reviews, planning, technical discussions, and product demonstrations.
• Use AI tools and agents to explore code, plan, prototype, implement, test, and document.
• Critically evaluate and verify AI-generated work rather than accepting it at face value.

As you grow, you may take ownership of features and engineering projects from problem definition through delivery.

Who we are looking for

• Are pursuing a relevant degree at ITU, DTU, DIKU, or another comparable institution.
• Have a foundation in programming from your studies, personal projects, employment, or open-source work.
• Enjoy breaking complicated or ambiguous problems into understandable steps.
• Take initiative when you encounter something unfamiliar.
• Can explain your thinking, including uncertainty, mistakes, and trade-offs.
• Are interested in AI-assisted and agentic ways of working.
• Want to learn through feedback, collaboration, and practical responsibility.
• Can communicate effectively in English.
• Are able to work regularly from our Copenhagen office.

You do not need previous professional experience with Blazor or .NET. Experience with another programming language or web framework can provide an equally good foundation.

Helpful, but not required

Experience or experimentation with any of the following is a plus:
• C#, .NET, Blazor, React, TypeScript, Java, Python, or similar technologies.
• Web applications, APIs, databases, automated testing, or Git.
• UX, accessibility, responsive design, or component libraries.
• Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or other AI development tools.
• AI agents, MCP, automation, or AI-assisted prototyping.
• University, personal, hackathon, or open-source software projects.

We do not expect you to arrive as an expert. We expect you to be interested enough to investigate, experiment, and learn.

The company

For over 20 years, Omnidocs has been redefining productivity in document generation. Born as a consultancy and developed into a SaaS business, we help organizations create better documents and presentations through software, automation, and design.
Today, the Omnidocs Group has almost 200 professionals across several international offices. You will join a collaborative environment where you can work closely with experienced engineers, product colleagues, and designers while developing your own technical skills and responsibilities.

What we offer

• Meaningful responsibility in live production software.
• A dedicated engineering mentor and regular feedback.
• Close collaboration with experienced engineers, product colleagues, and designers.
• Flexibility around classes, exams, and university projects.
• Opportunities to explore and develop modern AI and agentic engineering workflows.
• The possibility of connecting university projects or a thesis to relevant engineering challenges.
• Career development opportunities and the possibility of continuing with Omnidocs after graduation when there is a mutual fit and an available position.
• An informal workplace in the heart of Christianshavn.
• Lunch scheme, social activities, sports activities, and other employee benefits.

How to apply

Please apply through our recruitment system and upload your CV. Links to GitHub, a portfolio, or projects are welcome but optional.
As part of the application, we will ask you a few short questions about your education, something you have built, how you approach unfamiliar problems, your experience with AI-assisted development, and a situation where you took ownership.
You are welcome to use AI tools when preparing your application. We are more interested in authentic examples and personal reflection than perfectly polished answers.
Please use the dedicated application link rather than sending your application by email.
Omnidocs encourages applicants of all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team.

Processing of personal data

By registering in our HR system, BambooHR, and uploading your application and CV, you accept that Omnidocs stores the registered data and information included in the uploaded documents. All information is used solely for recruitment purposes and will be deleted within 12 months of upload.

Please do not include sensitive personal data in your application or CV, such as CPR number or information about race, religion, trade union membership, or health.
You can read more about Omnidocs' guidelines for processing personal data here:
https://omnidocs.com/processing-of-personal-data-in-the-context-of-recruitment/

The AI Architect is the technical authority responsible for designing secure, scalable and cost-efficient AI architectures for APAC deployments. The role defines technical standards, patterns and guardrails across models, data pipelines, APIs, cloud infrastructure and security layers, ensuring solutions align with global governance while meeting APAC data sovereignty and regulatory requirements. The role provides technical direction to the team, supporting the design, build, maintenance and continuous improvement of advanced AI and automation solutions. Key Responsibilities

Architecture Design & Standards

Design scalable, secure and cost-efficient AI system architectures for regional deployments.
Define and enforce technical standards, design patterns and architectural guardrails for the team.
Lead build vs buy vs integrate decisions, evaluating platforms and vendors.
Produce architecture artefacts (solution designs, data flows, integration maps, technical roadmaps).

Ensure infrastructure meets data sovereignty requirements across APAC countries.

Ensure AI development and deployment environments are designed for reliability, reproducibility, access control and operational support.

to join our AI team, owning the design, evaluation and delivery of LLM-powered agentic systems into the RegASK platform. Optimise embedding models, vector store integrations and RAG pipelines for domain-specific regulatory content.

Hands-on production experience with LangGraph, LangChain or comparable agent frameworks.

Strong command of embedding models, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Mongo Atlas Vector Search) and retrieval optimisation.

Strong Python engineering background (FastAPI, Transformers, spaCy) and working proficiency in TypeScript with Node and React. You will write both.
Experience with SQL and NoSQL data modelling and retrieval.
Solid LLMOps/MLOps practice: CI/CD, monitoring, scaling, cost control.
Excellent communication skills, able to explain system behaviour and evaluation results to non-technical regulatory and commercial stakeholders.

Experience with LLM fine-tuning or adaptation (LoRA, QLoRA, DPO) as a complement to retrieval and prompting.
Graph databases or knowledge graphs for hybrid RAG.
Continuous evaluation and A/B testing frameworks for agents in production.
Background in compliance, life sciences or regulatory intelligence.

Flexible working arrangements (hybrid)
Opportunity to work in a high impact role at the intersection on AI, SaaS and Compliance/ Regulatory intelligence
Continuous learning and professional development

We appreciate all applications, but only selected candidates will be contacted for an interview.

jobs.description:
Join Eaton, a global leader where equality and inclusivity are at the heart of our mission. Here, everyone is valued and belongs. Be part of a team that delivers cutting-edge, energy-efficient solutions, making a tangible impact on the world. We empower our customers to manage electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical energy more effectively, safely, and sustainably. At Eaton, we’re dedicated to enhancing quality of life and protecting the environment with our innovative energy management technologies and services. Our EMEA Business Service teams empower seamless operations and drive exceptional results across our electrical, industrial, and corporate teams.

What You’ll Do

The primary role of the Technical Support Engineer
is to deliver exceptional technical support and troubleshooting assistance to end-users, customers, and internal partners. Acting as a key point of contact across multiple channels—including telephone, email, and web tickets—this position focuses on EATON's electrical product portfolio, specifically tailored devices within the Electrical division.

In this capacity, you will engage with a diverse range of stakeholders, including end customers, wholesalers, distributors, panel builders, designers, logistics teams, quality departments, product management, R&D, manufacturing, and sales or service representatives. Your responsibilities will encompass a variety of pre-sales and post-sales functions, ensuring seamless communication and support.

You will provide vital assistance to sales functions across the EMEA region, and partially in APAC and the Americas, addressing technical inquiries, product-specific questions, warranty issues, documentation requests, repair and calibration needs, and troubleshooting challenges. Additionally, you will guide customers in product selection and application assistance through phone and email interactions. As the first point of escalation for non-standard inquiries and advanced troubleshooting related to hardware and software, your expertise will be invaluable.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as an engineering resource to resolve customer challenges related to single-phase UPS products (both hardware and software) through various communication channels, including phone, email, and web chat.
Manage and follow up on hardware and software escalations involving Level 2, Level 3, and Quality teams.
Foster customer loyalty by delivering high-quality service and enhancing value through a performance-driven culture.
Actively contribute to the organization and daily execution of technical support tasks, leveraging resources such as people, processes, and technology.
Maintain up-to-date process documentation to ensure clarity and efficiency.
Participate in knowledge-sharing sessions and continuous improvement initiatives, both within the team and across the organization, to implement best practices at BSC Budapest.
Collaborate with team members to enhance customer satisfaction, minimize customer effort, and achieve improvements in cycle time and cost through effective problem-solving.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) in Electrical/Electronic Engineering from an accredited institution

Skills

Understanding of Electrical products and basic applications
Basic Network Knowledge
Analytical mindset, communication skills, problem-solving
Excellent Dutch and English language knowledge

What We Offer

Competitive compensation and benefits package
Flexible working solutions
Excellent working environment – safety and ethics are important for us
Culture & Values – we are more than the products we invent and produce – the way we do business is just as important. At Eaton, our values and culture define who we are – both individually and as an organization – and direct our activities every day
Learning & Development - we invest in our employees for the long term – not just with salary and benefits, but with ongoing learning and development opportunities, made available through Eaton University

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.description:
About Change

Change has been around longer than most fintechs you've heard of. Our Dutch entity was incorporated in Amsterdam in 2010, and we have been MiFID II authorised since 2015, a decade of operating as a regulated investment firm. Today we serve around 120,000 verified users across all 30 EEA countries, with full passporting rights, and we are MiCA-authorised as one of the early CASPs in the Netherlands.

We operate an app-based investment platform built for retail investors. Our users trade cryptocurrencies, alongside CFDs on stocks, indices, currencies, gold, oil and other financial instruments — all in one place, on mobile, with the regulatory protections of a Dutch investment firm.
We are a small senior team with a practical, low-bureaucracy culture. We value ownership, clear processes, strong judgement and real operational discipline over unnecessary ceremony.
We are hiring a Senior Engineer
who treats AI agents and tooling as a core part of the SDLC — building, shipping and operating systems with tools like Codex, Claude Code and automated reviewers as standard engineering practice.

What you will do

• Take ownership of one or two core domains end-to-end, execution, custody integration, market data, risk, or the trading core, and ship measurable improvements against real, regulated, money-moving systems.
• Contribute meaningfully to the Kotlin-vs-.NET architectural evaluation: prototype, benchmark, document, push back. Help us produce an honest decision rather than a fashionable one.
• Define and prove out our agentic SDLC: how we use coding agents in design, in review, in testing, in incident response. Make the patterns explicit so the rest of the team can copy them.
• Raise the engineering bar by example; clean, well-tested, observable code that other engineers want to read and extend. Become the person whose PRs others learn from.
• Partner closely with the Dutch business hub, our compliance and marketing functions, and our infrastructure team. Speed and regulatory standing are not in tension here; we expect you to deliver both.

Who we are looking for

Engineering depth

• 5+ years building production systems where correctness and uptime matter, ideally in finance, payments, trading or similarly demanding environments.
• Strong expertise in either the modern JVM ecosystem (Kotlin, Spring Boot, Kafka) or modern .NET (.NET, C#, ASP.NET Core), with openness to work across both.
• Comfortable with AWS, EKS, observability and infrastructure concepts; able to work confidently around cloud-native systems.
• Strong understanding of event-driven systems, idempotency, reconciliation and the realities of distributed systems in production.
• Systems thinker who can clearly communicate architecture, boundaries, data flows and constraints — for both engineers and coding agents.
AI-native, agentic-first

• You use coding agents (Codex, Cursor, Claude Code, Aider or similar) daily and understand both their strengths and failure modes.
• You have built or customised at least one real agentic workflow, tool or automation used in practice.

Are you motivated by building technology solutions that change how businesses interact with their customers? Do you want to work across customer experience platforms, data architecture and modern AI, and make sure all of it connects and runs in production?

We are looking for a Data & AI Architect
who will own the technical design and delivery of customer technology solutions for our clients. You will work across CMS, CDP, commerce, CRM and AI, and work hands-on with delivery teams to bring it all to production.

In this key role, you will:

Design end-to-end solution architectures across customer technology landscapes, connecting content platforms, customer data, commerce systems and AI capabilities into scalable solutions

Lead technical delivery of complex, multi-platform projects, ensuring quality, integration and production-readiness from concept through go-live

Bring AI into customer technology by applying generative AI, agentic patterns and data-driven automation to CMS, CDP and commerce solutions

Bridge technology and business outcomes by translating client needs into concrete technical approaches with clear trade-offs across platforms and vendors

Keep on reading to learn more about the job, your future colleagues & all that Accenture has to offer!

Your Job

You are responsible for the technical vision and architecture of customer technology solutions across client engagements. You connect content management, customer data platforms, commerce, CRM and AI into working enterprise solutions, and you stay close to delivery to make sure what gets built matches what was designed.

You work hands-on with delivery teams: reviewing designs, unblocking technical challenges, validating integration approaches and making sure non-functional requirements (performance, security, scalability) are covered. The team comes to you when architecture gets complex, whether that’s a multi-platform CMS migration, a CDP integration with downstream activation channels, a Salesforce Agentforce implementation, or an AI-powered service automation.

You work with client stakeholders (IT leads, product owners, enterprise architects) to align solutions with their technology landscape and business priorities. You evaluate and recommend platforms, design integration patterns across vendors, and present options with trade-offs: what’s technically sound, what’s practical to build and maintain, and what delivers the most value.

You bring AI and data capabilities into the customer technology domain. Think generative AI applied to content and personalisation, agentic patterns for customer service, and data-driven automation across commerce and CRM.

You also contribute to Accenture Song’s practice by capturing reusable architecture patterns and sharing learnings across teams. You work with Accenture’s technology partnerships (Adobe, Salesforce, SAP, Sprinklr, Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud) to bring the right capabilities to each engagement.

Your Team

Accenture Song is an incredible place to work where you can keep learning. By joining us, you’ll become part of a global company with a world-class brand and reputation. Besides the work we do for our clients, we’re proud of our vibrant, diverse workplace culture: we believe in openness and honesty, fairness and equality, common sense and realism. We want to get to know the real you and help you explore and grow - whatever it is you’re great at. So you will always have lots of learning opportunities (formal and informal) to improve your role-specific skills and expertise.

Your Background

5–8 years of relevant experience in solution architecture, technical delivery or senior engineering roles within consulting, digital delivery or enterprise environments

Proven experience designing and delivering customer technology solutions across multiple platforms, not just single-vendor implementations

Strong architecture skills across customer technology domains, with depth in at least two of the following:

Content Management: Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, CoreMedia, or composable/headless CMS (MACH architecture)

Customer Data Platforms: Salesforce Data Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Tealium, Segment, or similar

Commerce: SAP Commerce Cloud, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), or composable commerce

Data & AI: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Databricks, data pipelines, LLM orchestration, RAG architectures

Integration expertise: experience designing cross-platform architectures connecting CMS, CDP, commerce, CRM and back-office systems (ERP, ticketing, fulfilment) through API management, event-driven patterns and middleware

Interest and growing experience in AI applied to customer technology: generative AI for content and personalisation, agentic AI for service automation, data-driven decisioning

Ability to lead technical delivery: not just design on paper, but guide teams through implementation, troubleshoot issues and make sure things work in production

Strong communication skills: able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and present architecture options with trade-offs

Proactive, hands-on attitude: you don’t wait for a perfect brief, you figure out the approach and iterate

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business or equivalent experience

Fluent in English, with professional proficiency in Dutch or French

Über die Stelle

Wir suchen einen Principal Software & AI Engineer
, der als technische Führungspersönlichkeit über den gesamten Delivery-Lifecycle hinweg agiert – von der Lösungsgestaltung mit Kunden bis hin zu Build, Deployment und Betrieb in Produktion. Du kombinierst tiefgreifende Fullstack-Engineering-Expertise mit Hands-on-AI-Engineering-Fähigkeiten und einem starken DevOps-Fundament. Genauso sicher am Whiteboard mit einem Kunden wie tief im Code, übersetzt du Business-Probleme in robuste, skalierbare Architekturen, gehst technisch mit gutem Beispiel voran und coachst Engineers über Teams hinweg. Diese Rolle ist hands-on: Du gibst die technische Richtung vor, treibst die Solutioning voran und bleibst dabei nah am Code.

Deine Aufgaben

Architektur und Aufbau von Fullstack-Anwendungen end-to-end – von modernen Web-Frontends über Backend-Services und APIs bis zur Datenschicht
Design, Entwicklung und Operationalisierung von Generative-AI-Fähigkeiten – inkl. LLM-basierter Lösungen, RAG-Pipelines, Prompt- und Context-Engineering, Modellintegration, Evaluation und Guardrails – und deren Einbettung in produktive Anwendungen
Führung des technischen Solutioning in Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden: Anforderungen erheben, Architekturen gestalten, Aufwände schätzen und technische Vorschläge sowie Trade-offs gegenüber technischen und geschäftlichen Stakeholdern präsentieren
Verantwortung für den gesamten DevOps-Lifecycle – CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, Containerisierung, Orchestrierung und Observability – mit Fokus auf sichere, verlässliche und wiederholbare Delivery
Festlegung und Sicherstellung von Engineering-Standards in Architektur, Code-Qualität, Testing und Security
Mentoring und Coaching von Engineers, Leitung technischer Reviews und Aufbau von Kompetenzen im Team
Als vertrauensvoller technischer Berater für Kunden agieren – Unterstützung bei Pre-Sales, Discovery und Delivery

Dein Profil

Umfassende Fullstack-Engineering-Erfahrung; der konkrete Stack ist offen, du bist aber sicher im Umgang mit modernen Frameworks im Frontend (z. B. TypeScript mit React oder Angular) und Backend (z. B. Python, Node.js, Java oder .NET)
Nachweisbar e AI-Engineering-Erfahru
ng: Aufbau und produktiver Einsatz von Generative-AI-Lösungen, Erfahrung mit LLMs, Embeddings/Vector Stores, RAG, Orchestrierungs-Frameworks sowie Modell-Evaluation und -Monitoring
Starker DevOps
-Hintergrund: CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code (z. B. Terraform / Bicep), Docker, Kubernetes sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure (verpflichtend – unsere primäre Cloud-Plattform)
Nachgewiesene Erfahrung i n technischer Beratu
ng und Pre-Sales: direkter Kundenkontakt, Leitung von Solutioning- und Architektur-Diskussionen, Unterstützung bei Discovery und Pre-Sales sowie klare Kommunikation mit technischen und geschäftlichen Stakeholdern
Nachweislich e technische Führungserfahru
ng und Mentoring-Kompetenz auf Principal-Level
Fundiertes Verständnis von Softwarearchitektur, Design Patterns, Security und Skalierbarkeit

Von Vorteil:
Erfahrung mit Microsoft Foundry oder vergleichbaren AI-Plattformen und Tools
Kenntnisse weiterer Cloud-Anbieter neben Azure sowie ein breites Spektrum an Frameworks über den gesamten Stack
Beiträge zu technischer Strategie, Capability-Building oder Thought Leadership
Erfahrung mit LLMOps-Praktiken für das Lifecycle-Management von Generative-AI-Systemen

About Us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About The Role

As a Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining advanced software solutions. You will be responsible for leading projects, participating in strategic technology decision-making, and mentoring less experienced team members. Your expertise in programming and software engineering will be essential for achieving project goals and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products.

This role is based in Madrid, Spain.

What will you be doing?

Designing system architectures and developing complex software components while considering both functional and non-functional requirements.
Creating high-quality software code in accordance with industry best practices and standards.
Managing software testing processes, identifying and resolving issues, and optimizing system performance and scalability.
Delivering cloud-oriented API-based components and microservices adhering to the highest engineering standards.
Mentoring junior team members by providing technical support, guidance, and sharing knowledge and experience to facilitate their professional growth.
Influencing team direction and task prioritization.
Tackling complex problems requiring deep analysis and evaluation of diverse factors.
Collaborating closely with other departments, such as production teams, and management, to ensure solution consistency and compliance.
Engaging in effective cooperation with team members.
Working collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders.
Inspiring and facilitating constructive discussions around complex topics.
Providing timely, concise, and actionable feedback to team colleagues.
Promoting a knowledge-sharing mindset.
Participating in recruitment interviews for your team.
Maintaining openness to communication with both local and external partners.
Developing mentoring skills, fostering learning, and sharing deep engineering expertise with peers.

What are we looking for?

Experience in designing and developing advanced software systems.
Proficiency in object-oriented programming concepts, algorithms, and data structures.
Continuous focus on enhancing skills in software architecture design, DevOps practices, and product development.
Strong orientation toward task automation to save time and effort.
Implementation of improvements and optimizations in daily operations.
Planning and managing complex multi-system deployments without impacting client operations.
Ability to balance the demands of delivering high-quality software within tight deadlines.
Programming across multiple languages.
Experience with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
Expertise in cloud infrastructure automation.
Knowledge and experience in use of design patterns
University or FP degree in Software Engineering
Proficiency in English is required for this role

What will make you stand out?

Experience with:
C# .NET
TypeScript
JavaScript / React (or any other JS framework)
Amazon Web Services

What do we offer?

💸 Clear and transparent compensation plan.
The salary range goes from 34,000 € to 50,000 €
. We will discuss the indicated range with you in the first recruiting call to ensure that we are on the same page.

💰 Flexible salary benefits

Save on personal income tax with Cobee for expenses like transport, restaurants, and kindergarten.

🩺 Private health insurance

Free for all employees via Cigna
, plus we cover 50% for your family members
.

🌅 Generous time off

Enjoy 26 days of holiday per year
(23 base days + your 🎂 birthday off
, Christmas Eve, and New Year’s Eve).

💻 Your gear, your choice

Whether you prefer Mac or Windows
, or need an extra screen, we’ll make sure you’re set up for success from day one.

🗓️ Annual Salary Review

We’re committed to recognizing your professional growth. Every year, we review salaries to reflect your individual development, achievements, and impact on our business success.

📙 Grow your skills

We offer up to €2000/year
in training (certifications, conferences, workshops) to boost your growth—both technical and personal.

📺 Learning resources

Access internal and external training
, including platforms like LinkedIn Learning
, completely free.

🧘‍♂️ Holistic wellness program

Includes access to Wellhub, Curalinc (psychological support), Rocketlawyer (legal advice), and regular health webinars & challenges.

😊 Volunteer day

Take one day off a year
to volunteer and give back. Bonus points for sharing pics on Slack!

Because your mental health matters.

to cover your gym or fitness classes (yoga, boxing, pilates, etc.).

Improve or learn a new language (English, Spanish, French, Italian, or German) in small groups with expert instructors—on us!

when you refer candidates we hire—depending on the role.

, push boundaries

the automotive world.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with strong expertise in C#/.NET, cloud-native backend development, and API engineering.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building scalable, secure, and maintainable backend services in cloud environments. The engineer will work closely with Tech Leads and cross-functional teams to implement high-quality solutions aligned with established architectural and engineering standards.

This role is not a Tech Lead or Architect position. The expectation is strong technical execution, active contribution to engineering quality, support for architecture compliance, and ownership of backend deliverables.

AI-assisted development practices are a core expectation for this role. Candidates should be comfortable using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code Codex, or similar within their daily engineering workflow.

Your Responsibilities

As a key member of the team, you will be responsible for:

Backend Development

Design, develop, and maintain backend services using C# and .NET Core.
Build secure, scalable, and high-performance REST APIs.
Implement backend solutions aligned with approved architectural patterns and technical guidelines.
Develop services capable of handling high concurrency and production-scale workloads.
Write optimized and maintainable database queries while ensuring data integrity and performance.
Troubleshoot and resolve backend and production issues efficiently.

Code Quality and Best Practices

Write clean, maintainable, testable, and production-ready code.
Apply SOLID principles and safeguard architectural practices such as Clean Architecture, Onion Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture, and Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
Implement and maintain:
Unit tests
Integration tests
End-to-end tests
Performance/load tests
Participate actively in code reviews and engineering quality initiatives.
Contribute to continuous improvement of development standards, tooling, and workflows.

Collaboration and Agile Development

Work closely with Tech Leads, frontend engineers, QA engineers, and DevOps engineers
Translate technical and business requirements into high-quality implementations.
Support architecture compliance and contribute to solution improvement discussions.
Provide technical guidance and support to less experienced engineers when needed.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and team collaboration activities.

DevOps, Cloud and Architecture

Work with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Containerize backend services using Docker.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
Support observability and monitoring practices using logging, metrics, and tracing tools.
Follow security, reliability, and operational best practices in backend implementations.

Continuous Improvement

Stay up to date with advancements in backend technologies.
Propose and implement improvements in system architecture and development workflows.

Contribute to knowledge-sharing initiatives and technical documentation

What We're Looking For

Experience:
A minimum of 6 years of experience in backend development.
Experience in developing and maintaining scalable backend services.
Experience writing and maintaining unit, integration and performance tests.
Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps practices.
Hands-on experience with GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude-Code … configuration, rule management and use.
Experience working in cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Languages: English (Interview will be conducted in English)
Communication: Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
Technical Skills:
Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core
Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs
Strong SQL and relational database experience
Good understanding of:
SOLID principles
Design patterns
Clean Architecture
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)

Experience with Docker and CI/CD workflows
Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
Understanding of scalable backend systems, observability, and reliability practices
AI Engineering
Practical experience using AI coding assistants in day-to-day software development (Cursor/Claude Code/Codex/Github Co-pilot)
Experience configuring or working with AI-assisted engineering workflows
Language Skills
Fluent in English (mandatory).
French language proficiency is a plus.
Soft Skills
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration int cross-functional teams.
Ability to take ownership and drive initiatives to completion.
Interpersonal Skills: Ability to collaborate in a diverse and dynamic environment.

Our Recruitment Process

15-minute introductory call with our Talent Acquisition Specialist.
Interview with the Hiring Team
Technical Interview

What We Offer

We understand that flexibility and trust
are essential for our teams. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

🏡 Remote Work: Up to 3 days a week!
Work-life balance: We have flexible entrance and departure time.
Summer schedule on Fridays: Start early your weekends!
🤝 Referral Bonus: €1500 for every talent you refer (after 6 months).
🍱 Flexible Remuneration: COBEE platform.
⚕️ Private Medical Insurance: Adeslas.
📚 Continuous Learning: Access to our internal platform for continuous development.
🌴 Vacation: 23 vacation days plus an intensive schedule in July and August.
Teambuilding: Our afterworks and activities are memorable!

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

At Nextlane, we are committed to creating a space where everyone feels valued and respected
. We firmly believe that diversity in experiences and backgrounds strengthens our culture and drives innovation.

Support for people with disabilities. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, let us know so we can provide the best possible experience.
Equal opportunities for all: We welcome applications regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

and become part of the technological revolution in the automotive industry.

Who we are. What we do.

We are Bystronic - a global technology company passionate about shaping the future of industrial manufacturing. We want to work with people who support us in creating new possibilities for connected sustainable production worldwide.
As a leading provider of solutions for sheet metal and material processing, we combine laser cutting technology, press brakes, automation, and software with innovative laser applications for new materials and processes.

Bystronic Software. The digital future of sheet metal processing.

In this role, you will join our Bystronic Software team. With our software solutions, developed specifically for the sheet metal processing industry, we enable companies to digitize their entire processes - from the initial quote to the final delivery.
Join Bystronic Software to build world-class software solutions for manufacturing customers in the sheet metal industry. You will work in agile, multidisciplinary teams to design, implement and evolve robust software that helps digitize industrial production.

What you will be doing

• Design, develop and maintain HMI applications for laser cutting systems and industrial automation solutions.
• Implement intuitive and reliable user interfaces that enable operators to efficiently control and monitor machine and automation processes.
• Collaborate with PLC, motion control, automation and mechanical engineering teams to ensure seamless integration between software and machine control systems
• Contribute to the design and evolution of software architectures supporting machine operation, diagnostics and production workflows.
• Participate in technical discussions around architecture, implementation, performance and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate closely with product, engineering and domain experts to deliver real impact for our customers.

Your education & experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or a related field.
• Professional experience in software development, ideally in product-oriented environments.
• Experience working in agile teams and contributing to shared engineering standards.

What you need to succeed

• Strong programming skills, with special consideration for full-stack experience in C#, .NET, WPF and React.
• Experience designing and developing Human Machine Interfaces (HMI) or industrial software applications.
• Ability to create clean, scalable and well-structured software solutions.
• Analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across software and machine systems.
• Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written.
• Team spirit, ownership and willingness to continuously learn.

What sets you apart

• Experience with industrial machinery, manufacturing systems or machine control software.
• Knowledge of laser cutting processes, sheet metal manufacturing or industrial automation environments
• Experience working directly with machine operators and translating operational needs into effective software solutions.
• Interest in shaping the digital factory of the future.

What's in it for you

• A hybrid work model connected to our offices in Bilbao, Derio and Vitoria.
• Flexible working schedule and reduced working hours during summer.
• Individual learning and development programs, including language courses, Microsoft certifications and participation in technical conferences.
• Multidisciplinary teams with diverse skills, perspectives and backgrounds working in agile ways.
• The opportunity to create real impact in the sheet metal industry and help shape the digital factory of the future.
• Salary and benefits aligned with the market and your experience.

People power our purpose

Imagine working in an environment that helps move the company to the next level, where your passion, values, and skills are integral to impacting industrial manufacturing and beyond. At Bystronic, this can become your reality. Our people are the edge to drive and nurture our ambitions and continued success. Together we have created a culture where our people are central, inspiring us to make decisions that best serve them and are aligned with our purpose. As much as we are in a technology business, human beings drive real change.

Life at Bystronic

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Industrial Data & Integration
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

SistelGroup delivers turnkey PLC, SCADA and OT data contextualization solutions for the manufacturing industry. For more than 30 years we have helped pharmaceutical, chemical, and food & beverage manufacturers run plants that are more efficient, safer and fully traceable.
We work as a partner, not a supplier. We learn our customers’ processes, we stay with them through the full life of a solution, and we are the people they call when something matters. That is why our clients stay with us for decades.
When you join us, you will work on international projects with advanced Industry 4.0 and digitalization technologies for leading manufacturing companies. You will also build your career in a group that covers both industrial automation and digital transformation for the manufacturing industry.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a Solution Architect to lead the technical direction of our industrial data and integration work. This is a hands-on architecture role, focused on Unified Namespace, industrial connectivity and data contextualization. You will design and build the architectures that connect the plant floor to business systems (SCADA, MES, ERP, warehousing systems, LIMS), and you will write the reference architecture and the standards that our engineers follow. Ignition is a particular focus: it is the platform we build most of these solutions on.
You are hands-on with the technology. You build proofs of concept, prototypes and demonstrations: to prove a design works, to show a client what is possible, and to give our engineers a working reference to learn from. Our project teams carry out the implementation and commissioning, and part of the Solution Architect role is to train them to do it well.
Much of this work is about context. A plant produces millions of values every day, but a value on its own means very little. Context is what turns it into insightful information: which equipment produced it, on which line, during which batch and for which product, and how it connects to the order in the ERP system and the result in the laboratory. You design the models, the naming and the relationships that carry that meaning, so that the same data serves an operator, a quality reviewer and a data scientist without anyone having to guess what it refers to.
You will work with our commercial team from the first client conversations, helping turn a business problem into a design, a demonstration, and a proposal. On projects: you are involved in the early stages — design, architecture and the technical decisions that shape the work — and then hand over to the delivery team. Most of our clients work in regulated industries, which means clear documentation and traceable design decisions are key.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and design

Design Unified Namespace architectures for plant data: namespace and topic structure, information models, and the context that gives each value its meaning.
Design the data models behind the architecture: equipment and site hierarchies, product and batch genealogy, and the relationships between assets, processes and quality results, using recognized models ISA-95 and ISA-88.
Design integrations between plant systems and business systems: PLC, SCADA, ERP, MES, LIMS, historians and data platforms.
Assess legacy plant and laboratory environments and design the modernization path for them.
Choose the technologies, and write reference architecture and design standards for this work.

Proofs of concept and integration

Build proofs of concept, prototypes and reference implementations that prove a design works before a project commits to it.
Build and prove data flows with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Work with Ignition and similar platforms as the plant-side layer of these architectures.
Build prototypes of data-driven applications on top of the architecture: equipment monitoring, predictive maintenance, and batch reporting.
Integrate with ERP and MES using standard message formats such as B2MML, so that production orders, confirmations and quality results flow in both directions.
Make plant data findable and “end user friendly” to people who did not build the system, through consistent naming, documented models and clear metadata.
Connect to business and laboratory systems: SAP and other ERP systems, MES platforms, LIMS and quality systems.

Pre-sales and client consulting

Work with our commercial team during early client conversations: understand the business problem before designing anything.
Run technical workshops with clients, design the solution, and present it clearly to both engineers and management.
Build the demonstrations and solution concepts that our commercial team uses in client meetings.
Contribute to development of technical proposals, solution designs and estimates together with our commercial team.

Technical expertise and knowledge sharing

Train engineers to implement and commission the solutions you design, and build the team’s capability in Ignition, MQTT, industrial data connectivity, and data contextualization concepts.
Lead the design phase of new projects, then hand over to the delivery team with the documentation and guidance they need.

REQUIREMENTS

Degree in engineering, computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of experience in industrial automation, industrial software or IT/OT integration, including several years in an architecture or solution design role.
Deep hands-on experience with Ignition (Inductive Automation): you build prototypes and demonstrations yourself, and you are comfortable working in the tools rather than only specifying them.
Proven experience designing and integrating plant-to-enterprise architectures in real production environments: Unified Namespace, PLC, DCS, SCADA, MES, ERP and LIMS.
Strong experience with MQTT, Sparkplug B, OPC UA, and REST APIs.
Proven experience modelling and contextualizing industrial data: hierarchies, naming conventions, metadata and the relationships between equipment, process and product.
Strong SQL skills, and at least one scripting language, preferably Python.
Experience delivering in GMP or other regulated environments, with working knowledge of GAMP 5, EU GMP Annex 11, 21 CFR Part 11.
The ability to explain a complex architecture simply, to engineers and to managers.
Commercial skills: effort estimation, and technical workshop facilitation.
English, spoken and written. Spanish is a plus.

DESIRABLE EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATIONS

The following skills are nice-to-have and will support the innovative engineering initiatives at our company.
Data-driven manufacturing applications: predictive maintenance, equipment monitoring, OEE, energy monitoring solutions, batch reporting and yield, golden batch.
MQTT broker platforms: HiveMQ, or the Cirrus Link modules for Ignition.
Cloud knowledge, preferably Azure.
Historians and industrial data platforms: AVEVA OSI PI, AspenTech Inmation, or similar.
Time-series and non-relational databases (MongoDB, InfluxDB, or similar).
Containers, CI/CD and version control (Docker, Kubernetes, Git).
Data analysis and dashboards (Power BI, Grafana or similar).
OT network and security design: segmentation, industrial DMZ, and ISA/IEC 62443 knowledge or certification.
MES platforms: Ignition Sepasoft, Körber PAS-X, Siemens Opcenter, or similar.
Multi-site standardization, or defining a technical service offering: creating a reference architecture or data model template and rolling it out across several plants or projects.
Regulatory awareness for industrial data: the EU GMP Annex 11 revision, and Annex 22 on artificial intelligence in GMP.

WHAT WE OFFER

A builder’s role with technical ownership: you design it, you prove it, and you see it become part of how the company works.
Training programs with our technology partners.
A direct line to the business: you work with our commercial team and see your designs turn into won projects.
Large international pharmaceutical clients and genuinely complex plants.
A specialized and collaborative technical team, and 30+ years of plant knowledge behind you. We are a people-oriented company, with special focus on ensuring the best environment for our engineers to work and collaborate.
Competitive salary according to your experience.
Flexible working hours and hybrid work.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Search & Relevance
jobs.description:
About the Role

Search is one of the primary ways people navigate our site, and it is a stream with significant headroom. We run Typesense and want to substantially extend how we use it - better relevance, broader coverage, faster and more reliable indexing, and search-driven discovery beyond the search box itself.
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer who understands that search is a product problem with an engineering substrate, and who is comfortable being judged on whether results actually got better.
This is a hands-on delivery role requiring hands-on experience with a search engine in production — relevance tuning, not just integration.

Responsibilities

Extend and improve our Typesense implementation across the site.
Tune relevance and ranking - weighting, synonyms, typo tolerance, faceting, filtering and sorting - against measured outcomes rather than intuition.
Build and harden indexing pipelines: index freshness, incremental updates, reindexing without downtime and consistency with source data.
Instrument search analytics - query logs, zero-result rates, click-through and conversion - and use them to drive the roadmap.
Run relevance experiments and build the evaluation harness that makes them trustworthy.
Extend search into discovery surfaces: autocomplete, related results, faceted browse and recommendations.
Evaluate hybrid and vector search where it measurably beats keyword ranking for our content.
Scale and operate the search infrastructure as index size and query volume grow.
Use agentic development tooling such as Claude Code as a core part of how you deliver, with the judgement to know when to rely on it and when not to.

How We Work

Small, focused streams with real ownership. Engineers shape work rather than receive tickets. We deploy frequently and expect people to own what they ship into production. Our stack is C# / .NET and React / Next.js running on on-prem infrastructure alongside managed cloud services.
We use agentic development tooling heavily, Claude Code and similar and expect you to be fluent with it. We are equally interested in your judgement about it: where it accelerates you, where you deliberately don't use it, and how you review what it produces before it reaches a customer.
To be clear about emphasis: this is a software engineering role first. We are hiring for demonstrated delivery of production systems. AI capability is part of how the work gets done, and sometimes part of what gets built - it is not the qualification.

Build internal tooling and automation that removes recurring manual effort from other teams.

De technologie zorgt ervoor dat waardevolle assets kunnen worden gevolgd, beveiligd en indien nodig teruggevonden. Hierbij wordt gewerkt met een combinatie van IoT-hardware, firmware, cloudsoftware, mobiele applicaties en real-time data.

Als .NET developer kom je terecht in een technische omgeving waarin hardware en software nauw met elkaar samenwerken. Je werkt samen met engineers vanuit verschillende disciplines en hebt direct invloed op de verdere ontwikkeling van de producten.

Jouw rol

Als .NET Developer werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een schaalbaar IoT-platform.
Je bouwt mee aan moderne back-end systemen en gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces waarmee real-time data van een groot aantal verbonden apparaten wordt verwerkt en inzichtelijk gemaakt.

Je werkzaamheden zijn onder andere:
Ontwikkelen van schaalbare en cloud-native applicaties;
Bouwen van moderne back-end systemen met C# en .NET;
Verwerken van real-time data afkomstig van IoT-devices;
Ontwikkelen van API's en backend-functionaliteiten;
Visualiseren van data in dashboards en gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces;
Bouwen aan systemen die miljoenen connected devices kunnen ondersteunen;
Meedenken over architectuur en de keuze voor nieuwe technologieën.

De technische omgeving

Je werkt in een moderne Microsoft-omgeving met een sterke focus op schaalbaarheid, performance en cloud-native development.

Belangrijke technologieën zijn:
C#
.NET / .NET Core
Microsoft Azure
Azure Messaging Services
SQL en NoSQL databases
Serverless toepassingen
Containers
CI/CD
Test automation
Azure DevOps
Git

Aan de front-end wordt gewerkt met:
TypeScript / JavaScript
HTML
CSS
Vue
React
Angular

Wie zoeken wij?

Je bent een ervaren .NET developer die graag inhoudelijk wordt uitgedaagd en energie krijgt van complexe technische vraagstukken.

Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en vindt het leuk om je vast te bijten in nieuwe technologieën. Daarnaast durf je verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en denk je graag mee over hoe software en architectuur slimmer kunnen worden ingericht.

Wij zoeken iemand die beschikt over:
Minimaal 4 à 5 jaar ervaring met C# en .NET;
Ervaring met Microsoft-technologieën en Azure;
Kennis van moderne webtechnologieën zoals TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML en CSS;
Ervaring met één of meerdere frameworks zoals React, Vue of Angular;
Ervaring met SQL en/of NoSQL databases;
Kennis van serverless en containerized applications;
Ervaring met CI/CD en testautomatisering;
Kennis van SOLID-principes en software design patterns;
Ervaring met Azure DevOps en Git.

Daarnaast ben je communicatief vaardig en kun je complexe technische vraagstukken helder uitleggen aan collega's met verschillende technische achtergronden.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Je komt terecht bij een innovatieve en groeiende technologieorganisatie waar je veel ruimte krijgt om technisch mee te denken en daadwerkelijk impact te maken.

Je kunt rekenen op:
Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende techorganisatie;
Een brutosalaris tussen de €4.000,- - €6.000,- (op basis van 40 uur ex vakantiegeld);
Veel technische vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid;
Flexibele werktijden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden (2 dagen minimaal op kantoor);
Complexe technische uitdagingen rondom schaalbaarheid en real-time data;

Leading one or more Agile delivery teams, you will ensure team success by coaching them to size, manage scope, design optimal technical solutions, and identify and mitigate technical risks. You will support one or more domains in the IT CCO Delivery team, including Asset Management, Pay Per Use, Salesforce CRM, Uniform/Global API, and Commercial Effectiveness. Additionally, you will work with your team members to help them develop and achieve their personal and organizational career goals.

Lead the definition, architecture design, development, testing, delivery, and support of business applications using one or more development platforms/applications in the IT-CCO Domain.

jobs.description:
As a Full stack Developer
at ORTEC LogiqCare, you will have a unique opportunity to explore the many facets of software engineering within an innovative, international organization.

Please note: for this role you need to be eligible to live and work in the Netherlands without sponsorship.

Your enthusiasm and thirst for knowledge are what pulls you out of bed in the morning. You’re looking for a career opportunity that allows you to prove yourself and your skills, day after day. You want your experience and capabilities to have a life-changing impact on other people. You are the Full-Stack Software Engineer we are looking for.

The Clinical Care & Research team is leveraging data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning and cutting-edge techniques to push the healthcare industry to the next level. We develop software applications for medical care and (bio)medical research: clinical decision-making tools, medical workflow support and applications for scientific research. These applications cover a broad area of medicine, e.g. cardiovascular medicine (most notably U-Prevent), oncology, lung disease and various other disciplines (e.g. rheumatology, pregnancy, toxicological prediction models).

The Healthcare platform has been written from scratch using modern architecture techniques like microservices, CQRS and event sourcing. We use DDD (domain-driven design) to get a thought-through domain model that closely models the business and provides us with a functional decomposition that maps to decoupled services. We use Angular and Typescript for frontend development and C# for backend development.

Who you are

1) Experience with:
· designing software, e.g. know what design patterns and SOLID are
· writing technical designs
· front-end development: Angular, Typescript, Cypress, Playwright
· back-end development: .NET 10.0, C#
· cloud development, specifically Azure cloud (e. g. services like App Service, Web Jobs, Application Insights, CosmosDB, Service Bus, Azure SQL, etc.)
2) Used to working in an agile software development environment, with: code reviews, unit testing, continuous integration/deployment
3) Familiar with or strong interest in Domain-driven design
4) Willingness to take part in on-call duties to support our customers 24/7 (approx. 8 weeks per year). You will be generously compensated.

What we offer

An open, friendly, and informal atmosphere with a strong emphasis on work-life balance.
A team of motivated colleagues who organize numerous enjoyable activities for employees.
Experience: Learn from day one while applying your knowledge in practice! We believe in your growth and provide the support and training necessary for your development.
A permanent contract with a salary in the range of € 4100,- and € 5020.- gross per month
An end-of-year bonus (13th month).
A mobility allowance of 3% of your gross monthly salary, seperate commuting allowance and business travel (or the option of an NS Business card).
Pension contributions.
Holiday pay.
25 vacation days, with additional days granted from age 35.
Compensation for private internet connection and a home working allowance.
A well-equipped workspace, including furniture and IT resources for remote work.

If you recognize yourself in this role, we are really keen to hear from you. Please upload both your CV and also your motivation letter and we will get back to you as soon as possible after your application.

What to expect

We will help you to thrive in your field of expertise. We offer development programs, tailored to your individual needs and function requirements, including opportunities to attend courses and seminars. We offer challenging, practical hands-on experience with opportunities to work abroad. We operate in a flat organizational structure that keeps communication lines short. The atmosphere is open, informal, cooperative and positive. We employ over 900 people in the Netherlands (HQ), Belgium, Germany, France, the U.K., Romania, Italy, the U.S., Australia, Brazil, Poland, Denmark and Singapore. Visit our website ortec.com to learn more about our solutions and clients’ experiences. Please do not use this vacancy as an acquisition opportunity.

jobs.description:
A strong digital ecosystem starts with user-centric design and seamless integration across our digital landscape. To further strengthen our digital transformation, we are looking for a passionate Full Stack Application Engineer to help build robust, user-friendly modern business applications using a mix of low-code, pro-code, AI assisted development and cloud native technologies that support and streamline our global business processes.

Make a difference as a Full Stack Application Engineer

As a Full Stack Application Engineer, you design, build, enhance and maintain modern business applications that help Enza Zaden work smarter and more efficiently. You translate business needs into scalable, user-friendly and well-integrated solutions, while continuously improving existing applications, workflows and interfaces. In this role, your work will include:

Develop and implement innovative solutions according to Enza Zaden UI/UX, security and quality standards using a mix of modern application development technologies to automate and enhance business processes across departments
Work in multidisciplinary teams that deliver direct business value through pragmatic, user-friendly digital solutions
Collaborate with technical domain expert teams that are responsible for defining and building the foundations and standards of our platforms
Support our user community and create reusable components, agents, templates and guidelines to ensure consistency, security and scalability across platforms
Contribute to the design and execution of our enterprise-wide Low Code and AI Assisted development strategy, aligned with our broader IT architecture
You play a key role in maintaining, securing, enhancing and monitoring the performance of existing applications and interfaces

What you bring as a future
colleague

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Minimum of 3 years of experience in designing, developing and deploying business applications in a professional environment.
Hands-on experience with application development, workflow automation, data models and user interfaces.
Able to use a mix of low-code, pro-code, AI assisted development and cloud native technologies and are familiar with integration methods such as REST APIs, Logic Apps and SQL.
Experience with governance, solution architecture and application lifecycle management is a plus.
Knowledge of Agile methodologies like Scrum and understanding of Devops practises and tooling like automated testing, CI/CD pipelines and monitoring tools
You are analytical, structured and a clear communicator and you excel in global cross-functional teamwork and align with stakeholders

Enza Zaden
as your employer

Enza Zaden is an international family-owned company that has been developing innovative vegetable varieties since 1938. Together with more than 3,300 colleagues worldwide, we work on vegetable seeds with better flavor, higher yields and strong resistances. We do this from our mission: “Breeding to feed the world.” Every day, more than 480 million people eat vegetables grown from our seeds, and that is something we are very proud of.

We are passionate about our work and care about one another. Good ideas are given room to grow and together we keep moving forward. This is how we continue to grow and innovate, both as a company and as colleagues.

What Can You Expect From Us

We believe it is important that you can grow in your work and feel good about what you do. That is why we invest in your development, well-being, and job satisfaction. Through our Great to Grow development program, our focus on vitality, and activities that bring colleagues together, we create a work environment where you can keep learning and contribute with energy and enjoyment.

You can also count on:

A position for 38hours per week;
A gross monthly salary between €3,984 and €5,500 (Scale 8, Collective Labor Agreement for Vegetable Seed Companies), based on a full-time workweek of 38 hours and aligned with your knowledge and experience;
8.33% vacation allowance and an attractive annual bonus program of 10% of your annual salary, depending on your job level and company performance;
25 vacation days, the option to purchase additional vacation days, and one paid vitality day per year, with extra vacation days granted as you get older;
A laptop and mobile phone provided by Enza Zaden;
A contribution toward overnight accommodation costs if you live farther away from Enza Zaden. This program applies to employees working for Enza Zaden in the Netherlands whose one-way commute exceeds 100 kilometers and 75 minutes;
An attractive retirement plan, commuting reimbursement if you live more than 10 kilometers from your workplace and a remote work allowance when working partly from home in consultation with your manager;
Opportunities for personal and professional growth through our Great to Grow development program, training courses, workshops, and e-learning platform;
Plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues outside of your daily work through social events organized by the Staff Association, as well as Young Enza networking events, inspiration sessions, and social gatherings. We also host an annual summer barbecue, Christmas market and New Year’s reception;
A strong focus on your health and well-being, including free fresh fruit, healthy lunch options at the office, a bike-to-work program, sports activities through enzActive, and mental well-being support through OpenUp.

Let’s connect

Du entwickelst bestehende Anwendungen gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter und sorgst dafür, dass sie unsere Geschäftsprozesse zuverlässig unterstützen

Lebenslanges Lernen: Innovatives Weiterbildungsangebot u.a. in Form von E-Learnings, Fachseminaren, Soft-Skill Trainings, Sprachkursen, Möglichkeit, durch Hospitationen in andere Abteilungen zu schnuppern
