jobs.title: Software Developer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a global leader in radiation safety, detection and measurement, Mirion Technologies is advancing radiation safety through innovative technologies and solutions.

Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)

Standort: München – Laim

Wir sind die Mirion Technologies GmbH – ein innovatives mittelständisches Unternehmen in München und Teil der internationalen Mirion-Gruppe. Seit über 70 Jahren entwickeln und produzieren wir hochwertige Messgeräte für die Radioaktivitäts- und Nuklearmesstechnik. Rund 80 Mitarbeitende arbeiten in einem modernen Umfeld eng zusammen und fertigen Geräte in Einzelfertigung oder Kleinserie nach höchsten Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards.

Unsere Produkte sind im Bereich der Funktionalen Sicherheit angesiedelt. Daraus ergeben sich besondere Anforderungen: Sowohl die in den Produkten verwendete Software selbst als auch der angewandte Entwicklungsprozess müssen den Vorgaben der internationalen Normen (z.B. IEC 60880) genügen. Dies stellt sicher, dass unsere Lösungen den höchsten Standards hinsichtlich Zuverlässigkeit, Qualität und Nachvollziehbarkeit entsprechen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Bereichs Research & Development suchen wir einen Software Developer (m/f/d)
, die/der an der sicheren, wirtschaftlichen und termingerechten Entwicklung von Softwarelösungen für unsere Produkte sowie zugehörige PC-Bedien- und Service-Software mitwirkt. Sie arbeiten eng mit angrenzenden Fachbereichen zusammen und begleiten den gesamten Software-Lebenszyklus – von der Konzeption über die Implementierung und Verifikation bis hin zur Produktpflege.

Ihre Aufgaben

Entwicklung und Implementierung von sicherheitsgerichteter Embedded-Software in C
Erstellung und Pflege von Software-Architekturen und detaillierten Designs unter Berücksichtigung der Anforderungen der funktionalen Sicherheit
Durchführung von Code-Reviews, statischen Analysen und Unit-Tests zur Sicherstellung höchster Softwarequalität
Erstellung sicherheitsrelevanter Dokumentation, einschließlich Software-Anforderungsspezifikationen, Designdokumente, Test- und Verifikationsberichte
Mitwirkung im gesamten Safety-Lifecycle – von der Anforderungsanalyse über die Implementierung bis hin zur Validierung und Zertifizierung
Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von Benutzerhandbüchern und technischer Dokumentation für unsere Kunden
Mitwirkung bei der Konfigurierung unserer Messgeräte im Rahmen von Kundenprojekten
Analyse und Behebung von Fehlern in bestehenden Embedded-Systemen sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Softwareprozesse
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Hardware-Entwicklung, Systemengineering, Qualitätssicherung und externen Prüfstellen (z. B. TÜV)
Mitwirkung bei Konzeption, Implementierung und Test von PC-SW, die für den Test und den Einsatz unserer Produkte benötigt wird (z.B. Python-SW für Geräte-Tests oder C#-SW für Konfigurations-Tools).
Auswahl und Bewertung geeigneter Entwicklungswerkzeuge, Compiler und Laufzeitumgebungen im Hinblick auf Safety-Anforderungen
Sonderaufgaben / ad hoc Anfragen

Ihr Profil

Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Informatik oder in einer vergleichbaren relevanten Fachrichtung
Erfahrungen in der Softwareentwicklung für Embedded Systeme (z.B. ARM Cortex M4) – sei es durch mehrjährige Berufspraxis, erste Berufserfahrung als Young Professional oder durch einschlägige Praktika im Rahmen Ihres Studiums
Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von Algorithmen im Bereich hardwarenaher Software
Mikrokontroller-Programmierung, Echtzeit- und Multitask-Betriebssysteme, Multiprozessorsysteme / Verteilte Systeme, Parallele Prozesse, Fließkomma- und Festpunkt- Arithmetik in Embedded- Systemen
Programmiersprachen: C, C#, Python, Delphi
Kenntnisse im Bereich Mikrokontroller und typische Peripheriebausteine, Embedded-Systeme, Halbleiter- Schaltungstechnik, SPI und I2C Interfaces, Bus-Systeme wie M-LVDS und RS 485, sowie Erfahrungen mit gängigen Entwicklungsumgebungen wie z.B. IAR EWARM für ARM basierte Mikrokontroller sind von Vorteil
Vorerfahrung in der Entwicklung sicherheitsrelevanter Software nach IEC 61508 oder vergleichbaren Normen ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung – wir unterstützen Sie dabei, sich in dieses spannende Fachgebiet einzuarbeiten
Die üblichen MS-Office-Anwendungen beherrschen Sie sicher
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Unser Angebot

Gestaltungsspielraum: Breites und vielfältiges Aufgabengebiet mit Verantwortung und Raum für eigene Ideen
Stabilität: sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem internationalen Unternehmen mit attraktivem Gehalt
Entwicklung: umfassende Einarbeitung sowie regelmäßige Schulungen und Trainings
Benefits: Jobticket, Wellpass, Corporate Benefits, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Regelung, Gesundheitsangebote und mehr

jobs.title: Advisory Solution Architect - Nutanix Database Service (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Hungry, Honest, Humble, with Heart!

The Opportunity

Nutanix is seeking a pre-sales Solution Architect for Nutanix Database Service (NDB) to drive the growth of our Database-as-a-Service (DBaaS) portfolio across the EMEA Central region. In this high-impact pre-sales role, you will serve as the premier database subject matter expert within our technical sales organization.

Working closely with account teams, partners, consultants, product managers and engineering groups, you will educate enterprise customers, architect tailored database automation solutions, execute hands-on technical validation, and drive regional sales targets across the region, in pair with a Sales Specialist.

Your Role

Lead Technical Engagements: Act as the primary technical authority and trusted advisor for Nutanix Database Service (NDB), guiding enterprise customers from initial discovery through technical decision-making.
Execute Technical Validation: Plan, deploy, configure, and maintain NDB during Proof of Concept (POC) engagements to demonstrate quantifiable business and technical value.
Architect Enterprise Solutions: Collaborate with field sales, systems engineers, and Nutanix Consulting Services to design scalable database as a service architectures that integrate with existing customer environments and with other Nutanix solutions.
Drive Product Feedback Loops: Synthesize field learnings, customer feature requests, and regional sales blockers to directly influence Nutanix product management, engineering, and marketing roadmaps.
Drive adoption of the solution: Work as the trusted advisor of Enterprise customers, to make sure NDB is implemented and used at the full of its features, helping customers to solve their management issues with NDB.
Thought Leadership & Community: Establish yourself as a DBaaS expert by participating in internal technical communities, presenting at industry conferences, and publishing reference architectures, blogs, and technical whitepapers.

What You Will Bring

Database Expertise: 5+ years of experience as a DBA, Database Architect, or Technical Pre-Sales Engineer with deep hands-on experience in enterprise database systems (e.g., MS SQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, or other NoSQL/virtualized database solutions).
Cloud & Modern Infrastructure Knowledge: Good knowledge of major public cloud platforms architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP), alongside a strong grasp of data center architecture (virtualisation, storage, networking), modern apps (using Kubernetes) and good knowledge of automation/DevOps practices.
Pre-Sales Track Record: Proven experience driving complex technical sales cycles, running hands-on evaluation deployments, and positioning technical capabilities against enterprise business outcomes.
Communication & Presentation: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build rapport and credibly present to both technical teams (DBAs, infrastructure leads) and executive decision-makers.
Languages: Native or fluent proficiency in both German and English (written and spoken). Additional European languages are a plus.
Location & Mobility: Must be legally based in Germany (remote position) with the willingness and ability to travel across the EMEA Central region for customer meetings, events, and workshops.

Work Arrangement

Remote: This position is primarily remote. There is no specific in-office requirement, however, there may be circumstances where you may be required to come into a local office for a specific purpose, and/or to travel to other locations based on business needs.

As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today.

About the role:

Join our ERP Engineering team iand help shape the technology behind one of Europe's largest and most advanced e-commerce fulfilment operations. You'll develop and enhance Microsoft Dynamics 365 Warehouse Management solutions that keep our logistics hub running efficiently, working alongside Product Teams, Functional Consultants and warehouse stakeholders to optimise warehouse processes, inventory management and fulfilment capabilities through innovative engineering solutions.

About the tech stack:

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O), Microsoft Dynamics 365 Warehouse Management (WMS), X++, Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, Lifecycle Services (LCS), SQL Server, T-SQL, Electronic Reporting (ER), SSRS Reporting, Data Management Framework (DMF), OData Services, REST APIs, Business Events, Dual-write, Power Platform (Power Apps & Power Automate), Git, CI/CD Pipelines.

Job Description

About your tasks:

Design and build Microsoft Dynamics 365 Warehouse Management (WMS) solutions that support high-volume warehouse operations across inbound logistics, inventory management and outbound fulfilment.
Develop custom X++ solutions, integrations, Data Entities, APIs, workflows and business events, connecting Dynamics 365 with warehouse technologies and surrounding enterprise systems.
Enhance warehouse execution processes, including receiving, put-away, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping and inventory movements to improve operational efficiency and scalability.
Drive engineering excellence by performing code reviews, mentoring colleagues, optimising application performance and contributing to CI/CD, release management and Microsoft development best practices.
Collaborate closely with Warehouse Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, Product Teams, QA Engineers and warehouse stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle, from solution design through production deployment.

Qualifications

About you:

You have extensive experience developing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations solutions with strong expertise in Warehouse Management (WMS) and X++ development.
You understand warehouse operations, fulfilment and inventory management processes, and enjoy translating operational challenges into scalable technical solutions.
You have experience building enterprise integrations using REST APIs, OData, Data Management Framework (DMF), Business Events or Dual-write and are passionate about developing clean, maintainable code.
You enjoy working closely with technical and business colleagues in an international environment and are excited to contribute to the continuous evolution of our warehouse technology landscape in Sevenum.

Additional Information

About your benefits:

In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs – whether it’s living a healthy life, having enough time for your needs, or developing your skills – we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits:

Welcome days: To ensure a comfortable welcome, you will be provided with all important details on your first day, e.g. on safety and important processes.
Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
Personal development: We are happy to promote your professional future with us and offer various training courses in our company and with external partners.
Vacation: We can offer you 28 vacation days and a vacation pay once per year (8 % of your annual gross) in addition to your salary.

jobs.title: .Net Developer
jobs.description:
About The Role & Team

At The Walt Disney Company, we believe that technology and storytelling go hand in hand. From our legendary parks and resorts to our cutting-edge platforms, technology is the invisible magic that powers everything we do.

This role sits within the Walt Disney Travel Company (International), the division that brings Disney Parks, Resorts, and experiences to guests across EMEA. We are seeking Senior .NET Developers to join our talented Hammersmith team and play a pivotal role in the next phase of our web platform modernisation, transitioning our e-commerce platform and marketing microsites from their current ASP.NET MVC 5 foundation toward a modern, cloud-hosted architecture.

This role will be based in our London Hammersmith office, 4 days a week, with either a Monday or Friday working from home.

Values

You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values
— acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

Overall Purpose of the Role

Work as an integral part of the Disney Destinations International team supporting Walt Disney Travel Company (International) ecommerce platform and portfolio of marketing microsites.
Work closely with the development team to maintain and update the bespoke ecommerce platform, taking a proactive approach in evolving the back-end technology stack and migrating legacy code across to an ASP.NET framework.
Advocate integration of technologies and development methodologies to help drive the business forward and ensure a robust, scalable platform.

Areas of Responsibility

Support back-end website development, providing technical knowledge to deliver complex solutions across full development life.
Work closely with the Digital Commerce & Production Manager to maintain and update the bespoke Classic ASP ecommerce platform.
Develop new features for a localized ASP.NET MVC 5 platform and contribute migrating legacy features over to this new platform.
Write maintainable, scalable, fault-tolerant code, utilizing SOLID principles and OO design/architectural patterns, TDD, etc.
Proactively manage tools, hardware and environments to support development requirements.
Work with team members to identify workflows and services for managing code, from version control to deployment strategies.
Log and troubleshoot errors using appropriate tools.
Proactively research and explore techniques to maintain position at the forefront of technology and enhance future business offerings.

Areas of Accountability

The position has direct responsibility to Lead Application Developer, Walt Disney Travel Company (International).

Experience And Professional Qualifications Required

A minimum 5 years digital experience with strong digital portfolio.
Experience with bespoke ecommerce web applications highly desirable.
Experience in a development role, either client- or agency-side.
Degree or equivalent in STEM or Computer Science discipline.

Skills Required

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Engineering Manager

Salary:
Up to £100,000 base + 15% bonus
Location:
Croydon – 2 days per week in the office
Work Type:
Permanent

Role

We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to join an established engineering group at an important point in its journey.

This is a newly created role with the opportunity to make a genuine impact on how engineering operates. The business currently has an established desktop application environment and is preparing for its future transition towards SaaS and cloud.

Before that transition begins, there is an opportunity to strengthen engineering effectiveness across the existing environment – improving the SDLC, reducing manual processes, increasing automation and creating a smoother, more predictable approach to delivering quality software.

You’ll inherit leadership responsibilities within a wider engineering group of around 30 people and play a role in building and leading capability in Poland as part of the wider transformation.
This isn't about joining and rewriting everything from scratch. It's about understanding what already works, identifying where engineering can improve and bringing the team with you on that journey.

Responsibilities

As Engineering Manager, you'll combine technical credibility, people leadership and engineering strategy.

Your focus will include:
Leading and supporting engineers within the wider engineering organisation.
Improving engineering effectiveness across the software development lifecycle.
Identifying and removing manual steps from the current release process.
Improving CI/CD, automated testing and release automation.
Addressing flaky tests, quality issues and security vulnerabilities as systemic engineering challenges rather than isolated problems.
Helping engineers understand not only what they are doing, but why engineering processes and practices matter.
Preparing the engineering environment for the future transition from desktop applications towards SaaS and cloud.
Considering how AI-assisted development impacts the wider SDLC, particularly testing, security, quality and release processes.
Bringing greater Product thinking into engineering by understanding how and why customers use the software.
Playing a role in building and leading the Poland engineering capability as part of the wider transformation.
Improving engineering practices pragmatically, without unnecessarily replacing existing systems or processes that work.

Required Skills

We're looking for someone who has started their career in software engineering and progressed into engineering leadership while maintaining strong technical credibility.

Experience we're particularly interested in includes:
A strong software engineering background, ideally within C#/.NET environments.
Engineering leadership experience with the ability to challenge, coach and support technical teams.
Experience working with or leading teams responsible for desktop applications.
An understanding of the different challenges involved in developing and releasing desktop software compared with SaaS products.
Experience improving SDLC and engineering effectiveness.
Strong knowledge of CI/CD, automated testing and release automation.
Experience tackling engineering quality issues such as flaky tests, manual release processes and security vulnerabilities.
Strong people leadership skills.
The ability to balance technical, Product and customer considerations when making engineering decisions.
A pragmatic approach to transformation and continuous improvement.

Experience considering or implementing AI-assisted software development practices would also be valuable, particularly where you've looked beyond code generation at the impact increased development velocity has on testing, security, quality and release processes.

Why should I apply?

This is an opportunity to join before a significant engineering transformation begins rather than arriving halfway through one.

You'll have the chance to influence how an established engineering organisation evolves, improve the foundations of the existing desktop environment and help prepare the team for its future move towards SaaS and cloud.

There are tangible engineering problems to solve today – from automation and testing through to release processes and engineering effectiveness – alongside the longer-term opportunity to influence how the organisation approaches modern software delivery.

You'll also have the opportunity to shape teams across the UK and Poland, bringing your own experience into an established engineering group while helping define what the next stage of its journey looks like.

Interview Process

The interview process consists of three stages:
Stage 1:
45-minute conversation with the hiring team
Stage 2:
Technical test
Stage 3:
Two-hour onsite final interview in Reigate

Interested?

Apply for the role today or send your CV to pierre.rodriguez@wedotech.uk

We are looking for senior software engineers who can also be people managers of other software engineers, for a share of their time (up to 50%).

ability to translate functional requirements into an elegant and simple design, and then deliver the code.

A well-established group supplying products and services into professional and healthcare-adjacent markets is bringing in an experienced Solutions Architect for a role they consider pivotal to the technology decisions ahead of them.

What matters more here is breadth, practicality and the ability to hold your own in front of senior stakeholders, translating technical trade-offs into commercial and business terms rather than jargon. You'll report into the IT leadership team and will regularly be in front of the transformation director, so you need to be someone they can trust to break a problem down clearly, whilst thinking with a commercial mindset. 

The work itself spans a genuinely varied portfolio. Seeing the Big Picture

Technical skills

Shape What Happens Next. Be Part Of Something Bigger.

Take on new challenges, grow your career, be recognised for your contributions, and benefit from our commitment to your wellbeing. Be part of something bigger — where your work has real impact and your development matters. There are so many reasons to take your next step with us.

Professional Services

The University of Edinburgh is a world-class organisation. We are a large University covering a wide range of activities. In Professional Services, we support the University’s research and teaching, offering many career and role specialisms.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Web Developer to help lead the continuous development and ongoing support of the University's central web services, principally the Web Publishing Platform (EdWeb 2) — the open-source, Drupal-based service behind nearly 170 environments and over 600 subsites, curated by more than 1,200 editors and reaching around 30 million users a year from across the world.

This is a senior, technically leading role. You'll set technical direction, architect and build complex enterprise-level features in Drupal, and champion the development, testing and coding standards that keep a platform of this scale robust. You'll also mentor and support the mid-level and junior developers around you — sharing knowledge and helping the whole team deliver high-quality software "small and often", through an agile, continuous-improvement approach.

You'll join the Website and Communications (WAC) team, a highly collaborative and supportive part of Information Services. We work in the open: EdWeb 2 and the University's Student & Staff Portal (MyEd) are both built on open-source software, reflecting the University's commitment to open software and data across its services.

We'd love to hear from someone with deep Drupal and PHP expertise and strong front-end skills, who's a creative, adaptable problem-solver with a genuine enthusiasm for emerging technologies and for bringing them into mainstream use, someone excited to shape a platform the whole University relies on.

People have always been at the heart of our work. Our people are at the centre of the University community and everything we do. We value colleagues with drive, determination and a passion for what they do. We are a place where everyone is welcome and offer a range of policies and benefits designed to support you in building the right meaningful flexibility that works for you.

Responsibility and autonomy
Contributing to the work and purpose of the University.

The team office location is at the west edge of the University’s central campus, in 5 Forrest Hill, Edinburgh, EH1 2QL.

The role follows a hybrid working pattern, combining time working from home with regular time on campus: we ask that colleagues spend at least two days a week on-site, one of which is our shared team anchor day, so the team can collaborate, support one another and stay connected in person.

CV
Cover letter

As a valued member of our team, you can expect:

A competitive salary
An exciting, positive, creative, challenging and rewarding place to work.
To be part of a diverse and vibrant international community.
Comprehensive Staff Benefits, including generous annual leave entitlement, a defined benefits pension scheme, a wide range of staff discounts, family-friendly initiatives, and flexible work options. Check out the full list on our staff benefits page (opens in a new tab) and use our reward calculator to discover the value of your pay and benefits.

Championing equality, diversity, and inclusion

The University of Edinburgh holds a Silver Athena SWAN award in recognition of our commitment to advance gender equality in higher education. We are members of the Race Equality Charter, and we are also a Stonewall Proud Employer, actively promoting LGBTQ+ equality.

The University is committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. If you have the right skills for the job, we want to hear from you. We encourage applications from the right candidates regardless of age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief or race.

As a world-leading research-intensive University, we are here to address tomorrow’s greatest challenges. Between now and 2030 we will do that with a values-led approach to teaching, research and innovation, and through the strength of our relationships, both locally and globally.

The Learning, Teaching & Web Services Directorate (LTW) brings together technology enhanced learning, e-learning, the University website, web services, graphics, multimedia, digital skills training and classroom technology teams to support learning, teaching and outreach for an enhanced student experience.

We provide a wide range of technology and support services for innovative learning and teaching, including classroom tools, virtual learning environment (VLE), blended learning, bespoke development, online video, open educational resources (OER), taught online Masters programmes, massive open online courses (MOOCs), feedback and assessment. That architecture is documented in both a PoC High Level Design and Full-Service High-Level Design, supported by Architecture Decision Records.

one or more iterations of the Full Service HLD based on a re-evaluation of technical and integration constraints. 
a body of options papers and ADRs that show the reasoning, alternatives and trade-offs behind each decision before the decision is written up. 
integration strategies for each justice partner that are specific to that partner's systems, appetite and supplier landscape.

Substantial experience as a technical architect on complex, integration-heavy digital services, with a track record of designs that were successfully delivered. 
Demonstrable ownership of HLD and LLD artefacts through multiple iterations and formal architectural assurance, in a governed public sector or comparably regulated environment. 
Deep, practical systems integration expertise: event-driven and message-based architecture, service buses, asynchronous patterns, idempotency, replay, dead-lettering, eventual consistency, change data capture and reconciliation. 
Strong API design and integration with legacy and third-party systems that you do not control and cannot change. 
Data architecture: modelling, entity correlation and matching across systems without shared identifiers, data quality, migration and seeding, retention and deletion. 
Cloud architecture on Azure — networking, identity, data services, messaging, secrets, IaC and CI/CD; ability to size and cost a workload. 
Security and privacy by design: authentication and identity (OIDC/OAuth2, federated identity), threat modelling, data protection and information governance for sensitive personal data.

Experience in the justice, policing or public safety sector

Experience with viewpoint-based architecture description (Rozanski & Woods or similar) and with C4 or equivalent modelling.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Longshot Systems we build advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the team that owns and develops our trading platform. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who can architect and implement whatever is needed to meet our next product, performance or stability goal. The team owns the technical standards and coding guidelines, CI/CD, observability and security. This role suits someone who wants to ship features and contribute to the wider technical excellence in the team and platform.

The trading platform at Longshot handles integrations with many bookmakers and exchanges worldwide. It normalises and combines the global odds data for many sports and makes it available internally for strategies to trade on. We handle thousands of odds updates and trades per second and have very strict bounds on latency, correctness and overall quality of the feed and trading. You would be at the heart of this team: integrating more trading venues, optimising key parts of the platform, making trading safer and faster, etc. We also maintain a significant historical data repository and support wider trading and research efforts around the company.

Our key platform systems are all in Golang, with message buses and databases at the core of the architecture. You don't need to be fluent in Golang, but it would help. It's easy to learn and we have a team full of experts able to teach you.

We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and flexible the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals.

Interview Process

Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests
1st Technical interview (30 mins) - live code review & pair programming
2nd Technical interview (60 mins) - deep dive technical questions
Full assessment day (10:30-5pm) - a one day systems programming exercise designed to be similar to the real work we do in the team. Meet some of the team, see the office, have a nice lunch (on us)

Requirements

Bachelors or Masters in a quantitative or technical subject (e.g. Maths, EE, Physics, Comp Sci) from a top university
2+ years experience building mission critical distributed systems (finance, gaming, telco, ad-tech, etc.) where throughput, correctness and availability are a hard requirement
Proven track record delivering and maintaining production systems in at least one systems language (Go, C++, Rust, Java, C#, etc.), with clear, idiomatic designs
Startup experience: shipping products in small, fast moving teams
Architecture & design: Able to reason about trade offs and produce clean, evolvable service boundaries
Cloud & DevOps: comfortable working in AWS, linux and wrangling build pipelines. We have dedicated DevOps people, but you do need to be competent in the core skills here
Fluent written and spoken English. Communicating with the team is as important as the technical work. You need to be able to effectively collaborate on everything from low level details to long term strategic planning

Nice to have

Trading, market making or exchange experience

Benefits

Participation in the uncapped company bonus scheme
10% matched pension contributions
Private healthcare insurance
Long term illness insurance
Gym membership

Vanquis is evolving.

We are looking for a Senior .NET Engineer to work on migrating a client-facing e-commerce/store application's payment processing from its current gateway to a new payment provider.

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement an abstraction layer that decouples the application from a single payment provider, enabling multiple providers to operate in parallel.
Implement the integration with the new payment provider, including the card-capture and payment/refund flows, in a way that minimizes the application's compliance exposure.

Build and Ship High-Impact Features

: Utilize agentic development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to radically accelerate the design, coding, and testing lifecycle for your team.

: Ensure our systems are built with a relentless focus on performance, reliability, and security to meet the demands of a global user base.

Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Demonstrated expertise in using AI-driven development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to significantly improve software engineering velocity and quality

A strong foundation in modern software development practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure-as-code.
A strong observability mindset—logging, metrics, and distributed tracing across microservices.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working across time zones.

We’re Even More Excited If You Have
Proven ability to translate complex business problems into simple, elegant technical solutions.
Experience building software in a regulated industry, such as finance or accounting.
Knowledge of cloud-native technologies and experience building applications on platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
Familiarity with the principles of Responsible AI and how to apply them in a software development context.

Location Hamburg/Hybrid or Poznan/Hybrid

Design, build and operate backend services in C# / .NET and Python - APIs, data pipelines and integration services

Must-have

Several years' professional experience building backend services in C# / .NET
, plus solid working command of Python

Knowledge of medical imaging / DICOM / DICOMweb / FHIR / NIFTI

Experience with regulated medical software

jobs.description:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a Senior MS Dynamics Business Central Developer
, you will join our global Tech team and play a pivotal role in shaping the technical backbone of our operations. In this senior role, you will take full ownership of core development initiatives, optimize complex system architectures, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to engineer innovative, scalable solutions. Driving continuous technical improvement and performance, your work will directly enable our operational excellence and international growth. This position is permanent
and based in Warsaw
.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design, develop, and implement advanced customisations and extensions for MS Dynamics Business Central using AL and related technologies to support Westwing’s multi-country, multi-language, and multi-currency operations
Lead the technical architecture for Business Central, ensuring scalability, performance, and alignment with overarching business goals
Collaborate closely with functional consultants and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into robust, high-performing technical solutions
Optimise and maintain Business Central environments, ensuring high availability and seamless integration across our system landscape
Develop and maintain integrations across Westwing’s IT portfolio, leveraging APIs, Power Platform, and modern integration tools
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues to guarantee high performance, minimal downtime, and maximum operational efficiency
Continuously evaluate new Business Central features, Azure services, and modern development tools to drive automation, technical innovation, and efficiency

YOU COME WITH

5+ years of hands-on development experience with MS Dynamics Business Central or Dynamics NAV, ideally within a Microsoft Partner or enterprise environment
Deep expertise in AL programming, Visual Studio Code, and Business Central development frameworks
Proven track record of delivering scalable, high-quality technical solutions for complex business processes
Strong knowledge of modern integration techniques, including APIs, Web Services, and Power Platform
Practical experience leveraging AI-powered tools and services to enhance ERP functionality
Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on optimising Business Central performance
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams, paired with fluency in English

WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.

At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:

A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
A flexible hybrid setup with 2 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen
Work-from-anywhere opportunities for up to 4 weeks per year - as fresh perspectives spark bold ideas
20 to 28 days of paid holiday to rest, recharge, and come back ready to create
A beautiful, centrally located, dog-friendly office with inspiring spaces
Exclusive discounts - 40% off Westwing Collection, 20% off third-party brands (each on non-reduced items), 10% Family & Friends discount, plus special-occasion vouchers
Wellbeing support through mental health resources, sports memberships, and preventive care
Team rituals that celebrate results and togetherness - from Summer & Winter Parties to Oktoberfest

ABOUT US

Westwing, Europe’s #1 in Beautiful Living e-commerce, is present in 20+ European countries and achieved a GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume) of EUR 507 million in 2025. As Europe’s premium one-stop destination for Design Lovers, it offers a unique brand experience with a carefully curated assortment of the Westwing Collection and 3rd party design brands. The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Westwing’s team works together on its shared purpose to “Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life”. Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018.

Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd.

Diversity is deeply rooted in our culture. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Desktop
jobs.description:
What is Box?

Box (NYSE: BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It's the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together — and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

Why Box needs you:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Desktop Applications team at Box, you'll be at the heart of building and evolving the products that millions of users rely on every day - Box Drive, Box Tools, and Box for Office on both Windows and macOS. You'll work across the full depth of the desktop stack, from virtual file systems and OS integrations to sync, networking, and UI, helping shape how enterprise content comes to life on the desktop. You'll collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to deliver features that are fast, reliable, and secure - and you'll bring a growth mindset and a passion for leveraging AI tools to accelerate your impact.

What you'll do:

Design, develop, and ship high-quality features for Box's desktop applications (Box Drive, Box Tools, Box for Office) on Windows and macOS, ensuring they are performant, user-friendly, and secure
Work across the full desktop stack — including virtual file systems, data persistence, OS integrations, network and sync layers, and UI — to solve complex technical challenges at scale
Contribute to cross-platform development using React Native, bridging front-end and native desktop experiences
Collaborate daily with Product Managers, QA engineers, and designers to translate requirements into robust, well-tested software
Lead and participate in design discussions, architecture reviews, and code reviews to uphold engineering quality and share knowledge across the team
Diagnose and resolve complex performance, reliability, and compatibility issues affecting millions of end users
Attend and engage in weekly stand-ups, team meetings, and manager 1:1s
Work collaboratively with other engineers, team members, and across teams
Play a role in developing and fostering Box culture in the Warsaw office and represent Box Poland internally and externally
Participate in our on-call rotation, available at all times while on-call to help respond to and triage any issues that arise

Who you are:

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

5+ years of professional desktop software development experience
Proficient in C++, C#, and/or Swift, with a strong command of software design and architecture principles
Demonstrated experience building and shipping desktop applications on Windows and/or macOS
Comfortable working across the full desktop stack: virtual file systems, OS integrations, networking, sync, and UI
Experienced with unit testing and functional testing practices in an agile team environment
Passionate about building software that is user-friendly, performant, and secure
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
Able to assess, communicate, and complete project milestones with your manager and team members in a time-sensitive manner
Must speak English proficiently

Preferred Skills:

Experience with Windows systems-level programming (Win32 APIs, multi-threading, IPC, COM)
Cross-platform development experience across both macOS and Windows
Prior experience using AI coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) as part of your daily workflow

Percentage of Time Spent:

15% design and architecture
60% coding, code reviews, and testing
15% bug fixes
5% documentation
5% meetings

Methodology:

Agile management — Scrum
Issue tracking — Jira
Knowledge repository — Box / Confluence / GitHub Enterprise
Code reviews — GitHub Enterprise
Version control — GIT
CI/CD — Jenkins
Communication — Slack / Zoom

Benefits

Check out the overview of Life at Box which include general perks and benefits.

Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.

At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation.

For details on how we protect your information when you apply, please see our Personnel Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:
Location: Katowice/Wrocław/Warsaw - 2 days in office / 3 days remote

Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS Poland – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.

Copilot Studio Developer
works within a technologically versatile team located in Poland, providing consulting services to biggest market players in EMEIA region and around the globe.

The opportunity

With a constant growth of our business and customers’ needs we are willing to move our projects on the new track. We are able to offer you a senior developer role with opportunity to support your further professional growth. You will work as part of a team that designs, develops, tests, deploys and supports different types of solutions using Power Platform, RPA and other modern technologies. You will work with the most recognizable and influential players on the financial markets within the challenging projects.

Your Key Responsibilities

In this role you will predominantly:

Design, develop, test, and deploy automations and transform business processes using Power Platform stack
Design, develop, test, and deploy Power Apps tools
Design, develop, test, and deploy agentic solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, focusing on low-code approaches.
Integrate Copilot Studio solutions with various business systems, leveraging the Power Platform and other relevant technologies.
Provide support and maintenance to the existing automations and applications
Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their needs, identify opportunities for AI-powered automation, and translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in Copilot Studio, Power Platform, and related AI technologies.

Skills And Attributes For Success

We are looking for experienced individuals with RPA and/or Power Platform skills, ready to further develop their technical and consulting skills across a variety of business processes, who are able to work independently but also as a part of a team.

To qualify for the role, you must have

Proven experience in implementing Power Platform solutions using Canvas Apps, Model Driven Apps, Power Pages (Portal), Power Automate
Proven experience in creating agents in Copilot Studio
Proven track record integrating Power Platform solutions with enterprise systems via REST APIs, Azure Functions, or Logic Apps.
Ability to translate business requirements into technical specs and manage projects independently.
Excellent communication skills in English; comfortable engaging both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ideally, you’ll also have

Experience in using Autogen or Microsoft Agent Framework
Experience with .Net framework.
Solid scripting or coding in JavaScript or C# for custom connectors and UI tweaks.
SQL Server or Azure SQL schema design and performance tuning.
Power Platform or Azure AI certification (PL-200 / AI-102 or similar).
Experience facilitating technical workshops or hackathons.

What We Look For

We love working with people who are passionate about their job and have great interpersonal skills, who are ready to face new professional challenges. Are you a person with a good sense of humor and open to significantly extend your skillset? If yes, it’s a role for you.

What We Offer

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across nine locations – Argentina, Hungary, India, the Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

About EY

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

The Exceptional EY Experience. It’s Yours To Build.

jobs.description:
About the job:

Are you excited about leading high-scale platform engineering in the core fintech sector? We are searching for a dynamic Engineering Manager who leads the platform engineering team responsible for JVM and .NET platform health, DevOps tooling, CI/CD, observability, and deployment infrastructure across all FinTech products.

You will be accountable for platform reliability, cost efficiency, developer velocity, and AI readiness across the FinTech engineering organization. For this position, the candidate must be an engineer specializing in either .NET or Java.

Important things for you:

Flexible working hours
in the hybrid model (4/1) — working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
Depending on your annual assessment and the company's results we offer:
Annual bonus
based on your annual performance and company results.
Long term discretionary incentive plan
based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).
Our team is based in Warsaw
.

Your responsibilities:

Leads and manages a cross-functional platform engineering team.
Drives platform adoption and removes technical and operational blockers across product teams.
Oversees infrastructure provisioning, cloud resource management, and container orchestration on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
Coordinates fleet-scale migrations, including JVM and .NET platform development, Java, .NET, and Spring Boot upgrades.
Optimizes CI/CD pipelines, GitOps deployment safety (canary releases, configuration versioning), and infrastructure cost efficiency.
Integrates AI tools into platform engineering workflows to accelerate developer velocity company-wide.
Manages capacity, sequencing, and cloud budgeting (Azure).
Runs team ceremonies, conducts 1:1 sessions, provides performance feedback, and leads talent acquisition.

Main challenges in this role:

High cloud logging and observability costs requiring validation and deployment of alternative logging backends like VictoriaLogs.
Scaling pipeline throughput and deployment safety to match the accelerated development speed driven by AI tools.
Modernizing JVM and .NET platform and tracking library adoption across products.
Balancing tight roadmap deadlines with team capacity and high operational interrupt volumes.

This is the right job for you if:

You are a strong leader with competencies in People Management, Talent Development, Strategic Thinking, Problem-Solving & Decision-Making, and Stakeholder Management.
You have crucial job-specific skills including Back-End Programming, Business Continuity and Resilience Planning, Software Architecture, DevOps and CI/CD, Agile Methodologies, and Scalability and Resilience.
You possess knowledge in Cloud Infrastructure Management (Microsoft Azure), Container Orchestration (AKS, Istio Service Mesh), Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi), and JVM and .NET Platform Management.
You exhibit general competencies such as Communication, Change Agility, Risk Savvy, Change Management, Continuous Improvement & Innovation, Resilience and Adaptability, AI Literacy, and Analytical Thinking.
You are fluent in Polish (C1) and have a strong command of English (B2).

What's in it for you:

Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
A 16" or 14" MacBook Pro or corresponding Dell with Windows (if you don't like Macs) and all the necessary accessories.
A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

And that's just the beginning! You can read more about the benefits here.

#goodtobehere means that:

You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.
You will become part of Allegro Tech - we speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!

Send us your CV and... see you at Allegro!

Job Description:

Leading technical contributor to the enhancement and maintenance of one or more Charles River IMS modules or components of an agile scrum team.

Java, Portfolio management, derivatives, risk models, risk management.
Technology - Java, React, SQL.

Prior experience with performance troubleshooting on the database and application layer are a plus
6-10 years of progressively responsible professional software engineering experience.
This role is not for a specific project but will be allocated to any one of Wealth Management department projects.

Summary:

Charles River Development empowers investment firms worldwide with a cloud-based platform that streamlines and automates the investment process across asset classes. As part of organisation, we bring together data, technology, and services to help clients make confident decisions and scale with agility. Our open ecosystem and global support model enable investment professionals—from portfolio managers to private markets specialists—to navigate complexity and drive innovation. At Charles River, we thrive on collaboration, continuous improvement, and a shared commitment to shaping the future of financial technology.
The platform services both Institutional and Wealth Management clients. The team sits in the heart of this solution. It develops and supports optimization engine tools used for portfolio construction and risk-based rebalancing within CRIMS system.
This position will be a critical contributor with ownership for designing and implementing complex wealth and investment management workflows leveraged by some of the largest participants in the industry. The role requires a strong full-stack engineer who can work across rich web functionality, backend services, automated testing, performance engineering, and system scalability while contributing to sustainable technical design and high-quality delivery in a collaborative environment.

Responsibilities:

Work under minimal supervision to analyze, design, develop, test, and debug small to large software enhancements and solutions within Charles River’s business and technical problem domains, with strong ownership of delivery quality and maintainability.
Collaborate with Business Analysts and Product Managers to turn business requirements of moderate complexity into working and sustainable software.
Participate in the design of product architecture within the team’s scope of responsibility, contributing to scalable, supportable, and sustainable technical solutions.
Develop, test, debug, and implement software programs, applications, and services using Java, C#, SQL, React, or other related software engineering technologies.
Provide thoughtful insight and suggestions in code reviews.
Write unit and automation tests to ensure a high-quality product.
Mentor junior developers and help establish engineering best practices across the team.
Conduct manual tests to ensure a high-quality product.
Contribute to written design and API documentation and participate in the customer documentation process.
Actively participate in the agile software development process by adhering to the CRD scrum methodology, including attending daily standups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives.
Participate in cross-team group activities to complete assignments.

Required Qualifications

6 to 10 years of progressively responsible professional software engineering experience.
Hands-on development experience with Java, React, SQL and related software engineering technologies, with the ability to deliver sustainable solutions with minimal supervision.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Good understanding of Algorithms/data structures, OO Design and SOLID principles
Able to work well with peers in a collaborative team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in financial services developing solutions for Portfolio Management, Trading, Wealth Management, Risk optimization, Optimizers like Axioma, Risk models.
Experience with modern web application development using React and related libraries.
B.S. degree (or foreign education equivalent) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, and Physics or other technical course of study required.
Demonstrated experience with object-oriented programming, REST APIs, event-driven systems, automated testing, scripting, and performance-focused engineering practices.
Previous experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Postgres, or Oracle.
Experience with cloud and modernization technologies, such as Azure, Kubernetes, Kafka, micro-services, and event-driven architecture.
Experience with engineering and operational tools such as Dynatrace, SolarWinds, and Temporal workflow engine would be helpful.
Experience with AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Agentic AI tools is preferred.
Experience with C# and WinForms is valuable for maintaining legacy software components.

jobs.title: Senior AI / ML Engineer
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us:

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they're doing! At BlackLine, we're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business of enterprise applications. Since being founded in 2001, BlackLine has become a leading provider of cloud software that automates and controls the entire financial close process. Our vision is to modernize the finance and accounting function to enable greater operational effectiveness and agility, and we are committed to delivering innovative solutions and services to empower accounting and finance leaders around the world to achieve Modern Finance.
Being a best-in-class SaaS Company, we understand that bringing in new ideas and innovative technology is mission critical. At BlackLine we are always working with new, cutting edge technology that encourages our teams to learn something new and expand their creativity and technical skillset that will accelerate their careers.
This role is specifically for our AI-powered Invoice-to-Cash solution, a market leading platform that uses intelligent automation to help companies collect cash faster, unlock working capital, and supercharge efficiency in their accounts receivable processes.

Make Your Mark:

As an AI Engineer at BlackLine, you will be a key player in our mission to bring autonomous finance to every company in the world. You will be at the forefront of developing and deploying innovative applications that leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) and foundation models. We are looking for a candidate with a deep understanding of AI Engineering with practical experience deploying GenAI solutions at scale.

You'll Get To:

Design, build, and deploy production-grade applications that leverage foundation models to deliver unprecedented insights and efficiency to Finance & Accounting teams.
Develop and implement robust evaluation methodologies for open-ended AI systems, including the use of "AI as a judge" to ensure our solutions meet the highest standards of accuracy and reliability.
Master and apply a variety of model adaptation techniques, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and fine-tuning, to tailor foundation models to specific financial use cases.
Create and manage datasets for training and fine-tuning models, ensuring data quality and relevance.
Build and deploy AI agents that can automate complex financial workflows and interact with various tools and systems.
Optimize the performance of our AI applications, focusing on reducing latency and cost to deliver a seamless user experience.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement the best AI-powered solutions to address the challenges faced by the office of the CFO.

What You'll Bring:

Technical/Specialized Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Proven experience in developing and deploying applications using foundation models (e.g., GPT-4o/o3, Claude Opus 4.x / Sonnet 4.x, Llama 3.x).
A strong understanding of the principles of AI Engineering, as distinct from traditional Machine Learning Engineering.
Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, including techniques for few-shot and zero-shot learning, and defensive prompt design.
Practical knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture and its application in building knowledge-intensive applications.
Experience with fine-tuning LLMs and an understanding of when to use fine-tuning versus RAG.
Experience with building and evaluating AI agents that can perform complex, multi-step tasks.
Familiarity with the challenges of evaluating foundation models and experience with designing and implementing evaluation pipelines.
Proficiency in Python or C# and experience with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, LangGraph, PyTorch).

We're Even More Excited If You Have:

Experience designing or operating AgenticOS patterns (e.g., memory management, tool registries, agent lifecycle orchestration, and inter-agent communication) to build reliable, production-grade autonomous agent systems.
Knowledge of techniques for optimizing inference, including quantization and other methods to improve latency and cost.
Expertise in multi-modal generative models (e.g., text, image, audio) and a proven ability to apply them to create innovative enterprise solutions.
A deep understanding of dataset engineering, including data curation, augmentation, and synthesis. Proven experience in designing and building end-to-end Generative AI systems, from data ingestion and model orchestration to scalable deployment and continuous monitoring.
A strong grasp of LLMOps principles and hands-on experience with tools and platforms for managing the entire lifecycle of Large Language Models in production.
Experience with Model Composition (MCP) techniques, demonstrating an ability to solve complex problems by intelligently combining multiple specialized models or AI agents.
Deep knowledge of Responsible AI principles and practical experience in implementing robust guardrails, safety filters, and ethical considerations into generative models to ensure fairness, transparency, and accountability.
Familiarity with the financial domain and the challenges of applying AI in a regulated industry.

Thrive at BlackLine Because You Are Joining:

A technology-based company with vision and ambition.
A culture that is kind, open, and diverse.
A workplace that empowers growth and continuous learning.
Professional development seminars and inclusive affinity groups.
Equal opportunity employer - inclusivity at the core.
Hybrid work model: at least 3 days per week in office for local candidates

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer – Smart Manufacturing (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
Dołącz do Etteplan

W Etteplan wierzymy, że technologia ma sens tylko wtedy, gdy pomaga rozwiązywać realne problemy biznesowe. Tworzymy i rozwijamy rozwiązania software'owe dla klientów z różnych gałęzi przemysłu, łącząc kompetencje z obszaru software, inżynierii i digitalizacji.

Obecnie poszukujemy Senior Java Developera
, który dołączy do projektu realizowanego dla międzynarodowego klienta z sektora przemysłowego i będzie współtworzył rozwiązania wykorzystywane w codziennej działalności organizacji działających na rynkach międzynarodowych.

O projekcie

Dołączysz do zespołu rozwijającego platformę wspierającą procesy produkcyjne oraz zarządzanie dokumentacją i jakością w środowisku przemysłowym. Rozwiązanie wykorzystywane jest przez międzynarodowe organizacje i odgrywa istotną rolę w ich codziennej działalności operacyjnej.

Projekt obejmuje zarówno rozwój nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymanie oraz stopniową modernizację istniejących rozwiązań. Nie jest to wyłącznie development ani wyłącznie maintenance - zależy nam na osobach, które potrafią spojrzeć na system całościowo, proponować usprawnienia i brać odpowiedzialność za jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań.

Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z międzynarodowym zespołem oraz ekspertami biznesowymi i technicznymi po stronie klienta.

Jak wykorzystujemy AI?

W tym projekcie narzędzia AI są naturalnym elementem codziennej pracy zespołu. Wspierają analizę kodu, implementację nowych funkcjonalności, automatyzację powtarzalnych zadań oraz zwiększanie efektywności procesu wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Szukamy osoby, która świadomie wykorzystuje rozwiązania AI jako wsparcie swojej pracy i chce rozwijać ten sposób tworzenia oprogramowania.

Dlaczego warto?

W tej roli:

rozwijasz rozwiązania wykorzystywane przez międzynarodową organizację z sektora przemysłowego,
masz realny wpływ na kierunek rozwoju systemu oraz jakość dostarczanych rozwiązań,
pracujesz w środowisku, które ceni samodzielność, inicjatywę i odpowiedzialność zamiast szczegółowego zarządzania zadaniami,
współpracujesz bezpośrednio z doświadczonym zespołem oraz klientem,
wykorzystujesz nowoczesne narzędzia AI wspierające proces tworzenia oprogramowania,
masz możliwość okazjonalnych wyjazdów służbowych do Finlandii lub Norwegii.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

rozwój oraz utrzymanie aplikacji opartych o Javę,
implementację nowych funkcjonalności oraz analizę i usuwanie błędów,
pracę z relacyjnymi bazami danych oraz warstwą dostępu do danych,
integrację aplikacji z pozostałymi komponentami środowiska klienta,
współpracę z zespołami technicznymi i biznesowymi,
dbanie o jakość kodu, wydajność oraz dobre praktyki inżynierskie,
proponowanie usprawnień oraz aktywny udział w rozwoju systemu,
wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI wspierających proces wytwarzania oprogramowania.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz kilkuletnie doświadczenie komercyjne jako Senior Java Developer,
bardzo dobrze znasz Javę oraz środowisko WildFly,
posiadasz praktyczne doświadczenie z Hibernate, JPA lub innymi rozwiązaniami ORM,
pracowałeś/-aś z bazami danych Microsoft SQL Server oraz Oracle,
rozumiesz zagadnienia związane ze środowiskami kontenerowymi, maszynami wirtualnymi oraz infrastrukturą aplikacyjną,
lubisz przejmować odpowiedzialność za realizowane rozwiązania i doprowadzać zadania do końca,
dobrze odnajdujesz się zarówno przy rozwoju nowych funkcjonalności, jak i utrzymaniu istniejących systemów,
wykorzystujesz narzędzia AI jako wsparcie codziennej pracy programistycznej,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim.

Docenimy również doświadczenie w jednym lub kilku z poniższych obszarów:

integracja systemów z wykorzystaniem brokerów komunikatów, takich jak RabbitMQ,
rozwój i utrzymanie aplikacji działających w środowiskach produkcyjnych,
projektowanie lub rozwój systemów o rozproszonej architekturze,
współpraca z klientami z sektora przemysłowego lub produkcyjnego,
wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do automatyzacji i usprawniania procesu developmentu,
zainteresowanie tematyką spawalnictwa lub doświadczenie zdobyte w branży przemysłowej.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

rozwój poprzez pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku i różnorodnych projektach oraz wymianę wiedzy w grupach kompetencyjnych,
budżet szkoleniowy i indywidualną ścieżkę rozwoju wspieraną przez regularne spotkania z managerem,
prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover, kartę MultiSport, grupowe ubezpieczenie na życie oraz dofinansowanie do posiłków,
elastyczne godziny pracy i możliwość współpracy w modelu hybrydowym,

Who We Are

Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services. We offer solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Accenture Song. For more information about Accenture Technology Poland please visit our website.

THE WORK

As an Cloud Architect in our Accenture Cloud First team, you will help enterprise clients design and evolve secure, scalable and cost‑efficient cloud landscapes, supporting their digital transformation journeys. Your work will include:

Designing end‑to‑end architectures for cloud, hybrid and on‑premises environments on Microsoft Azure, including Azure Landing Zones, governance and security models.

Defining and implementing compute environments (autoscaling, load balancing, serverless solutions), Azure database services and CI/CD pipelines, with integration to existing on‑premises services.

Designing cloud‑native networking (VNETs, peering, firewalls, container networking) and security & compliance controls (IAM, resource hierarchy, data security, cost management and billing).

Implementing monitoring, logging, profiling and alerting solutions to ensure reliability and observability of client platforms.

Preparing migration approaches and onboarding plans to Azure, including effort estimation, cost and resource calculations, and optimization scenarios.

Partnering with DevOps and engineering teams to apply Infrastructure as Code and automation practices, improve delivery pipelines and support a mature DevOps culture.

Leading or supporting incident, request, change and problem management activities, acting as a trusted technical advisor for client stakeholders.

Flexible: The work location for this role may include a mix of working remotely, onsite at a client or in an Accenture office - depending on specific project circumstances. With all our roles, there is some in-person time for collaboration, learning and building relationships with clients, peers, leaders, and communities. As an employer, we will be as flexible as possible to support your specific work/life needs.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Join Accenture’s Cloud First team if you are motivated to embrace new opportunities, enthusiastic about professional growth and dedicated to evolving your skills. You will:

Work on large‑scale cloud transformation projects for international enterprise clients, expanding your Azure and architecture skill set.

Shape modern cloud, hybrid and on‑premises platforms using automation, containers and DevOps practices, continuously enhancing your technical expertise.

Collaborate with experienced cloud professionals in a diverse team, gaining insights and feedback that support your continuous learning and development.

HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

5+ years of hands‑on experience in Azure cloud infrastructure engineering.

In‑depth knowledge of Microsoft Azure, supported by advanced/Expert‑level Azure certifications.

Ability to oversee the work of development teams, plan their tasks and translate technical requirements into a structured and actionable backlog.

Experience designing and planning highly available systems, including implementing Disaster Recovery strategies.

Strong understanding of container technologies and orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS).

Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools.

Solid grasp of virtualization technologies.

Comprehensive knowledge of DevOps culture, practices and tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git/GitLab, Pipelines, Helm charts, ArgoCD).

Ability to develop scripts and applications using at least one language (e.g., Bash or Python).

Experience in cost and resource calculations, as well as optimization for cloud environments.

Enterprise architecture experience within public cloud environments, including creating migration plans and managing onboarding processes.

Proficiency in troubleshooting and managing incidents, requests, changes and problems.

Upper‑intermediate level of English and Polish (spoken and written).

Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

Experience with at least one modern programming language (e.g., PowerShell, Azure CLI, Node.js, React, .NET, Python or Java).

Expertise in one or more Azure service categories, such as:

App Services (Web Apps, Mobile Apps, API Apps, Logic Apps).
