jobs.title: System Developer - Portfolio Investments Applications
jobs.description:
Myntro is a company in the middle of a transformation, shifting toward a more product- and technology-driven, data-enabled business. We are looking for a System Developer who wants to join that journey and help build our future. Are you a curious builder who enjoys creating new systems, navigating complexity, and using modern technology to solve real business problems? Then keep reading!

About The Role

As a System Developer at Myntro, you'll join a small DevOps team with end-to-end ownership of applications and systems at the heart of our debt portfolio investment business. Working closely with our investment team, you'll help turn complex portfolio data into reliable systems that support valuation, purchasing decisions, and portfolio management.

Our current focus is building a new investment platform and the services around it. You'll have real opportunities to design and build new capabilities, while also improving and maintaining the existing systems that keep the business running. You'll contribute across the development lifecycle and help shape technical decisions with both immediate and long-term impact.

In this role, you will:

Design, build, and maintain systems, services, and integrations for our debt portfolio investment business.
Develop a new investment platform that supports portfolio valuation, purchasing, and management.
Take ownership from design and implementation through deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.
Build with C#/.NET, SQL, Azure services, and microservice and event-driven architectures.
Improve and simplify existing applications and data flows in a complex technical landscape.
Contribute to architecture, Azure infrastructure, code quality, testing, observability, and how we build.

Who You Are

We are looking for someone who is curious, self-driven, and likes real engineering work. You enjoy understanding both the business problem and how systems actually behave, finding weak points, and making them better. You're comfortable exploring unfamiliar areas and learning what you need to move the work forward.

You take ownership, care about quality, and like building things that hold up in production. You're pragmatic and collaborative, but you don't wait for someone else to define every step. You can move between new development, architecture, infrastructure, data, and existing applications based on what the problem requires.

AI-assisted development isn't new to you; it's already part of how you work. You have your own setup, your own opinions, and you're paying attention to where the craft is heading. That matters here. We're actively building AI into both how we develop and what we deliver, and we need people who are already leaning in, not catching up.

We see that you likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of software development experience, ideally in production-critical environments.
Strong .NET/C# development skills.
Solid understanding of SQL, data modelling, and data flows.
Hands-on experience with Azure, cloud infrastructure, and microservice architectures.
Good communication skills in Swedish and English.

Experience in investment systems, finance, or debt portfolios is not required. What matters is that you're interested in learning the business context and applying your engineering skills to it.

Why join Myntro?

At Myntro, you'll work in a small team with broad ownership and close access to the people who use what you build. The new investment platform is important to how we value, purchase, and manage debt portfolios, and there is still plenty to design, build, and shape.

This is a good place if you are looking for variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to combine software development with architecture, cloud infrastructure, data, and real business problems. You'll be part of a team that's expected to think, build, operate, and improve together.

Our culture is built on care, accountability, and the belief that the best results come from working together. Collaboration, customer focus, personal accountability, and simplicity are how we actually make decisions, not just words on a wall.

Interested? Welcome to apply!

Sounds like your next challenge? We review applications and interview on a rolling basis, so don't wait too long to apply. The role is full-time and based at our head office in central Gothenburg.

For questions regarding the role or recruitment process, please contact Azra Semic, our Talent Acquisition Specialist – azra.semic@myntro.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!

We’re excited to welcome our first Staff Software Engineer to the newly forming Onsite Messaging team at Voyado.

Onsite Messaging (OSM) is one of Voyado’s most important customer engagement channels. Instead of communicating through email or SMS, OSM enables retailers to engage customers directly on their websites with personalized experiences based on real-time behavior. Every interaction can be measured, understood and optimized, making OSM a key part of creating seamless customer journeys.

We’re now bringing OSM onto Voyado’s Engage platform, and this role will play a central part in making that happen. You’ll join at the beginning of that journey, helping shape both the technical direction and the engineering practices while building a brand-new team in Stockholm together with colleagues in India.

About The Role

This is a Staff Engineer role for someone who enjoys leading through technology.

You'll act as the technical driver for Onsite Messaging. The frontend is moving into Voyado's Engage platform, while the backend continues to run and evolve on AWS — so you'll own both sides of that seam and make sure it holds together well. The transition is one chapter, not the job description. Although the role comes with significant technical ownership, it remains deeply hands-on. You’ll write code, review code, challenge architectural decisions and help the team make sound engineering choices every day.

Initially, much of the focus will be understanding the existing solution, reviewing code and working closely with our engineering team in India as knowledge and ownership gradually move to Stockholm. As the transition progresses, your focus will shift towards driving the technical roadmap, enabling new product development and shaping the future Onsite platform.

Modern backend development in C#, .NET (out tech stack), or Comfortable moving between languages; Java, Kotlin, Go or similar
JavaScript and TypeScript, with experience working across both frontend and backend when needed

Distributed systems, scalable web applications and high-traffic products
System design, software architecture and large technical migrations
CI/CD, observability, automated testing and engineering best practices

We also think you:

have successfully led complex technical initiatives or migration projects
enjoy reviewing code and helping other engineers grow
communicate confidently across teams, cultures and technical disciplines
thrive in environments where not everything has been defined yet
enjoy collaborating with distributed engineering teams
use AI coding tools as a natural part of software development and know how to review and quality-assure AI-generated code

High Impact. Great People. Real Growth.

Personal development opportunities

Four days from the office and one day from home

jobs.title: Customer Support Engineer
jobs.description:
Description

Customer Support Engineer – Hybrid – Gothenburg, Sweden

We seek a Customer Support Engineer to join our team at Microdeb in Gothenburg, Sweden!

About The Role

We're looking for a Support Engineer to join our team in Gothenburg. This is not a ticket-shuffling role. You'll be the person customers rely on when something breaks, when a query won't return, when a deployment misbehaves — and you'll have the technical depth to actually fix it, not just escalate it. You'll work across SQL databases, light development tasks, and customer-facing troubleshooting, with modern AI tools as a core part of how you work.

What You'll Do

Own customer issues end-to-end, from first contact through root cause and resolution.

Answer and handle incoming customer support calls as part of the day-to-day role, providing first-line technical assistance, troubleshooting issues, and taking ownership of follow-up through to resolution.

Diagnose and resolve database problems: query performance, indexing, locking, data integrity, backup and recovery.

Write and review SQL — from quick investigative queries to stored procedures and schema changes.

Read, debug, and occasionally patch application code to identify the source of issues.

Reproduce bugs in test environments, file detailed reports for engineering, and follow through. Build internal tools, scripts, and automations that reduce repeat work and speed up diagnosis.

Use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, internal LLM workflows) to accelerate investigation, draft responses, generate queries, and analyze logs.

Improve documentation and runbooks so the next person resolves the same issue faster.

What We're Looking For

Solid hands-on experience as a DBA or in a database-heavy support or engineering role. Strong SQL skills — you can write complex queries, read execution plans, and tune performance without reaching for a tutorial. Working knowledge of at least one general-purpose language (Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, or similar) — enough to read a codebase, debug, and write small fixes or tools. Fluency with AI-assisted workflows: you already use LLMs daily for coding, investigation, and writing, and you have opinions about where they help and where they don't. A bias for action: you'd rather dig in and reproduce the issue than wait for more information. Clear written and verbal communication in Swedish and English — you can explain a technical problem to a non-technical customer and to a senior engineer in the same day. Based in or willing to relocate to Gothenburg.

Nice to have

Experience with cloud databases (Azure SQL, AWS RDS, Snowflake, or similar). Familiarity with observability tools (Datadog, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Exposure to CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code. Swedish language skills are a must for this role.

Why this role

You'll see more of the product, the codebase, and real customer problems than almost any other role. Support engineers here move into platform, backend, or SRE roles when they want to. We invest in AI tooling and expect everyone to use it well — not as a gimmick, but as leverage.

Here is a little window into our company:
Microdeb is a leading provider of integrated payment and order management solutions, helping businesses modernize their payment ecosystems. With years of experience, a dedicated team of experts, and a passion for technology, we continuously innovate to meet the evolving needs of our clients. Microdeb was acquired by Valsoft and now operates under the Aspire Software portfolio. Aspire Software, the operational arm of Valsoft, operates and manages Valsoft’s global portfolio of wholly owned software companies, providing mission-critical solutions across multiple verticals. By implementing industry best practices, Aspire delivers a time-sensitive integration process, and the operation of a decentralized model has allowed it to become a hub for creating rapid growth by reinvesting in its portfolio.

The successful candidate will be based anywhere in Sweden, working in a hybrid work model from our office in Gothenburg!

Required

About You
:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience
2+ years in a technical support, DBA, or software engineering role with direct customer or stakeholder contact
Demonstrable SQL expertise: joins, window functions, CTEs, indexing strategy, query plan analysis, and performance tuning on a major RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Oracle)
Hands-on experience administering databases: backups and restores, user and permission management, monitoring, and incident response
Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar) sufficient to debug application code and write small utilities
Working knowledge of Git and standard development workflows (branches, pull requests, code review)
Experience using AI coding assistants and LLMs as part of a daily workflow — writing prompts that produce useful output, knowing when to verify, knowing when not to use them.
Strong written and spoken English. Eligible to work in Sweden

Preferred

Experience with cloud-hosted databases (Azure SQL, AWS RDS or Aurora, Google Cloud SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery)
Familiarity with Linux command line, shell scripting, and basic networking (DNS, TLS, HTTP, firewalls)
Exposure to containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes). Experience with logging and observability stacks (ELK, Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, OpenTelemetry)
Knowledge of REST APIs and how to debug them (Postman, curl, browser dev tools)
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI)
Prior experience in a SaaS or B2B product environment
Swedish language skills

Personal attributes

Curious by default — you want to know why something broke, not just how to make the symptom go away
Comfortable holding two threads at once: the customer who needs an answer now, and the underlying defect that needs a proper fix
Disciplined writer — your tickets, postmortems, and documentation make life easier for the next person. Direct and honest in communication, internally and with customers
Treats AI tools as leverage, not as a crutch — verifies output, understands the code that gets generated, and improves prompts over time

About The Team

You'll join our Support Engineering team in Gothenburg — a technical group that works at the intersection of engineering and customer success
We're the people the rest of the company turns to when something genuinely hard breaks, and we work closely with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to make sure issues get resolved properly, not just closed
How we work: we treat every incident as a chance to learn, document thoroughly so problems don't cost us twice, pair on hard tickets, and push fixes back into the product rather than working around them
We use AI tools heavily as part of our daily workflow and share what works across the team
You can expect real ownership of problems from first report to root cause, direct access to the engineers who built the system, and room to grow into adjacent technical roles over time
We're not a call centre, and we're not a feature factory — we're a team that takes pride in solving real problems well

For further information about Microdeb
, you can visit our website at https://microdeb.se/en/

We thank all applicants for their interest; however only the candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Are you passionate about making a sustainable impact in the world of electric transport? Do you thrive in an innovative and entrepreneurial environment? Then you might be the new Senior Backend Developer regional assistant to Erinion! 

About Erinion

Erinion designs, builds and operates depot and destination charging solutions for heavy-duty vehicles. As part of Scania and the TRATON Group, we combine the strength of a global transport leader with the agility of a fast-growing company. Our approach focuses on energy efficiency and optimal utilisation, ensuring that electrification is not only sustainable but also financially and commercially viable for our customers. We support different ways of financing, owning and operating charging sites, so that each customer can find the model that best fits their business. With operations across eight European markets and global expansion underway, we enable transport operators to electrify their fleets with confidence and long-term profitability.  

Role Summary

As a Senior Backend Developer, you will play a key role in building and evolving Erinion Connect, our cloud-native Charging Management System (CMS) for smart charging and energy management in commercial transport.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics and Applied AI teams, as well as a strategic technology partner, you will design and deliver scalable backend services, integrations and cloud-native solutions that support Erinion's growth.

We're looking for an experienced engineer who combines strong backend expertise with architectural thinking. AI-assisted development tools are part of our daily workflow, but we value engineers who can independently drive technical decisions and build robust, scalable systems.

This is a backend-first role, with approximately 70% of the work focused on platform and integration engineering
and the flexibility to contribute across the stack when needed.

Job Responsibilities

Build and enhance backend services using Python and Node.js/TypeScript.
Design scalable APIs, integrations, and event-driven architectures.
Develop solutions for smart charging, energy management, and fleet platforms.
Integrate Erinion Connect with TMS, FMS, ERP, and telematics systems.
Contribute to platform architecture and long-term product evolution.
Support React-based frontend development when needed.
Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software delivery.

Who You Are

5+ years of experience in backend software engineering.
Strong experience with Python and/or Node.js (TypeScript).
Experience designing and building cloud-native applications on AWS.
Solid understanding of software architecture, distributed systems and integration patterns.
Experience with PostgreSQL, DynamoDB and cloud storage solutions.
Experience building REST APIs, microservices and event-driven systems.
Ability to make sound technical and architectural decisions independently.
Experience using AI-assisted coding tools in day-to-day development.
Fluent English.

Nice to have

React experience.
Java experience.
Experience with TMS, FMS, ERP or telematics integrations.
Knowledge of OCPP, OCPI or EV charging technologies.
Experience with TimescaleDB.
Startup or scale-up experience.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.

Core Technology Stack

Languages
: Python, Node.js, TypeScript, Java, Frontend
: React

Cloud & Infrastructure:
AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, Step Functions, EventBridge, Cognito, S3), CloudFormation, Docker, GitLab CI

PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, S3, TimescaleDB (nice to have)

Architecture & Integration:
REST APIs, Microservices, Event-driven Architecture, WebSockets

AI Tooling:
Claude Code, Codex, AI-assisted Development

Why join Erinion?

At Erinion, you won't just be a part of the change, you'll pioneer it. 

Impact: Work at the forefront of the green transition in heavy transport 
Culture: Join an early-stage company where your ideas are valued, your contributions have a significant impact, and your decisions directly shape the local market

jobs.title: AI Software Developer i Stockholm
jobs.description:
Vi tror på- och vill förverkliga en AI- och datadriven framtid. Vi söker AI Software Developers som vill vara med och hjälpa våra kunder inom olika branscher att omvandla AI-experiment till skalbara, säkra och värdeskapande lösningar.

Hos oss blir du del av ett växande område med runt 20 konsulter inom Cloud, AI och systemutveckling. Samtidigt får du kollegor från hela Solita med expertis i allt från data, strategi och mycket mer att dela kunskap och perspektiv med, läs mer om det här.

När vi växer gör dina möjligheter också det, du får vara med och påverka kulturen, affären och din roll.

En dag på Solita

En dag på Solita kan börja med ett standup-möte med ditt team på kunduppdraget, ibland består det av fler kollegor från Solita. Är det fredag kanske du jobbar från Solitas kontor i Stockholm för att starta dagen med frukost. Andra dagar jobbar du från kundens kontor eller hemifrån.

Sen kliver du in i ditt arbete: när du stöter på ett problem söker du upp en lång diskussionstråd i slack med insikter från kollegor som haft samma problem. Andra gånger passar du på att fråga en kollega vid kaffemaskinen om deras perspektiv för att komma vidare. Du kan också delta i våra interna utbildningsmöten, där vi delar kunskap om allt från nya teknologier och arbetssätt till välmående. Vissa dagar avslutar du med AW, filmkväll, brädspel eller annan aktivitet du och kollegor tycker är kul.

Din roll som AI Software Developer

Du är med i hela utvecklingscykeln, inte sällan från tidigt pre-sales stadie eller i förstudier, för att utveckla, driftsätta och optimera agent-baserade och datadrivna system som hjälper kunder fatta bättre beslut eller automatisera processer på ett intelligent sätt. Exempelvis kan du arbeta med prompt optimering, designa och implementera RAG-arkitektur, utveckla AI-agenter, MCP-servrar, APIer och backend lösningar för att integrera befintliga system till LLM-tjänster. Läs mer om att jobba med AI på Solita här.

Utöver moderna systemutveckling-tekniker kommer du arbeta med diverse AI-verktyg och ramverk som exempelvis LangChain, Tensorflow, AI Foundry och Semantic Kernel för att nämna några. Då vi jobbar teknikagnostiskt får du stor frihet att forma teknikval och arkitektur för att möta affärsbehov. Läs mer om hur kollegor jobbar och diskuterar kring olika teknikval i vår Dev blog här.

Känner du igen dig i följande?

Du kan kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är ett plus om du varit konsult tidigare men det huvudsakliga är din förmåga att snabbt komma in i nya sammanhang och lära dig. Du är trygg i rollen tack vare din erfarenhet av både systemutveckling (särskilt om du jobbat i C# .NET eller Java Spring Boot) samt:

RAG- eller AI-agentarkitektur
Att bygga AI-drivna applikationer med moderna ramverk som ex. Semantic Kernel, LangChain eller liknande.
Att implementera molnbaserade AI-tjänster och produktionssätta AI-lösningar med hjälp av DevSecOps och IaC.

Vi letar inte bara efter tekniska skills, vi vill jobba med dig som tar ansvar för att bygga rätt lösningar på rätt sätt genom att utmana med omtanke. Du ser kod som ett hantverk, inte bara ett medel till funktion: du bryr dig om kvalitet, läsbarhet och hållbarhet. Du kommer trivas hos oss om du tycker om att dela med dig av din kunskap lika mycket som du är nyfiken på- och lyfter andras. .

Vad vi erbjuder

Vår företagskultur är väldigt viktig för oss. Vi värdesätter låg hierarki, självständighet och ansvar, värdeskapande arbete och trevliga kollegor. Här kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, och här kan du bläddra bland våra tech-bloggar.
Meningsfulla projekt: Arbeta i en agil miljö där du kan påverka teknikval och arbetssätt för att skapa de bästa lösningarna
Flexibilitet och autonomi för att utforma ditt arbete med flextider– läs mer från vår blogg.
Ständig utveckling: Vi erbjuder kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling för att säkerställa att våra medarbetare ligger längst fram i teknikutvecklingen.
Innovativ kultur: Arbeta tillsammans med några av de främsta experterna inom data, analys och utveckling

Utöver detta får du även ta del av följande förmåner:

💰 Fast lön oberoende av beläggningsgrad med möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande
🏦 Pensionsavsättning i linje med ITP1 samt möjlighet till löneväxling till ditt pensionssparande vid inkomst över 8,07 inkomstbasbelopp
🏖️ 30 semesterdagar
😃 Sjukvårdsförsäkring för både din mentala och fysiska hälsa som täcker dig även utanför tjänstetid
🏋️ ♀️ Friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr via Benifex (tidigare Benify).
💻 Ett brett nätverk av erfarna specialister från olika områden inom tech att samarbeta med
🔗 Intern coach för att stödja ditt välbefinnande
🪩 After Work och hobbyaktiviteter
🥐 Fredagsfrukostar

Vilka är vi?

Solita är ett värderingsstyrt konsultbolag med över 2000 medarbetare i 9 länder, varav ca 230 i Sverige. Vår storlek gör oss tillräckligt stora för att vara en stabil och innovativ arbetsgivare, men samtidigt tillräckligt små för att värna om våra medarbetare och kunder. Med bred kompetens inom digital transformation erbjuder vi en dynamisk arbetsmiljö. Hos oss får du friheten att utvecklas, både professionellt och personligt.

Intresserad av att höra mer?

Låter det som en spännande möjlighet? Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team som ligger i framkant av AI-utveckling!
Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team som ligger i framkant inom AI-utveckling. Om du har några frågor, skriv gärna till Jacob Beck på LinkedIn eller mailadressen jacob.beck@solita.se.

Hur ser processen ut?

I rekryteringsprocessen tror vi på en snabb och effektiv process. Du ansöker med CV eller LinkedIn och svarar på några korta frågor. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Om vi ser en potentiell matchning, bjuder vi in dig till ett första möte för att lära känna dig och berätta mer om vår kultur och våra värderingar på Solita. I andra intervjun fokuserar vi på din tekniska kompetens och din erfarenhet. Om allt går bra tar vi oss vidare till sista steget där vi presenterar ett erbjudande och välkomnar dig som ny Solitan!

Placeringsort för denna roll är i Stockholm, Sverige

Are you excited by the prospect of solving some of the hardest and most valued technical challenges of cloud computing? Do you want to apply your deep analytical and engineering skills to the space of highly-available replicated databases? Come join us in Amazon RDS and help us innovate!

The AWS Relational Database Service (RDS) is one of the largest cloud database businesses, providing super-simple provisioning and management for databases in the cloud. Customers can set up a new database with just a few clicks, and complex administrative tasks like scaling, fail-over, and monitoring are handled in an automated fashion by our control systems. Providing such simplified management for customers comes with the challenge of building sophisticated and reliable control systems. The systems we build manage huge numbers of databases and vast amounts of storage across multiple datacenters world-wide, and our service is growing rapidly, requiring constant innovations in our systems in order to handle the next order of magnitude in service scale.

We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer to join us and take ownership of significant features and components end-to-end. You’ll work on distributed systems that operate at scale across every AWS region from Active Directory and Kerberos authentication improvements, to third-party integrations, to tooling that helps customers manage their workload in our managed service. AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

The Opportunity

At Easee, we're building technology that makes electrification effortless. Our products are used across Europe, and our success depends on attracting people who share our ambition, curiosity, and commitment to great results.

As our Software Engineer, you'll help build, test, and maintain the RESTful APIs and microservices that power Easee's platform. You'll write clean, well-tested code while working closely with senior engineers on backend architecture. This is a role designed for someone with solid backend foundations who is ready to take ownership of real services in a supportive, collaborative environment.

Working alongside the API team, Frontend Engineers, the Platform team, and Product Support, you will help make sure our services are reliable, well-tested, and built to scale.

What's In It For You

A collaborative environment with experienced senior engineers for code reviews, architectural discussions, and technical sparring
High ownership over feature design and implementation, backed by strong team support when you need it
Opportunities to design end-to-end systems independently, particularly in the EV charger domain
A clear path from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer as you grow

Core Outcomes

Short-term

You have completed onboarding, set up your local development environment, and have a clear understanding of our core API codebases.
You have shipped early bug fixes and feature enhancements to production, building familiarity with our system architecture and review practices.
You have integrated smoothly into the API team's daily workflows, code review practices, and sprint cadence.

Long-term

You have full autonomy in designing and deploying end-to-end API features.
You have a deep understanding of our core system architecture and data flows.
You actively contribute ideas that improve our test and development workflows.

What You Need To Bring Along

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant hands-on experience can compensate for formal education.
2–4 years of professional backend development experience in a production environment.
Proven experience building, testing, and maintaining RESTful APIs or microservices.
Core programming skills in at least one backend language (e.g., .Net and C# (what we use), Java, or Go).
A solid understanding of REST principles, HTTP, and relational or NoSQL databases.
Familiarity with Git, Docker, automated testing frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines.

Interview Process

(30m) Recruiter Screen
(30m) Hiring Manager Screen
(90m) Hands-On Challenge and Technical Deep Dive

We request two professional references in our final round. We may conduct background checks if necessary.

Who we are

Easee is a Norwegian technology company with a clear purpose: Effortless Electrification for All.

We develop smart charging and energy solutions designed to make access to electrification simpler, smarter, and more scalable.

Our Culture Is Built Around Three Values

Dare:
We challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

Care:
We support each other, our partners, and our customers.

Deliver:
We take ownership and follow through on our commitments.

We believe great results come from ambitious people who care about each other, challenge the status quo, and take ownership.

What We Offer

A key role in developing Easee's next-generation EV chargers
The chance to work alongside some of the experts behind one of the world's best-selling EV chargers
Collaboration with skilled colleagues across hardware, software, and product
A part in Easee's international expansion into new markets
A modern company culture that values innovation, people, and fun
Competitive salary and benefits package

jobs.title: AI Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
We at Solita have helped leading Nordic companies turn early AI experiments into scalable, secure, and value-driven AI programs. With hundreds of projects and 2,000+ experts in the areas of software development, data, AI, cloud and design, we bridge the gap between ideas and impact. Join us to build tomorrow’s technical solutions!

Currently, we’re on a mission to build intelligent systems for our customers that unlock and harness the value of data and AI. Also, AI is transforming how we build software: automating routine work, amplifying creativity, and letting developers focus on solving real problems.

We are now looking for AI Full-Stack Developers
to join our growing community of experts and help shape the future of intelligent software. In this role, you can work in the Helsinki, Lahti, Oulu, Tampere, or Turku regions with hybrid working options.

At Solita, you’ll find a community that values both technical excellence and human connection. We believe in autonomy, continuous learning, and building together things that matter. You’ll have the chance to work on impactful projects with meaningful use of AI, collaborate with top experts across data, cloud, and design.

Read more of our thoughts on AI from our website, and get to know our very own LLM platform FunctionAI that our experts use in project deliveries.

Your role in a nutshell

As an AI Developer, you get to develop various agent-based and data-driven software solutions that have a real impact on our customers in various industries, both in private and public sectors. In addition to utilizing modern software development toolkits in your daily work, you will be working hands-on with various AI tools and frameworks, such as AWS Bedrock, Google AI, LangChain, MCP or AI Foundry to build secure, scalable and maintanable AI-powered software solutions that help our customers make better decisions, automate intelligently, and create real business value. You’ll work closely with a team of other software developers, AI/Data Scientists and Engineers, participating in the entire software development cycle.

We are a technology-agnostic company, always choosing the modern frameworks and platforms that best support the customer’s needs. The diversity of our projects offers excellent opportunities for learning, skill development, and rotation. You can find more information about our work on our Dev blog and in the results of our Developer Survey.

Here’s how our developer Miska describes his experience working on AI-based projects:
“I’ve had the opportunity to work on two AI-based projects at Solita and have been involved in both design and implementation. In both projects, it became clear that truly leveraging AI requires a pragmatic approach, continuous measurement, and above all, a deep understanding of the problem being solved. During the projects, I’ve worked with tools such as Cursor, LangGraph, Copilot, Claude, and ChatGPT. Developing AI solutions has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my career: it’s rare to work on something that simultaneously feels like exploring something entirely new and building the future.”

Read more of our developers’ thoughts on ‘How AI is reshaping software projects’ from our website, and get to know our very own LLM platform FunctionAI that our experts use in project deliveries.

What we are looking for

We hope you share our passion for writing high-quality code and collaborating in cross-functional teams. You don’t need to have worked under the title “AI Developer” before: what matters most is your curiosity towards AI, strong technical skills, and the ability to bridge software development and AI in your daily work.

We Expect You To Have

A strong background in software development: at least 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software development using Java, TypeScript, C# or Python.
Experience using agentic coding assistants as part of your daily work (like Github Copilot or Claude Code)
An understanding of AI agent architectures and modern AI frameworks (e.g. AWS Bedrock, Google AI, LangChain, MCP, or AI Foundry) is considered an advantage.
Experience with cloud-based AI services (AWS or Azure) and bringing AI solutions into production using DevOps and IaC practices is considered an advantage.
Fluent English language skills. fluent Finnish skills are considered as an advantage.
Strong problem-solving skills and a consultative mindset.

Why Solita is a great place to work

An expert community: Join our Dev community of over 400 top-tier software professionals in Finland. You’ll also get to collaborate with colleagues across our organization with other +2,000 Solitans.
Rotations and growth: At Solita, your career path doesn’t have to be linear. Many of our people have explored different roles and projects within the company, supported by our internal rotation opportunities, mentoring, and the Solita Growth Academy.
Freedom and flexibility: We know there is more to life than work. That is why we value flexibility and support a healthy work–life balance through trust, autonomy, and a culture that puts people first.
People first: Your wellbeing matters to us as much as your skills. We offer flexible ways of working, comprehensive employee benefits, and dedicated People Leads who provide support in all kinds of everyday situations.
Benefits for every need: Pick the devices that suit you best, enjoy extensive occupational healthcare, relax with regular massages, work with our in-house coaches, or recharge through our hobby clubs and community activities.
Fair and transparent pay: We believe great teamwork happens when there’s no pressure from billing-based salary models: that is why we offer a fixed monthly salary and encourage collaboration and shared success.

Got interested?

Let’s find out together if this could be the next step in your career at Solita! Please send us your CV, or link to your LinkedIn profile.

Our recruitment consists of two rounds of interviews where you will meet our team and learn more about working at Solita. You will be given the opportunity to show your skills and ask us questions. The purpose is to get to know each other better.

Any thoughts or questions, please reach out to our recruiter Neea Turunen / neea.turunen@solita.fi

As a key technology, data, and design partner, Solita’s business is built on trust and responsibility. For this reason, the selected candidate’s identity and employment background will be verified. These checks are carried out in accordance with and within the limits of the Act on the Protection of Privacy in Working Life. In addition, some of our customers may carry out a separate security clearance vetting made by the Finnish Security and Intelligence Service, for example in case you start working for a customer operating in critical infrastructure sector.

Are you a subject-matter-oriented Solution Architect ready to shape digital transformation in complex environments? Do you enjoy tackling business challenges in an international setting and collaborating closely with customers and fellow experts? Then this role might be just right for you.

Nortal is currently looking for a Solution Architect to join impactful projects with our enterprise customers. In this role, you will collaborate closely with both our customers and internal development teams, focusing on understanding business needs through active stakeholder discussions and shaping them into high-value solution opportunities. You play a key role in engaging with stakeholders, gathering and refining requirements, demonstrating solutions, and proactively identifying how we can best support business goals.

What you will do

Support customers in their digital transformation across areas such as data modelling and architecture, system integrations, platform modernization, and AI-driven solutions.
Engage in regular discussions with stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.
Translate high-level architectural directions into concrete guidance for development teams.
Own and prioritize the backlog, ensuring alignment between business value and technical feasibility.
Produce documentation, technical diagrams, architectural notes, and decision records.
Work closely with developers to clarify technical implications, even if you don’t write code yourself.
Collaborate closely with Nortal colleagues, including development, project management, and data/architecture experts.

Our tech environment
In this role you don’t need to program hands-on, but a background in software engineering is essential. Technologies in use include Azure (Azure SQL, Functions, Data Lake, Container Apps etc.), MS Fabric, C#, React, and API management.

What will help you to succeed

Ability to understand business needs and ways of working, enabling smooth collaboration.
Solid technical understanding and ability to discuss architectural-level topics such as software and data architectures, integrations, and AI.
A background in software development (hands-on coding experience at some stage).
Ownership mindset and ability to drive initiatives forward.
Consultant-like approach: proactive, solution-oriented, comfortable in the client interface, willingness to ask questions.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English.

If you’re not yet familiar with Nortal, we are a global leader in strategic change and technology. Our 2,500+ employees worldwide share the vision of creating a better future through seamless digital transformation, and we're constantly on the lookout for new talents to join us on this journey. We maintain offices in Helsinki, Oulu, Turku, Jyväskylä, and Uusikaupunki. Why join us?

You’ll play a central role in driving digital transformation for our customers. You’ll gain broad visibility into complex ecosystems—and real ownership of key areas. You’ll work closely with a friendly and experienced team.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

What You Can Expect

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Cloud Engineer to support the provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure within our Microsoft Azure environment. In this hands-on role, you will work alongside experienced engineers to automate deployments, manage containerized workloads, and contribute to secure, scalable, and efficient cloud operations. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically curious individual eager to build a career in cloud engineering.

How You'll Create Impact

Provision, configure, and maintain Azure cloud resources across development, QA, staging, and production environments.
Implement and maintain infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Bicep and ARM templates, following established standards and approval processes.
Monitor cloud environments for performance, availability, cost optimization, and application health using Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure Application Insights.
Assist in analyzing logs, metrics, traces, and alerts to support incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
Participate in day-to-day cloud operations including incident response, change management, access reviews, and cloud resource tagging.
Deploy, operate, and support containerized applications on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with an emphasis on secure-by-default and safety-focused configurations.
Support AKS safety and security features including:
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and least-privilege access
Network policies and private cluster configurations
Pod and container security best practices
Cluster and workload observability using logs, metrics, and alerts
Patch management and Kubernetes version upgrades under guidance

Perform scaling, health monitoring, and basic troubleshooting of Kubernetes workloads using kubectl, Helm, and Azure CLI.
Contribute to CI/CD workflows and deployment automation in collaboration with developers using GitHub Actions, with attention to deployment safety, validation, and rollback strategies.
Create and maintain documentation for cloud infrastructure, deployment processes, observability standards, security controls, and operational procedures.
Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, retrospectives, and internal knowledge-sharing sessions.

Your Background

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and core services such as Virtual Machines, App Services, Storage, Networking, and identity services.
Practical understanding of Kubernetes fundamentals (pods, deployments, services, namespaces) and container orchestration concepts.
Experience using Docker and container deployment tools such as Helm.
Familiarity with application monitoring and observability tools, including Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Azure Application Insights.
Experience with scripting or automation using PowerShell, Bash, or programming languages such as Python or C#.
Understanding of cloud security fundamentals including RBAC, identity management, network segmentation, and least-privilege principles.
Ability to follow defined processes and controls while progressively taking ownership of assigned systems and tasks.
Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented mindset.

Travel Expectations

Occasional overnight travel as necessary.

This is a full-time position and it may reasonably require additional hours during the week and weekend; specific requirements will be determined with Manager.

We're starting with insurance, because we think it's one of the clearest places to prove that financial services can be done differently, and better. Insurance is our starting point, not our end goal.

Why us Vahva is a Finnish fintech company built to put customers first, starting with how insurance works. We see insurance as a modern financial product, not a legacy category to maintain. Insurance and cashback are the beginning of a long, healthy customer relationship, one we build our wider portfolio of products around.
We're a seed-stage company, which means your voice shapes where we go next. You'll have real influence over decisions and over our customers' lives. We're building the founding team now. Join us.

What you'll do Build Vahva's consumer platform from the ground up, working side by side with the founder. You are the founding engineer in a growth-stage company bringing a new kind of insurance concept to market, first in Finland under the Vahva brand.
Ship product end-to-end: design, implement, deploy, and operate the services behind our cashback and insurance products (vahva.fi), which reward customers with real money for claim-free months, and the car-insurance products the platform grows into.
Shape the architecture of a platform that has to be reliable, secure, and scalable in a regulated industry, and ready to expand from Finland to the Nordics and beyond.
Take AI-first engineering from idea to practice: build AI into the platform and into how we work, from the ground up rather than bolted on afterward.
Set the engineering culture and lay the foundations the future team will build on: how we build, test, ship, and run software.
Work openly and close to our earliest users, who help develop the service with us; what they experience each month is the direct result of what you ship.

What we look for A senior product engineer who has built and run production systems end-to-end and is comfortable being the one who makes it work, from API design through distributed and event-driven architectures to operating enterprise-grade, cloud-native systems in production.

The foundations that let a small team ship fast and safely: infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and automated deployments, and a working command of observability, security engineering, and cloud governance.

Care for the trust our product runs on: money, insurance, and personal data demand security and correctness. Experience with fintech or other regulated domains is a clear advantage.
Fluent English; Finnish is a strong plus in a product built first for the Finnish market.

TypeScript
Node.js
React
PostgreSQL
Building cloud-based B2C products
AI engineering, applied from the ground up

jobs.title: AI Architect
jobs.description:
We are currently looking for an AI Architect to join our AI, Analytics & Agents business area in Finland.

At Solita AI, Analytics & Agents community, we support our customers throughout their entire AI journey, from early ideation to scaling AI adoption across the whole organization. We believe that impactful AI solutions are created through multidisciplinary collaboration, combining business and process expertise, cutting-edge technology & AI expertise, and human-centered design. Generative AI and the application of large language models are an increasingly important part of our solutions.

We take a holistic approach to our customers’ challenges and help them build sustainable, production-ready AI solutions that deliver value in real use cases.

Your role in a nutshell

As an AI Architect, you take lead responsibility for designing, developing, and driving production‑grade AI solutions for our customers. You combine hands‑on architectural work with project‑level technical leadership, acting as both the solution architect and a senior technical contributor.

In this role, you own the overall AI solution architecture: mapping the current state of data, analytics and AI capabilities, defining future target architectures, identifying opportunities, and creating concrete, actionable roadmaps. You will be involved in all phases of the project, from ideation, and solution design to production deployment, and continuous development.

Your work places a strong emphasis on LLM-based and generative AI solutions that are embedded into real business processes. You ensure that AI solutions are designed as part of a broader IT and enterprise architecture with clear attention to security, scalability, reliability and responsible AI.

You lead AI architecture work in large projects and across teams, collaborating closely with Data Scientists, AI/ML Engineers, Cloud Architects, data specialists and business stakeholders. While you are expected to be hands-on when needed, your key responsibility is to own the overall AI solution architecture, make critical technical decisions, and ensure high‑quality outcomes.

In addition, you contribute to Solita’s technical leadership in applied AI by shaping best practices, supporting pre‑sales and solution planning, mentoring colleagues, and influencing how production‑grade AI is delivered across customer projects.

We will discuss the exact scope and focus of your role based on your experience, skills, and interests. Depending on your level of experience and responsibility, your monthly salary will range from 5800 € to 7200 €.

In practice your work includes:

Taking technical lead responsibility in AI projects, acting as a hands‑on AI Architect and guiding the overall solution from concept and implementation to production.
Working closely with customers in a consultative role, translating business needs and constraints into concrete technical designs and implementation plans.
Designing and developing LLM‑based and generative AI solutions, such as knowledge and information retrieval systems, agent‑based workflows, systems that increase the level of automation in (customer) service processes and document processing solutions.
Defining end‑to‑end AI system designs, including data flows, model orchestration, system integrations, evaluation, guardrails, and human‑AI interaction.
Designing cloud‑based AI and LLM platforms, primarily on Azure, leveraging services such as Azure AI / ML, Databricks, and cloud‑native infrastructure.
Leading architectural decisions related to scalability, security, cost efficiency, reliability, and responsible AI, in alignment with broader IT and enterprise architecture.
Participating in pre‑sales and early project phases, supporting solution scoping, technical proposals, and architecture planning in collaboration with sales.

What helps you succeed in this role

Proven experience in designing and implementing AI/ML solutions in production environments, especially with generative AI and LLM technologies.
Solid experience in mapping out architecture-level AI solutions for both business decision-makers and the implementing experts in an understandable way.
You understand deeply the logic and practicalities related to AI solutions, and non-deterministic solutions in general, and their successful development.
Hands-on experience as an AI Architect, ML Architect, Lead AI/ML Engineer or similar role, with clear responsibility for architectural decisions.
Experience with generative AI and agent architectures, including LLM technologies (e.g. Azure OpenAI / Foundry, Databricks Agent Bricks, LangChain, Semantic Kernel), RAG methods, and multi-agent solutions.
Experience in production deployment and solution operations using technologies such as Azure AI/ML Services, Databricks, MLOps/LLMOps, evaluation and guardrail tools.
Architectural and hands-on experience with cloud-based AI platforms (Azure, AWS), including building cloud infrastructure using IaC tools.
Programming skills, especially with Python but other languages such as Java or C# are also beneficial.
Ability to act as a trusted consultant, guiding and challenging our customers and collaborating effectively with teams.
Passion for solving customer needs and exploring the latest AI technologies and methods (e.g. multi-agent architectures and collaboration mechanisms, self-optimizing AI agents, agent skills, advanced knowledge and memory management solutions, etc.)
Fluent working proficiency in English.

jobs.description:
Solitan Data Science, Machine Learning & AI -yhteisössä tuemme asiakkaitamme koko tekoälymatkan läpi – ideoinnin alusta aina tekoälyn hyödyntämisen skaalaamiseen koko organisaatiossa. Uskomme, että vaikuttavat tekoälyratkaisut syntyvät monialaisessa yhteistyössä – yhdistäen liiketoiminta- ja prosessiosaamisen, huipputeknologian sekä ihmislähtöisen suunnittelun. Erityisesti generatiivinen tekoäly (GenAI) ja suurten kielimallien (LLM) soveltaminen ovat kokoajan kasvava osa ratkaisujamme.

Otamme kokonaisvaltaisen näkökulman asiakkaidemme haasteisiin ja autamme heitä rakentamaan kestäviä, tuotantokelpoisia AI-ratkaisuja, jotka tuottavat arvoa oikeissa käyttökohteissa.

Työsi pähkinänkuoressa

AI / ML Engineerin roolissa suunnittelet ja toteutat älykkäitä ratkaisuja hyödyntäen generatiivista tekoälyä, agenttipohjaisia arkkitehtuureja ja uusimpia menetelmiä. Työ sisältää muun muassa LLM-teknologioiden hyödyntämisen, agenttien suunnittelun, monimutkaistenkin työprosessien tehostamisen sekä ihmisen ja tekoälyn yhteistyön kehittämisen käytännön asiakasratkaisuissa. Olet mukana projektin kaikissa vaiheissa: ideoinnista, datan tutkimisesta ja ratkaisumallien kehittämisestä aina tuotantoon vientiin ja jatkokehitykseen.

Työsi pitää sisällään muun muassa

AI-ratkaisujen suunnittelua ja toteuttamista asiakkaille – esimerkiksi asiakaspalveluprosessin tehostamista, tiedonhakuavustajia tai dokumenttiprosessien tehostamista LLM-teknologialla
Pilvipohjaisten LLM- ja koneoppimisalustojen rakentamista ja mallien käyttöönottoa julkipilvialustoilla, kuten Azure, AWS tai GCP
MLOpsin ja CI/CD-putkien suunnittelua ja toteutusta
Konsultointia ja teknistä sparrailua asiakkaiden kanssa – usein lähellä liiketoimintaa ja päätöksentekoa

Työskentelet osana kokeneiden AI/ML-arkkitehtien, datakonsulttien ja ohjelmistokehittäjien muodostamaa tiimiä. Ratkaisut rakennetaan yhteistyössä, mutta roolissasi pääset ottamaan vastuuta ja vaikuttamaan kokonaisuuteen alusta asti.

Keskustelemme kanssasi roolin tarkemmasta vastuusta ja painotuksista aiemman kokemuksesi, osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi perusteella. Riippuen lopullisen roolisi kokemus- ja vastuutasosta, kuukausipalkkasi on noin 4300–5800 euroa.

Toivomme sinulta:

Käytännön kokemusta AI/ML-ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta tuotantoympäristöissä – erityisesti generatiivisen tekoälyn ja LLM-teknologian parista
Generatiivinen tekoäly ja agenttiarkkitehtuurit: LLM-teknologiat (esim. Azure OpenAI / Foundry, Databricks Agent Bricks, LangChain, Semantic Kernel), RAG-menetelmät ja multi-agent -ratkaisut)
Kokemusta pilvipalveluista (Azure / AWS / GCP) ja pilvi-infrastruktuurin rakentamisesta ML-tarpeisiin IaC-työkaluilla
Kokemusta tuotantoon viennistä ja ratkaisujen hallinnasta mm. seuraavilla teknologioilla: Azure AI/ML Services, Databricks, MLOps/LLMOps, evaluointi- ja guardrail-työkalut.
Ohjelmointiosaamista, erityisesti Python – mutta myös esimerkiksi Java- tai C#-tausta tukee tehtävässä
Kokemusta CI/CD-prosesseista ja DevOps-työskentelystä
Intohimoa asiakkaiden tarpeiden ratkaisuun ja uusimpien teknologioiden tai menetelmien tutkimiseen (esim. Multi-agent -arkkitehtuurit ja yhteistyömekanismit, itseoptimoivat AI-agentit, AI-agenttien taidot, kehittyneet tiedon- ja muistinhallintaratkaisut, jne.)
Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Lisäksi arvostamme:

Kykyä työskennellä asiakasrajapinnassa, kiteyttää liiketoiminnan tarpeita ja muotoilla niihin sopivia teknisiä ratkaisuja
Kokemusta konsultatiivisesta työotteesta – kykyä kuunnella, keskustella, sparrata ja muodostaa ratkaisuehdotuksia

Näin me pidämme sinusta huolta:

Arvomme ovat välittäminen, rentous, rohkeus ja intohimo. Työntekijämme ovat valinneet ne itse, ja ehkäpä juuri siksi arvoihin perustuva toiminta näkyy ja tuntuu joka päivä. Tässä on muutamia esimerkkejä:

Välittäminen:
Kulttuurimme on luotu niin, että vaikeissa tilanteissa saat helposti tukea koko työyhteisöltä, et vain omalta projektiryhmältäsi.
Rentous:
Vaikka olemme jo melko suuri yritys, ilmapiiri on kodikas ja rento ja hierarkia on matala.
Rohkeus:
Rakennamme aitoja kumppanuuksia asiakkaidemme kanssa. Tämä vaatii joskus rohkeutta olla eri mieltä asiakkaan kanssa ja sanoa se myös ääneen.
Intohimo:
Solitalla työtä tehdään suurella intohimolla, mutta samalla pidetään hauskaa. Olemme ylpeitä työmme laadusta.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Plenty of developers have tried an AI agent. Fewer have run several in parallel, built their own tooling to keep them on track, and worked out exactly where they shine and where they still fall over. If you are on top of these things and want to contribute to the build-up of an agentic software organization, we should talk.

Getinge is looking for Senior .NET Developers in Copenhagen. You will be building software that hospitals around the world depend on every day, and you will be helping shape how a large software organization adopts AI. We have several positions open.

What You Would Be Building

Getinge is a global MedTech company, and our teams in Copenhagen, Hamburg and Aarhus build software that runs at the heart of a modern hospital. Our solutions track surgical instruments through sterile reprocessing with full traceability, orchestrate fleets of robots and reprocessing equipment, plan and optimize the surgical day, coordinate patient flow and staff in real time, and keep thousands of connected medical devices running in the field.

Our software is mission-critical, deeply integrated with hospital IT and physical equipment, and built to a high standard of quality. It is also software where the impact is immediate and real: better use of an operating room, an instrument set that arrives on time, a surgery that goes ahead instead of being cancelled. Not everyone gets to end the week knowing their work helped someone get treated.

What We Work With

Our teams work primarily in C#/.Net &Blazor, with focus on containerization and cloud deployment to Azure, across the organization that spans web and mobile applications, cloud services, real-time systems, and integration with physical equipment.

We are not looking for a checklist match for all of it. What matters is that you are strong in .NET, that you are comfortable working across a stack rather than in one corner of it, and that you pick new things up quickly. The exact mix varies by team, and we will find the right fit together.

Where we are with AI

We are currently in the process of accelerating our software factory with AI. Our teams have been exploring AI-assisted and agentic development processes for some time and are implementing our learnings. However, we are seeking additional fresh perspectives on the matter. This is where you come in.

If you have real experience here and strong opinions about what works, you will find both room to use them and colleagues who will argue back.

Our developers have access to the latest models and a meaningful budget for AI tooling and usage, and we are also looking at introducing new and improved methods and tools to improve our way of working.

What You Will Do

Design, build, and maintain robust .NET services and applications for mission-critical hospital software.
Build and integrate agentic AI capabilities – designing, orchestrating, and evaluating AI agents and LLM-driven workflows in our products and in how we work.
Drive AI adoption in your team and across the organization, setting the standard for how modern tooling improves quality, speed, and value delivered.
Contribute to system architecture, code quality, and engineering practices.
Work closely with product owners, architects, UX/UI, and developers across multiple sites.

You will bring

Strong .NET expertise – deep, hands-on experience building and maintaining production software in C# and modern .NET.
Breadth and adaptability – you are happy to work across the stack and into the cloud, and you are not thrown by a technology you have not used before.
Real depth with AI in practice – you use AI tools in your daily work, you are hands-on with agents and LLM-driven workflows, and you can point to things you have actually built with them. We care more about what you have done and how you think about it than about years on a CV.
A proactive, positive, and constructive mindset – you take ownership from start to finish, communicate openly, and make the people around you better.
The ability to build maintainable, high-quality solutions and to work independently as well as in a team.

Nice to have

Experience with hardware–software integration, robotics, or embedded systems.
Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging, or distributed systems.
Experience working in Agile teams on regulated or safety-critical products.

What We Offer

Getinge is a leading global provider of products and systems that improve healthcare quality and efficiency, with the ambition to be the most desired MedTech company in the world. You would join our Digital Health Solutions department, which counts around 165 people across Denmark, Germany, and the UK, plus a further 100 colleagues in Getinge offices globally.

A smart working environment with shared desks, several work-from-home days per week, and a budget for your home office setup.
Flexible working hours.
Competitive benefits including health insurance and pension.
Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning.
A collaborative, inclusive, and motivating culture.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continually, and we therefore recommend sending us your application as soon as possible, but no later than 17-10-2026

We kindly ask you to submit your application in our recruitment system by clicking the “apply now” button. Due to GDPR regulations we do not accept applications via e-mail.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Joakim Martinsson at joakim.martinsson@getinge.com

We look forward to receiving your application. We hope you will join us on our journey to become the world’s most desired MedTech company.

About Us 

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

jobs.location: Copenhagen Municipality, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Start your software development career building real products used by professionals around the world.

Are you about to finish – or have you recently finished – your Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or a related field?

At Dalux, you will join a product team where you can develop your technical skills while taking real responsibility from the the outset. You will work alongside experienced developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers to build software used across the global construction industry.

Your role

As a Full-Stack Software Developer, you will work across our technology stack and take part in developing features end-to-end – from understanding the problem and designing a solution to implementation and delivery.

You will not be expected to know everything when you join.

Instead, we expect you to be curious, willing to learn, and ready to take increasing ownership as your skills develop. You will have experienced colleagues around you for daily technical sparring, code reviews, and support.

Your work will include:

Designing and developing new product functionality
Working across both front-end and back-end technologies
Collaborating with developers, Product Managers, and Product Designers
Writing maintainable, reliable, and high-quality software
Learning our products, architecture, and engineering practices
Taking increasing ownership of features and technical decisions as you develop
Contributing ideas for how we can improve our products and the way we build them

Developing software with AI

AI-assisted development is becoming an increasingly important part of how we build software at Dalux.

We are actively exploring how AI can help developers understand code, explore solutions, implement and refactor functionality, create tests, debug problems, and automate repetitive work.

You do not need to be an AI expert. But we are looking for developers who are curious about these tools, willing to experiment, and able to think critically about when AI improves a solution – and when it does not.

If you have already experimented with AI-assisted development through your studies, student job, personal projects, or other work, we would be interested to hear what you learned.

Technologies we work with

Our main full-stack technologies include:

C# / .NET
Angular / TypeScript
GitHub CoPilot
MSSQL
Elasticsearch
Optionally, Android / iOS development using .NET MAUI

You are not expected to know our entire stack when you join. Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn are more important.

Product development at Dalux

Our developers do more than implement specifications.

You will work in a product team together with a Product Manager and Product Designer, combining different perspectives on user value, usability, technical feasibility, and business viability.

This means understanding why we build something, contributing to how we solve the problem, and seeing your work become part of a product used by professionals worldwide.

We work according to agile principles and maintain a strong focus on quality, stability, and long-term maintainability.

Your background

We expect that you:

Have, or are about to complete, a Master's degree in Software Development, Computer Science, or a similar technical field
Have a solid foundation in software development and computer science
Are curious and motivated to learn new technologies
Enjoy solving problems and understanding how things work
Care about building good software, not simply making code compile
Are comfortable asking questions, receiving feedback, and challenging yourself
Want to take ownership and responsibility as your skills grow

Professional experience is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What matters most is your technical potential, curiosity, interest in software craftsmanship, and willingness to learn.

What You Can Expect From Dalux

Dalux is a software company at heart, and software development is central to what we do.

You can expect:

Meaningful product responsibility early in your career
Daily sparring with skilled and experienced developers
Short paths between ideas, technical decisions, and implementation
High levels of trust and freedom in how you solve problems
Close collaboration with Product Management and Design
The opportunity to learn how AI-assisted development is changing software engineering
A social development environment with monthly events and employee-driven clubs

All our software development takes place in-house at our headquarters in Vibenshuset, Copenhagen. We believe working together makes learning, technical collaboration, and knowledge sharing significantly easier – particularly at the beginning of your career.

About Dalux

Dalux is a Danish software company founded in 2005 by Bent Dalgaard and Torben Dalgaard.

We build digital tools that make the construction industry smarter and more efficient. Using our own 3D BIM technology, we develop user-friendly software used in more than 140 countries.

Our core technology is developed entirely in-house at Dalux.

Ready to start your development career?

If you are looking for a place where you can learn quickly, take real responsibility, and build software with visible impact, we would like to hear from you.

Our recruitment process is ongoing and typically consists of:

Application
Screening
First interview
Second interview
Job offer

We hire several Software Developers throughout the year as Dalux continues to grow.

jobs.location: Hørsholm, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Job Description

Trackman is the leading brand in its field, trusted by elite athletes worldwide. We’re growing and looking for a Senior Full Stack SDET who is passionate about quality engineering and excited to help test and improve world-class sports technology products.

This senior, full-stack quality engineering role spans backend API testing and frontend (Windows and web) application testing. You’ll combine strong automation skills with the ability to define end-to-end quality strategies across the Trackman ecosystem—from radar data pipelines to TM Performance Studio used by athletes and coaches worldwide.

You’ll join an international team and help elevate quality practices by mentoring peers, partnering closely with developers, product owners, and UI/UX designers, and championing a quality-first approach throughout the development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain robust test automation frameworks for both backend APIs (REST/GraphQL), web applications and Windows desktop applications
Architect end-to-end test strategies covering integration, system, performance, and regression testing
Lead test planning and review sessions within Agile/Scrum ceremonies alongside developers and product owners
Drive quality across the full stack: from data ingestion APIs and cloud services through to client-facing Windows/Web applications
Define and enforce test coverage standards, reporting metrics, and quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
Explore and implement AI-assisted testing techniques — including AI-generated test cases, intelligent test prioritisation, and anomaly detection — to increase testing efficiency and coverage
Mentor and guide junior QA engineers and SDETs across the team
Collaborate with DevOps and platform engineers to embed testing earlier in the development pipeline (shift-left)
Participate in design reviews and contribute to technical architecture discussions from a testability perspective
Conduct exploratory and risk-based testing to uncover edge cases beyond automated suites

Job Requirements

The Ideal Candidate

Holds a relevant degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent (bachelor's level minimum)
Has 5+ years of experience in quality engineering or SDET roles, with proven seniority in at least two of: backend API testing, desktop/Windows application testing, or test framework architecture
Is highly proficient in C# for test automation, with strong understanding of object-oriented design principles.
Has hands-on experience with API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., RestEaze, Postman, Playwright, SpecFlow, or similar)
Has experience testing Windows/Web based applications and understands UI automation frameworks
Is experienced with Azure DevOps or equivalent CI/CD platforms for pipeline integration and test reporting
Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to diagnose complex, cross-layer defects

AI & Emerging Technologies

Has experience with and understands how AI and machine learning concepts can be applied within a quality engineering context

It Will Also Be a Plus If You Have

Experience in the gaming or sports technology industry
Knowledge of radar, computer vision, or sensor data systems
Golf knowledge or broader sports interest — you don't need to be a pro, but a genuine passion for sports helps!

We Offer

A senior, high-impact role in which you will directly shape Trackman's quality engineering culture and practices
The chance to work with and test the world's leading sports tracking technology, trusted by elite athletes across golf, baseball, and football
A collaborative, cross-functional team with 40+ highly skilled colleagues from more than 35 nationalities
Exposure to cutting-edge technology — radar, computer vision, real-time data, and AI — in a unique product domain
An open, informal, and ambitious company culture where great ideas are heard and innovation is encouraged
Continuous learning and growth opportunities as Trackman scales
Social activities and a vibrant team culture

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race.

We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.

Where innovation happens

At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.

Share our Passion!

Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.
